0.Name: Into the Darkness
0.Description: You have entered a dark, dry cave. You must climb along the walls to get down into the bottom, which appears to be quite some distance below you.

1.Name: Into the Darkness
1.Description: The cave continues down into the depths of the earth. The air remains cold and dry.

2.Name: Bottom of the Cave
2.Description: You are standing at the bottom of the cave. To the north, a small hole in the rock leads off into the darkness.

3.Name: Entrance of the Cavern
3.Description: Beyond the small rock passageway, you are standing before a vast cavern. The air is cold and dry, and you wonder why there is such a large cave under the forest here.

4.Name: The Cavern
4.Description: You are standing in the large main cavern of this underground cave. You have no idea how far it extends, but you see no end in sight. There is almost no light down here, and the air continues to be dry and cold.

5.Name: The Cavern
5.Description: You are standing in the large main cavern of this underground cave. You have no idea how far it extends, but you see no end in sight. There is almost no light down here, and the air continues to be dry and cold.

6.Name: The Cavern
6.Description: You are standing in the large main cavern of this underground cave. You have no idea how far it extends, but you see no end in sight. There is almost no light down here, and the air continues to be dry and cold.

7.Name: The Cavern
7.Description: You are standing in the large main cavern of this underground cave. You have no idea how far it extends, but you see no end in sight. There is almost no light down here, and the air continues to be dry and cold.

8.Name: The Cavern
8.Description: You are standing in the large main cavern of this underground cave. You have no idea how far it extends, but you see no end in sight. There is almost no light down here, and the air continues to be dry and cold.

9.Name: The Cavern
9.Description: You are standing in the large main cavern of this underground cave. A large opening in the cavern wall leads to the north here.

10.Name: In the Cavern
10.Description: The air gets colder and a bit more moist the further you head into the passage.

11.Name: In the Cavern
11.Description: The passage turns hard to the east here, as there is some sort of obstruction to the north. It looks the same as the rock walls everywhere else, but feels almost like ... stone.

12.Name: In the Cavern
12.Description: The obstruction to the north continues, and the cave contiues to the east. You start to notice that perhaps this passage is not a part of the natural cavern, but was instead created artificially. How, you have no idea.

13.Name: In the Cavern
13.Description: The obstruction to the north continues. It now becomes apparent that this passage was probably created by an excavation team. It actually looks pretty recently dug out, too.

14.Name: In the Cavern
14.Description: The obstruction ends, and the excavated passageway turns to the north. The air is getting more moist and much, much cooler.

15.Name: In the Cavern
15.Description: You see a shovel along the side of the rock wall here, which looks like it was hastily abandoned. The air begins to get downright chilly.

16.Name: In the Cavern
16.Description: The excavated passageway continues to the north. It actually seems to get brighter here, and you wonder what could be illuminating the passage.

17.Name: In the Cavern
17.Description: The passageway takes a hard turn to the left, and all of a sudden you realize that the obstruction was an ancient buried stone wall! The excavated dug right through the wall, and created a small opening which leads into what looks like an eerily lit ... underground city?

18.Name: Before the Buried City
18.Description: It looks like the excavators had great difficulty cutting through the huge stone wall of the buried city. By the looks of the chared stone and rock around here, it looks like they had to bring in Demolition Mages to get the job done. To the west is an ancient stone street.

19.Name: The Buried City
19.Description: You are standing on the ancient paving stones of a buried city. The stale air of the place makes it difficult to breath, and the frigid air makes you long for the warmth of sunlight so far above.

20.Name: An Ancient Building
20.Description: A nearly destroyed marble shelf here is engraved with a symbol here. You can barely make it out, but you think it has a picture of a crescent moon with a staff in front it. Judging by the artwork of the symbol, it looks to be ancient.

21.Name: An Ancient Building
21.Description: Some bones of the long dead citizens of this city lie on the floor in this building. Even in the eerie light, it is hard to see what this building may have been used for. Probably a simple house. A half collapsed door leads to another part of the house off to the east.

22.Name: The Buried City
22.Description: The road continues west towards a large plaza, and east towards the hole in the city wall where the excavators broke through. On both sides of you are two ancient crumbling buildings, but they both look safe to go inside.

23.Name: The Buried City
23.Description: A solid wall of what looks to be volcanic rock blocks any further progress on this part of the ancient street.

24.Name: An Ancient Building
24.Description: Some bones of the long dead citizens of this city lie on the floor in this building. Even in the eerie light, it is hard to see what this building may have been used for. Probably a simple house.

25.Name: The Buried City
25.Description: You are standing on the ancient paving stones of a buried city. The stale air of the place makes it difficult to breath, and the frigid air makes you long for the warmth of sunlight so far above.

26.Name: The Buried City
26.Description: You are standing on the ancient paving stones of a buried city. The stale air of the place makes it difficult to breath, and the frigid air makes you long for the warmth of sunlight so far above.

27.Name: The Buried City
27.Description: You are standing on the ancient paving stones of a buried city. The stale air of the place makes it difficult to breath, and the frigid air makes you long for the warmth of sunlight so far above.

28.Name: The Buried City
28.Description: Below you, another ancient building is here. The stone used to construct this building must be at least 2500 years old, judging by the thickness and cut of the stone.

29.Name: An Ancient Building
29.Description: Some bones of the long dead citizens of this city lie on the floor in this building. Even in the eerie light, it is hard to see what this building may have been used for. Probably a simple house.

30.Name: The Buried City
30.Description: You are now in what looks like to have been a plaza of the city. A partially destroyed, empty stone fountain is in the middle of the area here. It must have been an impressive sight when it actually had water in it.

31.Name: The Buried City
31.Description: Before you is a large stone building in relativly good condition. It seems to be even colder inside it than out here. A small tablet marked, "Pugna", is lying here.

32.Name: The Buried City
32.Description: You enter into a passage, that until very recently, was yet to be excavated. Apparently the Council diggers have been active, for the passage is now completly free of rubble.

33.Name: The Buried City
33.Description: You are standing on the ancient paving stones of a buried city. The stale air of the place makes it difficult to breath, and the frigid air makes you long for the warmth of sunlight so far above.

34.Name: The Buried City
34.Description: You are standing on the ancient paving stones of a buried city. The stale air of the place makes it difficult to breath, and the frigid air makes you long for the warmth of sunlight so far above.

35.Name: An Ancient Building
35.Description: You are standing in the foyer of yet another ancient building in this buried city. This looks like it was a building of great importance, when it wasn't half destroyed by volcanic ash and rock.

36.Name: An Ancient Building
36.Description: Some bones of the long dead citizens of this city lie on the floor in this building. Even in the eerie light, it is hard to see what this building may have been used for. Probably a simple house.

37.Name: The Buried City
37.Description: The volcanic rock walls of the cavern in which this city exists blocks of further passage of the street here.

38.Name: An Ancient Building
38.Description: This room looks to be an office of someone important. Papers preserved by volcanic ash contain a strange writing which you are unable to decipher. You notice the moon and staff seal on the bottom of some of the papers.

39.Name: An Ancient Building
39.Description: Many of the rooms of this building are cut off by the volcanic rock. This appears to be a hallway.

40.Name: The Buried City
40.Description: You are standing on the ancient paving stones of a buried city. The stale air of the place makes it difficult to breath, and the frigid air makes you long for the warmth of sunlight so far above.

41.Name: A Rock Tunnel
41.Description: The ancient stone of the buried city ends abruptly here, and it seems the excavaters noticed this, for the tunnel turns sharply to the west. It seems to be getting darker in here.

42.Name: A Rock Tunnel
42.Description: The tunnel continues to bore through the volcanic rock. There no sign of the buried city anywhere here. The tunnel turns sharply to the north and continues on into darkness.

43.Name: A Rock Tunnel
43.Description: Just before you begin to think the tunnel is leading no where, you see the end of it up ahead. To the west is a hole you can barely crawl through, but on the other side you see what looks to be an underground courtyard.

44.Name: The Buried Courtyard
44.Description: Crawling out of the tunnel, you return to the buried city. But the architecture is different here. The stone on the ground seems to be much more carefully laid and of better quality. The courtyard covers a huge area, and expands to the north and west.

45.Name: The Buried Courtyard
45.Description: The size of the courtyard makes you think that it belonged to an immense palace of some kind. You can not see any around however, for it is much darker in this part of the caverns.

46.Name: The Buried Courtyard
46.Description: An ancient stone street exits the courtyard heading south, but abruptly runs into the volcanic rock walls of the cavern. Apparently the ones excavating here were not interested in what was to be found down here.

47.Name: The Buried Courtyard
47.Description: The size of the courtyard makes you think that it belonged to an immense palace of some kind. You can not see any around however, for it is much darker in this part of the caverns.

48.Name: The Buried Courtyard
48.Description: Just when you think the courtyard goes on forever, you see a set of worn stairs leading up to a pitch black part of the cavern. On the ground here, you think you can make out some inscriptions in the stone, but they are impossible to make out with the rubble strewn about from the excavation.

49.Name: The Buried Courtyard
49.Description: The size of the courtyard makes you think that it belonged to an immense palace of some kind. You can not see any around however, for it is much darker in this part of the caverns.

50.Name: The Buried Courtyard
50.Description: The size of the courtyard makes you think that it belonged to an immense palace of some kind. You can not see any around however, for it is much darker in this part of the caverns.

51.Name: Before the Buried Palace
51.Description: The stairs here lead up from the courtyard into a gigantic stone gate. It looks like the stairs at one time were covered in gold, but the volcanic erruption that must have destroyed the city has left only rusty stains on the rock.

52.Name: The Buried Palace
52.Description: Ancient steps, that again look to be have been covered in gold at one point, head up deeper into the palace. The pale red light continues here as in any other part of the light-forsaken Palace.

53.Name: The Buried Palace
53.Description: You are standing in the antechamber of an enormous palace. This probably was where the ruler of the city lived. Illumination is provided by an eerie red glow that you can't determine where it comes from. It is shockingly cold in here, and you doubt it is a wise idea to head off down either cooridors of the place.

54.Name: The Buried Palace
54.Description: The palace continues here. You see many rooms to the east of the corridor here, but all of them are filled with volcanic rock.

55.Name: The Buried Palace
55.Description: Ancient steps, that again look to be have been covered in gold at one point, head up deeper into the palace. The pale red light continues here as in any other part of the light-forsaken Palace.

56.Name: The Buried Palace
56.Description: Covering the floor here are the ruins of several massive statues, constructed out of a material that you can not identify. Even destroyed as they are, it looks like they were statues of men or perhaps women.

57.Name: The Buried Palace
57.Description: The palace continues here. You see many rooms to the west of the cooridor here, but all of them are filled with volcanic rock.

58.Name: Ancient Throne Room
58.Description: A massive gold throne, inlaid with all sorts of precious gems, is standing on a partially ruined marble pedastool at the far end of the room. Everything is covered in frost, and you see the source of the blinding red light. Shielding your eyes from the glare, you see that it is a ruby crystal floating above an amazingly elaborate diamond stand. How it got here, you do not know, but it's most likely the source of all the evil in these caverns.

59.Name: The Buried Palace
59.Description: The palace continues here. You see many rooms to the east of the corridor here, but all of them are filled with volcanic rock.

60.Name: The Buried Palace
60.Description: The cold is becoming painful to bear. The red light seems to be getting brighter as you head deeper into the Palace, but it could just be your eyes playing tricks on you. A partially ruined cooridor leads to the west, and there is enough room for you to make it through.

61.Name: An Ancient Library
61.Description: Through the cooridor, it quickly becomes apparent that this was the library of the palace. Charred wooden shelves lie here, standing or broken on the floor, covered with the ash of what were probably once books and scrolls. Half hidden by an ancient bookcase is the nearly undeciphirable script from Veratine times. You believe it says Revas.

62.Name: The Buried Palace
62.Description: It is getting colder and colder as you head deeper into this terrible place. The red light is also becoming more and more intense. The excavation team seems to have worked through this spot much faster, as there is rock and rubble everywhere, making it hard to move.

63.Name: The Buried Palace
63.Description: It is getting colder and colder as you head deeper into this terrible place. The red light is also becoming more and more intense. The excavation team seems to have worked through this spot much faster, as there is rock and rubble everywhere, making it hard to move.

64.Name: Ancient Antechamber
64.Description: The tools and corpses of two seperate excavation teams are found here. Whatever they were digging for, it probably found them first. To the north is a ruined marble and gold arch that leads into probably a throne room. You can not see much however, because of the blinding red light coming from that room. It probably is a VERY bad idea to go see what is actually up there...

65.Name: The Buried Palace
65.Description: It is so cold here, there is frost covering the stone and rock on the ground and along the walls. There is another set of ancient stairs leading up to the west.

66.Name: The Buried Palace
66.Description: It is so cold here, there is frost covering the stone and rock on the ground and along the walls. There is another set of ancient stairs leading up to the east.

101.Name: Majestia Imperial Library
101.Description: Upon entering the library your nose is caressed by the smell of paper and leather. The walls are lined from floor to ceiling with shelves filled with books and scrolls.  Never have you seen so many books in one location. Lighted alcoves line each wall providing a quiet space to study. Comfortable reading chairs are scattered throughout the room making you wish you were here for leisure rather than business.  Magic light globes hang from the ceiling giving the room a warm and inviting glow. In the center of the room is a large wooden desk made from expensive Coranin Ironwood. Making his way down from one of the many bookshelf ladders is a bespectacled, yet stately gentleman.

0.Name: Southern Highway
0.Description: A small sign along side the stone paved road announces that the highway's name changes here to the "southern highway". This helps alert travelers that from this point the journy gets rough.

1.Name: Southern Highway
1.Description: A small dirt path leads off to the east, but the real highway turns sharply to the south. Looking off the road you can see little reminders of the fertile land surrounding Epiach. Most of the grass here is dead, and sand is fast replacing the dirt.

2.Name: Southern Highway
2.Description: A tan colored mixture of sand and dirt has spilled onto the road's paving stones. The Brevaran Desrt is well known for tremendous wind storms. This is probably how the sand got onto the road.

3.Name: Southern Highway Bend
3.Description: The desert road bends to the east, avoiding a large rock outcropping. It's face has been worn smooth from years of intense sand storms and it looks impossible to climb up.

4.Name: Southern Highway
4.Description: The paved road continues to the east. The stones of the road are full of small cracks that have been filled with sand. Beyond the cracks, the road is in good shape. It is the newest road in the Empire, built just thirty years ago.

5.Name: Southern Highway
5.Description: The paved road continues to the east. The stones of the road are full of small cracks that have been filled with sand. Beyond the cracks, the road is in good shape. It is the newest road in the Empire, built just thirty years ago.

6.Name: Southern Highway Bend
6.Description: The highway turns back to the south. Ahead a ways is a medium sized wooden building. It must be the Pujuda Inn, which is always gossiped about in Epiach for having such good food.

7.Name: Before Pujuda's Inn
7.Description: A large sign on the side of the road reads: "Stop here at Pujuda's Inn! Experience the finest dining in all of Brevaran. Make sure to rest up, because the journey to Sucaran is long, difficult, and hot!". To the west is a sun cooked wooden building. It looks inviting enough, and it would be nice to get out of the heat.

8.Name: Southern Highway Bend
8.Description: Once again, a large rock outcropping blocks the road from progressing south. Most of the rock piles in the desert are small, but this particular one is massive, towering at least two hundred feet over the surrounding terrain.

9.Name: Southern Highway
9.Description: The southern highway continues on towards the south. With little to look at while walking along, your eyes turn to the stones of the road. Having been constructed so recently, you can still see the insignias of the master stone masons from Atlaand who cut and laid these stones.

10.Name: Ruined Highway
10.Description: The highway ends abruptly, having been destroyed by a recent earthquake which jutted this new, huge rock outcropping out of the ground. There is a temporary dirt road that goes around the giant rock.

11.Name: Dirt Detour
11.Description: A sign at the strart of the detour reads: "The Imperial Engineering Guild apologizes for the obstruction of the highway. We have demolitions experts coming to destroy the rock. Until then, use this detour to get back to the southern highway."

12.Name: Dirt Detour
12.Description: The dirt detour continues on, around the large rock obstruction. The slope of the rock is actually shallow enough to be climbable here, although it is probably going to be very dangerous to get on top of it.

13.Name: Climbing up the Rock
13.Description: With much difficulty, you're able to scramble up the rocks. This outcropping was created by a very recent earthquake. With the power of the land being torn apart this rock was able to rise up.

14.Name: Southern Highway
14.Description: The huge rock obstruction has destroyed the highway here and makes further travel north impossible. Fortunately, there is a dirt road detour around the rock to the west.

15.Name: Southern Highway
15.Description: The grand southern road continues along here. The temperature continues to increase as you travel farther south. With these uncomfortable travel conditions, it is a mystery how merchants between Epiach and Sucaran can survive.

16.Name: Southern Highway Bend
16.Description: The highway takes yet another turn here. Noting that the Brevaran Desert is nothing but sand and small rocks, you wonder why this road was built with so many turns.

17.Name: Southern Highway
17.Description: The grand southern road continues along here. The temperature continues to increase as you travel farther south. With these uncomfortable travel conditions, it is a mystery how merchants between Epiach and Sucaran can survive.

18.Name: Southern Highway
18.Description: A great amount of sand has spilled onto the road here, making it hard to see which way to continue going in. Luckily, someone piled a stack of rocks pointing to the east.

19.Name: Southern Highway
19.Description: The intense heat causes the horizons to shimmer as if dancing. You do not understand how such a desolate and unforgiving place could come into existance.

20.Name: Southern Highway Bend
20.Description: A bit of sand has spilled onto the road from the west. Farther on to the east it seems that an earthquake has destroyed the paving stones of the highway.

21.Name: Destroyed Highway
21.Description: The paving stones were literally thrown apart by a recent earthquake. All that remains of the highway is the packed dirt from the construction effort, which makes a surprinsingly decent road.

22.Name: Destroyed Highway
22.Description: You can see massive fissures in the ground that display the tremendous force that the earthquake tore through the desert with. It would certainly be unfortunate to be stuck in one while traveling here.

23.Name: Sandy Pit
23.Description: The center of the earthquake must have passed through here, because even the dirt of the road has been sunken into the ground. The crossing of the earthquake pit is very treacharous. The Imperial Engineers need to be alerted so that they can build a bridge here.

24.Name: Destroyed Highway
24.Description: The devastation from the earthquake continues on to here. Up ahead the paving stones of the highway return, but they look loose and cracked.

25.Name: Edge of the Earthquake
25.Description: The road turns up to the north and it's quality improves. Looking off to the sides of the desert, you can see the wide range of devastation caused by the quake. Thinking about history, you wonder if it was earthquakes like these that tore Kaldana apart during the Rakalla.

26.Name: Southern Highway Bend
26.Description: The wide sun baked stone paving stones continue on here. The immensity of the Brevaran Desert is almost frightening, considering how lifeless and desolate it is.

27.Name: Southern Highway
27.Description: Sand from the north has spilled all over the highway. There are stories of merchants who were trapped in one of the Brevaran sand storms. One story says a merchant was blown by winds so powerful that he was flung all the way to the shores of the Adadric Sea. His broken corpse was discovered a few days later by a merchant ship.

28.Name: Southern Highway Bend
28.Description: The wide sun baked stone paving stones continue on here. The immensity of the Brevaran Desert is almost frightening, considering how lifeless and desolate it is.

29.Name: Southern Highway
29.Description: The wide sun baked stone paving stones continue on here. The immensity of the Brevaran Desert is almost frightening, considering how lifeless and desolate it is.

30.Name: Southern Highway Bend
30.Description: Once again the southern highway turns sharply to avoid a rock outcropping. Even though it seems impossible, the temperature continues to get even hotter.

31.Name: Southern Highway Bend
31.Description: Once again the southern highway turns sharply to avoid a rock outcropping. Even though it seems impossible, the temperature continues to get even hotter.

32.Name: Southern Highway
32.Description: Looking to the east, you finally see an unbroken stretch of straight highway. The heat is so stiffling, you can do nothing but look at the ground and trudge onwards.

33.Name: Southern Highway
33.Description: Looking to the east, you finally see an unbroken stretch of straight highway. The heat is so stiffling, you can do nothing but look at the ground and trudge onwards.

34.Name: Brevaran Desert Highway
34.Description: The highway continues on it's way through the Brevaran Desert. Looking far to the east, you can see the desert continue to get even more desolate. You are approaching the Forsaken Wastelands.

35.Name: Dirt Detour
35.Description: The detour ends hear, leading east back to the highway. There is another sign here that says: "Highway obstructed by rock. Use detour."

36.Name: On a Sandy Patch
36.Description: Standing here gives a good vantage looking out over the Brevaran desert. You notice a very sandy landscape that is broken by rocks of all sizes. There is almost no signs of life, except for the plethora of angry desert creatures.

37.Name: Old Dirt Road
37.Description: This is the dirt foundation of a road that was about to paved. It looks like the original builders of the southern highway were going to build in this direction, and then at the last minute changed their mind and decided to build south instead.

38.Name: A Lone Grassy Patch
38.Description: Looking south across the rocky desert, you can see no other patches of healthy grass except for the one you are standing on. You get an odd feeling of tranquility standing on this grass looking out at the desolation of the Brevaran Desert.

39.Name: Overlooking the Desert
39.Description: Standing here gives a good vantage looking out over the Brevaran desert. You notice a very sandy landscape that is broken by rocks of all sizes. There is almost no signs of life, except for the plethora of angry desert creatures.

40.Name: Pujuda's Inn
40.Description: This humble building standing in the sand along side the southern highway is one of the few settlements along the desert road between Epiach and Sucaran. The innkeeper, Pujuda, is a tough man who knows the Inn business well. His kitchen cooks a tasty scorpion meat roast and the beds are stuffed with cooled desert sand that provides for a comfortable nights stay.

41.Name: On Top of the Rock
41.Description: From the top of the rock you can see far off into the desert. The view is fairly uninteresting, with mainly sand and rocks broken only by the southern highway meandering through the desert on it's way southeast towards Sucaran.

42.Name: Before the Chasm
42.Description: To the east there is a huge gaping chasm, cutting right between the rock and heading down so far that you cannot see the bottom. There is a tiny ledge to the east that you can edge along.

43.Name: Besides the Chasm
43.Description: There is barely enough room, but you can just manage to edge along the side of the chasm. A variety of desert birds have set up nests in the sides of the cliff, where they are safe from most desert predators.

44.Name: Peering into the Abyss
44.Description: A frigid wind blows from down in the chasm, making it seem more like an evil abyss to you. There is no more room on the small ledge, so the only place to go is back to the saftey of the rock.

45.Name: Besides the Chasm
45.Description: There is barely enough room, but you can just manage to edge along the side of the chasm. A variety of desert birds have set up nests in the sides of the cliff, where they are safe from most desert predators.

46.Name: In the Desert
46.Description: The sand is hot to your touch and you fear it may burn a hole in your boots. There is not one hint of friendly life out here.

47.Name: In the Desert
47.Description: No friendly life indeed, but there are plenty of unfriendlies. One wrong step will land your foot into a giant scorpion den.

48.Name: In the Desert
48.Description: The sand here gets thicker and harder to move through. The heat is unrelenting and sweat pours down your face and into your eyes. A vacation to the Silverspire Mountains seems like a great idea about now.

49.Name: In the Desert
49.Description: Here a sand dune, made up of thick sun baked sand, rises out of the banal flatness of the rest of the desert. Climbing up, you are surprised to see from grass and even a small oasis to the south!

50.Name: Near the Oasis
50.Description: The coarse desert sand is giving way to actual living grass. The grass is receiving it's life from the small oasis that miraculously exists here.

51.Name: Grassy Desert
51.Description: Intermitent patches of nearly dead grass struggle for life in the harsh and unforgiving conditions of the Brevaran Desert. It is obvious that the desert is winning the fight here.

52.Name: A Struggling Oasis
52.Description: The grass here provides a gentle relief for your sand burnt feet, but it is still uncomfortably hot. This is definitly not an oasis that you could spend much time at, as is apparent by the thin supply of unhappy looking desert animals.

53.Name: bad room
53.Description: ooops.

54.Name: Shores of the Oasis
54.Description: You notice the oasis faintly steaming. It is so hot here that the water is actually evaporating. There is a rim of salt along the water's edge, suggesting that this isn't even a fresh water oasis.

55.Name: Grassy Desert
55.Description: Intermitent patches of nearly dead grass struggle for life in the harsh and unforgiving conditions of the Brevaran Desert. It is obvious that the desert is winning the fight here.

56.Name: Near the Oasis
56.Description: At the edge of the oasis, you can see out into the rest of the unchanging desert. You can feel the rays of the sun crisping your skin. Gazing far towards the south, you think you can see the sparkling reflection of the Asadric Sea.

57.Name: Scorpion Den
57.Description: A large sandy mound has an opening in it that makes room for a very, very, very large scorpion. In fact, the scorpion that lives here could be called an unrealistically gigantic one. Watch out!

58.Name: A Struggling Oasis
58.Description: The coarse yellow sand spills right into the waters of the oasis, allowing no grass to grow in this spot. Noticing a rim of salt where the sand reaches the small oasis, you realize this water is rapidly evaporating.

59.Name: In the Desert
59.Description: Up ahead is a large sand dune that is in the curious shape of a giant fish. It was probably formed by that because of a big sand storm, but it worth looking into nonetheless.

60.Name: Before the Dune
60.Description: The tall dune casts it's shadow over the area, creating a small relief from the punishing heat of the desert. You see a small stone block sticking out from the base of the dune.

61.Name: Shade of the Dune
61.Description: The shade from the dune has allowed a small patch of grass to grow. It doesn't look very healthy, but it is better than the endless expanse of sand and rock.

62.Name: On the Dune
62.Description: With some difficulty you manage to climb up the dune. It provides a decent vantage point over the area, where you can see alot of sand and rocks.

63.Name: Top of the Dune
63.Description: Another stone block is sticking out of the sand near the top of the dune. Perhaps this dune is actually sand that was blown over an ancient structure of some sort. You can't recall ever hearing about ruins being found in the Brevaran Desert, but then again one never knows.

64.Name: On the Dune
64.Description: The thought of having discovered some ancient ruins is very exciting. You think of the famous lumberjack from Steltan, Kutz, who discovered the Ancient Caverns one day. He was invited to become a scholar of the Academy of the Arcane Sciences as a reward for his discovery.

65.Name: End of the Dune
65.Description: From here the dune slopes back down to the regular desert. There are no obvious signs that this dune is an ancient ruin, which is dissapointing.

66.Name: Shade of a Large Rock
66.Description: The large rock looms overhead, allowing some temporary relief from the sun.  You are not the only one who appreciates the shade of this boulder though....

20.Description: The old road more closely resembles a highway here, and is much better maintained. You can actually see evidence of routine Imperial patrols in this part, especially as Havershan Village approaches to the northeast!

23.Name: The Old Imperial Highway
23.Description: The road takes a sharp turn to the north here, and up ahead you can see a cluster of fine looking wooden buildings that is Havershan Village

24.Name: Before Havershan Village
24.Description: Havershan Village is located in a clearing that was created from years of logging the forest. You can see a handful of well built buildings, and farther off the solid stone walls of the Havershan Inn.

25.Name: Havershan Village
25.Description: The packed dirt street of Havershan Village doubles as the final stretches of the Royal Atlaand Highway. To the west is the well built house of the mayor of the village, and the rest of the houses are located off to the east.

26.Name: Havershan Village
26.Description: Havershan continues on here, with the town square of the village up to the north, and the local potion shop located to the south.

27.Name: Havershan Village
27.Description: Havershan Village is located in a clearing that was created from years of logging the forest. You can see a handful of well built buildings, and farther off the solid stone walls of the Havershan Inn.

28.Name: Before Havershan Village
28.Description: The Royal Atlaand Highway runs right into the main street of Havershan Village, which is located off to the west. Havershan is the last village this far to the west in northern Majestia.

29.Name: The Royal Atlaand Highway
29.Description: To the west of the highway is a small lake, whicih provides the water for Havershan Village which is also off to the west. The highway turns to the south, avoiding the lake.

30.Name: The Royal Atlaand Highway
30.Description: The well packed dirt of the Royal Atlaand Highway continues here. To both sides of the road are the dense trees of the Coranin Forest, although they are starting to lighten up as the road heads east out of the forest.

31.Name: The Royal Atlaand Highway
31.Description: The well packed dirt of the Royal Atlaand Highway continues here. To both sides of the road are the dense trees of the Coranin Forest, although they are starting to lighten up as the road heads east out of the forest.

33.Name: The Royal Atlaand Highway
33.Description: The well packed dirt of the Royal Atlaand Highway continues here. It begins to get lighter as the road heads out of the forest and starts sloping down into the vast grasslands of the Atlaand Basin.

34.Name: The Royal Atlaand Highway
34.Description: The well packed dirt of the Royal Atlaand Highway continues here. It begins to get lighter as the road heads out of the forest and starts sloping down into the vast grasslands of the Atlaand Basin.

35.Name: Before the Atlaand Basin
35.Description: The well packed dirt of the Royal Atlaand Highway continues here. The trees are left behind now as the highway emerges out of the Coranin Forest. From here you can see down the gentle slope into the Atlaand Basin. Farms and small villages dot the outer ages of the basin, and far off you can see the sparkling blue waters of Lake Emperoch, with the grand city of Atlaand sitting on an island in the middle of the lake!!!

42.Description: Scattered on both sides of the path are piles of ancient rock. They look to be the remnants of a once great city... To the west the ground is replaced by ancient stone pavement, and the density of ruins increases tremendously.

43.Name: Before the Ruins of Serpolis
43.Description: As you head farther west into the ruins, you climb onto a rise and get a good look at the expanse of the ruins. What you see is totally shocking -- an ancient gigantic city that is totally destroyed. You are gazing upon the ruins of Serpolis, which was once the greatest city in all of Kaldana, and which now sits forgotten in the deepest part of the Coranin Forest.

44.Name: An Ancient Grove of Trees
44.Description: Off to the side of the ruins is an ancient grove of trees, which seem to stand in stark defiance to the desecration of this area.

70.Description: Twigs and other objects have been put on the ground here to hide the path, but it's obvious that it exists from all the footprints. Off to the east the trees grow less dense, and you can see a camp of some sorts.

71.Name: Coranin Bandit Camp
71.Description: Deep in the Coranin Forest, this seems no place for a camp. But sure enough, cook fires and tents located all around the area show that quite a few people live here.

72.Name: Coranin Bandit Camp
72.Description: Deep in the Coranin Forest, this seems no place for a camp. But sure enough, cook fires and tents located all around the area show that quite a few people live here.

73.Name: Coranin Bandit Camp
73.Description: Many trees have been cut down here, and from the timber two shacks have been built. The one to the east is the largest, but both seem to house the most important people of the camp.

74.Name: Coranin Bandit Shack
74.Description: The interior of the shack is filled with chests and weapon racks. In the corner is a small cot and a wooden wash basin. A skull of a large wolf is hanging on the western wall.

75.Name: Coranin Bandit Camp
75.Description: Deep in the Coranin Forest, this seems no place for a camp. But sure enough, cook fires and tents located all around the area show that quite a few people live here.

76.Name: Ralthorn's Shack
76.Description: The interior of this shack is filled with golden chests filled to the brim with precious gems and silk rugs and other such fine items. There is a king sized bed in the back of the shack, as well as a silver wash basin. Whoever lives in here has done quite well for him or herself.

77.Name: Havershan Village
77.Description: Havershan Village spreads out in all directions from here. To the east are the crystal clear waters of the small town lake, where the drinking water comes from. Up to the north is the town square of the village.

78.Name: Havershan Town Square
78.Description: The Havershan Village town square is pretty plain, with no fountain or statue in the center to comemorate the village. However, to the north of the town square the well polished stone walls of the Havershan Inn beckon all weary travelers! To the west are a few more houses and the Havershan library, and to the east is the Havershan weapon shop.

79.Name: Havershan Village
79.Description: The village continues along the road here. To the west is a large wooden building with a big picture of an open book hanging above the door. Back to the east is the village's town square.

80.Name: Havershan Library
80.Description: Rows and rows of book cases, filled to the brim with all types of books, both ancient and modern, are located here.  Torches hanging from the ceiling provide plenty of light for reading.

81.Name: The Havershan Inn
81.Description: The kitchen of the inn is filled with stoves and plenty of cooks moving back and forth between the ovens and the cooking tables. Havershan Inn is famous in northern Majestia for its Coranin Berry Pie, and you can see quite a few ovens dedicated soley to the production of the delicacies.

82.Description: ooops.

83.Name: Crazy Audrey's Potion Shop
83.Description: The interior of this shop is very dim, and it seems that there is a blue fog in here. There is a counter in the front of the shop, with a crazy looking lady sitting on a stool, mixing together potions. In the back of the shop you can see racks and racks full of all every shape of bottle.

84.Name: Coranin Forest
84.Description: A small path winds through the dense forest, allowing difficult but possible travel through the trees. The thick canopy overhead allows only a little bit of light down through the tree tops, and so it is quite dim here.

85.Name: bad room
85.Description: ooops.

86.Name: bad room
86.Description: ooops.

87.Name: The Proud Axe
87.Description: Massive wood cutting axes line the walls of the shop, and look like they would be quite deadly if used in combat. Naturally, they are marketed purely for wood cutting, but you are sure that there have been people who have purchased one of these with the internet of harming someone with it!

88.Name: The Havershan Inn
88.Description: The common room of the Havershan Inn is well lit and is crowded with people. A large fire place at the northeast corner of the room provides plenty of light and warmth, and plenty of tasty plates of food are on top of the polished wooden tables. To the west of the room is the kitchen, and stone stairs lead up to the guest rooms upstairs.

89.Name: Mayor Demwan's House
89.Description: The interior of Mayor Demwan's house is well lit and is very welcoming. The smells of fresh bread waft from the kitchen, and you think maybe you should visit the town's Inn for some food!

90.Name: Coranin Forest
90.Description: A bunch of tree stumps mark this as the current spot that the people of Havershan are logging. A few of the gigantic axes that the lumberjacks use are stuck in the ground here, and look as if they could cause quite a bit of damage is used against another person.

91.Name: Coranin Forest

94.Name: An Ancient Grove of Trees
94.Description: Off to the side of the ruins is an ancient grove of trees, which seem to stand in stark defiance to the desecration of this area.

95.Name: bad room
95.Description: ooops.

0.Name: Inner Sanctum Entrance
0.Description: You descend the ancient staircase and find yourself in the hidden inner sanctum of this shrine. A horrible fear washes over you and you set foot in this level, and despite the fact that there is no wind, you are chilled to the bone. You could turn back now if you wished...it might be wise.

1.Name: The Inner Sanctum, Main Hallway
1.Description: You take a few steps forward, and as your terror mounts, you hear a horrible crash of stone behind you. The way back has been closed! You have no way to go now but forward...

2.Name: The Inner Sanctum, Main Hallway
2.Description: You continue, shaken, down the main hallway. The icy cold is growing, and your limbs are beginning to feel numb. You feel powerful evil energies coming from either side of you, but even stronger ahead.

3.Name: The Inner Sanctum, Antechamber
3.Description: You reach the antechamber of the inner sanctum. Torches are somehow burning bright here, despite the lack of oxygen. You sense the prescence of something truely horrible and deadly directly ahead, but you have made it this far, and cannot turn back now.

4.Name: Chamber of Tarnael'dar
4.Description: You have finally reached the end of this horrid place; the abode of the ancient, malevolent god of shadow, Tarnael'dar. You are nearly struck down by fear, but you somehow manage to hold yourself up, and prepare for the battle to come...

5.Name: Shadow Chamber
5.Description: You walk into one of the side rooms. It is pitch dark, but you sense that there is SOMETHING in here, and it doesn't appreciate your intrusion.

6.Name: Shadow Chamber
6.Description: You walk into one of the side rooms. It is pitch dark, but you sense that there is SOMETHING in here, and it doesn't appreciate your intrusion.

7.Name: Shadow Chamber

8.Name: Shadow Chamber

0.Name: A Dark Hallway
0.Description: The dirt of the mine floor suddenly becomes stone as the mine shaft becomes a dimly lit hallway. The oil lamps now adorn the wall at more regular intervals, and look as though they are looked after regularly.

1.Name: A Dark Hallway
1.Description: You continue down the dim hallway. The strange voices are becoming louder with every step you take.

2.Name: A Dark Hallway
2.Description: You continue down the dim hallway. The strange voices are becoming louder with every step you take.

3.Name: Junction
3.Description: You have reached the end of the hallway. You find yourself at a junction splitting off to the east and west. You're not sure which way is a worse idea.

4.Name: Hallway
4.Description: You turn to the west, and walk down the hallway. You can hear muffled chanting from farther west.

5.Name: Hallway
5.Description: You turn to the east, and head down the hallway. The lighting is far better here, but you feel more unnerved as screams of pain come from farther down the hall.

6.Name: Hallway
6.Description: You continue walking down the long stone hallway. The screams of agony become louder as you proceed. You have a feeling you might want to turn back...

7.Name: Hallway
7.Description: You reach a point where the hallway turns a corner. You think the screams are coming from around the corner.

8.Name: Mine Shaft
8.Description: You crawl down the hole, and find yourself in an old abandoned mineshaft. You can hardly breath as you are assaulted with a noxious, musty stench.

9.Name: Mine Shaft
9.Description: You continue down the mine shaft. It is very dark, but you notice a few oil lamps are still burning dimly along the walls. You wonder who might be keeping them going.

10.Name: Mine Shaft
10.Description: The tunnel is getting far lighter now. You feel vaguely uneasy as you continue to walk forward, and you think you here voices in the distance.

11.Name: Torture Chamber
11.Description: You have stumbled into the cult's torture chamber, and it is a truly grisly site. Implements of torture line the walls, and blood is everywhere. You barely avoid crushing a stray body part with your foot.

12.Name: Torture Chamber
12.Description: The lighting in the torture chamber increases, and you get a better look at the prisoners. There are bodies strapped to racks and hung from the walls. You're becoming a little nauseated.

13.Name: Torture Chamber
13.Description: You reach the end of the long torture chamber. There are less bodies here, and you notice a door, lying open on its hinges, to the east.

14.Name: Torturer's Chambers
14.Description: You've stumbled into the private chambers of the Cult's torturer. Whips and knives line the wall; you shudder at the site of them as you check to see if the rooms occupant is around.

15.Name: Dome
15.Description: You're standing under an impressive, carved out dome. To the west, you see what looks like the enterance to a temple. The hallway starts again to the north.

16.Name: Temple Antechamber
16.Description: You step into the Antechamber of the temple. The walls are covered in odd, arcane markings, and the whole building seems to have been carved of obsidian.

17.Name: Cultists' Chambers
17.Description: You enter the living quarters of a number of the strange robed cultists. A number of them are resting here.

18.Name: Temple
18.Description: You continue walking through the temple, heading behind a small wall. You can hear many voices from the next room.

19.Name: Temple
19.Description: You continue into the temple. The sound of chanting is loud from the west.

20.Name: Ritual Chamber
20.Description: You enter the ritual chamber of the temple. A number of priests are huddled around an altar, preforming some strange ritual.

21.Name: Hallway
21.Description: You continue up the hallway to the north. This part of the temple seems fairly quiet, though you can't help but feel like you're being watched.

22.Name: Hallway
22.Description: You continue down the quiet hallway. You think you can hear voices, but they're very soft.

23.Name: Hallway
23.Description: You come to a place where the stone passage turns west. You can here voices speaking in hushed tones in that direction.

24.Name: Antechamber
24.Description: You come to a small antechamber. There are a number of seats carved of stone placed on the floor. You imagine this is a place where the cultists come to meditate.

25.Name: Tunnel
25.Description: The stone floor of the cult's hideaway suddenly gives way to the dirt of the mine. You feel relieved to be out of the place, but for some reason you feel even more nervous about what lies ahead.

26.Name: Stairwell
26.Description: You continue west, and to your surpirse, you come upon a large spiral staircase leading down. It is pitch dark below; the only way to find out what is there is to go down...

27.Name: Doorway
27.Description: You are standing at a large, open doorway. Beyond it, you can see a lavishly decorated, well lit room.

28.Name: Fancy Room
28.Description: You enter the room, and are amazed by the extravagence of it. Red silks cover the walls, and the floor is richly carpeted.

29.Name: Washroom
29.Description: You stumble into the bathroom of whoever occupies this room. There's not much of interest here; just a bathtub and some smelly soaps.

30.Name: Abberak's Chambers
30.Description: You enter the chambers of the High Cultist Abberak, the leader of this group of madmen. He is sitting at a desk, studying some arcane ritual, and feeling a human skull with his other hand.

31.Name: Fancy Room
31.Description: You continue exploring the massive, complicated room. You can smell a number of scented herbs, but it cannot hide the unmistakable stench of death coming from the west.

32.Name: Grotto
32.Description: You squeez your way through the hallway into a small cavelike grotto. You doubt anything will bother to follow you here.

33.Name: Cramped Hallway
33.Description: You are walking in a cramped hallway to the south of a massive central chamber. You are having some difficulty sqeezing your way through.

34.Name: Central Chamber
34.Description: You are in a huge, beautifully decorated chamber. There are murals and tapestries on the walls, and a fertile garden is somehow growing nearby. There are hundreds of statues lining all the walls of this chamber.

35.Name: Central Chamber
35.Description: You are in a huge, beautifully decorated chamber. There are murals and tapestries on the walls, and a fertile garden is somehow growing nearby. There are hundreds of statues lining all the walls of this chamber.

45.Name: Central Chamber
45.Description: You are in a huge, beautifully decorated chamber. There are murals and tapestries on the walls, and a fertile garden is somehow growing to the southeast. There are hundreds of statues lining all the walls of this chamber.

46.Name: Central Chamber
46.Description: You are in a huge, beautifully decorated chamber.  There are murals and tapestries on the walls, and a fertile garden is somehow growing to the southeast. A small table reading "Cascada" is lying here.

47.Name: Dark Hallway
47.Description: You are walking down the western hallway. It is very dark, and you have to feel along the walls to avoid falling. The central chamber lies back to the east.

48.Name: Central Chamber
48.Description: You are in a huge, beautifully decorated chamber. There are murals and tapestries on the walls, and a fertile garden is somehow growing nearby. There are hundreds of statues lining all the walls of this chamber.

49.Name: Garden
49.Description: You walk into the garden, which is somehow growing in the middle of the chamber. You can only guess that it is sustained by some kind of ancient magic...

50.Name: Central Chamber
50.Description: You are in a huge, beautifully decorated chamber. There are murals and tapestries on the walls, and a fertile garden is somehow growing nearby. There are hundreds of statues lining all the walls of this chamber.

51.Name: Eastern Hallway
51.Description: You are walking down a very long, torchlit hallway. An odd stench of decay is coming from the east, and it gets stronger with every step you take.

52.Name: Dark Hallway
52.Description: The lighting in the hallway is very poor here, and is becomes ever worse to the west. You wonder what is hiding in the dark corners of this place.

53.Name: Stone Hallway
53.Description: You are walking down a stone hallway. You are amazed by the ornate carvings on the walls and pillars. Despite its beauty, you feel very nervous about continuing into this place.

54.Name: North Hallway
54.Description: You are walking in the massive northern hallway of the shrine. It extends to the north as far as you can see, and is fairly well lit.

55.Name: Hallway Junction
55.Description: You reach a point where the massive northern and eastern hallways intersect. There are many large pillars here, holding up the shrine.

56.Name: Northern Hallway
56.Description: You are walking in the massive northern hallway of the shrine. It extends to the north as far as you can see, and is fairly well lit.

57.Name: Eastern Hallway
57.Description: You are walking down a very long, torchlit hallway. An odd stench of decay is coming from the east, and it gets stronger with every step you take.

60.Name: Eastern Hallway
60.Description: You continue down the long hallway, and hear strange scraping noises in this area...you wonder what you may encounter.

61.Name: Eastern Hallway
61.Description: You reach a point in the hallway where it turns south. It is fairly dark here, and you could probably hide without too much trouble.

62.Name: Eastern Hallway
62.Description: You're walking in the long, twisting eastern hallway of the shrine. You can smell something foul from the south, and you're a bit nervous about heading there.

63.Name: Junction
63.Description: You are at a small junction in the hallway. The long hall continues to the north and south. To the east, the stench of decay and long dead flesh is terribly strong.

64.Name: Eastern Hallway
64.Description: You are walking down a very long, torchlit hallway. The hallway turns to the north here, and you sense something horrible lies ahead, though you know not what.

65.Name: Northern Hallway
65.Description: You are walking in the massive northern hallway of the shrine. It extends to the north as far as you can see, and is fairly well lit.

66.Name: Luxurious Room
66.Description: You enter a beautifully decorated room. You don't know what down here would appreciate such find decorations; perhaps it is left by inhabitants of many years past.

67.Name: Northern Hallway
67.Description: You are walking in the massive northern hallway of the shrine. It extends to the north as far as you can see, and is fairly well lit.

68.Name: Creepy Room
68.Description: You are in a room in a cramped, vaguely frightening room. You can't put your finger on just what, but you're sure that there is something in here that doesn't like you.

69.Name: Creepy Room
69.Description: You are in a room in a cramped, vaguely frightening room. You see a light coming from a closed off room to the south, though you're not sure what may lie within.

70.Name: Vampire Lair
70.Description: You stumble into a room filled with coffins. Unlike most coffins, however, these do not have heavy lids, and many of them are removed, their inhabitants, vampires, walking about.

71.Name: Vampire Lair
71.Description: You stumble into a room filled with coffins. Unlike most coffins, however, these do not have heavy lids, and many of them are removed, their inhabitants, vampires, walking about.

74.Name: Northern Hallway
74.Description: You continue down the huge hallway. As you get closer, you notice a previously invisible hall leading off to the west. You can hear chanting and scraping coming from whatever lies in that direction.

75.Name: Northern Hallway
75.Description: As you get farther down the hallway, you think you can see an end to it in the distance; a massive, carved stone doorway leading into another large chamber. You dread to think of what may lie within.

76.Name: Gloomy Hallway
76.Description: The lighting sharply drops off here; only a few candles burn in crevices in the walls. The solemn chanting gets louder as you move west.

77.Name: Gloomy Hallway
77.Description: The lighting sharply drops off here; only a few candles burn in crevices in the walls. The solemn chanting gets louder as you move west.

78.Name: Ritual Chamber
78.Description: You reach a frightening vampire altar. There are a number of deadly vampires in the area, and they're very unhappy with you for interrupting them.

79.Name: Altar
79.Description: You proceed to the back of the room, to the altar. It is covered in blood and intestines, and a number of vampires are drinking blood from large bowls.

80.Name: Ritual Chamber
80.Description: You reach a frightening vampire altar. There are a number of deadly vampires in the area, and they're very unhappy with you for interrupting them.

81.Name: Ritual Chamber

82.Name: Northern Hallway
82.Description: As you get farther down the hallway, you think you can see an end to it in the distance; a massive, carved stone doorway leading into another large chamber. You dread to think of what may lie within.

83.Name: Northern Hallway
83.Description: You reach the end of the long hallway. You can see the massive room clearly now. The stone arch is carved with arcane symbold and pictographs which are foreign to you. You can hear horrible hissing and voices from within the room, and even more from the room to the east.

84.Name: Gloomy Hallway
84.Description: You enter another poorly lit side hallway. This one ends abrubtly at a large stone doorway, which leads into a brightly lit chamber.

85.Name: Glowing Aura
85.Description: You enter the glowing room, and are overwhelmed by a sickly green light. You're not sure what this aura is, but it is making you feel sick to your stomach.

86.Name: Sanctum
86.Description: You are in the massive sanctum of this shrine. There are hideous vampires all around, and you think you see a glowing red light near the northern end of the chamber. You begin to become very afraid despite yourself, but you steel yourself to move onwards.

87.Name: Sanctum
87.Description: You are in the massive sanctum of this shrine. There are hideous vampires all around, and you think you see a glowing red light near the northern end of the chamber. You begin to become very afraid despite yourself, but you steel yourself to move onwards.

92.Name: Glowing Throne
92.Description: You reach the blood red throne at the north end of the Sanctum. You see, to your dismay, that it is guarded by the legendary ancient Vampire Vukodlak...you can do nothing now but prepare for the battle to come.

93.Name: Obsidian Stairwell
93.Description: You walk around Vukodlak's throne, and find a stairway carved into the stone of the cave. There is a chill air flowing up from below, and you feel very afraid of going on. However, if you are truly brave, you might be able to continue.

99.Name: Stone Hallway
99.Description: You are walking through an ornately carved stone hallway. The craftsmanship is amazingly skilled; you wonder what could have created this place.

100.Name: Dirt Chamber
100.Description: You find your way through the quiet room, and find yourself at a large cave-like enterace. You can't quite see what lies beyond, but you have a very bad feeling in your gut.

101.Name: Dirt Chamber
101.Description: You step away from the staircase, and find yourself in a dimly lit room. The floor is dirt, and all is quiet.

102.Name: Dirt Chamber
102.Description: The dirt on the ground begins to stir up with your footsteps, rising unnaturally high into the air. You have a nasty feeling about this place...

103.Name: Dirt Chamber
103.Description: This room is virtually empty, and completely silent. You don't see much reason to linger here long.

104.Name: Staircase
104.Description: You are at the bottom of the staircase. It's still very dark, and you're not quite sure where you are...

105.Name: Chamber of Tarnael'dar
105.Description: You have finally reached the end of this horrid place; the abode of the ancient, malevolent god of shadow, Tarnael'dar. You are nearly struck down by fear, but you somehow manage to hold yourself up, and prepare for the battle to come...

0.Name: Passing the Gap
0.Description: You find a narrow pathway leading upwards from the gap, winding up the mountainside high above the clouds. The air gets thinner here, and you grit you teeth as you begin the ascent.

1.Name: Mountain Path
1.Description: The path is muddied from glacial melt seeping down the rock face of the mountainside. You press onwards, wary of beasts that might seek easy prey in this precarious position.

2.Name: The Frozen Entranceway
2.Description: The main entranceway of the temple makes a steep turn up the mountain peak. From here you can see the light of the sun amplified through the icy structure of the temple itself, splitting into a thousand colours.

3.Name: A Frozen Temple
3.Description: You move slowly through the temple. It seems that the constructs guarding and maintaining it have not met a living being in many ages.

4.Name: Snow-encrusted Steps
4.Description: The steps here are covered with snow, forcing you to tread carefully.

5.Name: Snow-encrusted Steps
5.Description: You find steps leading upwards from the mountain gap. The air gets thinner here, and you grit you teeth as you push forward.

6.Name: Icy Stairs
6.Description: The steps begin to widen as you ascend. The dizzying altitude makes you pause for breath - which you can see coming out in white puffs readily.

7.Name: End of the Pass
7.Description: After a fitful climb through worsening conditions, you pat yourself on the back for making it this far. Up ahead, you hear a deep rumbling... what is that?

8.Name: Gates of Marble and Ice
8.Description: You emerge from the long stairwell and are nearly blinded by the sheer brilliance of the view in front of you. Two massive gates of marble and ice rise before you, adorned with the motif of a massive winged serpent. The gates are locked, but there appears to be a recess by the side through which you might be able to place an offering.

9.Name: A Frozen Temple
9.Description: You pass through an ornately decorated entranceway. Columns of marble encased in ice rise up in rows before you, and a great crystalline arch spans the ceiling, letting the sunlight in. You keep yourself busy warming your hands and almost fail to notice some of the columns appear to be moving!

10.Name: A Sacred Pool
10.Description: You step into a spring-fed pool of azure water. The light dances on its surface, so brilliant it hurts your eyes.

11.Name: Sanctuary of Marble
11.Description: This section of the temple is clad almost entirely in brilliant white marble. Inscrutable automaton sculptors labor here to animate stone in service to the god of this temple, powered by orbs of living marble and a magic unfamiliar to you.

12.Name: A Column of Marble and Ice
12.Description: The massive support columns holding up the diamondlike ceiling are minutely sculpted with the  image of a giant winged serpent, coiling around it from floor to ceiling. Rather than feeling repulsed, you somehow feel lighter as you appreciate the marvel.

13.Name: A Sacred Pool
13.Description: You step into a spring-fed pool of azure water. The light dances on its surface, so brilliant it hurts your eyes.

14.Name: A Frozen Temple
14.Description: You move slowly through the temple. It seems that the constructs guarding and maintaining it have not met a living being in many ages.

15.Name: A Sacred Pool
15.Description: You step into a spring-fed pool of azure water. The light dances on its surface, so brilliant it hurts your eyes.

16.Name: A Frozen Temple
16.Description: You move slowly through the temple. It seems that the constructs guarding and maintaining it have not met a living being in many ages.

17.Name: An Archway of Marble and Ice
17.Description: An immense archway separates the inner sanctum of the temple from the rest. Like the support columns throughout the temple, it has been sculpted with the image of a winged serpent. At its apex, you make out the likeness of a crowned snake. You suddenly feel unworthy to be in this place.

18.Name: The Inner Sanctum
18.Description: The inner sanctum is tended to by handmaidens bringing crystal clear water from the sacred pools to an altar on a dais, which emanates a soft radiant glow. You feel unclean in the presence of light so pure.

19.Name: The Inner Sanctum

20.Name: A Radiant Altar
20.Description: The handmaidens bring water from the sacred pool up to the radiant altar, pouring it with reverence into a golden chalice decorated with sapphires. Though they continually fill it, it never seems to overflow. You suddenly realise what you must do, and step up to the radiant altar to prepare for your penance.

The pool reflects the light of the temple, creating a double image of the inner temple so lifelike that you have a sense of vertigo for a moment. Constructs move slowly through the pool, tending to the upkeep of the temple.

You find it beautiful, and forget for a moment that where there are eggs, there must be a mother nearby...

143.Name: The High Sanctum
143.Description: With the Oracle satisfied, you have leave to ascend a crystal flight of stairs behind the altar to enter what appears to be some sort of observatory. You are drawn to a corner of the sanctum which at first seems brighter than the rest, yet somehow not.

144.Name: The High Sanctum
144.Description: The glassy ice roof of the temple is remarkably clear, and several instruments have been set up here, presumably for the Oracle's usage.

145.Name: A Welling of Power
145.Description: You step into the far corner of the High Sanctum, drawn to it by a feeling of power, but are unable to find any obvous source.

146.Name: The High Sanctum
146.Description: There is a large crystalline desk here, stacked with charts and almanacs. Many of the constellations marked are unfamiliar to you, although you recognise the constituent stars. All of the marked constellations appear centred around one with a long, wavy form. It is marked in ornate, gold handwriting: Diamandia.

147.Name: Taking a Tumble
147.Description: As you take a step on the slippery path, you lose your footing and tumble right off the cliffside! You twist and turn, trying to find something - anything - to slow your fall, but only end up dislodging boulders.

0.Name: Inside the Druid Grove
0.Description: You step through the thicket and enter a grove of trees that looks as if it has been here for hundreds of years.  Loud creakings and crackings break the silence.  No song birds sing here.

1.Name: A Small Path
1.Description: After some wandering, you stumble upon a small animal path through the grove.  You are not sure where it leads, but you feel at peace here.  You will probably not be threatened.

2.Name: A Small Path
2.Description: The path gently curves and slopes around trees and through a small ravine.  Not too far away, you can hear the trickling of water through the woods.

3.Name: A Small Path
3.Description: The trickling stream sooths you and you soon forget how far you have traveled along the creek.  Before you know it, you seem to have reached the end of the trail.  Stopping to look around, you finally notice that it heads south.

4.Name: Old Ironwoods
4.Description: These Ironwoods press upon you a feeling of invincibility.  If one of the local Lumberjacks were to attempt to cut down one of these beautiful trees, you are sure it would dull the axe.

5.Name: A Secluded Runewood Tree
5.Description: A single small runewood tree lies here seperated from its grove.  The air seems filled with sadness and regret.  For a few moments, you feel a tear begin to well up in your eyes.

6.Name: A Small Path
6.Description: The path gently curves and slopes around trees and through a small ravine.  Not too far away, you can hear the trickling of water through the woods.

7.Name: A Small Path
7.Description: You overlook the lazy creek as it drifts quietly eastwards.  Like the creek, life here in the grove seems to be silent and peaceful.

8.Name: The Fig Grove
8.Description: The large fig trees are more spread out through the forest then the others you've seen.  Each seems to have a personality, and a want of personal space.

9.Name: Overlooking the Creek
9.Description: You get a fine view of the creek from here.  Its gently flowing waters shimmer lightly under the sun's bright rays.

10.Name: Small Clearing
10.Description: You notice the path seems to head straight for a fallen tree ahead, but the serenity of the surrounding trees makes you feel like exploring them.

11.Name: The Runewood Trees
11.Description: As you walk between the small runewood trees, you can't help but feel something on the wind...almost like whispers.

12.Name: The Runewood Trees
12.Description: As you walk between the small runewood trees, you can't help but feel something on the wind...almost like whispers.

13.Name: A Large Stump
13.Description: You walk along the forest path and see the remains of where one of the greatest trees in the forest once stood.  It has now fallen though, but conveniently, it looks like you could cross the creek from here.

14.Name: A Fallen Tree
14.Description: The trunk of the tree is strong, and you find no hazards in crossing the creek.  As you walk along, you can see a dark pool of water with a multitude of trout swimming.  Now you wish you had brought a fishing pole, for the fish look delicious.

15.Name: Near the Creek
15.Description: The crystal clear water flows placidly here to under the fallen tree and beyond.  The sun warms you, and leaning down, you drink from the creek.

16.Name: A Fallen Tree
16.Description: You finally step off the end of the trunk onto a smooth stone step.  A soft breeze blows through, rustling the leaves of the nearby woods.

17.Name: bad room
17.Description: ooops.

18.Name: On the Sandy Bank
18.Description: This looks like one of the more popular fishing spots of the druids.  Looking down into the water, you can see many trout swimming in its depths. This, with the herbs and fruits from the trees, must be what sustains the druids here.

19.Name: A Weeping Willow
19.Description: You step under the dangling fronds of the weeping willow tree.  The warm afternoon sun beams down on you and combined with the gentle wind coming from the west, urges you to sit and rest your aching body.

20.Name: Along the Sandy Bank
20.Description: The Weeping Willow behind you, you walk farther along the peaceful creek.  The urge to throw a stone into the creek comes over you, but disturbing the creek almost seems like a crime.

21.Name: Along the Sandy Creek
21.Description: The sandy creek bank ends here, moving up the bank and into a small clearing ahead.

22.Name: Edge of the Ancient Cypress Trees
22.Description: Many new cypress trees have taken root here, growing over the years from being tended by the Druids.

23.Name: A Small Clearing
23.Description: The woods seem to sweep away from the soft short grasses of this clearing.  The beauty of this hidden grove is amazing, and you feel that you must somehow protect it. Ahead you can hear the trickling of a small creek.

24.Name: The Creekside
24.Description: The creek trickles off into the distance, running behind the Highway Side Inn and towards the town of Lakeside.

25.Name: A Weeping Willow
25.Description: You step under the dangling fronds of the weeping willow tree.  The warm afternoon sun beams down on you and combined with the gentle wind coming from the west, urges you to sit and rest your aching body.

26.Name: A Small Clearing
26.Description: The woods seem to sweep away from the soft short grasses of this clearing.  The beauty of this hidden grove is amazing, and you feel that you must somehow protect it.

27.Name: The Ancient Cypress Trees
27.Description: The cypress trees normally live for hundreds of years, but somehow these trees look far older.  The trees spring up about you, and their thick canopy keeps much of the sun from reaching the ground below.

28.Name: The Ancient Cypress Trees
28.Description: The cypress trees normally live for hundreds of years, but somehow these trees look far older.  The trees spring up about you, and their thick canopy keeps much of the sun from reaching the ground below.

29.Name: Along the Sandy Bank
29.Description: The soft sand shifts slightly beneath you as the peaceful creek trickles by.  Farther along the bank, you see a large Weeping Willow, with its tendrils hanging in the water.

30.Name: The Druid's Clearing
30.Description: The grass and wildflowers grow thicker here, lending the air a perfumed smell.  The smell makes you lightheaded and sleepy, so maybe you should hurry along your way.

31.Name: Druid's Path
31.Description: The path of the Druids follows along the edge of the clearing, so as not to disturb the delicate flowers and herbs growing in the it.

32.Name: Druid's Path
32.Description: The sun is warm overhead, but there is something else here that makes this place seem special.  The druids keep very good care of the grove. The clearing is clean of sticks and other natural rubbish lending it purity and serenity.

33.Name: Druid's Path
33.Description: The forest falls away as you step into a large clearing.  Many druids walk  back and forth, ministering to the trees and plants of the forest.

34.Name: Druid's Path
34.Description: You finally catch your first sign of something living in these woods. Deep footprints in the soft ground show that someone has been here recently.

35.Name: The Ancient Oaks
35.Description: The old Oak Trees have stood longer then the times of man in this area, but even they are not the oldest trees in this grove.

36.Name: Near the Cypress Woods
36.Description: The edge of the clearing runs along a thick hedgerow of old cypress trees.  Beyond them lies the Cypress grove, and home of the more tempermental treants.

37.Name: The Druid's Clearing
37.Description: The grass and wildflowers grow thicker here, lending the air a perfumed smell.  The smell makes you lightheaded and sleepy, so maybe you should hurry along your way.

38.Description: The edge of the clearing runs along a thick hedgerow of old cypress trees.  Beyond them lies the Cypress grove, and home of the more tempermental treants.

39.Name: The Ancient Cypress Trees
39.Description: The cypress trees normally live for hundreds of years, but somehow these trees look far older.  Ahead of you towards the creek, you can see the trees break away to form a small peaceful clearing.
