48.Description: ooops.

49.Name: The Fig Grove
49.Description: The large fig trees are more spread out through the forest then the others you've seen.  Each seems to have a personality, and a want of personal space. A small tablet lies here saying, "Requiem".

50.Name: bad room
50.Description: ooops.

51.Name: The Hidden Bank
51.Description: Under the shade of some Fig trees stretching overhead, is a small private bank.  You could probably rest here and not be found very easy if you wanted.

52.Name: bad room
52.Description: ooops.

53.Name: bad room
53.Description: ooops.

54.Name: The Ancient Oaks
54.Description: The old Oak Trees have stood longer then the times of man in this area, but even they are not the oldest trees in this grove.

55.Name: A Wilted Elm
55.Description: The air here is thick and pungent with the smell of decay.  The woods seem to seperate around the cursed Elm, whose bark emits a thin poisonous fog.

56.Name: The Old Ash Grove
56.Description: A smoky mist drifts through the haze of this part of the forest, and you realize that you are in the oldest parts of the Coranin Forest.  Huge Ash trees twist up majestically, their canopy's blotting out the sun's warm rays.

57.Name: The Old Ash Grove
57.Description: A smoky mist drifts through the haze of this part of the forest, and you realize that you are in the oldest parts of the Coranin Forest.  Huge Ash trees twist up majestically, their canopy's blotting out the sun's warm rays.

58.Name: The Druid's Clearing
58.Description: The shorter grass and herbs make travel easier, and you can see a grove of old Ash trees to the south of you.

59.Name: The Druid's Clearing
59.Description: At the end of the Druid's Clearing you can see the start of the Ironwood trees east of you.  As you begin to head in that direction, you notice a large Ash tree to the south of you, but it looks as if it is no longer living.

60.Name: The Druid's Clearing
60.Description: The grass and wildflowers grow thicker here, lending the air a perfumed smell.  The smell makes you lightheaded and sleepy, so maybe you should hurry along your way.

61.Name: Eastern Honing Stone
61.Description: There is a massive stone here with the letter E on it. Very mysterious in nature.

62.Name: The Druid's Clearing
62.Description: The shorter grass and herbs make travel easier, and you can see a grove of old Ash trees to the south of you.

63.Name: The Druid's Clearing
63.Description: As you walk around the Druid Clearing, you see a thin white mist getting thicker as you head south.  It seems to be coming from a forest of old ash trees to the south.

64.Name: The Druid's Clearing
64.Description: You walk steadily along the edge of the clearing, taking in the scents and sites of the grove.  After passing the wildflowers, you notice a large forest of Ash to the south.

65.Name: A Rocky Outcropping
65.Description: The lichen covered rock is slick and hard to stand on. If you aren't careful, you might find a quick and painful way off of the rock.  Holding still, you are able to get a good look of the Druid Circle. As you are surveying the landscape, a noxious smell invades your senses.  Its seems to be coming from the south.

66.Name: The Druid's Clearing
66.Description: A large outcropping of rock appears south of you, looming overhead.  What is trapped behind it, you can't tell.  If you were to climb it, you might get a large vantage point over the entire grove.

67.Name: A Hollowed Out Trunk
67.Description: You step through the trunk of a large hollowed Ash.  The Ash is much larger then any Ash that could possibly exist.  You are about to turn back when you notice something moving amongst the bark...

68.Name: Northern Honing Stone
68.Description: There is a massive stone here with the letter N on it. Very mysterious in nature.

69.Name: Druid Circle
69.Description: The ground is bare of grass and roots, but it doesn't look as if it were barren.  There is an immense feeling of power within the Druid Circle, but it doesn't feel evil. When you look up, you the ancient Honing stones of the druids, inscribed with the vestiges of Verinae.

70.Name: Southern Honing Stone
70.Description: There is a massive stone here with the letter S on it. Very mysterious in nature.

71.Name: The Druid's Clearing
71.Description: The grass and wildflowers grow thicker here, lending the air a perfumed smell.  The smell makes you lightheaded and sleepy, so maybe you should hurry along your way.

72.Name: Entrance to the Druid Circle
72.Description: A path of stone leads up the hill to the Druid Circle.  The Druid Circle is renowned amongst the followers of Verinae as a center of wisdom.

73.Name: The Old Ash Grove
73.Description: A smoky mist drifts through the haze of this part of the forest, and you realize that you are in the oldest parts of the Coranin Forest.  Huge Ash trees twist up majestically, their canopy's blotting out the sun's warm rays.

74.Name: The Druid's Clearing
74.Description: The grass and wildflowers grow thicker here, lending the air a perfumed smell.  The smell makes you lightheaded and sleepy, so maybe you should hurry along your way.

75.Description: ooops.

76.Name: bad room
76.Description: ooops.

77.Name: Near the Cypress Woods
77.Description: The edge of the clearing runs along a thick hedgerow of old cypress trees.  Beyond them lies the Cypress grove, and home of the more tempermental treants.

78.Name: The Ancient Cypress Trees
78.Description: The cypress trees normally live for hundreds of years, but somehow these trees look far older.  The trees spring up about you, and their thick canopy keeps much of the sun from reaching the ground below.

79.Name: Edge of the Druid's Clearing
79.Description: The trees begin to loom once more over you as you approach the end of the clearing.  Before you, the forests spans almost endlessly.

80.Name: Dead End
80.Description: This corner seems to lead to a dead end. Better make your way out before something unlucky happens.

0.Name: Road to nowhere
0.Description: You have a funny feeling that you have been here before.

0.Name: The Highway
0.Description: You are on a long, boring stretch of the highway. Not much of interest here, so you continue walking.

1.Name: The Highway
1.Description: You are walking along the long, boring highway. To the south you can see a fairly large expanse of farmland, all seeming to belong to one farmer. You wonder whose it is.

2.Name: The Highway
2.Description: You are on the long, dull highway. To the south is a large green field, bordering some farmland. It seems very large. You also think you can see a lake in the distance.

3.Name: The Highway
3.Description: You continue along the boring highway. Your feet are beginning to get a little sore on the poorly placed cobblestones. This thing could certainly stand some maintenance.

4.Name: The Highway
4.Description: You reach a part of the highway where a small dirt path branches off to the north. You believe this is the way to the Epiach Graveyard, where the dead citizens of that city are put to rest.

5.Name: Graveyard Path
5.Description: You are walking on the narrow dirt path between the Epiach Graveyard and the highway. The path feels a little eerie and enclosed as you get closer to the graveyard, but you've gotten used to this feeling after weeks of adventuring.

6.Name: Graveyard Path
6.Description: You reach the end of the dirt path. To the east, you can see a fairly large forest. which you could make your way into if you wished. To the west you see the intimitating main gates of the Epiach Graveyard.

7.Name: Epiach Highway - Forest Grove
7.Description: You are in a small, pleasant grove among the trees in this forest. Light shines down from above, releasing you from the claustrophopic feeling caused by the tightly growing trees. This could be a nice place to sit down and relax for a while.

8.Name: Epiach Highway - Forest
8.Description: You are in a tightly packed section of the forest, with trees growing densely all around you. With the Gnolls that you've seen in the area, you can't help but think that this would be an absolutely perfect place to stage an ambush of an unwary adventurer.

9.Name: Epiach Highway - Forest Grove
9.Description: Unlike the other groves in the forest, this one is swarming with Gnolls. It probably doesn't help that it is right next to their encampment, but you can't help but feel a bit angry that these loathsome creatures are defiling such a pleasant forest.

10.Name: Epiach Highway - Forest
10.Description: You are walking through a pleasant part of the forest. To the north you can see a small grove where the trees have failed to grow, and farther east lies more of the forest, though you can't see too much of it through the trees.

11.Name: Epiach Highway - Forest
11.Description: You are wandering in a large, pretty forest. You see a number of strange birds flying above your head in the treetops, and some even jump close to you along the branches. You can hear the rustling of animals in the underbrush, but they do not come out to meet you.

12.Name: Epiach Farmland - Pablos House
12.Description: You enter the large beat up farm house. Inside, you see a poor, bedraggled farmer. He greets you, and identified himself as Pablo, the brother of Pedro, the very successful, womanizing farmer to the west. You wander what could have cause the sudden drop in prosperity at Pablo's farm.

13.Name: Crypt
13.Description: You have stumbled upon the tomb of a long dead hero of the Empire. To your dismay, you find that the heroes grave is no longer closed and sealed as it should be, but is rather quite open. You also notice, to further dismay, that its inhabitant is up and walking around. This can't be good.

14.Name: Epiach Graveyard
14.Description: You walk along a short, grey dirt path to a large crypt. You are not particularly looking forward to going in there, and as you get closer, your forboding mounts. Perhaps you might want to turn back?

15.Name: Epiach Farmland
15.Description: You enter the fields of Paolo the farmer. The animals here look less than happy than normal, and you get the feeling that there is some foul-play afoot. Could it be his brother, Pablo?

16.Name: Epiach Graveyard - Mausoleum
16.Description: You are standing near a small mausoleum. Sadly, despite all your adventurer's instincts, you are unable to force your way into the sealed tomb. Oh well, perhaps you can get into some other one.

17.Name: Epiach Graveyard - Crossing
17.Description: The meandering paths between the numerous graves come together here. You could go south into the mass of grave sites, north to a small mausoleum, or along paths to the two large crypts.

18.Name: Epiach Graveyard - Graves
18.Description: You are at a corner of the large grouping of grave sites. These are smaller, and generally less ornate. Most likely the poorer families are buried here.

19.Name: Epiach Graveyard - Graves
19.Description: You walk through the long rows of graves. A worrisomely large amount are turned up, without any bodies within. Roaming zombies begin to make violent groaning noises as you walk around.

20.Name: Epiach Graveyard - Graves
20.Description: You walk through the long rows of graves. A worrisomely large amount are turned up, without any bodies within. Roaming zombies begin to make violent groaning noises as you walk around.

21.Name: Epiach Graveyard - Gates
21.Description: You are at the entrance of the Epiach Graveyard. You have a funny feeling that this graveyard, like most of the others in the world, is rather overrun with undead. This theory is strengthened by the various zombies you notice roaming about.

22.Name: Epiach Graveyard - Crypt Entrance
22.Description: You are at the entrance to the right crypt. Strangely, the massive stone door to the crypt has been swung wide open, allowing anyone entrance...or exit from its confines. You feel a sudden temptation to go back, but you quell the urge, and resolve to move forward if neccessary.

23.Name: Epiach Farmland
23.Description: You enter the fields of Paolo the farmer. The animals here look less than happy than normal, and you get the feeling that there is some foul-play afoot. Could it be his brother, Pablo?

24.Name: Epiach Graveyard - Crypt Entrance
24.Description: You are at the entrance to the left crypt. This crypt is a bit larger than the other one in this graveyard, and its stone door has been thrown open. You wonder what may lie inside, and whether or not it could pose a threat to nearby Epiach.

25.Name: Epiach Graveyard
25.Description: You walk along a short, grey dirt path to a large crypt. You are not particularly looking forward to going in there, and as you get closer, your forboding mounts. Perhaps you might want to turn back?

26.Name: Epiach Graveyard
26.Description: You walk along a short, grey dirt path to a large crypt. You are not particularly looking forward to going in there, and as you get closer, your forboding mounts. Perhaps you might want to turn back?

27.Name: Epiach Graveyard - Left Path
27.Description: You are along the left path, leading to a large crypt. It is in the distance still, but this crypt appears to be very large, likely the burial site of a very important person, or a hero.

28.Name: Epiach Graveyard
28.Description: You walk along a short, grey dirt path to a large crypt. You are not particularly looking forward to going in there, and as you get closer, your forboding mounts. Perhaps you might want to turn back?

29.Name: Epiach Graveyard - Right Path
29.Description: You take the right path around a large cluster of graves. To the north, you can see a large crypt. Likely some very important, or at least wealthy person was buried there.

30.Name: Epiach Graveyard - Graves
30.Description: You are in the center of the rows of graves. There are only a smattering of undisturbed graves here, and various undead are definitely becoming annoyed at your presence.

31.Name: Epiach Graveyard - Graves
31.Description: You walk through the long rows of graves. A worrisomely large amount are turned up, without any bodies within. Roaming zombies begin to make violent groaning noises as you walk around.

32.Name: Epiach Farmland
32.Description: You walk through the large, empty field. To the east, you can see a large lake, and a beach, with a variety of organisms crawling about on it. To the north you can make out the boring highway.

33.Name: Epiach Graveyard - Graves
33.Description: You walk through the lines of graves, where the dead have been laid to a (usually) permanent rest. A disturbing number of them have been dug up.

34.Name: Epiach Farmland
34.Description: You are walking through another large field, bordering a farm. You spot a large, but dilapidated farmhouse to the southwest, and a very large lake to the southeast. Both might be worth exploring.

35.Name: Epiach Farmlands
35.Description: You are walking through a large field of crops. The crops seem to be doing well, though not so prosperously as the farms to the north. It seems odd that a farmer with so much land is having trouble.

36.Name: Epiach Farmland
36.Description: You continue walking through a large field. There is a big, but broken down farmhouse to the west. It looks as though whoever is working here has fallen upon hard times.

37.Name: Epiach Highway - Forest
37.Description: You are wandering in a large, pretty forest. You see a number of strange birds flying above your head in the treetops, and some even jump close to you along the branches. You can hear the rustling of animals in the underbrush, but they do not come out to meet you.

38.Name: Epiach Highway - Forest
38.Description: You are at the southern edge of this forest. A small dirt path leads to the south, back to the Epiach Highway, and the forest spreads out in all other directions. It might be interesting to explore it further.

39.Name: Epiach Highway - Forest
39.Description: You are in the eastern part of the forest. The smell of Gnolls is strong here, and you are sure that their camp must be somewhere nearby. You hope that there are not too many of them in it for you to handle.

40.Name: Epiach Highway - Gnoll Camp
40.Description: You have stumbled upon a large camp of Gnolls! The vile, furry beasts are everywhere, slinking around through the trees either to avoid you, or to plan a surprise attack. You feel a profound disgust at discovering these creatures here.

41.Name: Epiach Highway - Forest Grove
41.Description: You are in a small, pleasant grove among the trees in this forest. Light shines down from above, releasing you from the claustrophopic feeling caused by the tightly growing trees. This could be a nice place to sit down and relax for a while.

42.Name: Epiach Highway - Forest Grove
42.Description: You are in a small, pleasant grove among the trees in this forest. Light shines down from above, releasing you from the claustrophopic feeling caused by the tightly growing trees. This could be a nice place to sit down and relax for a while.

43.Name: Epiach Highway - Forest
43.Description: As you enter this part of the forest, you begin to smell a faint aroma that most every adventurer is familiar with. You groan inwardly at the inevitable annoyance to come; there's Gnolls around here.

44.Name: Epiach Farmlands - Barn
44.Description: You enter a large barn, and it is CHAOS. Animals are milling everywhere, but don't seem to be leaving the area. You wonder what could possibly be instigating such an event.

45.Name: Crypt
45.Description: You are at the exit of a crypt. The crypt extends a bit to the south, and you get a general bad feeling from that area. You are becoming rather frightened down here, but gather the resolve to continue onwards.

46.Name: Epiach Highway - Forest
46.Description: As you enter this part of the forest, you begin to smell a faint aroma that most every adventurer is familiar with. You groan inwardly at the inevitable annoyance to come; there's Gnolls around here.

47.Name: Epiach Highway
47.Description: The highway continues here, and to your delight, you can see a large beach to the south, and it looks as though it would be a very peaceful place to rest. To the east is even more highway, it seems endless.

48.Name: Epiach Highway
48.Description: The highway continues on and on. You're getting really bored of walking along the plain highway, but you decided that it was the quickest, least painful route. You sullenly trudge onwards.

49.Name: Epiach Highway
49.Description: Cobblestones, cobblestones, cobblestones, as far as the eye can see. You're getting really tired of cobblestones.

50.Name: Epiach Highway
50.Description: The highway takes a slight bend to the south here, indicating its ultimate direction. You continue walking along the otherwise uninteresting highway.

51.Name: Epiach Highway
51.Description: The highway continues on and on. You're getting really bored of walking along the plain highway, but you decided that it was the quickest, least painful route. You sullenly trudge onwards.

52.Name: Epiach Highway
52.Description: The highway continues on and on. You're getting really bored of walking along the plain highway, but you decided that it was the quickest, least painful route. You sullenly trudge onwards.

53.Name: Epiach Highway
53.Description: You are walking along the Epiach Highway. To the south, you can see a large lake with a beach, and a small dirt path branching off the highway to lead to it. Perhaps you could have a rest on the beach.

54.Name: Epiach Highway
54.Description: As you continue along the highway, you notice a small path break of to the north here and head towards the woods. Perhaps that would be more interesting than this highway.

55.Name: Epiach Highway
55.Description: The highway continues on and on. You're getting really bored of walking along the plain highway, but you decided that it was the quickest, least painful route. You sullenly trudge onwards.

56.Name: Epiach Highway
56.Description: The highway continues on and on. You're getting really bored of walking along the plain highway, but you decided that it was the quickest, least painful route. You sullenly trudge onwards.

57.Name: Epiach Highway
57.Description: The highway takes a sharp turn here, heading down south towards the port city of Sucaran, and to the city of Epiach to the west. To the north, there is a small guardhouse, where a few guards from Epiach watch over the highway.

58.Name: Path
58.Description: You are nearing the forest on the small dirt path. You can hear the sounds of chirping birds in the distance, and the sounds of animals as well.

59.Name: Path
59.Description: You are walking along a dirt path between the highway, and a large forested area.

60.Name: Epiach Highway - Gnoll Camp
60.Description: You have stumbled upon a large camp of Gnolls! The vile, furry beasts are everywhere, slinking around through the trees either to avoid you, or to plan a surprise attack. You feel a profound disgust at discovering these creatures here.

61.Name: Epiach Highway - Forest
61.Description: You walk through the northern section of the large forest. The trees are getting rather thick up here, making further progress north impossible, but you can see some viable pathways through the trees to the east.

62.Name: Epiach Highway
62.Description: The highway continues on and on. You're getting really bored of walking along the plain highway, but you decided that it was the quickest, least painful route. You sullenly trudge onwards.

63.Name: Epiach Highway
63.Description: You march on along the highway. There isn't much change in the scenery to the south, or the north, or west for that matter, and you decide you may as well keep moving.

64.Name: Epiach Highway
64.Description: You march on along the highway. There isn't much change in the scenery to the south, or the north, or west for that matter, and you decide you may as well keep moving.

65.Name: Epiach Highway
65.Description: To the south, you can finally see something interesting, though not in a very good way. To the south lies a great, and very unpleasant desert. You wonder if you might want to head back to Epiach to prepare before venturing farther south.

66.Name: Epiach Highway
66.Description: You are nearing the large desert. You notice now that the temperature has been rising steadily as you've been making your way south along the road, and now you see what the heat has ultimately lead to. It's somewhat surprising that Epiach is able to maintain so much fertile farmland so close to a desert.

67.Name: Epiach Highway - Beach
67.Description: You step onto the beach, surrounding a large lake. The beach is very pleasant, with a few lake-dwelling creatures scuttling around your feet. You decide that this would be a nice place to take a vacation.

68.Name: Epiach Farmland
68.Description: You are at the edge of the large field. Nearby to the east is a large lake, and a beach. The lake looks very inviting; possibly it would be fun to take a swim in it.

69.Name: Epiach Highway - Lake
69.Description: You are wading deeper into the lake. The water is getting a little deeper, and you decide not to go any further out in your armor. It's still nice to take a dip in the water though.

70.Name: Epiach Highway - Lake
70.Description: You take a dip in the pleasant lake. You're pleased that the empire has not yet ruined this lovely piece of scenery, though you do notice some disturbingly large fish swimming around in the water, you continue to enjoy yourself.

71.Name: Epiach Highway - The Beach
71.Description: You are walking along a beach. The lake to the south is glimmering in the sun, and you can spot a number of small fish, along with some larger ones, swimming around in the clear water. Nice place.

72.Name: Epiach Highway - Beach
72.Description: You are on a large beach, near a grassy path to the north, leading back to the long highway. The lake to the south looks rather inviting, perhaps you could go for a dip.

73.Name: Epiach Highway - Guardhouse
73.Description: You are in the small barracks of Epiach Guards. From here, the guards patrol the highway, and make sure no bandits take up residence in the area. The guards here look gruff and well trained.

74.Name: Epiach Highway - Guardhouse
74.Description: You are in the back of the Guardhouse. A few guards are playing dice and telling stories in front of a blazing hearth. They welcome you, and you sit down with them and have a quick drink. You decide it's time to go though.

75.Name: Crypt
75.Description: You are in the southern section of the crypt. All of the coffins here have been torn open, and no corpses are in sight. You think you here a soft scuttling noise coming from a dark corner, but you aren't sure. Perhaps you should leave this place, quickly.

76.Name: Epiach Highway - Gnoll Chief's Hut
76.Description: You enter the shoddy hut of the Gnoll tribe's chief. The hut isn't in terribly good repair, but it has a fortune of animal skins tossed carelessly about the floor, and hung on the walls. You hope that the chief himself doesn't notice your intrusion.

77.Name: Epiach Highway - Forest
77.Description: You are at the western edge of the large forest. You can see a dirt path leading out, and you believe towards the Epiach Graveyard. The sounds of animals and birds are all around to the east.

78.Name: Epiach Highway - Forest
78.Description: You are nearing the edge of the forest. To the east, all manner of creatures slink about through the woods, not used to being disturbed by a human such as you.

79.Name: Crypt
79.Description: You are at the exit of a crypt. The crypt extends a bit to the south, and you get a general bad feeling from that area. You are becoming rather frightened down here, but gather the resolve to continue onwards.

80.Name: Epiach Highway
80.Description: You are walking along a small grassy path which leads to a lake to the south. The grass becomes mingled with sand as you walk closer to the beach, and you are suddenly tempted to take off your boots.

81.Name: Epiach Highway - Beach
81.Description: You walk along the eastern part of the beach. This is a very pleasant place, you think, as the warm sun beats down on your neck. You ponder lying down to take a nap, but decide that there's some serious adventuring that needs doing.

82.Name: Highway - Beach
82.Description: You walk along the beach, quietly thinking to yourself. This place is making you contemplative about your life of adventuring, but you quickly decide that the riches and fame are better than a quiet life by the lake.

83.Name: Epiach Highway - Beach
83.Description: You walk along the quiet beach, taking in the pretty view of the large lake. This place is certainly a pleasant diversion, but you'll need to get back to serious adventuring soon. Well, if you feel like it.

84.Name: Epiach Highway - Beach
84.Description: You are at the eastern end of the long beach. Nearby is a dirt path leading back to the Epiach Highway, and further travels. The long, sandy expanse of the beach is quite tempting, and you think a quick relaxing stroll might be nice.

85.Name: Epiach Highway - Beach
85.Description: You are walking along the beach. To the south, the beach gives way to large, impassible rocks and cliffs, to which you have no desire to go. To the east you can make out a path leading back to the long, boring highway.

86.Name: Epiach Highway - Lake
86.Description: You take a dip in the pleasant lake. You're pleased that the empire has not yet ruined this lovely piece of scenery, though you do notice some disturbingly large fish swimming around in the water, you continue to enjoy yourself.

87.Name: Epiach Highway - Beach
87.Description: You walk along the beach near the lake. The water is crystal clear, and you can see animals swimming in it even from your vantage on the beach. It's getting a little warm, but you ignore it.

88.Name: Epiach Highway - Lake
88.Description: You take a dip in the pleasant lake. You're pleased that the empire has not yet ruined this lovely piece of scenery, though you do notice some disturbingly large fish swimming around in the water, you continue to enjoy yourself.

91.Name: Path
91.Description: You're walking along a short path between the beach and the highway. It's a rather uninteresting path. No, really, totally uninteresting. Nothing to see here at all.

92.Name: Path
92.Description: You're walking along a short path between the beach and the highway. It's a rather uninteresting path. No, really, totally uninteresting. Nothing to see here at all.

93.Name: The Highway
93.Description: You are on the long stone highway, now just south of a large, concentrated cluster of farmland. Perhaps it might be interersting to take a look at the farms.

94.Name: The Highway
94.Description: You walk out of Epiach, and onto the long, cobblestoned way of the Eastern Highway. Farmlands spread far to the north and south, helping to feed the growing population of Epiach.

95.Name: Epiach Farmlands
95.Description: You are in a large, grassy field that is dotted on the edges by various farms. You see a few animals here and there which have been set free to wander about.

96.Name: Epiach Farmlands
96.Description: You are walking in a large open field outside some farmhouses. This part of the field is largely uninteresting, other than some grazing animals.

97.Name: Epiach Farmlands
97.Description: You are walking around in a large field. Nearby to the west, you can see a fairly large farmhouse. Perhaps the farmer would give a hungry traveller a bite to eat.

98.Name: The Epiach Farmlands
98.Description: You are in a small, very well-used field for grazing farm animals. It looks like the field is in dire need of some rainfall, but the animals still seem to be fairly content. And...tasty looking.

99.Name: Epiach Farmlands - Farmhouse
99.Description: You are in a fairly small farmhouse. It is small, but the occupants are fairly friendly to you, offering you a place to sit and rest your feet for a while before you continue your journey. There is a back exit to a grazing field.

100.Name: Epiach Farmlands
100.Description: You continue to wander around the large field. You notice that you have come rather close to a couple of farmhouses. You don't know if their occupants would appreciate you intruding, but you don't really care.

101.Name: Epiach Farmlands - Farmhouse
101.Description: You enter a very large farmhouse. It looks to you like the inhabitants of this place have done fairly well for themselves, but they still offer you a bite to eat and a place to rest for a moment. Out of the back, you see an exit to some fields.

102.Name: Epiach Farmlands
102.Description: You are in a field set up as a grazing area for cattle. Any number of different types of livestock are back here, quietly munching away at the grass. They look...tasty.

103.Name: Epiach Farmlands - Farmhouse
103.Description: You are in a large farmhouse. The occupants actually seem fairly happy to see an adventurer, and open up their place of living to you. The house is quite pleasant, with a fire burning in a hearth, and a meal seemingly eternally cooking above it. You notice a back exit to a large grazing field.

104.Name: Epiach Farmlands
104.Description: Unlike the other farms, this field seems devoted to growing crops. Various vegetables and grains are growing healthily in rows all throughout the area. You notice a large barn near the far end of the field. Perhaps that's where this farm's animals are kept.

0.Name: Epiach Town Square
0.Description: You are standing in the absolute center of the Central Plaza of the grand city of Epiach. A large crowd of people moves around, with the hurried pace and bustle commonly found in the larger cities of the Majestic Empire. Four huge marble fountains on the corners of the Central Plaza spout water high into the air, and create a pleasing sound to drown out the noises from the crowd.

1.Name: Central Plaza of Epiach
1.Description: The crowds thin out slightly as you leave the center of the plaza, but not by much. In the central of the plaza here is a far greater than life sized statue of Turain Lemoiak, the famous hero of Epiach who almost single handedly defended the city against the ogre invasion 400 years ago.

2.Name: Before the Civil Palace
2.Description: Past the central plaza here stands the marble building that is the Epiach Civil Palace. A group of well trained and well armed Epiach guardsmen stand watch, watching those who enter and exit the palace.

3.Name: Central Plaza of Epiach
3.Description: The central plaza of Epiach continues here. The crowds of people do not seize to impress you. To the north is the Epiach Grand Boulevard, which leads through all the way through the city.

4.Name: Before the Temple of Aran
4.Description: The stone paving stones are painted yellow and have small golden symbols of Aran engraved into them around the gigantic marble temple here. The entrance to the huge temple is barred with steel and wooden beams, and the windows that once held breathtaking stained glass images now are filled with boards and broken glass.

5.Name: Central Plaza of Epiach
5.Description: The central plaza of Epiach continues here, full of people. A fantastic marble and silver statue on a golden pedestal in the center of the plaza depicts Emperess Olina holding up a shield with the symbol of the Majestic Empire on it.

6.Name: Before House Mandralor
6.Description: The stone paving stones near the massive marble palace are painted blue here, marking the territory of House Mandralor. The crowds here are careful not to cross the property boundary. An entire squadron of stone faced guards, wearing finely polished full platemail, prevent anyone from entering the palace entrance to the east.

7.Name: Central Plaza of Epiach
7.Description: The central plaza of Epiach continues here. The crowds of people do not seize to impress you. To the south is the Epiach Grand Boulevard, which leads through all the way through the city.

8.Name: Before House Laraikin
8.Description: The marble palace here has red colored paving stones surrounding it, signifying the property of House Laraikin. The guards standing outside of the palace continue to glare towards the palace in the south west. The extreme hatred between the two Houses is very apparent by the behavior of the guards.

9.Name: Tibrooke Boulevard
9.Description: The street begins to widen here, to accommodate the massive crowds of people traveling through this way. The central plaza of the city is directly ahead.

13.Name: The Epiach Civil Palace

23.Name: The Great Cathedral of Epiach
23.Description: The symbol still stands, an enormous white marble statue of the symbol of Aran, the God of Light. Looking up at the three story symbol you notice a part of it to be missing. Which could explain the pile of broken marble boulders at the base of the symbol. Wait a minute! You think you hear a voice coming from below the marble. You venture into the large pile of boulders. You make your way to the very base of the symbol to find a square shaped opening in the ground. You peer down into the square hole, down into the darkness...

This is the symbol of the Majestic Empire. Two marble spiral staircases lead to the second floor of the palace.

40.Name: Epiach Grand Boulevard

41.Name: Home Street

42.Name: Home Street

43.Name: Epiach Grand Boulevard

44.Name: Epiach Grand Boulevard
44.Description: The wide street continues through the great city of Epiach. Multi story stone buildings line both sides of the street, which house a plethora of shops on the street level and above, homes for the merchants wealthy enough to own shops on the main street of Epiach.

45.Name: Tibrooke Boulevard
45.Description: After ascending a number of worn stone steps, the many shops and houses surrounding the boulevard give way to the marble walls of two of the four great palaces of Epiach. The amount of people traveling in the road here is truly impressive.

46.Name: Tibrooke Boulevard
46.Description: The relatively small road continues here, towards the north gates of the city. Northern Avenue intersects the street here, heading off to the east and west among the various houses and shops of north Epiach.

47.Name: Tibrooke Boulevard
47.Description: The road continues on here, towards the northern gates. The buildings here are smaller and newer than those found elsewhere in the city, suggestion that this area of the city was developed fairly recently.

48.Name: Northern Avenue
48.Description: A lovely grove of trees is located to the north of the road. To the south are the slowly fading marble walls of the temple of Aran.

49.Name: Northern Avenue
49.Description: The majority of the citizens of Epiach live in the many houses here. Each building is two or three stories tall, and look to be decently maintained. The quality of houses here is quite good, considering how large of a city Epiach is. To the south are the massive marble walls of the Epiach Civil Palace.

79.Name: The Great Cathedral of Epiach
79.Description: You crawl through a tiny opening in the hedges... You stand in the inner courtyard of what was once the most beautiful palace in all of Epiach. This place has been ransacked; marble columns lay in the courtyard here, knocked out from the three balconies of the palace, apparently in an attempt to cause the whole building to collapse. As you look up you see the whole of the inner palace and are awestruck even now at its gorgeous architecture. A deep sadness wells up inside you as you image the glory of what it once was. All just a memory now. The plant life here has infested itself everywhere. Hundreds of vines dangle from what columns are still intact. Dark green moss grows on the ground here. Strangely enough you spot, what must certainly be, newly made footsteps leading towards the statue of Aran.

174.Description: The walls of Epiach tower above you as you approach the eastern gate.

175.Name: Nothern Gate Entryway
175.Description: The walls of Epiach tower above you as you approach the northern gate. The huge steel gate is lowered here, barring any progress outside of the city. Off to the north, the ancient mountain road continues off into the Silverspire Foothills.

176.Name: Southern Gate Entryway
176.Description: The walls of Epiach tower above you as you approach the northern gate.

177.Name: The Watchers Hall of Epiach
177.Description: After passing through several gruff looking guards, you enter inside the wooden building. The first thing you notice is the symbol of the Watchers of Chaos. The central hall of the building is well furnished, and a surprising number of people are sitting or standing in here. Sitting in a plus red chair at the far side of the main hall is surely the guildmaster of the Epiach Hall, Ulrad Din'arbor.

178.Name: Epiach Coliseum
178.Description: The sand of the Coliseum floor is raked after each fight to keep it smooth. It feels sturdy under your feet. Up in the stadium, you can hear the audience cheering wildly.

179.Name: Epiach Coliseum Stadium
179.Description: The seating for the Coliseum continues here. The rows of stone benches are not very comfortable, but the blood sport occurring down below surely will take thoughts off of your sore behind.

180.Name: Epiach Coliseum
180.Description: The light smell of blood is something that the Coliseum staff cannot get rid of between fights, no matter how they try. The smell invades your nostrils, invigorating you with an unnatural lust for pain.

182.Description: A long rug stretches across the floor here.  A warm bed a small table are the only other things that adorn this room.

183.Name: Changeway Inn
183.Description: The smooth stone floor runs the length of the hallway.  Sconces line the walls emitting a steady light in the hall. Doors line the sides leading to the various rooms of the Inn.

184.Name: Changeway Inn
184.Description: The foyer of the Inn is very simple and functional.  A cliff bear hide rug lays across the floor in front of a crackling fire and several chairs and benches are all throughout the room.

185.Name: Changeway Inn
185.Description: A small bar lines the wall where people can get drinks or for those in need of accomodations, a room.  Several bear heads are mounted on the wall, and the owner of this establishment must have been an accomplished hunter.

186.Name: Changeway Inn

188.Name: Echo's Private Chambers
188.Description: Not knowing what awaits you on the other side, you turn the key and enter into the room. The door slams behind you. You glance around the room lit only by candles and the gentle glow of the burning fireplace and see a huge soft bed covered in rose petals, wolf hide pillows and bearskin blankets. You see a table with a bottle of rum and two empty glass so you begin to pour yourself a glass. Out of the corner of your eye you catch a glimpse of a table next to the bed lined with handcuffs, blindfolds, riding crops and various other pleasure devices. Suddenly, the door slams! You hear the sound of stiletto�s walking across the hard floor. You feel someone pressed against you from behind and a breathy, sexy voice whispers in your ear, "Well, well... what what do we have here?"

194.Name: Before the Fortress of Epiach
194.Description: To the north is the large steel gate which leads into the Fortress of Epiach. While the city is a prosperous center of trade for the Empire, it still must be defended, and the soldiers who live in the fortress do just that. The fortress is a fully stocked garrison of the Imperial Army, and troops are constantly coming and going.

199.Description: A dark alley leads off of the road to the west here. At the end of the alley, is a small wooden door that leads into an old wooden building. You notice that none of the city guards are patrolling in the alley here.

203.Name: Epiach Grand Boulevard
203.Description: The stone road continues on here, through the market district of Epiach. To the west, a sign on a building reads "The Hide Protector". On a building to the east, there is a picture of a flaming sword with the words "Imperial Steel" written below it.

204.Name: Epiach Grand Boulevard
204.Description: The stone street continues on here, full of city people going about their usual daily business. Numerous stone and wood buildings flank both sides of the street, with many shops on the lower floors and private residences above. To the west is a building with a sign that reads "Woven Wonders".

205.Name: Epiach Grand Boulevard
205.Description: Another stone street heads off to the west here, intersecting with the Grand Boulevard. The crowds are thinning out here, as the boulevard approaches the southern gate. To the east is a building with a sign of a torch and backpack, which reads "The Traveler's Friend".

206.Name: Epiach Grand Boulevard
206.Description: You step foot into the great city of Epiach. From here you can see down Epiach Grand Boulevard. Many stone buildings line its streets. Not many people are in the road here, as most of the crowds and business is conducted closer to the center of the city. Far up the road, you can see the four marble palaces of Epiach.

208.Name: Southern Avenue
208.Description: A wide stone plaza heads off to the north here, which leads to the entrance of the Mages Academy of Epiach. Even from here, you are impressed by the size of the massive building. To the south of a small shop with a picture of a bomb and a glowing crystal. That symbol can mean it is none other then the famous alchemy shop, Zolantar's Trance.

209.Name: Southern Avenue
209.Description: The small marble road continues on here. A grove of well trimmed trees is located to the south, providing a nice change from the monotony of the stone, marble, and wood of the huge city.

210.Name: The Traveler's Friend
210.Description: Stepping inside this large shop, you see a bustling marketplace full of townspeople eagerly searching for things to buy. A few aproned clerks run around, frantically trying to provide service to the many shoppers. The proprietor of the shop is sitting behind a polished oak table top, counting a stack of gold coins.

212.Name: Market Street
212.Description: The wide street continues through the great city of Epiach. Multi story stone buildings line both sides of the street, which house a plethora of shops on the street level and above, homes for the merchants wealthy enough to own shops in the market district. To the west is the Grand Boulevard.

213.Name: Champion Armorers
213.Description: A few well polished suits of platemail hang on racks around the store. The extreme expensive and difficulty in crafting this armor is apparent here, for only a few wealthy looking merchants are in the store. No doubt most of the owner's orders come from the Fortress of Epiach.

214.Name: Blades of Epiach
214.Description: Unlike this stores main competition, Imperial Steel, it is not so immaculately furnished. The variety and quantity of weaponry in here is still impressive, but it is nothing compared to the grand display to be found at Imperial Steel.

215.Name: The Hide Protector
215.Description: Unlike smaller leather armor shops, there is no smell of tanning leather in here. Instead, leather armor of all kinds is located on a variety of armor racks, distributed throughout the store. Thick carpet covers the floor, and is very pleasing to walk on.

216.Name: Imperial Steel
216.Description: Inside the well lit shop, weapons and armor of every kind cover the walls of the place. The center of the shop is open, allowing customers to get a feel for the weapons and armor before purchasing them. Two stoic guards stand near the exit of the shop, and seem more than capable of stopping any potential thief.

217.Name: The Imperial Bank of Epiach
217.Description: The interior of the bank is decorated with all sorts of furniture and art shipped from Atlaand. Plush red carpet covers the floor, making it a delight to walk around. The vaults in the back of the bank are truly massive, and feel your items and money deposited here are nothing but safe.

219.Name: Stone Plaza
219.Description: The stone plaza continues on here. The entire west side of the street meets up with the massive Mages Academy of Epiach, while the east side has more shops.

220.Name: Before the Mages Academy of Epiach
220.Description: To the west is the massive marble and stone building that houses the Mages Academy of Epiach. You can see the spire of the academy towering high above all other buildings in the area.

221.Name: The Mages Academy of Epiach
221.Description: You stand in an enormous hallway. Banners hang from the ceiling with rune symbols on them. The windows here seem to magnify the intensity of the light from outside, the lighting here is magnificent. In between the tall pointed windows are bookshelves lined with thousands of large books. This must be the academy's library.

222.Name: Stone Street
222.Description: The stone road continues on here, through one of the wealthier residential districts of the city. A number of well maintained wooden houses line both sides of the street.

223.Name: Stone Street
223.Description: The stone road continues on here, through one of the wealthier residential districts of the city. A number of well maintained wooden houses line both sides of the street.

224.Name: Stone Street
224.Description: The stone road continues on here, through one of the wealthier residential districts of the city. A number of well maintained wooden houses line both sides of the street. To the west is a small bookstore.

227.Name: Rayven Dalawdac's Bookstore
227.Description: The interior of this shop is well lit and is filled with wooden bookcases. As the might of the Majestic Empire has fallen, so has the literacy rate of the average citizen, and so the shop appears to be in poor condition. The tombs of lore found within these shelves could provide great knowledge and power to those who take the time to read them...

228.Name: Stone Street
228.Description: The stone road continues on here, through one of the wealthier residential districts of the city. A number of well maintained wooden houses line both sides of the street.

229.Name: Epiach Home
229.Description: Several pieces of furniture and bookshelves line the walls of the home of a moderately successful local. The home is relatively clean and neat, no thanks to the random people who barge in.

230.Name: The Mages Academy of Epiach
230.Description: You stand in an enormous hallway. Banners hang from the ceiling with rune symbols on them. The windows here seem to magnify the intensity of the light from outside, the lighting here is magnificent. In between the tall pointy windows are bookshelves lined with thousands of large books. This must be the academy's library. Some book keepers seem to be arranging books by use of their telepathic powers. There is an enormous fireplace in the corner of this room. Large cushioned chairs are placed in a semi circle around it. This looks like a cosy place to study.

231.Name: The Mages Academy of Epiach
231.Description: The entrance to the Mages Academy of Epiach is surrounded by a beautiful assortment of exotic plants and flowers. Marble arches provide the entrances to the Academy to the north and the south of the garden.

232.Name: The Mages Academy of Epiach
232.Description: As you step into the water you have a strange sensation of cold then quickly warmth. As if the water changed its temperature just to accommodate you. You feel a supernatural rush of relaxation and mental peace from the soothing movement of the warm waters. The fish aren't scared of you either. Nothing ceases to amaze you here, especially the fact that although you are submerged within the waters you do not even feel wet.

233.Name: The Mages Academy of Epiach
233.Description: A great stone staircase leads up to the second floor. The stairs, as well as the carpet, are carpeted in blue with gold trimming. A large crystalline chandelier hangs from the ceiling above you causing some interesting lighting effects along the stairs as you walk upwards.

234.Name: The Mages Academy of Epiach
234.Description: You stand in an enormous hallway. Banners hang from the ceiling with rune symbols on them. The windows here seem to magnify the intensity of the light from outside, the lighting here is magnificent. In between the tall pointy windows are bookshelves lined with thousands of large books. This must be the academy's library.

235.Name: Stone Plaza
235.Description: The stone plaza continues on here. The entire west side of the street meets up with the massive Mages Academy of Epiach, while the east side has more shops.

236.Name: Woven Wonders
236.Description: Woven Wonders is a small shop, compared to some of the massive places located in the market district here. A number of shelves are located in here, each covered with various finely created clothing. An elderly lady sits behind the shop counter, smiling at the small number of patrons silently looking at the different clothing available.

239.Name: Small Home
239.Description: The small home is cozy and comfortable but not extravagant in the least.  It is obviously the home of one of the less prominent members of Epiach.

240.Name: Epiach Home
240.Description: Several pieces of furniture and bookshelves line the walls of the home of a moderately successful local. The home is relatively clean and neat, no thanks to the random people who barge in.

241.Name: Small Home
241.Description: The small home is cozy and comfortable but not extravagant in the least.  It is obviously the home of one of the less prominent members of Epiach.

242.Name: Epiach Guardian Office
242.Description: Several dark polished wooden desks line the bare walls.  All in all this building is not much to look at.

243.Name: Zolantar's Trance
243.Description: The pungent smell of potions and other alchemical goodies overwhelm you as you enter the small shop. The shelves and tables are completely covered with various potions, plants, and trinkets relating to alchemy. The proprietor of the establishment, none other than Zolantar himself, sits behind the counter, grinding at a number of mortar and pestles.

244.Name: Falling Star Public House
244.Description: The falling star is the pride establishment of high class citizens throughout Epiach. From its fine china, choice food and drinks, and service, it is the epitome of luxury!

246.Name: The Epiach Bazaar
246.Description: This brand new shop is full of tables covered with various weapons and armor for sale. The shop's owner, Olaf, recently moved to Epiach from Sucaran and is eager for his shop to gain the reputation as the only place for people to sell their wares in all of Southern Majestia.

247.Name: Manor Courtyard
247.Description: Massive courtyard with a beautiful fountain centerpiece can be seen in the distance.

249.Name: Manor Courtyard
249.Description: There lies an incredible, large fountain in as the centerpiece of the courtyard. You can see the glistening of gold coins tossed into the fountain.

261.Name: Stone Street
261.Description: The stone road continues on here, through one of the wealthier residential districts of the city. A number of well maintained wooden houses line both sides of the street.

262.Name: Home Street
262.Description: The majority of the citizens of Epiach live in the many houses here. Each building is two or three stories tall, and look to be decently maintained. The quality of houses here is quite good, considering how large of a city Epiach is.

263.Name: Home Street
263.Description: The majority of the citizens of Epiach live in the many houses here. Each building is two or three stories tall, and look to be decently maintained. The quality of houses here is quite good, considering how large of a city Epiach is.

264.Name: Home Street
264.Description: The majority of the citizens of Epiach live in the many houses here. Each building is two or three stories tall, and look to be decently maintained. The quality of houses here is quite good, considering how large of a city Epiach is.

265.Name: Home Street
265.Description: The majority of the citizens of Epiach live in the many houses here. Each building is two or three stories tall, and look to be decently maintained. The quality of houses here is quite good, considering how large of a city Epiach is.

266.Name: Southern Avenue
266.Description: The avenue turns to the north here, and continues on into a peaceful residential district. This party of the city is relativly quiet, as it is far from the huge crowds of people near the central parts of the city. To the south is another refreshing grove of trees.

267.Name: Southern Avenue
267.Description: The stone road here is not as big as the Grand Boulevard to the east, but is still a road of significant size. All along the street are stone and wooden buildings. A steady stream of people continue on the road here, all with the look of people who know exactly where they are headed.

269.Name: Southern Avenue
269.Description: The stone road here is not as big as the Grand Boulevard to the east, but is still a road of significant size. All along the street are stone and wooden buildings. A steady stream of people continues on the road here, all with the look of people who know exactly where they are headed.

270.Name: Market Street
270.Description: The wide street continues through the great city of Epiach. Multi story stone buildings line both sides of the street, which house a plethora of shops on the street level and above, homes for the merchants wealthy enough to own shops in the market district. To the north is a large stone building, with the words Imperial Bank of Epiach engraved above the large doorway.

272.Name: Before the Mansion
272.Description: To the east here is the entrance to the gardened courtyard of the biggest residence in the city. The current owner, Yevrick Diatlan, is said to have made a fortune selling jewels in Atlaand, and has only recently moved to Epiach to escape the hectic life that comes with living in the capital of the Empire.

275.Name: Market Street
275.Description: The wide street continues through the great city of Epiach. Multi story stone buildings line both sides of the street, which house a plethora of shops on the street level and above, homes for the merchants wealthy enough to own shops in the market district.

276.Name: Market Street
276.Description: The wide street continues through the great city of Epiach. Multi story stone buildings line both sides of the street, which house a plethora of shops on the street level and above, homes for the merchants wealthy enough to own shops in the market district. To the north is the newly opened Epiach Bazaar.

277.Name: Market Street
277.Description: The wide street continues through the great city of Epiach. Multi story stone buildings line both sides of the street, which house a plethora of shops on the street level and above, homes for the merchants wealthy enough to own shops in the market district.

278.Name: Market Street
278.Description: The wide street continues through the great city of Epiach. Multi story stone buildings line both sides of the street, which house a plethora of shops on the street level and above, homes for the merchants wealthy enough to own shops in the market district.

279.Name: Market Street
279.Description: The wide street continues through the great city of Epiach. Multi story stone buildings line both sides of the street, which house a plethora of shops on the street level and above, homes for the merchants wealthy enough to own shops in the market district.

280.Name: Stone Road
280.Description: A number of well built houses surround both sides of the road here. The street continues north to intersect with Aravin Avenue, and towards Market Street to the south.

281.Name: Aravin Avenue
281.Description: Aravin Avenue turns south into Market Street here, and more and more shops begin to take the places of residences here.

283.Name: The Royal Consulate
283.Description: You turn the key and push open the heavy door. You enter a grand room illuminated by a warm glowing fireplace. Large tapestries and beautiful paintings of our King and Queen and the members of The Royal Family adorn the walls. In the center of the room is a large wooden table with many chairs seated around it. On the table sits golden goblets and plates and a huge feast to fill your empty belly after a long day of battle and weary travels.

284.Name: The Fortress of Epiach
284.Description: This isn't exactly the most beautiful courtyard you've ever seen. It is just a flat area with spots of dead grass and mud puddles.

285.Name: The Catacombs
285.Description: You find this place to be lit with torches. You hear singing from the hall to the west of you. A strange light seems to emanate from across the corner. These tunnels must be the secret catacombs of the Cathedral of Aran!

286.Name: Beneath the Church
286.Description: The dark stone passage continues down, far below the huge church above.

287.Name: Beneath the Church
287.Description: You venture down into the black to find what feels like a very narrow staircase leading downwards. You hear water dripping down below...

288.Name: The Mages Academy of Epiach
288.Description: Some of the most beautiful plants you've ever seen grow here. The whole second story is one giant courtyard it seems. There are many trees with pink leaves and some ponds with small fish in them. There are many benches to sit on, not to mention the most green grass you have ever seen in your life.

289.Name: The Mages Academy of Epiach
289.Description: Some of the most beautiful plants you've ever seen grow here. The whole second story is one giant courtyard it seems. There are many trees with pink leaves and some ponds with small fish in them. There are many benches to sit on, not to mention the greenest grass you have ever seen in your life.

290.Name: The Mages Academy of Epiach
290.Description: Some of the most beautiful plants you've ever seen grow here. The whole second story is one giant courtyard it seems. There are many trees with pink leaves and some ponds with small fish in them. There are many benches to sit on, not to mention the greenest grass you have ever seen in your life.

291.Name: The Mages Academy of Epiach
291.Description: There are twelve private classrooms along here, six on either side. You walk quietly and try not to disturb.

292.Name: The Mages Academy of Epiach
292.Description: The stairs continue to wind upwards. A large crystalline chandelier hangs from the ceiling above you causing some interesting lighting effects along the stairs as you walk upwards.

293.Name: The Mages Academy of Epiach
293.Description: After knocking on a wooden door and being allowed to enter, you stand in the study of Arch Mage Khume, 34th Head of the Mages Academy of Epiach and a council member of the Council of Magi. The walls of the room are lined with bookshelves, each of which are neatly filled with hundreds of books in a multitude of languages, both modern and ancient. A carved oak desk in the middle of the room provides a place for Khume to do his work, and his high backed marble chair looks much like a throne. Two tapestries hanging near the elaborate window to the west show the symbol of the Majestic Empire and the flaming clenched fist of the Council of Magi.

294.Name: The Fortress of Epiach
294.Description: You stand inside the upper fortress. Its walls are covered in banners with symbols representing all that the empire stands for. There are tables with detailed maps and golden pieces to mark the placement of troops. All eyes are on you as you quietly inspect the room. It?s a surprise they let you in considering you are not a high ranking officer. They seem both anxious and impatient for you to report.

295.Name: The Fortress of Epiach
295.Description: You stand atop the walls of the fortress. Many guardsmen patrol here armed with deadly bows and plenty of ammunition. You can see all the way down Lemoiak Avenue from here. You understand the placement of the guild now. If the eastern or northern gates ever were to fall under attack archers could be deployed quickly to either of northern or eastern gates. And if those gates were ever broken incoming attackers would be devastated by the archers of this fortress, being that the fortress is in perfect firing range of both gate entryways.

296.Name: The Fortress of Epiach
296.Description: You stand atop the walls of the fortress. Many guardsmen patrol here armed with deadly bows and plenty of ammunition. You can see all the way down Lemoiak Avenue from here. You understand the placement of the guild now. If the eastern or northern gates ever were to fall under attack archers could be deployed quickly to either of northern or eastern gates. And if those gates were ever broken incoming attackers would be devastated by the archers of this fortress, being that the fortress is in perfect firing range of both gate entryways.

And if those gates were ever broken incoming attackers would be devastated by the archers of this fortress, being that the fortress is in perfect firing range of both gate entryways.

298.Description: You stand inside the upper fortress. Its walls are covered in banners with symbols representing all that the empire stands for. There are tables with detailed maps and golden pieces to mark the placement of troops. All eyes are on you as you quietly inspect the room. It?s a surprise they let you in considering you are not a high ranking officer. They seem both anxious and impatient for you to report.

299.Name: The Fortress of Epiach
299.Description: There is a large round stone table here, elevated somewhat from the rest of the room. As you walk forward you see many high ranking officers standing around it pointing and nodding as they discuss very seriously what needs to be done. They most certainly are aware of your presence, but take their time in glancing up to acknowledge you.

300.Name: The Catacombs
300.Description: You find this place to be lit with torches. You hear singing from the hall to the west of you. You have to duck in order to move the ceiling is so low.  A strange light seems to emanate from across the corner.

301.Name: The Catacombs
301.Description: You find this place to be lit with torches. You hear singing from the hall to the west of you. You have to duck in order to move the ceiling is so low.  A strange light seems to emanate from across the corner.

302.Name: The Catacombs
302.Description: The light from this hall is astounding! You are almost blinded by it! You have no idea what would be singing, but you definitely hear it getting louder and louder.

303.Name: The Catacombs
303.Description: The light from this hall is astounding! You are almost blinded by it! You have no idea what would be singing, but you definitely hear it getting louder and louder.

304.Name: The Catacombs
304.Description: You stumble around! Blinded by the godlike radiance.

305.Name: The Catacombs
305.Description: The light of this room was not meant to be seen with human eyes. It is incredible and terrifying at the same time. You refrain from opening your eyes, and don't feel the need to venture any further.

306.Name: The Catacombs
306.Description: You stumble around! Blinded by the godlike radiance.

307.Name: The Epiach Civil Palace
307.Description: The marble hallway of the civil palace continues here. Various important looking officials travel back and forth here, and others are standing in various parts of the palace talking about the politics of the city.

308.Name: The Catacombs
308.Description: You stumble around! Blinded by the godlike radiance.

312.Name: The Epiach Civil Palace
312.Description: The spiral staircase leads down to the first floor or the palace, and two marble hallways lead off to the south and the north.

313.Name: The Catacombs
313.Description: You find this place to be lit with torches. You hear singing off in a distance. You have to duck in order to move the ceiling is so low.

314.Name: The Epiach Civil Palace
314.Description: The marble hallway of the civil palace continues here. Various important looking officials travel back and forth here, and others are standing in various parts of the palace talking about the politics of the city.

315.Name: The Catacombs
315.Description: This part of the catacombs is better lit, and around you are several living quarters, no doubt of those who have defied the decree of the late Emperor Gregorin and still declare open allegiance to the Church of Aran.

316.Name: The Governor's Hall
316.Description: The marble hallway opens up here to a huge room, decorated more elaborately than anywhere else in the city. This is the Governor's Hall, which is where the Tribunal of Governors gather to conduct city business. It has several large windows in the southern and eastern walls which allow a view down into the central plaza of Epiach.

317.Name: Office of the Registrar
317.Description: Epiach is a unique city in the Majestic Empire, because it has it's own Imperial Registrar. Lord Curadis has been ordered to Epiach by Empress Olina, in order to provide base imperial services were before only able to be gotten in Atlaand. The office is well furnished, and has quite a few mementos reminding Curadis of his home far away in Atlaand.

318.Name: The Catacombs
318.Description: This part of the catacombs is better lit, and around you are several living quarters, no doubt of those who have defied the decree of the late Emperor Gregorin and still declare open allegiance to the Church of Aran.

322.Name: The Catacombs
322.Description: The lighting is very good here, and to the east is a large room that is no doubt the office and living area of the head of the now defunct Church in Epiach.

323.Name: The Catacombs
323.Description: This part of the catacombs is better lit, and around you are several living quarters, no doubt of those who have defied the decree of the late Emperor Gregorin and still declare open allegiance to the Church of Aran.

324.Name: The Catacombs Pit of Darkness
324.Description: This part of the catacombs is better lit, and around you are several living quarters, no doubt of those who have defied the decree of the late Emperor Gregorin and still declare open allegiance to the Church of Aran.

325.Name: The Catacombs
325.Description: Set up in the corner of the dark catacombs here, is a small living quarters, better furnished than the others located down here. A worn and slightly burnt tapestry hangs on the wall. There is enough light to notice that it is a picture of the symbol of Aran floating over an aging picture of the old Cathedral.

326.Name: Beneath the Church
326.Description: You venture down into the black to find what feels like a very narrow staircase leading downwards. You hear water dripping down below...

327.Name: Epiach Coliseum Stadium
327.Description: Directly below you is the sandy floor of the Coliseum. Built into a natural stone bowl, this place is famous all throughout the Empire as the place to go to watch a good fight. To the south is the Arena Master's stand, and to the north is more spectator seating.

328.Name: Arena Master's Stand
328.Description: The large wooden stand built over the Coliseum houses the plush red throne of the Arena Master. This man is responsible for all fights that occur in the Coliseum, and before his retirement was a famous duelist himself. He now works closely with Lord Curadis to ensure that Epiach is the entertainment capital of the Empire.

329.Name: Epiach Coliseum
329.Description: The sand of the Coliseum floor is raked after each fight to keep it smooth. It feels sturdy under your feet. Up in the stadium, you can hear the audience cheering wildly.

330.Name: Epiach Coliseum
330.Description: The sand floor of the Coliseum is cleaned after each match, to keep it clean of blood and severed limbs and other remnants of the violent fights that go on here. The sand gives your feet a good quick grip.

331.Name: Epiach Coliseum
331.Description: The sand of the Coliseum floor is raked after each fight to keep it smooth. It feels sturdy under your feet. Up in the stadium, you can hear the audience cheering wildly.

335.Name: The Hall of Heroes Staircase
335.Description: The elaborate staircase continues up further through the marble palace. You can tell by the fine artistry and condition of the interior that this is a more recent addition to the palace.

336.Name: The Hall of Heroes
336.Description: A sign at the top of the staircase reads, "Welcome to the Hall of Heroes". Fresh air seeps in through the ornate slits in the marble walls around you. The light reflecting off the jeweled surfaces around is almost blinding.

337.Name: The Hall of Heroes
337.Description: Fresh air seeps in through the ornate slits in the marble walls around you. The walls and the floors are coated in dazzling jewels and the atmosphere here is even more majestic than the rest of the palace.

338.Name: The Hall of Heroes
338.Description: Fresh air seeps in through the ornate slits in the marble walls around you. The walls and the floors are coated in dazzling jewels and the atmosphere here is even more majestic than the rest of the palace.

348.Name: Stone Street
348.Description: The stone road continues on here. Though this is a recent addition to the city it seems as though there's already a few shops set up around here. You get the feeling that this isn't like any other part of the city though and wonder what the plan for the new construction may be.

351.Name: Stone Street
351.Description: The stone road continues on here. Though this is a recent addition to the city it seems as though there's already a few shops set up around here. You get the feeling that this isn't like any other part of the city though and wonder what the plan for the new construction may be.

352.Name: Josep's Toy Chest
352.Description: This little shop was just built recently. There are shelves lined with various sized boxes with pictures of the same face on each of them. For whatever reason you feel a chill run down your spine as you look around. Maybe you shouldn't have walked in here after all?

353.Name: Stone Street
353.Description: The stone road continues on here. Though this is a recent addition to the city it seems as though there's already a few shops set up around here. You get the feeling that this isn't like any other part of the city though and wonder what the plan for the new construction may be.

354.Name: Epiach Theater
354.Description: Upon entering the doors to this large building you can immediately tell what kind of place this is. It's a Playhouse! The scents of various foods commingling together fills the air. The carpeting is a deep crimson and artwork decorates the wood panelled walls all around. There's a ticket counter ahead with an eloquently dressed gentleman standing behind it.

355.Name: Epiach Theater
355.Description: The enormous room is dimly lit and you see rows of comfortable looking seating lining the aisles. You don't appear to have a seat number on your ticket so you can probably just sit wherever you like. You decide to find a spot before the curtains open.

55.Name: Bridge over the Raim River
55.Description: This massive stone bridge crossing the Raim River is nothing short of a remarkable creation. Its construction outdates the current highway traveling through this region, judging by the worn ancient stones beneath your feet.

The well traveled road here leads off to the north, towards the huge city of Epiach.

104.Name: A Farm House

105.Name: Epiach Grasslands

347.Description: Stone statues of angry looking Orcs line the walls of the passage, as it leads south into the throne room. There is a rack full of massive battle axes on the left side of the hallway, that must be the weapons for the thone room guards.

410.Description: The grasslands suddenly end before a massive stone wall to the south. A hulking fortress is before you, and it is quite an impossing sight. Angry cries can be heard from inside the walls. Along the outskirts of the wall, blooded skulls impaled on wooden stakes are in no short supply.

412.Description: The grasslands here give way quickly to a lush riparian area surrounding the Raim river. It is definitely a fine change in scenery from the endless grass of the Epiach Fields.

418.Name: Pedro's House
418.Description: The central area of Pedro's house has many rooms for guests to stay in. Pedro is well known for his large "country parties", and has people staying at his place all the time. Another hallway to the south leads to his own bedroom.

419.Name: A Dirt Tunnel
419.Description: The bottom fo the dirt tunnel is covered with the bones of past adventurers who attempted to break into the Orc fortress to steal the rumored fortunes. Instead, all the fools ended up doing was to get killed. The tunnel leads to the north, where a hole in the underground wall of the fortress is.

420.Name: Before a Gigantic Fortress
420.Description: The grasslands suddenly end before a massive stone wall to the north. A hulking fortress is before you, and it is quite an impossing sight. Angry cries can be heard from inside the walls. Along the outskirts of the wall, blooded skulls impaled on wooden stakes are in no short supply.

421.Name: The Orc Throne Room
421.Description: The damp air and dark interior of the orc fortress is somewhat lessened her due to several large open flames burning on both sides of the room. A tattered carpet leads through the middle of the chamber, and a garantuan throne lays at the end of the carpet.

422.Name: A Storeroom
422.Description: The dark stone walls of this storageroom keep its contents nice and cold. The actual contents kept in here ... you probably don't want to know.

423.Name: Pedro's House
423.Description: The foyer to Pedro's house is grand, filled with polished wooden furniture. Lush carpeting covers the floor, keeping a certain warmth inside the house. To the west, a hallway leads to the rest of the house.

424.Name: Epiach Farmlands
424.Description: You stand amongst the planted crops of Pedro the farmer. His advanced farming methods are the wonder of everyone in Epiach, and he consistantly grows more than anyone else.

425.Name: Pedro's Love Room
425.Description: The master bedroom of the house is a veritable love palace, filled with all sorts of silk sheets and various potions to aid Pedro in his love making. You wonder how a farmer, even a rich one, could be so preoccupied with females.

426.Name: Epiach Grasslands
426.Description: The flat grass here continues, south of the farms. Further south is a dense riparian area bordering the Raim river.

427.Name: Woodland Along the Raim River
427.Description: The lush trees here make up a delightful riparian area which flanks the Raim River. A variety of creatures live here, where water is close and fish are able to be easily caught from the river.
