0.Name: The Southern Road
0.Description: You stand on the Southern Road, which leads out of the great town of Myronmet.  The road, which has been worn down over the years by the carts of many travelers, runs to the east and west from here

1.Name: The Southern Road
1.Description: To the West you see the swamp town of Myronmet.  To the east the road enters a dense forest.

2.Name: The Southern Road
2.Description: You have reached the edge of the Ilundium Forest.  The Southern Road continues to the east and west from here.

3.Name: The Southern Road
3.Description: The dense tree cover makes it very difficult to see much here, luckily, enough light is provided such that you can see that the Southern Road contiunes to the East and West.

4.Name: The Southern Road
4.Description: A sign on the road indicates that the main path continues to the North and West from here.  A smaller sign underneath tells you that a lesser-used path stretches to the South.

5.Name: The Southern Road
5.Description: The historic Southern Road weaves its way through the forest here.  A plaque posted on a tree here warns you to beware of goblins.  A path heads through the brush to the north.

6.Name: The Southern Road
6.Description: You stand on an east-west portion of the Southern Road.  The massive amount of trees here makes it hard to discern your surroundings.  Luckily, you can just make out the path ahead of you.

7.Name: Fork in the Southern Road
7.Description: You have reached a fork in the Southern Road.  To the north lies the Old Road, while the Southern Road proper continues to the south.

8.Name: The Southern Road
8.Description: The Southern Road continues to the South here.  The chirps of nearby animals fills your ears.  This part of the forest seems especially full of life.

9.Name: The Southern Road
9.Description: The Southern Road continues through the forest.  You begin to realize just how vast this wood really is.

10.Name: The Southern Road
10.Description: Although the main Southern Road continues to the east and the west, you notice lesser used paths to the north and south here.

11.Name: The Southern Road
11.Description: The Southern Road continues through the forest.  You begin to realize just how vast this wood really is.

12.Name: The Southern Road
12.Description: You are on a north-south segment of the road.  Despite the fact that this is one of the worst maintained roads you have been on, it is rather indescript.

13.Name: The Southern Road
13.Description: You are on a north-south segment of the road.  Despite the fact that this is one of the worst maintained roads you have been on, it is rather indescript.

14.Name: The Southern Road
14.Description: You are on a north-south segment of the road.  Despite the fact that this is one of the worst maintained roads you have been on, it is rather indescript. A small path leads to the east.

15.Name: The Southern Road
15.Description: You are on a north-south segment of the road.  Despite the fact that this is one of the worst maintained roads you have been on, it is rather indescript.

16.Name: The Southern Road
16.Description: You are on a north-south segment of the road.  Despite the fact that this is one of the worst maintained roads you have been on, it is rather indescript.

17.Name: The Southern Road
17.Description: The road weaves to the south and east from here.

18.Name: The Southern Road
18.Description: The ill-maintained Southern Road progresses to the west and east from here.

19.Name: The Southern Road
19.Description: You stand on the Southern Road.  Nothing too special about this part of the road.

20.Name: The Southern Road
20.Description: You stand on the Southern Road.  Nothing too special about this part of the road.

21.Name: The Southern Road
21.Description: You stand on the once-great Southern Road. Unfortunately, the road has seen its better days, as it is greatly in meed of maintenance.

22.Name: The Southern Road
22.Description: The well-worn path continues to the north and south here.  A large amount of trash clutters the area.  Disgusted, you make a mental note to call the Adopt-A-Road program and have them send some people out to clean up this mess.

23.Name: The Old Road
23.Description: You stand on the Old Road. While used less than the Southern Road, it still provides a more comfortable way of getting around than fighting your way through the forest.

24.Name: The Old Road
24.Description: The Old road continues to head north and south here. The actual condition of the road is quite good considering its name.

25.Name: The Old Road
25.Description: The Old Road continues here.  The shimmer of a shiny object catches your eye along the path, but upon further inspection you realize it is only a small button, relatively worthless...

26.Name: The Old Road
26.Description: The Old Road continues to the north here through the forest.

27.Name: Ilundium Forest
27.Description: You are on a path in the Ilundium Forest.  The sounds of the forest surround you as you make your way through the dim light.

28.Name: Maloney's Magics
28.Description: B. Maloney, a friendly troll, peddles his magical wares here.  However, beware, for his items are not always what they may seem.

35.Description: Benjamin McClune, once a respected resident of the town of Myronmet and now a marked outlaw, makes his residence here.  Although he himself has not been seen for years, members of his gang can frequently be found here.  You remember a sign in town informing you that they are wanted... dead or alive.

36.Name: Tree Stump
36.Description: A tree stump lies in the middle of this clearing.  By counting the tree rings you figure out that this tree was 604 years old when it was cut.  You proceed to thank your lucky stars you learned about tree ring dating when you were younger.

53.Description: Mystic runes can be seen all around this clearing.

54.Name: Dead End
54.Description: The path ends abruptly, and clearly you have turned the wrong way.  Although you can hear the bustle of the Southern Road, you cannot reach it directly from here.

60.Description: You stand on an east-west path in the Ilundium Forest.  Over the normal sounds of forest animals, you hear a wailing noise from the south.

61.Description: You are a path in the Ilundium Forest.  The sounds of the forest surround you as you make your way through the dim light.

62.Name: Ilundium Forest
62.Description: You stand on one of the many paths through the Ilundium Forest.  Although light here is very scarce, you see that the path contiunes to the west and north.

63.Name: Tower Entrance
63.Description: You stand before a fairly large tower in the middle of the forest.  Although abandoned years ago by the original owners, and certainly in dire need of repair, you can sense that something evil has been living there recently. A steel lock is covers a stone door leading down.

64.Name: Ilundium Forest
64.Description: You are a path in the Ilundium Forest.  The sounds of the forest surround you as you make your way through the dim light.

66.Description: You are a path in the Ilundium Forest.  The sounds of the forest surround you as you make your way through the dim light.

67.Name: Tower Floor One
67.Description: A short staircaise leads through the main doors of the tower to the outside from here.  In the entranceway, large statues, long ago stripped of anything remotely valuable, stare at you.

68.Name: The Shack Al'Fraze
68.Description: You stand inside the Al'Fraze shack.  You can't help but notice the overwhelming amount of goodberries lying around.  One wonders what plans someone has for them.

69.Name: Goblin Lair
69.Description: You stand in the entrance to the goblin lair.  The amount of bones along the walls make you realize that these goblins mean business.  You pray that you are prepared enough to take on these vile beasts.

70.Name: Tower Floor One
70.Description: You are on the first floor of the tower, its small rooms, while slighty stuffy, were once elegant quarters, although some of the flair has deteriorated with time.

71.Name: Tower Floor One
71.Description: You are on the first floor of the tower, its small rooms, while slighty stuffy, were once elegant quarters, although some of the flair has deteriorated with time.

72.Name: Tower Floor One
72.Description: You are on the first floor of the tower, its small rooms, while slighty stuffy, were once elegant quarters, although some of the flair has deteriorated with time.  A stairwell leads upstairs from here.

73.Name: Tower Floor Two
73.Description: The second floor of the tower has deteriorated much quicker than the first, and the signs of struggle are present throughout the rooms.  You could swear that some of the markings on the walls are bloodstains, but you try to ignore it for the time being.

74.Name: Tower Floor Two
74.Description: The decayed tower continues here. There is definitly something wrong with this place, as you get a great foreboding of something very evil above you.

75.Name: Tower Floor Two
75.Description: The decayed tower continues here. The ancient stone is unnaturally cold, and you get chilled as you walk around.

76.Name: Tower Floor Two
76.Description: A trail of blood lines the partially broken stone staircase here leading to the third floor. It seems to be safe to walk up, but you never know...

77.Name: Tower Floor Three
77.Description: The Third floor is almost barren when compared to the relative elegance of the first two. Apparently this part of the tower has been set up as a torture chamber, judging by the various instruments of death laying around.

78.Name: Tower Floor Three

80.Name: Tower Floor Three
80.Description: Another stone staircase leads to the top floor of the tower. You sense a great presence of evil above you, and a faint blue mist is floating down from the top of the staircase.

81.Name: Tower Floor Four
81.Description: A thick and very cold mist obstructs much of your vision up here. You smell the putrid scent of rotting flesh and of fresh blood.

82.Name: Tower Floor Four
82.Description: A thick and very cold mist obstructs much of your vision up here. You smell the putrid scent of rotting flesh and of fresh blood.

83.Name: Tower Floor Four
83.Description: The horrid stench and the evil mist only get thicker here. Ahead of you appears to be some sort of make shift altar, no doubt to an evil god judging by the trail of blood leading up to it.

84.Name: Tower Floor Four
84.Description: A terrible altar of evil is here, which has been created out of a defiled symbol of Aran. A pool of fresh blood stains the rotting stone floor, and the evil mist is eminating from the altar. You begin to prefer even the darkest part of the forest over this place.

124.Description: Flowers cover the ground in this clearing, neatly arranged to make a beautiful pattern.

127.Description: A Well lies in the middle of a small clearing.  However, the bucket is missing, so you can't get anything out of it at this time.

130.Name: Talan Phraze's Shack
130.Description: A ramshackle house is put together loosely in this small clearing.  Talan Phraze, a friendly troll, makes his residence here.  He shows you his brand new tattoo, the symbol from a popular troll game from about 5 years ago.

131.Name: Ilundium Forest
131.Description: You are a path in the Ilundium Forest.  The sounds of the forest surround you as you make your way through the dim light.

132.Name: A Broken Cart
132.Description: A man stands here, obviously needing help to fix the axle on his cart.  If only you had the proper tools to help out.

133.Name: Goblin Passageway
133.Description: Built for defense purposes, this passageway allows for advance warning of intruders in the nearby guard gate... you can bet that if they find you threatining, they will be ready for your arrival.

134.Name: Goblin Guard Post
134.Description: Despite the wretched existance the goblins live, their defence mechanisms are quite ingenious.  This room affords attack from all four directions, as long as the proper warning is given.

135.Name: Goblin Passageway
135.Description: This passageway curves to the East and South.  Intricate markings on the wall indicate that some sort of planning went on here.

136.Name: Goblin War Room
136.Description: This, to the best of your knowledge, would be a war room for the goblin lair.  All kinds of strategy might be unfolded in here, but you're glad that no schemes are being hatched at the current moment.

137.Name: Goblin Hallway
137.Description: This hallway seperates the living quarters of the lair from the outside.  Torches line the walls, dimly lighting your surroundings.

138.Name: Southern Passageway
138.Description: The southern passageway is a little bit dimmer than the northern counterpart.  It extends to the East from here.

139.Name: Goblin Trash Heap
139.Description: Yuck, the stench from this room is overwhelming, as the trash from the goblin lair is stored in this area.  You would like to leave this room as soon as possible.

140.Name: Goblin storage
140.Description: This room has the sole purpose of being a storage area for the goblins, primarily for their food.

141.Name: Goblin Hallway
141.Description: The dimly lit hallway turns to the north here. There is a small room to the south which is used by the Forest goblins here to store gathered food.

142.Name: Goblin Hallway
142.Description: This hallway leads to the various rooms of the lair.  To the north lies another storage area, while to the east lies another hallway.

143.Name: Goblin Storage Area
143.Description: This is a storage room for the goblins.  Nothing else about this area is particularly notable.

144.Name: Goblin Hallway
144.Description: The torch lit goblin hallway stretches from north to south here, another exit is to the east.

145.Name: Goblin Hallway
145.Description: This hallway connects the rear half of the Goblin Lair to the front.

146.Name: Goblin Lair
146.Description: This hallway connects the rear half of the Goblin Lair to the front.

147.Name: Goblin Hallway
147.Description: To the north lie the goblin prince's quarters.  The halway turns the corner to the west and stretches on to the throne room.

148.Name: Prince's quarters
148.Description: The Goblin Prince resides in this room.  Lavishly decorated (as far as goblins are concerned), it is one of the few places in the lair you would call "homey".

149.Name: Goblin Hallway
149.Description: This hallway leads to the throne room of the Goblin Lair.

150.Name: Goblin Princess' Quarters
150.Description: This is the room of the Goblin Princess.  The sheer elegance of this room is remarkable, as human treasures have been placed in the room, commemmorating Goblin victories.

151.Name: Goblin Hallway
151.Description: This hallway stretches to the north and south from here.

152.Name: Goblin Hallway
152.Description: The Hallway curves to the East here.

153.Name: Goblin Hallway
153.Description: To the south lie the goblin princess' quarters, the main hallway continues to the west.

154.Name: Goblin Treasure Room
154.Description: This is the Goblin treasure room.  Usually closely guarded, it has been treasure-free for some time now...

155.Name: Goblin Hallway
155.Description: This hallway leads to the throne room of the Goblin Lair.

156.Name: Goblin Hallway
156.Description: This hallway leads to the throne room of the Goblin Lair.  You hear the crackling of a fireplace in the distance

157.Name: The Great Hall
157.Description: This is the great room of the Lair, and to the East lies the throne room itself.  The immense size of this room makes you wonder if it is used for paries and social gatherings.

158.Name: Throne Room
158.Description: The throne of the king and queen lie in this room.  Unfortunately, though the thrones are stately indeed, they contain nothing of value to the average traveler.

159.Name: Goblin Treasure Room
159.Description: This is where the Goblin's most prized treasures are kept.  While the front treasure room is left empty, this room still containes some valuable merchandise... should you manage to get by those guarding it.

160.Name: The Ruined Tower Basement
160.Description: The dark and dank basement of the tower has seen better days. Cob webs and cracked stone are abundant, with piles of dirt leaking in from the ruined walls. To the south there is a large stone tomb.

161.Name: The Ruined Tower Basement
161.Description: The tower cellar basement turns to the east. There is a massive stone tomb here, with an illegable name carved onto the side of it.

162.Name: The Ruined Tower Cellar
162.Description: A small book stand here has an ancient iron bound book on it. The light is too poor here to make out what the book could be about.

163.Name: A Grassy Pathway
163.Description: The forrest gives way abruptly to a large grassy path. The trees here have obviously been cut down. To the west, you see the large wooden walls of the Conclave of Watchers's building.

164.Name: Entrance to the Conclave of Watchers
164.Description: Beyond the simple wooden doors of the building, you see a very plain interior. A few torches burn along the walls to provide light, but you get the impression that the people who live here like the darkness.

165.Name: The Conclave of Watchers
165.Description: This is the central room of the Conclave's building. Around you, people stand talking in small groups. The members of the Conclave rejected the petty guild affiliations of Myronmet and went off on their own to live in the Forrest. To the west of the meeting room of the Conclave, and to the south the hall continues.

166.Name: The Hall of the Conclave
166.Description: A large wooden table with many seats is located in the center of this room. The decorations in here are much more elaborate, but they are still very grim. This is where the higher up members of the Conclave gather to talk about political happenings in the world around and them how they can continue to stay as neutral as possible.

167.Name: The Conclave of Watchers
167.Description: The people standing around here are much more lively, and there are more torches here to provide better light. The merchants of the Conclave gather here to sell their wares and to look for curious new items to add to their own collections.

0.Name: Entering the Forsaken Wastelands
0.Description: The broken road sinks down underneath the sand, where it will probably rest forever. The rolling dunes of this part of the desert have been called the 'Forsaken Wastelands of Aran'.  Over time it has shortened to just 'Forsaken Wastelands'.

1.Name: Brevaran Dunes
1.Description: The Brevaran Dunes stretch out far to the east of you, obscuring the horizon, and concealing how dangerous the wastelands really are.

2.Name: Brevaran Dunes
2.Description: The Brevaran Dunes stretch out far to the east of you, obscuring the horizon, and concealing how dangerous the wastelands really are.

3.Name: Brevaran Dunes
3.Description: A slow wind blows the rough sand south across the wasteland, a dry breeze that seems to rob your mouth of spit and chap your lips to cracking.  Putting one foot in front of the other, you traverse across the dunes. There is nothing else to see, so that is all you can concentrate on.

5.Name: Dark Dunes
5.Description: Lying half covered in dark sand is the scorched corpse of a desert traveler.  The clothes they wore are ripped to shreds and all the fluids their body once contained seems to have evaporated out into the air.

6.Name: Dark Dunes
6.Description: The sun turns black through the haze overhead, but it is still there, searing possibly deeper then just your skin.  The evil surrounding these sands are exerting their will on you and it is a constant struggle just to stay focused among the mass of bleached bones and dark sand.

20.Description: Sand has not yet come to this part of the fields, but it is only a matter of time. Already the vegetation has started dying, and the soil is not suitable for the growth of trees.

21.Name: Dark Dunes
21.Description: The sands look much darker and colder, the dark haze lulling your soul into depression.  The sand seems to rise up from the ground to swallow you, and it is difficult to fight the temptation to just give up.

23.Name: Crest of the Brevaran Dunes
23.Description: Looking out across the southern wasteland, you can't help but feel vaunted by the vastness of the wastes.  They seem to stretch out well past the horizon eastwards.  There are more pressing matters though, a dark haze seems to hang over the southern desert, one that the sun cannot seem to burn away.

24.Name: A Small Campfire
24.Description: A small campfire burns at the edge of the dying grass.  Several people are huddled around it, swapping stories of tales long past.  There seems to be an uproar of laughter though, as something was said that you couldn't overhear.

25.Name: Down from the Crest
25.Description: The Dunes slide away behind you, seeming to push unsuspecting travelers into the black haze south or the raging sandstorm east.  Both surely spell the demise of any unprepared travelers.

26.Name: Blinding Sandstorm

30.Name: Altair Dunes
30.Description: In the low dunes of sand below you, a swath is being cut through the desert by a howling sandstorm.  You can see nothing of what is below, just the haze of windswept sand in the air.

31.Name: Altair Dunes
31.Description: You find your self sliding down the shifting sand back into the ravenous maw of the sandstorm below.  After using your hands and feet to scramble back up the dune, you lay on your back and feel thankful you didn't slide to your doom.

32.Name: Altair Dunes
32.Description: You stand on a small dune overlooking the massive sandstorm cutting through the wastelands to the west.  The roar is loud enough to almost drown out the painful screams and wails of the storm.  It almost seems alive.

33.Name: Blinding Sandstorm
33.Description: The blowing sand tears at your skin and into your eyes. You become hopelessly lost in the sandstorm.

34.Name: Looking up the Steep Stone Steps
34.Description: You stand at the base of the sun bleached stone steps that lead into the temple.  The temple is normal as far as you can tell, until you notice what is missing.  Sand.  Along the steps leading inside, and along the edges and cracks of the temple, there exists no sand.  Something else is at work here.  This is not something a small adventurer should venture into blindly.

38.Description: Being this close to the storm, is deafening, but after several moments of listening, you notice the one thing that is out of place.  The sandstorm, or something in it, is screaming shrieking in the storm.

39.Name: Sheltered Rock
39.Description: You rest in the shade of a small windblown outcropping of rock.  The air is cooler, and it makes it much easier to breathe as well as recover your strength from the wind.

51.Description: From the rise of this dune you can survey the entirety of the Lelic Dunes and what lies beyond.  Much to your depression, all you see is sand.

52.Name: Andam Dunes
52.Description: A small wind passes you,  a welcome relief to the dry desert heat, even though the wind was hot and dry as well.

55.Name: Andam Dunes
55.Description: The dunes of Andam lie east of you, stark and featureless against the otherwise bland landscape.  If you want to continue your journey across the desert, you will have to climb the steep dunes ahead up to the Lelic Dunes.

60.Name: Bandit Captain's Room
60.Description: The leader of the bandits is the only one afforded  the luxury of having their own room.  Dry clay stops up the gaps between the wooden boards and a rugged carpet lays across the floor. A real desk found in cities elsewhere has been 'aquired'  and set next to a large hammock with an assortment of pillows laid across it.

61.Name: A Desert Well
61.Description: A few rough stones and a large wooden cover marks the well that provides water to the group of shacks nearby.  Pulling the ladle from the bucket, the water is simmering hot, but it does the trick.

63.Description: The encroaching sand has all but destroyed the grass in this area, soon there will be nothing left as the desert expands.

70.Name: Dark Dunes
70.Description: Lying half covered in dark sand is the scorched corpse of a desert traveler.  The clothes they wore are ripped to shreds and all the fluids their body once contained seems to have evaporated out into the air.

78.Name: Altair Dunes
78.Description: You find your self sliding down the shifting sand back into the ravenous maw of the sandstorm below.  After using your hands and feet to scramble back up the dune, you lay on your back and feel thankful you didn't slide to your doom.

79.Name: Altair Dunes
79.Description: The high ridges make any attempt to enter the sandstorm nigh impossible.  The sand slowly seems to be eaten away from the sides of the edge, as the sandstorm devours more sand to fuel its fury.

80.Name: Altair Dunes
80.Description: You shield your eyes against a strong gust of wind that blasts sand against your face. Winds rise and fall quickly in the wastes, carrying the deadly sand with them.

81.Name: Altair Dunes
81.Description: Sand blasts hard against any skin left exposed here.  The slope down the sand is gentle enough that you can make your way down into the raging winds below. Going through the storm is the only way to make it through to Brevaran and beyond.

82.Name: Blinding Sandstorm
82.Description: The blowing sand tears at your skin and into your eyes. You become hopelessly lost in the sandstorm.

83.Name: Edge of the Sandstorm
83.Description: The Brevaran Dunes drop sharply, being swallowed and eroded away by the blinding sandstorm.  The screams seem louder, almost beckoning you into the monster's maw.  Whatever you choose, you know it is not safe to go down into the storm.

84.Name: Edge of the Sandstorm
84.Description: You stand atop the summit of one of the dunes near the sandstorm.  The storm inflicts awe on those who see it, for it commands a great amount of respec for its power.

85.Name: Sheltered Rock
85.Description: You rest in the shade of a small windblown outcropping of rock.  The air is cooler, and it makes it much easier to breathe as well as recover your strength from the wind.

86.Name: Andam Dunes
86.Description: The dunes rise steadily to the west, as they merge and transition into the much more hostile Lelic Dunes.

87.Name: Before the Rustic Shelters
87.Description: Several shacks look like they have been joined together into a single building with some shoddy carpentry work.  However the building is extremely sturdy and easily withstands the sand and wind of the wastelands.

88.Name: Brevaran Dunes
88.Description: The Brevaran Dunes stretch out far to the east of you, obscuring the horizon, and concealing how dangerous the wastelands really are.

89.Name: A Small Shack
89.Description: Various implements of desert survival lay about on shelves and tables.  Orca-hide waterskins, dried scorpion meat and some dried desert vegetation are all necessary for survival in this harsh environment.

90.Name: Wasteland Bandits' Hideout
90.Description: Several hammocks sway back and forth with the small amount of desert wind allowed into the shacks from cracks and holes in the wall.  A few crates mark the few meager belongings of this group, and shows that Desert Robbery hasn't been the best lately.

91.Name: Wasteland Bandits' Hideout
91.Description: Several hammocks sway back and forth with the small amount of desert wind allowed into the shacks from cracks and holes in the wall.  A few crates mark the few meager belongings of this group, and shows that Desert Robbery hasn't been the best lately.

92.Name: Wasteland Bandits' Hideout
92.Description: A heavy wooden door seperates the shack to the east from the rest of the building.  Someone important in this bandit group must reside there.

93.Name: Wasteland Bandits' Hideout
93.Description: The entry to this hovel is very simple and plain.  Several hooks hang on the wall, some holding the heavy desert cloaks of some bandits who are still inside somewhere.

94.Name: A Dark Portal
94.Description: Two tall spires curl into twisted spikes at the roof and floor of the cavern.  Dark energy arcs across the spikes, lancing into the center where a black shroud gives an unerring sense of depth against what would normally be a rock wall.  Several demons guard the gate, attempting to keep others from passing into their realm.

103.Description: The dunes of Andam lie east of you, stark and featureless against the otherwise bland landscape.  If you want to continue your journey across the desert, you will have to climb the steep dunes ahead up to the Lelic Dunes.

107.Description: The Brevaran Dunes drop sharply, being swallowed and eroded away by the blinding sandstorm.  The storm is at its worst here and only the bravest and strongest of souls should enter!

108.Description: Large drag fences are set about every few feet to keep the sands from swallowing a small group of shacks to the northwest.

110.Description: You sit down and lay your back against the bleached wood of the shack.  The temperature is a lot cooler then being under the baking sun.

111.Name: Desert Fences

112.Name: Brevaran Dunes
112.Description: A slow wind blows the rough sand south across the wasteland, a dry breeze that seems to rob your mouth of spit and chap your lips to cracking.  Putting one foot in front of the other, you traverse across the dunes. There is nothing else to see, so that is all you can concentrate on.

113.Name: A Deafening Sandstorm
113.Description: A black cloud of sand swirls to the east, filling your ears with the constant dull thunder of a sandstorm whistling through the dunes.

114.Name: Edge of the Sandstorm

118.Name: Andam Dunes
118.Description: Once past the relative shelter of the Desert Fields, the sun seems to have taken on an intensity never seen before in your life.  The sand under your feet grows hotter with each step and the sweat has already begun to trickle down your brow.

119.Name: Blinding Sandstorm
119.Description: The blowing sand tears at your skin and into your eyes. You become hopelessly lost in the sandstorm.

120.Name: Down the Sandy Dunes
120.Description: The slope of the dune descends down straight into the middle of the sandstorm.  The flying sand and howly wind do very little to disguise the inhuman screams at this close of range.

125.Description: The dark tunnel divides into different directions, branching out under the wastelands.

126.Name: Altair Dunes
126.Description: The sand slides down past your feet as you make your way across the steep side of one of the many dunes in the Wasteland.

127.Name: Altair Dunes

130.Name: Altair Dunes
130.Description: The sand shifts away as you stumble across the steeply sloped side of a large sand dune.  You grow a bit delirious from being exposed to the sun for so long, and laugh maniacally as you say the words "Aran's Sandbox".

131.Name: Sand Worm Tunnels
131.Description: The dark tunnel offers shade and cooler temperatures.  It would almost be a perfect place to rest for a while if it were not for the constant rumblings of the walls and floor to make you cautious.

132.Name: Altair Dunes
132.Description: The sands shift and slide down the slope between the dunes that rise arounds you.  With the sand that is always moving, you best not stay here or you might be swallowed and forgotten like much in the wastelands.

140.Description: You start moving up the side of the dunes that make your passage into the desert complete.  Dust devils and fiery spirits abound in the area, so you feel that you should be cautious when traveling here.

141.Name: Altair Dunes

144.Name: Wasteland Ruins
144.Description: Pieces of a broken statue lie broken and strewn across the ground.  The broken feet are all that is left attached to the pedastel that was probably an honor to a great man or god.

145.Name: Altair Dunes
145.Description: The sand sways back and forth, rolling across the surface of the wasteland, much like the tide of the ocean upon a beach.

146.Name: Altair Dunes
146.Description: You reach the end of the crest of the dune and start to descend back down its side.

147.Name: Altair Dunes
147.Description: The dunes of Altair rise westwards, leading eventually to the Brevaran Desert and Epiach beyond.  Below you, the sand spills down into the gentler sands of the Lelic Dunes.

148.Name: Altair Dunes
148.Description: You shield your eyes against a strong gust of wind that blasts sand against your face. Winds rise and fall quickly in the wastes, carrying the deadly sand with them.

149.Name: Wasteland Ruins
149.Description: A small pillar juts out of the sand inbetween two of the largest dunes you  have seen thus far.  You recognize the design easily, you have seen the same type of pillar at the People's Palace in epiach.

150.Name: Altair Dunes
150.Description: You walk up the sides of one of the largest dunes in the sandy Altair sea.  Sand is swept off the top of the dune by a high wind, swirling up a cloud of sand below.

151.Name: Altair Dunes
151.Description: The sand seems to eb away from the temple, forming a invisible barrier of sorts.  Something powerful is at work around this temple, but if it is for the powers of good or evil, you cannot tell.

152.Name: Altair Dunes

156.Name: Altair Dunes
156.Description: The sand slides down past your feet as you make your way across the steep side of the small dune that crests to the west.

157.Name: Altair Dunes
157.Description: You stand on a small dune overlooking the massive sandstorm cutting through the wastelands to the west.  The roar is loud enough to almost drown out the painful screams and wails of the storm.  It almost seems alive.

158.Name: Altair Dunes
158.Description: The sand slides down past your feet as you make your way across the steep side of one of the many dunes in the Wasteland.

159.Name: Traveler Camp
159.Description: Several travelers have gathered and setup a temporary camp at the edge of the Andam Dunes.

160.Name: Altair Dunes
160.Description: The sand slides down past your feet as you make your way across the steep side of one of the many dunes in the Wasteland.

161.Name: Altair Dunes
161.Description: Swirlling sand marks a sinkhole down into an abyss or the clutches of some deranged monsters below.  It probably wouldn't be safe to go down, and you aren't sure if you can make back up the sand once you descend.

162.Name: Sand Worm Tunnels
162.Description: The dark tunnel divides into different directions, branching out under the wastelands.

163.Name: Altair Dunes
163.Description: The sands shift and slide down the slope between the dunes that rise arounds you.  With the sand that is always moving, you best not stay here or you might be swallowed and forgotten like much in the wastelands.

164.Name: Andam Dunes
164.Description: The remains of several bodies lay scorched on the ground, their minds and souls having been possessed by the insanity caused by the burning sands.

165.Name: Blinding Sandstorm
165.Description: The blowing sand tears at your skin and into your eyes. You become hopelessly lost in the sandstorm.

166.Name: Andam Dunes
166.Description: Several travelers have gathered and setup a temporary camp at the edge of the Andam Dunes to the north.

167.Name: Andam Dunes
167.Description: The dunes rise steadily to the west, as they merge and transition into the much more hostile Lelic Dunes. To the north, a small camp seems to have been set up as several tents are visible against the drab sand.

168.Name: Entering the Halls of the Temple
168.Description: The biggest thing you notice, is the drop in temperature of the temple.  Where as the blasting heat outside is unbearable, the cool interior is pleasant and enjoyable.

169.Name: The Halls of the Temple
169.Description: Elegantly carved pillars line the smooth polished walls.  While the tenants of this temple have since passed to the realm of the dead, they have spared no effort in the upkeep of the temple.  You have never heard or wondered of such devotion from an undead.

170.Name: Desert Field
170.Description: Sand has not yet come to this part of the fields, but it is only a matter of time. Already the vegetation has started dying, and the soil is not suitable for the growth of trees.

171.Name: Andam Dunes
171.Description: The desert travelers seem to be well equipped for traversing the desert.  Several Ta'n Orcas are attached to a rail to carry their luggage, several waterskins hang to each side of the light canopy tents.

172.Name: In the Hall of Murals
172.Description: Here, a mural depicts an encounter between a man and a beast.  In the Book of Aran, the story went that man asked Aran who was better of the two.  Aran simply replied that they were both his children.

173.Name: In the Hall of Murals
173.Description: The murals end here, as a steep ramping of steps ascends to the topmost levels of the temple.

174.Name: In the Hall of Murals
174.Description: The mural on this wall is foreboding, as it tells the story of the  battles between the forces of light and darkness.  Great warriors clad in light and dark arms, brother versus brother, father versus son.  The beginning of the dark wars would destroy all at the end of time.  You never recall anything of this from the Book of Aran.  Such things are either an artist's imagination, or dark prophecy, and you pray to Aran above that it is the former.

175.Name: Blinding Sandstorm
175.Description: The blowing sand tears at your skin and into your eyes. You become hopelessly lost in the sandstorm.

176.Name: In the Hall of Murals
176.Description: This wall seems to be full of sacrilegious murals.  The raping of women, the burning of the town  you saw in the first mural, and the desecration of the exterior of the temple.  The murals are not as high a quality as the others, which might be the connection between the artist's haste and the desolation outside the temple.

177.Name: In the Hall of Murals
177.Description: This wall seems to be full of sacrilegious murals.  The raping of women, the burning of the town  you saw in the first mural, and the desecration of the exterior of the temple.  The murals are not as high a quality as the others, which might be the connection between the artist's haste and the desolation outside the temple.

178.Name: A Stone Stairway
178.Description: A close look at the rock and it does not even seem that the staircase was carved at all, but naturally formed this way!  This is a stark contrast to the rest of the temple, where it was easily manmade.

179.Name: Atop the Ramp
179.Description: A large mural spans the corridor, showing a horde of darkness rising from the earth at your feet.  Above the clouds on the ceiling is a bright light with a picture depicting the divine hand of Aran holding the mass back effortlessly.  To the sides of the divine vision there is landscaping and animals of the earth.  After looking over the intricate details, you think this is a picture of the Creation as told by the book of Aran.

180.Name: Blinding Sandstorm
180.Description: The blowing sand tears at your skin and into your eyes. You become hopelessly lost in the sandstorm.

181.Name: Fury of the Storm
181.Description: The stone you are on is encompassed by the overwhelming fury of the sandstorm.  The windblown sand threatens to impale your eyes and shed your skin. A ghastly howl carries on the wind, and you soon realize you are not alone.

182.Name: Andam Dunes
182.Description: A small wind passes you,  a welcome relief to the dry desert heat, even though the wind was hot and dry as well.

183.Name: Altair Dunes
183.Description: In the low dunes of sand below you, a swath is being cut through the desert by a howling sandstorm.  You can see nothing of what is below, just the haze of windswept sand in the air.

184.Name: Traveler Camp
184.Description: Several travelers have gathered and setup a temporary camp at the edge of the Andam Dunes.

185.Name: Altair Dunes - Undulating Dunes
185.Description: The wasteland sands seem to stretch on into the horizon with no end in sight.  You trudge along to the top of a dune, and take a good look around.  Oddly shaped stones lay half buried in the sand northward, perhaps an indication of a path?  However a rocky cliff to the west is swept over by the fury of the sandstorm.  It is a place you are sure you would regret entering.

186.Name: Altair Dunes - Deserted Path
186.Description: A few stones rise up from the ground, part of some ancient civilization or the like buried under the sand.  The stones were once pieces of a great road, that once lead to a prosperous city that used to exist to the north.  However only sand travels the stones these days.

187.Name: Blinding Sandstorm
187.Description: The blowing sand tears at your skin and into your eyes. You become hopelessly lost in the sandstorm.

188.Name: Blinding Sandstorm
188.Description: The blowing sand tears at your skin and into your eyes. You become hopelessly lost in the sandstorm.

189.Name: Path of Light
189.Description: You descend unto the Path of Light, created to guard against darker evils that dwell deep within the earth.

190.Name: Path of Light
190.Description: Holy Guardians set by some diety help to hold the balance against the dark forces that exist here.  Gargoyles of holy intent, they were created from a special ore, said to be part of the heavens itself.  How much of this is true, is beyond you.  However their goal is simple.  Keep evil beings from leaving the blackest pits and keep wanderers from getting there.

194.Name: Path of Ambivalence
194.Description: You have entered a place where light niether shines nor darkness prevails.  It is confusing with the ambience of such a place, it radiates niether pure good nor evil, yet something of both.  Below you however exists the darkest blackness.  Smart adventurers should veer away.

195.Name: Path of Darkness
195.Description: The light fades away, leaving an unpleasant gloom in its wake.  There are deeper, darker things that go bump in the night, and it feels as if you are walking into the Pits of Hell itself.  It is not yet too late to turn back.

196.Name: Path of Darkness
196.Description: These stone gargoyles are the opposite of the Guardians to the very last detail.  Bulky and grotesque, compared to the Light's fluidous grace.  Their power and size is undeniable.

197.Name: Path of Darkness
197.Description: The neverending night continues as more Unholy Guardians bar your way.  It is obvious you are not welcome here and should turn back.

198.Name: Path of Darkness
198.Description: The neverending night continues as more Unholy Guardians bar your way.  It is obvious you are not welcome here and should turn back.

199.Name: Path of Darkness
199.Description: The neverending night continues as more Unholy Guardians bar your way.  It is obvious you are not welcome here and should turn back.

200.Name: Path of Darkness
200.Description: The blackness finally fades as hellish hues of red appear from below you.  The end of the tunnel seems to be within your grasp.

201.Name: Bowels of the Earth
201.Description: The cavern is lit by the red haze of flowing magma against the cavern ceiling.  The heat is unbearable, easily as sweltering as that of the wasteland.

202.Name: Before the Lake of Magma
202.Description: Your skin is scorched by the proximity of the flowing magma.  You shield yourself as best you can, the sweat rolling down your face.  It is much hotter here, then even in the wastelands above.

204.Name: Before the Lake of Magma
204.Description: Your skin is scorched by the proximity of the flowing magma.  You shield yourself as best you can, the sweat rolling down your face.  It is much hotter here, then even in the wastelands above.

205.Name: Bowels of the Earth
205.Description: The ground here is curled and dark, a mix of cooled molten rock and magma.  Although the ground appears solid, you can feel it shake from the rivers of magma passing beneath it.

208.Description: The encroaching sand has all but destroyed the grass in this area, soon there will be nothing left as the desert expands.

209.Name: Bowels of the Earth
209.Description: The crackle of energy and a hum of power catch your attention immeadiately to the east.  It is too dark to see, as the area seems to be absorbing all light that is nearby.

213.Description: Your skin is scorched by the proximity of the flowing magma.  You shield yourself as best you can, the sweat rolling down your face.  It is much hotter here, then even in the wastelands above.

214.Name: Bowels of the Earth
214.Description: The ground here is curled and dark, a mix of cooled molten rock and magma.  Although the ground appears solid, you can feel it shake from the rivers of magma passing beneath it.

215.Name: Before the Lake of Magma

216.Name: Halls of the Temple
216.Description: Elegantly carved pillars line the smooth polished walls.  While the tenants of this temple have since passed to the realm of the dead, they have spared no effort in the upkeep of the temple.  You have never heard or wondered of such devotion from an undead.

229.Name: In the Hall of Murals
229.Description: This wall seems to be full of sacrilegious murals.  The raping of women, the burning of the town  you saw in the first mural, and the desecration of the exterior of the temple.  The murals are not as high a quality as the others, which might be the connection between the artist's haste and the desolation outside the temple.

230.Name: Andam Dunes
230.Description: The dunes seem to stretch on forever, with nothing more then plain hills of loose sand to be seen.  There is no vegetation anywhere, and it seems that if there was, the sand swallowed it up long ago.

231.Name: In the Hall of Murals
231.Description: The mural here depicts the faithful of Aran, being shielded against a dark force.  The art and detail is exquisite, as is the blend of colors.  It almost appears as if Aran's hand is actually sheltering you.

232.Name: Andam Dunes
232.Description: You shield your eyes as a sharp wind picks up sand and sends it sailing into the air.  Taking a quick glance at your surroundings, there is no wind. It must be a dust devil.

233.Name: In the Hall of Murals
233.Description: A large mural takes up the entire wall and floor as you walk into the hall.  It depicts flowing fertile farmlands, blue water and small town called Altair.  It seems like just another landscape portrait until you notice one key feature in the mural.  This Temple.

234.Name: Entrance to the Hall of Murals
234.Description: Intricate mural work flows across the walls like the telling of a tale.  Most of the murals are easily recognizable as popular passages in the Book of Aran.  There are several however that do not seem familiar, and some that even seem sacrilegious.

235.Name: Blinding Sandstorm
235.Description: The blowing sand tears at your skin and into your eyes. You become hopelessly lost in the sandstorm.

236.Name: Throne Room of Calick'Gon
236.Description: A large dais rests at the end of the hall, where the beleaguered self-proclaimed god grows weary after many centuries of holding the evil below this temple at bay.  Calick'Gon's stone skin seems fringed with frustration, if that is possible, and it is obvious that a great burden looms over him.  His servants attend to his needs, attempting to keep up his strength against the rising terrors below.

237.Name: Andam Dunes
237.Description: The dunes seem to stretch on forever, with nothing more then plain hills of loose sand to be seen.  There is no vegetation anywhere, and it seems that if there was, the sand swallowed it up long ago.

238.Name: Across the Sands
238.Description: You trudge across the steep slope of sand that marks the easiest passage between the Lelic and Altair Dunes.

239.Name: Lelic Dunes
239.Description: A moderate slope of sand ascends to the higher dunes in the Forsaken Wastelands called the Altair Dunes.  It is full of many hazards, and travelers through the Altair Dunes are often never heard from again.

240.Name: Lelic Dunes
240.Description: A nest of sand dragon eggs lay out incubating in the scorching sun.  The eggs are not left unattended, as a ferocious roar says otherwise.

241.Name: Sand Dragon Lair
241.Description: You enter the lair of the sand dragons, proof that even the robust dragons cannot survive indefinitely under the harsh rays of the sun.

242.Name: Osseus Graveyard
242.Description: Bones of every shape size occupy this graveyard of bleached bones.  Entire skeletons of animals and even people lay scattered in the sand. It is hard to believe they came all this way to die.

243.Name: Osseus Graveyard
243.Description: You walk through the ribs of the largest beast you have ever seen, easily standing more then four times your height out of the white desert sand.

244.Name: Sand Worm Tunnels
244.Description: The dark tunnel has been eaten away by the passage of the sand worms.  Easily large enough to fit a small house in.

253.Name: Lelic Dunes

255.Name: Lelic Dunes
255.Description: The sand gently rolls westwards across the Lelic Dunes, but the easy of travel across its surface cannot hide the blistering sun that has been bearing down on you the entire way.

256.Name: Lelic Dunes
256.Description: A nest of sand dragon eggs lay out incubating in the scorching sun.  The eggs are not left unattended, as a ferocious roar says otherwise.

257.Name: Lelic Dunes
257.Description: You walk through the Lelic Dunes and stop after a terrible roar fills the air.  Turning around several times, you decide the sound is coming from the north, and it sounds hungry.  It might be best for you to avoid that direction.

258.Name: Lelic Dunes
258.Description: The gently sloping dunes descend towards a black hole in the ground to the north.  The shade looks welcoming, but you are afraid of what the darkness hides.

259.Name: Lelic Dunes
259.Description: Far to the west, is a large cavern gouged straight out of the side a of a Dune.  It is impossible to see how sand can hold any structure at this distance, much less continue to be stable.

260.Name: Lelic Dunes
260.Description: There is a large cave brimmed with crusted sand to form a weak stone of some type.  The shade and cavern look cool and after traversing the wastelands, it feels most welcome.

261.Name: Lelic Dunes
261.Description: The gently rolling dunes of Lelic began to grow higher, where they join with the dunes of Altair to the west.

263.Name: Lelic Dunes
263.Description: The Lelic dunes gently roll westward, following a soft wind that blows in the same direction.

264.Name: Darkness Falls
264.Description: You slide down a dark tunnel along a stream of sand falling from the gap above.  The tunnel descends deeper into the ground, and you have no choice now but to continue.

271.Name: Sand Dragon Lair
271.Description: The lair branches off into different directions, heading to the back of the tunnels.  There are many dragons about and you do not feel very comfortable around so many hungry tooth-filled maws.

272.Name: Lelic Dunes
272.Description: To the north you find a large hole with shed dragon scales laying near the entrance.  The burough has withstood the test of the wastelands, and you wonder what could possibly live there.

273.Name: Lelic Dunes

276.Name: Swirling Portal
276.Description: You stand before a giant swirling portal. This is what all the local inhabitants have been talking about. staring into the portal you can make out a large forest with a black tower luming above the forest canopy... is it safe to enter?

277.Name: Sand Dragon Lair

285.Name: Andam Dunes

286.Name: Ta'n Orca Lines
286.Description: Several of the native Domican beasts are tethered to a small pole staked deep into the ground.  They seem just as comfortable laying on the hot sand as you would be in a cool bath right now.

290.Name: Desert Field
290.Description: Rustic grasses and shrubs are all that grow this close to the desert.  With the shifting of the desert each year, soon the desert will cover up and destroy this small oasis of life.

295.Name: Andam Dunes
295.Description: And thus you enter the first dunes on the east side of the Forsaken Wastelands.  The Andam dunes are small and mild compared to the other parts of the Forsaken Wastelands that lies beyond.

296.Name: Sand Worm Tunnels
296.Description: The dark tunnel has been eaten away by the passage of the sand worms.  Easily large enough to fit a small house in.

297.Name: Sand Worm Tunnels
297.Description: The dark tunnel divides into different directions, branching out under the wastelands.

300.Description: The blowing sand tears at your skin and into your eyes. You become hopelessly lost in the sandstorm.

301.Name: Weakened Sandstorm
301.Description: The sand settles more and more as you head north through the trench carved by the sandstorm between the two dunes.  The wind is barely enough to keep any sand in the air.

302.Name: Windswept path to Sassaren
302.Description: The road continues up steeply, moving through the pass that the wastelands have not been able to overcome yet.

303.Name: Windswept path to Sassaren
303.Description: The road continues up steeply, moving through the pass that the wastelands have not been able to overcome yet.

304.Name: Road to Sassaren
304.Description: You march sullenly up the road that leads to the once abandoned fort at Sassaren Fields.  The fort has not been used by the Majestic Empire for hundreds of years, so you are not sure of the state the fort is in.

0.Name: On an Icy Cliff
0.Description: You continue to climb the icy cliff, barely managing to slip and fall to your death on the valley floor. Just above you is the ledge leading to the summit of the Silverspire Mountains, and below is the base of the cliff and the entrance of the vale.

1.Name: Below the Icy Cliff
1.Description: You climb off the cliff and look up to see it towering many spans into the air. The frozen vale expands in a narrow band to the west. It is filled with towering pine trees, frozen solid from the extreme cold.

2.Name: In the Vale
2.Description: The air is perfectly still in the valley, yet even so the extreme cold pierces into your heart. The snow is in small patches here, showing the dark green of the frozen grasses.

3.Name: In the Vale
3.Description: The air is perfectly still in the valley, yet even so the extreme cold pierces into your heart. The snow is in small patches here, showing the dark green of the frozen grasses.

4.Name: In the Vale
4.Description: The air is perfectly still in the valley, yet even so the extreme cold pierces into your heart. The snow is in small patches here, showing the dark green of the frozen grasses.

5.Name: Before the Avalanche
5.Description: This area of the vale is covered with uprooted pine trees. An avalanche down the north face of the vale's wall must have uprooted the trees and carried them here.

6.Name: Above the Avalanche
6.Description: Climbing up the huge pile of snow you can get a good look at the gash in the valley's north face that the avalanche carved when it crashed down into the vale.

7.Name: The Snowy Vale
7.Description: The air is perfectly still in the valley, yet even so the extreme cold pierces into your heart. The deep snow half buries some of the smaller pine trees.

8.Name: The Snowy Vale
8.Description: The snow piles high on the ground here, burying some of the smaller pine trees. To the west are the ice cold waters of a small alpine lake.

9.Name: The Snowy Vale
9.Description: The deep snow makes it hard to walk. To the south is the high rock wall of the valley. Up the wall a ways you can see a cave entrance.

10.Name: The Snowy Vale
10.Description: The deep snow makes it hard to walk. To the south is the high rock wall of the valley. To the north is the ice cold water of a small lake.

11.Name: In the Vale
11.Description: The air is perfectly still in the valley, yet even so the extreme cold pierces into your heart. To the south is a snowy path leading up the south face of the vale's rock walls.

12.Name: In the Vale
12.Description: The air is perfectly still in the valley, yet even so the extreme cold pierces into your heart. The snow is in small patches here, showing the dark green of the frozen grasses. To the east are the freezing waters of a small lake.

13.Name: Inside the Frozen Tree
13.Description: Climbing inside the frozen tree, you are blasted with an intensely cold wind. You quickly realize that it was not such a good idea to come inside of here.

14.Name: West Edge of the Vale
14.Description: The water of the small river here is totally frozen. It looks safe to walk on to the west, but to the north it doesn't seem sturdy enough to support your weight.

15.Name: bad room
15.Description: ooops.

16.Name: bad room
16.Description: ooops.

17.Name: bad room
17.Description: ooops.

18.Name: On the Frozen River
18.Description: Stepping slowly, you walk onto the frozen river. You can see through the clear ice and see the frozen corpses of several exotic fish.

19.Name: bad room
19.Description: ooops.

20.Name: Before a Frozen Tree
20.Description: The frozen vale continues on here. To the north is a gigantic frozen pine tree. It's still majesty inspires a feeling of serenity inside of you. A hole in it's massive trunk leads into the center of the tree.

21.Name: Up the Vale Wall
21.Description: The snow covered path quickly ascends up the south face of the wall.

22.Name: West Edge of the Vale
22.Description: The eastern portion of the vale is even colder than the west. To the west are half frozen waters of a river that is totally frozen up to the north.

23.Name: Up the Vale Wall
23.Description: The snow covered path quickly ascends up the south face of the wall.

24.Name: Before a Large Cave
24.Description: The ascent stops and you look into a large cave etched out of the rock wall. A cold frost wisps out of the cave entrance.

25.Name: Inside the Large Freezing Cavern
25.Description: This is quite possibly the coldest place in all of Kaldana. You can't control your shivering as you walk around this large cave. You have no idea what could cause it to be so devoid of heat.

26.Name: Near the Frozen River
26.Description: You step onto a portion of land between the frozen river. The snow here is lumpy, as if there are objects below it.

27.Name: bad room
27.Description: ooops.

28.Name: Inside a Cold Cave
28.Description: You climb up the valley wall into the cave. Expecting it to be warmer inside, it is actually much colder in here than in the vale.

29.Name: Frozen Entrance
29.Description: The way down seemed easy enough, but looking at the slickness of the ice and the walls, you will have to find another way out.

30.Name: Frozen Exit
30.Description: The slope is much gentler here, and seems to lead to a large frozen cavern up ahead.  Judging by the fresh freezing air, you think this might be a way out.

31.Name: Freezing Cavern
31.Description: As you stumble in the low light of the cavern, red eyes follow your progress.  Apparently you are not alone here!

32.Name: Freezing Cavern
32.Description: A cold wind blows westwards, chilling the air beyond anything normal.  The cold here is astounding, and the deeper you move into the cave, the worse it gets.

33.Name: Broken Ceiling
33.Description: Long ago, some earthquake caused the ceiling to crackle and crumble here, finally collapsing to the cave floor below. Flurries of snow and ice blow down constantly, accumulating on the ground.  The walls are too steep to climb, so you will have to find aother way out.

34.Name: Freezing Cavern
34.Description: The air is very cold here, freezing each breath in midair to crackle on the ground.  Seizures of intense shivering take over, and you know you have to keep moving or risk freezing to death.

35.Name: Freezing Cavern
35.Description: The cave slopes up to the south with fresh freezing air blowing from that direction.  It just might be the way out.

36.Name: Freezing Cavern
36.Description: A large pillar of ice juts up from the ground in front of a descending tunnel that leads lower into the caves.

37.Name: Freezing Cavern
37.Description: A large pillar of ice juts up from the ground in front of a descending tunnel that leads lower into the caves.

38.Name: Downward Slope
38.Description: The caverns narrows and joints with a tunnel that leads deeper into the caves. There is nothing particular about this entrance, other then the blasts of freezing air that constantly come from down below.

39.Name: Freezing Cavern
39.Description: The air is very cold here, freezing each breath in midair to crackle on the ground.  Seizures of intense shivering take over, and you know you have to keep moving or risk freezing to death.

40.Name: Freezing Cavern
40.Description: The air is very cold here, freezing each breath in midair to crackle on the ground.  Seizures of intense shivering take over, and you know you have to keep moving or risk freezing to death.

41.Name: Down the Freezing Tunnel
41.Description: The tunnel steadily descends deeper and deeper.  The walls start becoming slick with ice and permafrost and several times, your feet almost slip out from under you.

42.Name: Down the Freezing Tunnel
42.Description: The tunnel steadily descends deeper and deeper.  The walls start becoming slick with ice and permafrost and several times, your feet almost slip out from under you.

43.Name: An Old Den
43.Description: The remains of several animals litter the ground of what looks like the home of some animal.  From what you can tell, nothing has been here for a while, but then again, what do you know about these things?

44.Name: Down the Freezing Tunnel
44.Description: The tunnel steadily descends deeper and deeper.  The walls start becoming slick with ice and permafrost and several times, your feet almost slip out from under you.

45.Name: More Frozen Tunnels
45.Description: The frozen tunnel twists and turns around various pillars of earth and ice.  The floor grows more frozen by each step, becoming increasingly difficult to walk on, as well as dangerous.

46.Name: More Frozen Tunnels

49.Name: Frozen Caverns
49.Description: The ground is level and covered in a thin blanket of frost.  The wind is steadier here, but still extremely cold.  Other then the frost, there is not much to see.

50.Name: Inside the Small Tunnel
50.Description: The small tunnel continues, and occassionally you can hear sounds echoing from the far end.

51.Name: Vale Bear Den
51.Description: You have stumbled upon the den of vale bears!  This must be where they wait out the terrible winters that plague the Frozen Vale during the years.  Waiting out the cold winter makes them grumpy...and hungry.

52.Name: Vale Bear Den
52.Description: The den is surprisingly warm compared to the rest of the caves.  All the bears that stay here help attribute to the warmness of the air.  No matter how pleasant the warmth is, the bears aren't exactly happy to see you.

53.Name: Vale Bear Den
53.Description: The den is surprisingly warm compared to the rest of the caves.  All the bears that stay here help attribute to the warmness of the air.  No matter how pleasant the warmth is, the bears aren't exactly happy to see you.

57.Name: Crack in the Floor
57.Description: You see a crack in the floor but can't see any possible way to get down into a large cavern that lies below this one.

58.Name: Wall of the Vale Bear Den
58.Description: Seeking safety behind a large rock formation, you feel the tingling of dripping water coming from above you.  Looking up, you can see a fissure in the cave wall that leads up to another part of the caves.

59.Name: Vale Bear Den
59.Description: The den is surprisingly warm compared to the rest of the caves.  All the bears that stay here help attribute to the warmness of the air.  No matter how pleasant the warmth is, the bears aren't exactly happy to see you.

60.Name: Small Tunnel Entrance
60.Description: A small tunnel, less then half the height of a man begins here.  Where it ends, you can't be sure, but you notice a plethora of animal tracks on the ground.

61.Name: More Frozen Tunnels
61.Description: The frozen tunnel twists and turns around various pillars of earth and ice.  The floor grows more frozen by each step, becoming increasingly difficult to walk on, as well as dangerous.

62.Name: Cave of the Yeti
62.Description: In this cave lies the eldest of the Yeti clan.  The cave is full of pottery, assorted charms and talismans made out of skin and bones of the various animals in the Vale.  At the rear of the cave is another crevice that you can climb up through a crack in the ceiling.

63.Name: A Yeti Hutt
63.Description: You walk past a Yeti Hutt, which is made of simple beams with serpent skins and bear hides stretched across to keep the cold and beasts out when they rest.

64.Name: Tunnel of the Yeti
64.Description: The more you walk, the more questions that pop into your head about these man-like beasts.

65.Name: Tunnel of the Yeti
65.Description: The path is long and you begin to wonder about these Yeti.  How long have they been here? Where did they come from originally?  Are they the ancestors of man?  Many more questions come up, but you seem to lack the answers.

66.Name: Tunnel of the Yeti
66.Description: The Yeti are an ancient race of beings stemming from before the Veratine Empire.  They are very reclusive and avoid man at all times.  Your tresspass here has not gone unnoticed.

67.Name: Frozen River
67.Description: You step carefully onto the slick surface of frozen water. A large underground river spans here, but has been frozen solid for centuries.

68.Name: Frozen River
68.Description: The River narrows slightly and you are forced to crawl under some very low parts of the cave ceiling.

69.Name: Frozen River
69.Description: The River narrows slightly and you are forced to crawl under some very low parts of the cave ceiling.

70.Name: Tunnel of the Yeti
70.Description: As you walk through the tunnels of the Yeti, you feel pretty sure that even the Council of Magi does not know these mythical beasts are this deep here in the Vale.

71.Name: Frozen River
71.Description: The River turns southward away from the northern bank.  The most noticeable thing, is the large man-like footprints in the frost ahead.

72.Name: Den of Wolves
72.Description: Bare bones and skeletons lie scattered here.  From the looks of them, a patch of meat hasn't been on these bones in months.

73.Name: Tunnel of the Yeti
73.Description: The more you walk, the more questions that pop into your head about these man-like beasts.

74.Name: Treacherous Cliffs
74.Description: This edge of the plateau here is covered with thick ice.  Moving closer to the edge is perilous, for once you start sliding, you will not be able to stop. Until you fall off the cliff that is.

75.Name: Den of Wolves
75.Description: Bare bones and skeletons lie scattered here.  From the looks of them, a patch of meat hasn't been on these bones in months.

76.Name: A Yeti Hutt

77.Name: Frosted Caverns
77.Description: You approach a division in the path that slowly works its way upwards.   The path continues eastward, but to the west lies a large ice shelf that looks pretty interesting.

78.Name: Ice Shelf
78.Description: Massive mastadons roam across this frozen ice shelf overlooking the cave floor below.  How they came here or survive here is a mystery, however.

79.Name: Ice Shelf
79.Description: Massive mastadons roam across this frozen ice shelf overlooking the cave floor below.  How they came here or survive here is a mystery, however.

80.Name: Tunnel Bottom
80.Description: With a slow skittering you come to a halt at the base of the tunnel.  The path is too slippery and steep to be able to make it back up.  You will just have to find another way out.

81.Name: Frosted Caverns
81.Description: The air is filled with misty frost that pains you with each breath you take.  It almost feels like tiny shards of ice piercing inside you.  Struggling to stay warm, you notice that you have ended up in a cave full of wiggle marks in the ground.  Whatever caused them, you are sure you will find out soon enough.

82.Name: Frosted Caverns
82.Description: The wiggle marks in the frost are everywhere here, which means that whatever made them uses this path often.

83.Name: Frosted Caverns
83.Description: The wiggle marks in the frost are everywhere here, which means that whatever made them uses this path often.

84.Name: Frosted Caverns
84.Description: The wiggle marks in the frost are everywhere here, which means that whatever made them uses this path often.

85.Name: More Downward Tunnels
85.Description: The depth of this cave is amazing.  Who would have thought such a complex cavern system lay beneath the Frozen Vale?

86.Name: Frozen River
86.Description: The River stops here, but you cannot see a reason immeadiately. Only after a closer look, you figure that the river originates from underground, but with it being frozen solid, there is no way to press on to its source.

87.Name: Frozen Steps
87.Description: Ice carved blocks are set into the slope of the floor, forming frozen steps that cascade down into the deepest depths of the Vale Caves.

88.Name: Frosted Caverns
88.Description: The cavern dome narrows once more leading into a tunnel that heads north.

89.Name: Frosted Caverns
89.Description: The wiggle marks in the frost are everywhere here, which means that whatever made them uses this path often.

90.Name: Frosted Caverns
90.Description: The wiggle marks in the frost are everywhere here, which means that whatever made them uses this path often.

91.Name: Frosted Caverns
91.Description: As you walk through the narrow cave, the walls widen and expand, and soon becomes a large domed cavern which is overlooked by an ice shelf above.

92.Name: Ice Shelf
92.Description: Massive mastadons roam across this frozen ice shelf overlooking the cave floor below.  How they came here or survive here is a mystery, however.

93.Name: Ice Shelf
93.Description: Massive mastadons roam across this frozen ice shelf overlooking the cave floor below.  How they came here or survive here is a mystery, however.

94.Name: Frosted Caverns
94.Description: The slither and wiggle patterns in the frost dissappear mostly here as you seem to be moving away from the serpent nests.  You take it as a good and bad sign.  Good that the serpents are behind you. Bad that there is something they fear further ahead.

95.Name: Up the Crevice
95.Description: The air is cold yet serene and you feel rather at peace.  Whatever lives in this part of the caves must contribute to this peaceful atmosphere. But it could be decieving.

96.Name: Lair of the Ice Dragons
96.Description: The first thing you see is the beautiful ice stalagmites and stalactites that fill the ceiling and floor.  The untarnished look of the cave lends it an air of serenity and peace. The deep marks in the ground however, show it is inhabited.

97.Name: Lair of the Ice Dragons
97.Description: The cave itself is elegant, with smoothed ice and crystalline sculptures. A large nest of frozen diamonds and icy sapphires rest against the cave wall.

98.Name: Lair of the Ice Dragons

100.Name: Lair of the Ice Dragons
100.Description: This isolated dragon nest has been torn asunder, probably in the dragon's rage. Whatever happened here, it could not have been pleasant.

101.Name: Large Tunnel Opening
101.Description: The tunnel widens here a great deal leading back down into the deeper portions of the caverns.

102.Name: Lair of the Ice Dragons
102.Description: The cave itself is elegant, with smoothed ice and crystalline sculptures. A large nest of frozen diamonds and icy sapphires rest against the cave wall.

103.Name: Entrance to a large Cavern
103.Description: You finally reach level floor again.  The hair on your neck stands on end, clearly an indication that hostility is present!

104.Name: Edge of the Abyss
104.Description: You walk along the edge of the abyss, moving carefull so as not to bring about your demise so early.

105.Name: Occupied Cave
105.Description: This cave has been used recently.  Bones of various creatures, including the majestic ice dragons lay scattered here.  However, you quickly notice that this cave is not empty as glowing red eyes and a ravenous appetite leap at you!

106.Name: Edge of the Abyss

109.Name: Edge of the Abyss
109.Description: You come to a quick halt as you nearly walk off the edge of the cliff into the black abyss below! After a quick glance around, you see a path along the cave wall that woudl allow you to skirt the edge of this massive pit.

110.Name: Occupied Cave

111.Name: Frozen Sloping Tunnel
111.Description: The slick tunnel leading down is clear of rocks and ice shards that jut up occassionally.  However because of the slickness of the ice, the trip might be one way.  Looks like fun to go sliding down though.

112.Name: Den of Wolves
112.Description: A sense of overwhelming doom overcomes you as you enter this cavern. Rather then out of the frying pan and into the fire, you feel as if you have just been put on the dinner plate as a pack of starving wolves begins to surround you.

113.Name: Den of Wolves
113.Description: Bare bones and skeletons lie scattered here.  From the looks of them, a patch of meat hasn't been on these bones in months.

114.Name: Den of Wolves
114.Description: The most ferocious wolves of this pack rest here.  Their long teeth, sharp claws and ragged fur is a testament to their strength.  However only one thing is on their mind. Dinner and you.

115.Name: Den of Wolves
115.Description: Bare bones and skeletons lie scattered here.  From the looks of them, a patch of meat hasn't been on these bones in months.

116.Name: Den of Wolves
116.Description: The most ferocious wolves of this pack rest here.  Their long teeth, sharp claws and ragged fur is a testament to their strength.  However only one thing is on their mind. Dinner and you.

117.Name: Den of Wolves
117.Description: In the center of the wolf den lies a large clump of skeletons.  The bones are from a bit of everything: dragons, bears, other wolves, and a few skeletons of men.

118.Name: Bottom of the Frozen Steps
118.Description: The frozen ice steps end here at the entrance to a mysterious arch.  The symbols etched into the frozen arch are archaic and seem to be be imbued with some sort of power.

119.Name: Ice Angel Lair
119.Description: As you walk further, you see glyphs drawn and imbued in the wall.  Figures of man-like beings with wings seem to be the imminent glyph amongst the wall's history.

120.Name: Ice Angel Lair
120.Description: According to the symbols, long ago, the Vale used to be a warm area.  Then, some cataclysm happened that seemed to doom the Vale to the frozen wastes that it currently is.  Wanting to learn more, you continue along the walls.  But nothing tells you why these angels are here, and why these records were made.

121.Name: Overlooking the Frozen River
121.Description: The chilled air freezes your breath as you peer over the edge.  The narrow river would normally flow south to warmer climate if it were not frozen solid.

122.Name: Frozen Plateau
122.Description: Permafrost lays thick on the ground, crunching and cracking under each footfall.  The top of the plateau would be a splendid place, if it was not for the freezing winds and sub zero temperatures.

123.Name: Windswept Evergreen
123.Description: Hunching under its protective boughs, the evergreen tree creeks and groans with each great gust of wind.  Sitting there in the windbreak of the tree,  you realize you must eventually go back out into the frozen gale.

124.Name: Beyond the Arch
124.Description: As you walk through the Arch, you can feel a tingling sensation run through your body.  Something happened, although it isn't apparent at first what that is.

129.Name: Yellow Snow
129.Description: You are walking along the windswept plateau, when you stumble upon a huge patch of yellow snow.  In the middle of the snow, you see an old Hermit squatting. How disgusting!

130.Name: Treacherous Cliffs

131.Name: Tracks in the Ice
131.Description: As you bow your head down to escape the fury freezing wind, you look down and see large tracks in the ice.  The tracks seem to be fresh, and heading somewhere east.

132.Name: Windswept Evergreen
132.Description: Hunching under its protective boughs, the evergreen tree creeks and groans with each great gust of wind.  Sitting there in the windbreak of the tree,  you realize you must eventually go back out into the frozen gale.

133.Name: Atop the Frozen Plateau
133.Description: Finally reaching the top, you cast your eyes across a small plateau somewhere in the Silverspire Mountains. The plateau is covered in frozen ice and lichens, with many wild animals roaming the top.

134.Name: Treacherous Cliffs
134.Description: This edge of the plateau here is covered with thick ice.  Moving closer to the edge is perilous, for once you start sliding, you will not be able to stop. Until you fall off the cliff that is.

135.Name: Treacherous Cliffs
135.Description: The winds blow cold here above the frozen vale below.  While the depth of the vale below protects from the worst of the winds, you are offered no protection here.

139.Description: A sharp cold wind buffets the side of this mountain, making climbing hazardous.

140.Name: Rocky Ledge
140.Description: The rocky ledge is covered with the remains of many beasts, both large and small.  Bones and patches of fur lie strewn about.  Whatever caused this, you hope it is not around.
