0.Name: Path Down
0.Description: You are on a slippery path leading down into a huge chasm. The cliffs tower up on either side of you, coated with ice. It is difficult to keep your footing while descending, and you fall more than once. Farther ahead, the ground seems to level out.

1.Name: Slippery Path
1.Description: You are walking down a slippery path, at the bottom of the slope leading back up to the area surrounding Naraikos. To the north, the ice seems to become covered in snow.

2.Name: Troll Cave
2.Description: You have wandered into the shelter of a cave in the wall of the chasm. There are a number of bones from unidentified creatures in here, but you notice more than one human skull lying around. You think it would be best to make a quick exit.

3.Name: Icy Chasm
3.Description: You are slowly making your way across the ice covered floor of the chasm. It's very hard to keep your footing here, and the difficulty is compounded by the fact that there are a fair number of massive trolls moving about the area.

4.Name: Slippery Path
4.Description: You are standing on a snow covered patch of ice. It seems a large amount of snow tumbled down from the surrounding mountains and covered the area. To the north is a similar spot, while to the west the path slopes downward to an icy area.

5.Name: Snow Covered Chasm
5.Description: You are standing on a snow covered patch of ice. It seems a large amount of snow tumbled down from the surrounding mountains and covered the area.  The chasm continues to the east, while the snow dissapates.

6.Name: Icy Chasm
6.Description: You are slowly making your way across the ice covered floor of the chasm. It's very hard to keep your footing here, and the difficulty is compounded by the fact that there are a fair number of massive trolls moving about the area.

7.Name: Icy Chasm
7.Description: You are slowly making your way across the ice covered floor of the chasm. It's very hard to keep your footing here, and the difficulty is compounded by the fact that there are a fair number of massive trolls moving about the area.

8.Name: Troll Cave
8.Description: You have wandered into the shelter of a cave in the wall of the chasm. There are a number of bones from unidentified creatures in here, but you notice more than one human skull lying around. You think it would be best to make a quick exit.

9.Name: Troll Cave
9.Description: You are deep within a troll's home. The cave doesn't seem to be naturally occuring, so you can only conclude that a number of trolls carved it out with their claws. You shudder to think of what claws that can carve stone could do to you.

10.Name: Troll Cave
10.Description: You are deep within a troll's home. The cave doesn't seem to be naturally occuring, so you can only conclude that a number of trolls carved it out with their claws. You shudder to think of what claws that can carve stone could do to you.

11.Name: Icy Chasm
11.Description: You are making your way through the slippery pathways of the chasm. Back to the west, there is a large snow covered area, while to the east, the path begins to descend slowly downwards. You have a feeling that down is the way to go.

12.Name: Deep Chasm
12.Description: You are making your way down a icy slope, descending deeper into the earth. The temperature is dropping rapidly as you descend, and you are having trouble moving at a normal pace. You begin to get the uneasy feeling that things are watching your from inside the icy chasm walls.

13.Name: Deep Chasm
13.Description: You are making your way down a icy slope, descending deeper into the earth. The temperature is dropping rapidly as you descend, and you are having trouble moving at a normal pace. You begin to get the uneasy feeling that things are watching your from inside the icy chasm walls.

14.Name: Deep Chasm
14.Description: You are making your way down a icy slope, descending deeper into the earth. The temperature is dropping rapidly as you descend, and you are having trouble moving at a normal pace. You begin to get the uneasy feeling that things are watching your from inside the icy chasm walls. To the west, there is a cave mouth opening in the cliffs.

15.Name: Dark Cave
15.Description: You are in a deep, dark, and extremely cold cave. The cave itself seems to be devoid of enemies, and might make a decent place to rest, if it weren't for the bone-chilling cold. The cave continues on to the north.

16.Name: Dark Cave
16.Description: You are in a deep, dark, and extremely cold cave. The cave itself seems to be devoid of enemies, and might make a decent place to rest, if it weren't for the bone-chilling cold. The cave continues on to the north. There seems to be an opening in cave wall to the east.

17.Name: Icy Chasm
17.Description: You are standing in a small cleft in the cliffs surrounding the chasm. It is extremely cold here, and you get a nervous feeling just being here, like something is watching you. Not that you haven't been feeling that for most of your adventuring life.

18.Name: Dark Cave
18.Description: You seemed to have reached the back of this cave, and to the north you can see an exit. Sadly, it seems to just be a whole lot more ice and cold, just what you were looking forward to.

19.Name: Icy Chasm
19.Description: You have reached a somewhat large open area in the chasm. The frozen path continues off to the west and east, or into a cave mouth to the south.

20.Name: Frozen Cave
20.Description: You are walking in a large, frozen cave. Ice hangs off all the rock outcroppings, and the floor is slippery with it. You can hear the lumbering of large creatures in here, and hope that you can find your way somewhere else quickly.

21.Name: Frozen Cave
21.Description: You are walking in a large, frozen cave. Ice hangs off all the rock outcroppings, and the floor is slippery with it. You can hear the lumbering of large creatures in here, and hope that you can find your way somewhere else quickly.

22.Name: Icy Chasm
22.Description: You are walking through a large, icy area of the chasm. The cold here is even more intense than in previous areas, and you can't help but think that there may be a reason for the abnormal cold other than the weather.

23.Name: Icy Chasm
23.Description: You are walking through a large, icy area of the chasm. The cold here is even more intense than in previous areas, and you can't help but think that there may be a reason for the abnormal cold other than the weather.

25.Name: Deep Frozen Cave
25.Description: You have made it to a deeper portion of the cave. Very little to no light has managed to make it back here, and seeing anything is difficult. You can however tell that there are things other than you in here, and they don't appreciate being disturbed.

26.Name: Deep Frozen Caves

28.Name: Snow Covered Chasm
28.Description: This area is covered in snow. Your progress is slowed even further. This pile of snow seems to have been caused by a recent avalanche, and the ice continues to the north and south.

29.Name: Icy Chasm
29.Description: The chasm drops down a bit farther here into the ground. It rises up again to the east and south, but you have a hard time climbing up the slippery slope. Not that that's anything new around here.

30.Name: Troll Cave
30.Description: You have wandered into the shelter of a cave in the wall of the chasm. There are a number of bones from unidentified creatures in here, but you notice more than one human skull lying around. You think it would be best to make a quick exit.

31.Description: You are deep within a troll's home. The cave doesn't seem to be naturally occuring, so you can only conclude that a number of trolls carved it out with their claws. You shudder to think of what claws that can carve stone could do to you.

32.Name: Deep Troll Caves
32.Description: You are deep within a large troll cave. The stench of rotting flesh is quite strong in here, and you become powerfully nauseous. The floor here is covered in a thin sheen of ice, unlike the rest of the cave - you wonder why.

33.Name: Troll Cave Altar
33.Description: You are deep within the large troll cave. This side chamber seems to have been painstakingly carved out of the rock, and there is a crude stone altar, covered in various bones, at the far end of the chamber.

34.Name: Troll King's Chambers
34.Description: You have entered what seems to be a throne room deep in the caves. The throne is crudely carved out of the stone the cave came from, and is a part of the room itself. Of course, when a throne room is found, the king is soon to follow.

35.Name: Icy Chasm
35.Description: You are slowly making your way across the ice covered floor of the chasm. It's very hard to keep your footing here, and the difficulty is compounded by the fact that there are a fair number of massive trolls moving about the area.

36.Name: Icy Chasm
36.Description: You are slowly making your way across the ice covered floor of the chasm. It's very hard to keep your footing here, and the difficulty is compounded by the fact that there are a fair number of massive trolls moving about the area. The chasm seems to come to an end here, but there is a opening in the cliffs leading into a cave.

37.Name: Icy Chasm
37.Description: You are standing at another large cave entrance in the cliffs. This one seems to almost emanate an unnatural chill, and you wonder what creatures might be inside to cause such a temperature.

38.Name: Icy Chasm
38.Description: You are walking through a large, icy area of the chasm. The cold here is even more intense than in previous areas, and you can't help but think that there may be a reason for the abnormal cold other than the weather.

41.Name: Dark Passage Down
41.Description: You seem to have made it to the back of the cave. It stops going back here, but you notice in the almost blinding dark what seems to be a man-made staircase, long since fallen apart with age, leading down. You don't see anywhere else to go.

42.Name: Dark Stairway
42.Description: You are at the bottom of a large, dark staircase. You're not sure exactly why a staircase was created here, but this whole area seems to be man-made. It looks incredibly old, perhaps even dating to before the days of the Veratine.

43.Name: Long Stone Passage
43.Description: You are making your way along a lengthy carved stone passageway. This place was obviously created purposefully by humans or perhaps some other race long ago. You notice a number of intricate carvings along the walls, but cannot fathom their meanings. You are quickly snapped out of your observations by the loud sounds of crashing footsteps.

46.Name: Altar Chamber
46.Description: You are standing in a room that looks to have been dedicated to religious ceremony. There are a number of carvings on the walls depicting what you can only assume are religious scenes, and in the middle of the room is a large carved stone altar. You wonder what god this place was created to worship.

47.Name: Long Stone Passage
47.Description: You are walking along a long stone passagway. The carvings on the wall here start to show various scenes rather than cryptic pictographs. You see scenes of battles and the construction of cities. The people in them look to be human, but their clothes and equipment look very strange. To both the north and south, there are doorways.

54.Name: Dead Garden
54.Description: You have entered what looks to be a garden, though all the plants and herbs once growing here have long since withered, leaving only a few weeds. It is very warm in here, again leaving you to assume that some long lasting enchantment has been placed upon the area.

55.Name: Wooden Walkway
55.Description: Against all logic, you are now walking along an intricately carved wooden bridge, over a large chasm. The wood seems to not have decayed at all, unlike the carved stone, leaving you to assume that it has been somehow enchanted. The Contruct guards to not seem to want to come on to the bridge.

56.Name: Wooden Walkway
56.Description: Against all logic, you are now walking along an intricately carved wooden bridge, over a large chasm. The wood seems to not have decayed at all, unlike the carved stone, leaving you to assume that it has been somehow enchanted. The Contruct guards to not seem to want to come on to the bridge. To the north, the bridge seems to lead towards a room of some sort.

57.Name: Wooden Walkway
57.Description: You have reached the end of the wooden walkway. Whatever was keeping the rest of it intact seems to have weakened here, and the wooden boards seem rather precarious and dangerous to stand on. You can still make your way across it safely though.

58.Name: Winding Stone Passageway
58.Description: You are now walking down another long carved stone passageway. This one is much more irregularly carved, and the walls are battered, as if a battle took place here long ago. The Contruct guards patroll this area in great numbers, making you wonder if whoever created them has something important stored at the end.

59.Name: Winding Stone Passageway
59.Description: You are now walking down another long carved stone passageway. This one is much more irregularly carved, and the walls are battered, as if a battle took place here long ago. The Contruct guards patroll this area in great numbers, making you wonder if whoever created them has something important stored at the end.

The Contruct guards patroll this area in great numbers, making you wonder if whoever created them has something important stored at the end.

61.Name: Long Stone Passage
61.Description: You are making your way down another long passage. This one extends into the distance beyond your field of view. You hope you don't have to make your way through too many more of these.

62.Name: Stone Passageway
62.Description: You have made your way to a carved stone tunnel. It is rather dark here, compared to the rest of the area, and it seems like this area was abandoned by whoever made this place before they themselves left.

63.Name: Stone Passageway
63.Description: You seem to have reached a dead end. It looks as though there was once an exit leading to the south, but the stone has long since collapsed, blocking your way. There is nowhere else to go in this direction.

64.Name: Library
64.Description: You have stumbled in to what looks to be an ancient library. The shelves were carved out of stone, and you even see a few old scrolls and tomes still lying around, preserved by a powerful magic. Sadly, you cannot decipher any of them.

65.Name: Winding Stone Passageway
65.Description: You seem to have finally reched the end of this passage. The walls here are almost obliterated, and look to be charred with flames. You wonder what happened here, back when the place was still inhabited. You notice a small carved doorway that is still intact to the west. You wonder what was protecting that place that it was untouched by the destruction.

66.Name: Winding Stone Passageway
66.Description: You are now walking down another long carved stone passageway. This one is much more irregularly carved, and the walls are battered, as if a battle took place here long ago. The Contruct guards patroll this area in great numbers, making you wonder if whoever created them has something important stored at the end.

70.Description: You are now walking down another long carved stone passageway. This one is much more irregularly carved, and the walls are battered, as if a battle took place here long ago. The Contruct guards patroll this area in great numbers, making you wonder if whoever created them has something important stored at the end.

71.Name: Long Stone Passage
71.Description: The passageway turns sharply here, and begins to slope downward. You are a bit leery of descending any deeper into this place, but you don't see any other way to go.

72.Name: Long Stone Passage
72.Description: The passageway here continues downward, and ahead you can see than it turns sharply again, stopping your from being able to see exactly where it is leading you. You have no choice but to push on one way or another.

73.Name: Long Stone Passage
73.Description: The passageway turns again here, and slopes even more sharply downward. You notice that the walls here are beginning to become more broken up, but you also are for some reason starting to become slightly warmer.

74.Name: Long Stone Passage
74.Description: The downward sloping stops here, and the passage levels out. The strange warmth is growing slightly here, but a sharp curve of the passage ahead prevents you from seeing where it may be coming from.

75.Name: Long Stone Passage
75.Description: You seem to have reached the end of the stone passage. However, to the east, there is a large hole in the wall, and through it you can see what looks to be, to your surprise, greenery. You weren't expecting to find plantlife down here, but it is an almost pleasant site after the freezing wasteland above.

76.Name: Dirty Passage
76.Description: The stone seems to have inexplicable vanished from the floor here, and it is now covered in brownish dirt, and there is even a small amount of grass growing. You are certainly not used to grass growing underground, and you become a bit confused.

77.Name: Swampy Passage
77.Description: Somehow, this area seems to have some vegetation growing. More than that, this place seems to be becoming an underground swamp. You wonder what could have caused this. It would be quite a feat if whoever created this place was able to change the entire ecosystem of a cave to resemble an aboveground swamp.

78.Name: Swampy Passage
78.Description: You are now making your way through an almost inexplicable swampy area. The path you are making your way along seems to slope downward slightly, leading to another, more open area. You wonder if it is a good idea to continue.

79.Name: Swampy Area
79.Description: You have descended in to what looks to be a large underground swamp. There are some dying trees down here that indicate that this place might one have been a forest, though it has long been taken over by the murky swamp. You wonder what cause this place to come into being underground.

80.Name: Underground Swamp
80.Description: You have begun wading in a fairly deep, and unpleasant swamp. It does not smell nearly as bad as the swamps on the surface however, and you can see a number of small islands and dying trees in the murk. To the west, the swamp seems to give way briefly to a rising stone outcropping in the ground.

81.Name: Rocky Outcropping
81.Description: You have managed to get to a high outcropping of stone along the walls of this place. None of the spirits seem to be able to get up here, so you should be safe to rest here if neccessary.

82.Name: Rocky Outcropping
82.Description: You have managed to get to a high outcropping of stone along the walls of this place. None of the spirits seem to be able to get up here, so you should be safe to rest here if neccessary.

83.Name: Deep Swamp
83.Description: You are currently making your way through a particularly deep and unpleasant part of the swamp, where the muck comes almost up to your chest. You have some difficulty moving as your feet constantly sink into the mud below.

84.Name: Deep Swamp
84.Description: You are currently making your way through a particularly deep and unpleasant part of the swamp, where the muck comes almost up to your chest. You have some difficulty moving as your feet constantly sink into the mud below.

85.Name: Tree Filled Swamp
85.Description: You have come to another area of the swamp where a number of trees grow. There are not so many of them here, but you can still see a number of lonely spirits wandering around.

86.Name: Tree Filled Swamp
86.Description: You have come to another area of the swamp where a number of trees grow. There are not so many of them here, but you can still see a number of lonely spirits wandering around.

87.Name: Deep Swamp
87.Description: You are currently making your way through a particularly deep and unpleasant part of the swamp, where the muck comes almost up to your chest. You have some difficulty moving as your feet constantly sink into the mud below.

88.Name: Tree Filled Swamp
88.Description: You are making your way through a particularly thick bunch of dying trees. To the north, you think you can see an end to the swampy area, and what looks like some grass.

89.Name: Grassy Area
89.Description: Strangely, the swamp seems to end here, and become a fertile patch of grass. It looks as though something has made an effort to make the swamp more easily passable here. You wonder what could be down here that would bother to do such a thing.

90.Name: Tree Filled Swamp
90.Description: This area of the swamp has a fairly large number of old rotting trees scattered around. You think you notice a few insubstantial shapes wandering among the trees, looking lost. This place makes you feel strangely uneasy.

91.Name: Deep Swamp
91.Description: You are currently making your way through a particularly deep and unpleasant part of the swamp, where the muck comes almost up to your chest. You have some difficulty moving as your feet constantly sink into the mud below.

92.Name: Tree Filled Swamp
92.Description: This part of the swamp seems to have a lot more trees in it, some of which look almost alive. You can see a number of shapes moving around here, watching you. You can feel an almost perceptible sadness emanating from this place.

93.Name: Tree Filled Swamp
93.Description: This part of the swamp seems to have a lot more trees in it, some of which look almost alive. You can see a number of shapes moving around here, watching you. You can feel an almost perceptible sadness emanating from this place.

94.Name: Tree Filled Swamp
94.Description: This part of the swamp seems to have a lot more trees in it, some of which look almost alive. You can see a number of shapes moving around here, watching you. You can feel an almost perceptible sadness emanating from this place.

95.Name: Tree Filled Swamp
95.Description: This part of the swamp seems to have a lot more trees in it, some of which look almost alive. You can see a number of shapes moving around here, watching you. You can feel an almost perceptible sadness emanating from this place.

96.Name: Tree Filled Swamp
96.Description: This part of the swamp seems to have a lot more trees in it, some of which look almost alive. You can see a number of shapes moving around here, watching you. You can feel an almost perceptible sadness emanating from this place.

97.Name: Underground Swamp
97.Description: This area of the swamp has a fairly large number of old rotting trees scattered around. You think you notice a few insubstantial shapes wandering among the trees, looking lost. This place makes you feel strangely uneasy.

98.Name: Rocky Outcropping
98.Description: You have managed to get to a high outcropping of stone along the walls of this place. None of the spirits seem to be able to get up here, so you should be safe to rest here if neccessary.

99.Name: Underground Swamp
99.Description: You are wading through a shin-deep swamp. A number of unidentified creatures swim past your legs in the murk, and you try to avoid thinking about just what is rubbing up against your ankles. You move forward as quickly as you can to keep anything from getting a hold of you.

100.Name: Underground Swamp
100.Description: You are wading through a shin-deep swamp. A number of unidentified creatures swim past your legs in the murk, and you try to avoid thinking about just what is rubbing up against your ankles. You move forward as quickly as you can to keep anything from getting a hold of you.

101.Name: Underground Swamp
101.Description: You are wading through a shin-deep swamp. A number of unidentified creatures swim past your legs in the murk, and you try to avoid thinking about just what is rubbing up against your ankles. You move forward as quickly as you can to keep anything from getting a hold of you.

102.Name: Underground Swamp
102.Description: You are in a deep, murky area of the swamp. This place seems to be rather wet, and you evetually find yourself wading through murk up to your waste. It is not a pleasant experience at all, but you think you can see slightly more stable ground to the north and east.

103.Name: Tree Filled Swamp
103.Description: This area of the swamp has a fairly large number of old rotting trees scattered around. You think you notice a few insubstantial shapes wandering among the trees, looking lost. This place makes you feel strangely uneasy.

104.Name: Slope Down
104.Description: Here, the path through the swamp begins to become more solid, and you see some stone outcroppings appearing in the ground. The path slopes downward a bit here, likely leading even deeper into this place.

105.Name: Underground Swamp
105.Description: You are in a deep, murky area of the swamp. This place seems to be rather wet, and you evetually find yourself wading through murk up to your waste. It is not a pleasant experience at all, but you think you can see slightly more stable ground to the south and west.

106.Name: Tree Filled Swamp
106.Description: This area of the swamp has a fairly large number of old rotting trees scattered around. You think you notice a few insubstantial shapes wandering among the trees, looking lost. This place makes you feel strangely uneasy.

107.Name: Swampy Passage
107.Description: You are at the bottom of a long descending passage. The swampiness of the area seems to be dissapating here, and movement becomes much easier.

108.Name: Swampy Passage
108.Description: You are walking through what looks to be the end of the underground swamp. The ground here has turned mostly into dying grass, and movement is now fairly simple again. In the distance, you think you can hear the rushing of water.

109.Name: Swampy Passage
109.Description: You are walking through what looks to be the end of the underground swamp. The ground here has turned mostly into dying grass, and movement is now fairly simple again. To the south, there is a fairly large open cave. You can see what looks to be a number of other cave openings in the walls.

110.Name: Lizardman Cave
110.Description: You have entered a smaller cave. Inside, a fire is burning, and you can see a number of shapes gathered around it. A hissing and snarling sound begins to rise as your presence is noticed. Perhaps it would be prudent to make an exit.

111.Name: Open Cave
111.Description: You are standing in the corner of this area of caves. To the north and west are two fairly large openings in the cave walls, and you think you can here noises from within.

112.Name: Open Cave
112.Description: You are standing in a fairly large cave area. To the west, you see a number of openings in the cave wall, possibly the home of some creature. To the south, you can hear the sound of running water.

113.Name: Open Cave
113.Description: You are at the far end of this cave. The sound of rushing water is very loud behind the cave wall, but you can't see exactly where it is coming from. To the east, there is a large opening in the cave wall, which looks to be the only way left to go.

114.Name: Lizardman Cave
114.Description: You have entered a cave full of Lizardmen. You're not sure why so many of them are gathered here, but you can only guess that they are protecting something. It's not immediately apparent what that is, but to the south you can see another opening, leading to what looks like  a large underground river.

115.Name: Lizardman Cave
115.Description: You have entered a smaller cave. Inside, a fire is burning, and you can see a number of shapes gathered around it. A hissing and snarling sound begins to rise as your presence is noticed. Perhaps it would be prudent to make an exit.

116.Name: Underground River.
116.Description: You are wading, or sometimes swimming, through a fairly large underground river. The current is fairly strong here, and you are being gradually pulled downstream.

117.Name: Underground River
117.Description: You are making your way down an underground river. The river seems to be flowing downward, taking you even deeper into this place. You could probably struggle against it if you wished, but this seems like the only way to go.

118.Name: Underground River
118.Description: You are wading, and frequently swimming through a fast moving underground river. You're not sure where it will lead you, but there doesn't seem to be any other way to go.

119.Name: Underground River
119.Description: You are wading, and frequently swimming through a fast moving underground river. You're not sure where it will lead you, but there doesn't seem to be any other way to go.

120.Name: Gate Up
120.Description: You are slowly being drawn up a shaft of light. There is no way for you to go back down.

121.Name: Underground River
121.Description: You are wading, and frequently swimming through a fast moving underground river. You're not sure where it will lead you, but there doesn't seem to be any other way to go.

122.Name: Underground River
122.Description: You are wading, and frequently swimming through a fast moving underground river. You're not sure where it will lead you, but there doesn't seem to be any other way to go.

123.Name: Underground River
123.Description: The river seems to slow down here, and you can see a "Beach" of stone to the south. You are finally able to make your way out of the river and to some relatively dry land. Farther to the south, you think you can make out a man-made spiral staircase heading down. You don't particularly want to think about what might have made it.

124.Name: Gate Up
124.Description: You are slowly being drawn up a shaft of light. There is no way for you to go back down.

125.Name: Gate Up
125.Description: You are slowly being drawn up a shaft of light. There is no way for you to go back down.

126.Name: Stairway Down
126.Description: You are standing at the top of a large spiral staircase heading down into the earth. You have no clue who made it, or why, but it seems to be the only way to progress deeper into this place.

127.Name: Mysterious Chamber
127.Description: You are at the bottom of a long, spiral staircase. This area appears to be largely undamaged, unlike the other places above. The walls are intricated carved with murals, and various unrecognizable letters. You wonder just who could have made this place.

128.Name: Mysterious Chamber
128.Description: The hallway leads straight on here. The walls along this chamber are covered with engravings depicting a huge, majestic city, far greater than anything you have ever seen. The hallway seems to continue far into the distance.

129.Name: Mysterious Chamber
129.Description: The hallway leads straight on here. The walls along this chamber are covered with engravings depicting a huge, majestic city, far greater than anything you have ever seen. The hallway seems to continue far into the distance.

130.Name: Central Chamber
130.Description: You seem to have reached an intersection point in this chamber. Hallways lead off in all directions, and you have no idea which direction is the right one to take. You will just have to keep exploring.

131.Name: Mysterious Chamber
131.Description: You are walking down another hallway. This passageway also has a number of murals on the wall, but they seem to depict scenes of fire, and of the great city seen in other murals burning. You wonder what could have cause the destruction of such a place.

132.Name: Mysterious Chamber
132.Description: You are walking down another hallway. This passageway also has a number of murals on the wall, but they seem to depict scenes of fire, and of the great city seen in other murals burning. You wonder what could have cause the destruction of such a place.

133.Name: Hall of Bone
133.Description: The feeling of death grown stronger here, and you can tell that it is emanating from down below. The bones lining the wall seem to pull the life from you as you walk by, but you resolve to push on.

134.Name: Mysterious Chamber
134.Description: You are walking down another hallway. The walls here are covered in murals depicting what looks to be a great battle. There are a number of mages and priests fighting against each other, while a single warrior seems to be locking in battle against a towering giant.

135.Name: Mysterious Chamber
135.Description: You are walking down another hallway. The walls here are covered in murals depicting what looks to be a great battle. There are a number of mages and priests fighting against each other, while a single warrior seems to be locking in battle against a towering giant.

136.Name: Dark Hallway
136.Description: This place seems to have had all the light sucked out of it. Although there are torches burning, they barely provide enough light to see by. This place makes you very nervous.

137.Name: Dark Hallway
137.Description: The darkness is pervasive here, and the many burning torches provide only barely enough light to see anything by. At the end of the hall you believe that you can make out a staircase leading down.

138.Name: Mysterious Chamber
138.Description: You are walking down another hallway. The murals on the wall here seem to show a number of mages banded together, controlling huge armies of the undead. You wonder if these mages have any relation to the many Necromancers you have found around here.

139.Name: Mysterious Chamber
139.Description: You are walking down another hallway. The murals on the wall here seem to show a number of mages banded together, controlling huge armies of the undead. You wonder if these mages have any relation to the many Necromancers you have found around here.

140.Name: Hall of Bone
140.Description: The walls here are lined with a number of human bones. You can feel dark power emenating from this place, and the feeling of death sends a chill down your spine. You guess that this is where the Necromancers keep most of their creations.

141.Name: Red Chamber
141.Description: The hallway here begins to glow red. At first you're not sure where the light is coming from, but you notice that the fire in the murals along the wall is beginning to glow. You feel a bit uneasy about continuing any farther, as the heat is beginning to become very intense.

142.Name: Red Chamber
142.Description: The heat here is very intense, almost as if you are standing in a fire yourself. At the end of the hallway, is a stairway leading down. Perhaps this will lead you deeper into this place.

143.Name: Stone Platform
143.Description: You are standing on a stone platform above a sea of fire. To the east, there looks to a huge amount of raging flames. The heat coming from them is extremely intense, but you think you could make your way down and look around if you so desired.

144.Name: Mass of Flames
144.Description: You are slowly making your way through masses of searing flames. The flames obscure your vision somewhat, but you are certain that you can make out a number of shapes moving around in the flames. The intense heat is beginning to get to you, and you wouldn't mind getting out of here as soon as possible.

145.Name: Hall of Bone
145.Description: You are at the bottom of a staircase. This chamber is filled with human bones, many of which have been put together and are moving around. The oppressive feeling in the area is very strong, and you have to use all your willpower to keep from collapsing on the ground.

146.Name: Hall of Bone
146.Description: This large chamber is filled with bones, mostly human ones. There is a large number of animated skeletal creatures wandering around, perhaps keeping guard, or perhaps simply waiting for a foolish person like you to wander down here. Either way, this place is one of the least pleasant you have ever been - the feeling of death makes you almost want to give up and collapse, but you manage to keep your senses and continue on.

147.Name: Hall of Bone
147.Description: This large chamber is filled with bones, mostly human ones. There is a large number of animated skeletal creatures wandering around, perhaps keeping guard, or perhaps simply waiting for a foolish person like you to wander down here. Either way, this place is one of the least pleasant you have ever been - the feeling of death makes you almost want to give up and collapse, but you manage to keep your senses and continue on.

148.Description: This large chamber is filled with bones, mostly human ones. 149.Description: This large chamber is filled with bones, mostly human ones. There is a large number of animated skeletal creatures wandering around, perhaps keeping guard, or perhaps simply waiting for a foolish person like you to wander down here. Either way, this place is one of the least pleasant you have ever been - the feeling of death makes you almost want to give up and collapse, but you manage to keep your senses and continue on.

150.Name: Hall of Bone
150.Description: Here, the feeling of death is replaced by one of dread. You are not sure exactly what is causing the fear that is permeating you right now, but it is surely something very powerful. You have an almost irresistable urge to turn back, but you steel yourself to move forward if neccessary.

151.Name: Hall of Bone
151.Description: This large chamber is filled with bones, mostly human ones. There is a large number of animated skeletal creatures wandering around, perhaps keeping guard, or perhaps simply waiting for a foolish person like you to wander down here. Either way, this place is one of the least pleasant you have ever been - the feeling of death makes you almost want to give up and collapse, but you manage to keep your senses and continue on.

152.Description: This large chamber is filled with bones, mostly human ones. There is a large number of animated skeletal creatures wandering around, perhaps keeping guard, or perhaps simply waiting for a foolish person like you to wander down here. Either way, this place is one of the least pleasant you have ever been - the feeling of death makes you almost want to give up and collapse, but you manage to keep your senses and continue on.

153.Name: Antechamber
153.Description: You are in a small room where the oppressive feeling of the area seems to lift slightly. The walls in here are not covered in bone, and you can gain a slight respite by taking some time to recover, although you know that there are certainly more undead creatures waiting for you when you leave.

154.Name: Hall of Bone
154.Description: The deathly feeling is growing even stronger in this area, as you attempt to make your way even deeper into this chamber. You aren't even entirely sure what you are doing anymore, all of your focus is taken up by retaining your will to stay alive in this place.

155.Name: Hall of Bone
155.Description: The deathly feeling is growing even stronger in this area, as you attempt to make your way even deeper into this chamber. You aren't even entirely sure what you are doing anymore, all of your focus is taken up by retaining your will to stay alive in this place.

156.Name: Hall of Bone
156.Description: The deathly feeling is growing even stronger in this area, as you attempt to make your way even deeper into this chamber. You aren't even entirely sure what you are doing anymore, all of your focus is taken up by retaining your will to stay alive in this place.

157.Description: The deathly feeling is growing even stronger in this area, as you attempt to make your way even deeper into this chamber. You aren't even entirely sure what you are doing anymore, all of your focus is taken up by retaining your will to stay alive in this place.

158.Description: Here, the feeling of death is replaced by one of dread. You are not sure exactly what is causing the fear that is permeating you right now, but it is surely something very powerful. You have an almost irresistable urge to turn back, but you steel yourself to move forward if neccessary.

159.Name: Lich's Chambers
159.Description: Here at the back of the Hall of Bone, you have discovered the chambers of a number of ancient liches. The feeling of pure dread intensifies as you step into this room, and are able to see the horrible undead beings which are at its source.

160.Name: Lich's Chambers
160.Description: Here at the back of the Hall of Bone, you have discovered the chambers of a number of ancient liches. The feeling of pure dread intensifies as you step into this room, and are able to see the horrible undead beings which are at its source.

161.Name: Dark Chamber
161.Description: You are in a subdued, dark chamber. You don't know what the source of this mystical darkness is, but it is making your feel very alone, and more than a little fearful. You hear whispers and the cracking of bones in the dark.

162.Name: Dark Chamber
162.Description: You are in a subdued, dark chamber. You don't know what the source of this mystical darkness is, but it is making your feel very alone, and more than a little fearful. You hear whispers and the cracking of bones in the dark.

163.Name: Ancient Library
163.Description: This room appears to be a library. There are hundreds of books and scrolls lining the walls, but you are not able to read the writing on any of them. Perhaps these books contain knowledge of what occured in this place long ago - you will likely never know.

164.Name: Dark Chamber
164.Description: The darkness seems to lessen in intensity slightly here. The torches on the walls burn a little brighter, and you are able to see a room to the east. You wonder what could possibly be stored down here.

165.Name: Dark Chamber
165.Description: You are in a subdued, dark chamber. You don't know what the source of this mystical darkness is, but it is making your feel very alone, and more than a little fearful. You hear whispers and the cracking of bones in the dark.

166.Name: Dark Chamber
166.Description: You are in a subdued, dark chamber. You don't know what the source of this mystical darkness is, but it is making your feel very alone, and more than a little fearful. You hear whispers and the cracking of bones in the dark.

167.Name: Dark Chamber
167.Description: You are in a subdued, dark chamber. You don't know what the source of this mystical darkness is, but it is making your feel very alone, and more than a little fearful. You hear whispers and the cracking of bones in the dark.

168.Name: Dark Chamber
168.Description: You are in a subdued, dark chamber. You don't know what the source of this mystical darkness is, but it is making your feel very alone, and more than a little fearful. You hear whispers and the cracking of bones in the dark.

169.Name: Darkness
169.Description: You are in complete darkness. For some odd reason, you almost feel as if you can see better without the flickering light of the torches, and you have little difficulty navigating the narrow hallway.

170.Name: Darkness
170.Description: You are in complete darkness. For some odd reason, you almost feel as if you can see better without the flickering light of the torches, and you have little difficulty navigating the narrow hallway.

171.Name: Darkness
171.Description: You seem to have reached the end of this hallway. Your senses seem to be prenaturally sharp here, and you can sense the presence of various creatures in the dark in spite of being unable to see.

172.Name: Dark Room
172.Description: This room is pitch black. You can't tell what you are standing on, and you have to idea how far it extends. The only thing you can see is a single flicker of greenish light off in the distance. You figure that is the only way for you to go.

173.Name: Ethereal Passage
173.Description: You are walking through a strange, ethereal passageway. You are surrounded on all sides by a greenish glow, and you think you can make out some faces in the walls. To the east, you can see the entrance of a pitch black room.

174.Name: Ethereal Passage
174.Description: You are walking down a bizzare ethereal passageway. The walls seem to shimmer in and out of existance, and you would swear that you occasionally spot human shapes behind the walls, although they never appear for more than an instant. You begin to feel slightly dizzy walking down this disorienting path.

175.Name: Ethereal Passage
175.Description: You are walking down a bizzare ethereal passageway. The walls seem to shimmer in and out of existance, and you would swear that you occasionally spot human shapes behind the walls, although they never appear for more than an instant. You begin to feel slightly dizzy walking down this disorienting path.

176.Name: Ethereal Passage
176.Description: You are walking down a bizzare ethereal passageway. The walls seem to shimmer in and out of existance, and you would swear that you occasionally spot human shapes behind the walls, although they never appear for more than an instant. You begin to feel slightly dizzy walking down this disorienting path.

177.Name: Ethereal Passage
177.Description: The glowing light here intensifies, and turns a bright shade of blue. You are starting to have some diffuculty seeing where you are going. The dizzy feeling in your head intensifies as you cross into this area, and you have to step carefully to avoid losing your footing.

178.Name: Ethereal Passage
178.Description: The walls here glow a bright shade of blue. You can see ghost like figures hovering behind the walls, some of them coming a little too close for comfort. You become very dizzy as you continue down the passage, as everything around you doesn't seem to be quite so...stable as you are used to.

179.Name: Ethereal Passage
179.Description: The walls here glow a bright shade of blue. You can see ghost like figures hovering behind the walls, some of them coming a little too close for comfort. You become very dizzy as you continue down the passage, as everything around you doesn't seem to be quite so...stable as you are used to.

180.Name: Ethereal Passage
180.Description: The walls here glow a bright shade of blue. You can see ghost like figures hovering behind the walls, some of them coming a little too close for comfort. You become very dizzy as you continue down the passage, as everything around you doesn't seem to be quite so...stable as you are used to.

181.Name: Etheareal Passage
181.Description: The long hallway is growing oddly insubstantial here. The strange figures in the walls continue to float around, but the boundaries on the sides of the passage are becoming disturbingly unreal.

182.Name: Ethereal Path
182.Description: The walls here have become even more difficult to navigate. They seem to blend in with the world around in a way you have never seen before, almost as if you could reach through them. You wonder how much longer this path will go on.

183.Name: Ethereal Path
183.Description: It is becoming harder and harder to see. The world seems to be shifting in and out of existance here, and you hardly trust the floor to stay beneath your feet. You wonder if there is any end to this path.

184.Name: Etheareal Path
184.Description: It is becoming harder and harder to see. The world seems to be shifting in and out of existance here, and you hardly trust the floor to stay beneath your feet. You wonder if there is any end to this path.

185.Name: Ethereal Pathway
185.Description: It is becoming harder and harder to see. The world seems to be shifting in and out of existance here, and you hardly trust the floor to stay beneath your feet. You wonder if there is any end to this path.

186.Name: Ethereal Pathway
186.Description: The dizzying, winding pathway you are on has become almost imperceptible. In the distance to the west, you can see a shining white glow, but you cannot tell what it is. You hope against hope that you have finally reached the end of this place.

187.Name: The Gate
187.Description: The floor here is almost invisible. Everything around you shifts in bizzare fashion, as if it is not really a part of this world. You turn around and look back, but find to your dismay that the path your were walking on is no longer there. As you look around, the only thing you can see is a towering white gate. It seems to be made out of shifting light, and changes shape and size occasionally. You feel yourself drawn towards the gate by something in you beyond your comprehension, and as you get close is when you notice a solitary figure.

188.Name: Gate Up
188.Description: You are slowly being drawn up a shaft of light. There is no way for you to go back down.

189.Name: Gate Up
189.Description: You are slowly being drawn up a shaft of light. There is no way for you to go back down.

190.Name: Gate Up
190.Description: You are slowly being drawn up a shaft of light. There is no way for you to go back down.

191.Name: Stone Platform
191.Description: You have manage to have reached a stone platform above the flames. You should be safe from the various creatures down below here, as they do not seem to want to leave the fire.

192.Name: Mass of Flames
192.Description: You are slowly making your way through masses of searing flames. The flames obscure your vision somewhat, but you are certain that you can make out a number of shapes moving around in the flames. The intense heat is beginning to get to you, and you wouldn't mind getting out of here as soon as possible.

193.Name: Mass of Flames
193.Description: You are slowly making your way through masses of searing flames. The flames obscure your vision somewhat, but you are certain that you can make out a number of shapes moving around in the flames. The intense heat is beginning to get to you, and you wouldn't mind getting out of here as soon as possible.

The intense heat is beginning to get to you, and you wouldn't mind getting out of here as soon as possible.

196.Name: Swampy Path
196.Description: You are standing in a slightly swampy patch of ground. As you look around in the dim light, you think you notice a number of wooden huts, certainly not what you would expect to find down here.

197.Name: Lizardman Hut
197.Description: You have entered the hut of what looks to be an elder of this tribe of lizardmen. You can see a number of totems and fetishes on the wall, leading you to believe that this tribe practices some sort of shamanistic magic.

198.Name: Open Cave
198.Description: You are walking in a large carved out cave. You don't know what this place's original purpose was, but it seems to have become a village of Lizardmen. The look vaguely like the smaller breed you saw near Myronmet, but they are so much larger that the resemblace is passing at best.

199.Name: Lizardman Hut
199.Description: This hut seems somewhat different from the others. There are a number of spears along the walls, but also some large nets. On the other end of the hut, there is a staircase leading down. You take a guess that this is a fisherman's hut.

200.Name: Open Cave
200.Description: You are walking in a large carved out cave. You don't know what this place's original purpose was, but it seems to have become a village of Lizardmen. The look vaguely like the smaller breed you saw near Myronmet, but they are so much larger that the resemblace is passing at best.

201.Name: Lizardman Hut
201.Description: You have entered the home of some of the Lizardmen. A number of them are gathered in here, and none of them look happy to see humans intruding in their hut. There are a number of weapons lining the walls, as well as some strange objects of art.

202.Name: Lizardman Hut
202.Description: You have entered the home of some of the Lizardmen. A number of them are gathered in here, and none of them look happy to see humans intruding in their hut. There are a number of weapons lining the walls, as well as some strange objects of art.

203.Name: Small Grove
203.Description: There is a small grove of trees here, some of them even still alive. As you look around, you see a number of large, reptillian shapes slinking around the area. You wonder what you have walked into.

204.Name: Lizardman Hut
204.Description: You have entered the home of some of the Lizardmen. A number of them are gathered in here, and none of them look happy to see humans intruding in their hut. There are a number of weapons lining the walls, as well as some strange objects of art.

205.Name: Underground Lake Bank
205.Description: You are on the bank of a large underground lake. It seems rather shallow near the bank, so you could probably wade in a little ways if you so desired.

206.Name: Underground Lake
206.Description: You are wading, and sometimes swimming through an underground lake. You're not sure why you are doing so, as there are a number of very hostile creatures in here, but at least the water cleans off all that muck you got on you in the swamp.

207.Name: Underground Lake
207.Description: You are wading, and sometimes swimming through an underground lake. You're not sure why you are doing so, as there are a number of very hostile creatures in here, but at least the water cleans off all that muck you got on you in the swamp.

209.Description: You are wading, and sometimes swimming through an underground lake. You're not sure why you are doing so, as there are a number of very hostile creatures in here, but at least the water cleans off all that muck you got on you in the swamp.

210.Name: Underground Lake
210.Description: You are slowly wading through a deeper part of the underground lake. There is a small raised rock on the bottom of the lake which allows you to walk through this part, but the lake becomes dangerously deep on either side.

211.Name: Underground Lake
211.Description: You are slowly wading through a deeper part of the underground lake. There is a small raised rock on the bottom of the lake which allows you to walk through this part, but the lake becomes dangerously deep on either side. You don't think you can continue any farther.

0.Description: Beyond the dark steel gates, you can see into a dark stone fortress.

1.Description: The ancient stone walls of the Fortress of Greeanjok display a craftsmanship that was definitly not done by ogres. Very little light can be found inside here, and howls can be heard from deeper in the place.

2.Name: A Massive Stone Hall
2.Description: The ancient stone walls of the Fortress of Greeanjok display a craftsmanship that was definitly not done by ogres. Very little light can be found inside here, and howls can be heard from deeper in the place.

3.Name: The Halls of Greeanjok
3.Description: The huge stone hall splits off to the north and to the south here. A crude painting that was most likely done with blood displays a scene of an ogre tearing off the head of an unlucky human soldier.

4.Name: The Halls of Greeanjok
4.Description: The ancient stone walls of the Fortress of Greeanjok display a craftsmanship that was definitly not done by ogres. Very little light can be found inside here, and howls can be heard from deeper in the place.

8.Name: The Halls of Greeanjok
8.Description: An old wooden door marks the entrance to, surprisingly, an ogre library. It seems odd that these bloodthirsty maniacs would have any use for books. The stone hall way continues on to the south, leading to the central chamber of the fortress.

9.Name: A Dark Library
9.Description: Ancient wooden bookcases are filled to the brim with priceless texts from the times of the Veratine Empire, and perhaps even before that. If even one book could be smuggled out of here, it would make that person rich beyond imagination...

10.Name: The Halls of Greeanjok
10.Description: The ancient stone walls of the Fortress of Greeanjok display a craftsmanship that was definitly not done by ogres. Very little light can be found inside here, and howls can be heard from deeper in the place.

11.Name: The Halls of Greeanjok
11.Description: Up ahead you can see the Courtyard of Bone, which is the central chamber and meeting area of the ogre's Fortress.

12.Name: Before the Courtyard of Bone
12.Description: Up ahead you can see the Courtyard of Bone, which is the central chamber and meeting area of the ogre's Fortress.

13.Name: The Courtyard of Bone
13.Description: Legends have it that this courtyard was once a place where enlightened minds from all over the world gathered to debate the future of Kaldana. Now, it is filled with bones of the long vanquished foes of the ogres.

14.Name: The Courtyard of Bone
14.Description: Legends have it that this courtyard was once a place where enlightened minds from all over the world gathered to debate the future of Kaldana. Now, it is filled with bones of the long vanquished foes of the ogres.

20.Name: Before the Chamber of the Warlord
20.Description: The bones give way here to a marble entrance to the ancient throne room of the fortress.

21.Name: Chamber of the Warlord
21.Description: A gigantic throne made out of bone sits at the far center of the room, marking the seat of the current ogre to have earned the title Warlord Greeanjok. Ancient Veratine tapestries line the walls of the chamber, mocking those humans who dare challenge the might of the Greeanjok Ogres.

22.Name: The Halls of Greeanjok
22.Description: As you head into this part of the fortress, it seems to get darker and a bit colder. Torches line the walls, but only few have been lit.

23.Name: The Halls of Greeanjok
23.Description: As you head into this part of the fortress, it seems to get darker and a bit colder. Torches line the walls, but only few have been lit.

24.Name: The Halls of Greeanjok
24.Description: The passage turns sharply to the south, and the frightning howls of pain are getting louder.

25.Name: The Halls of Greeanjok
25.Description: To the west is an open steel door, which leads into some sort of office. To the east there is a huge stone staircase which leads into the cold depths of the fortress.

26.Name: The Office of the Captain
26.Description: A huge stone chair and desk marks this as the office of the Captain of the Greeanjok prisons. Bones are scattered about the room, and the ancient stone floor is stained with blood.

27.Name: The Halls of Greeanjok
27.Description: To the south the stone stairs lead down into the depths of the fortress, where the infamous ogre prisons are kept.

28.Name: Before the Greeanjok Jails
28.Description: The stones on the stairs have been painted pure black as they head lower and lower into the fortress basement.

29.Name: Entry to the Greeanjok Jails
29.Description: The black stone stairs end here, and a cold passageway leads off to the prisons in the east.

30.Name: The Prison Hall
30.Description: The prison hallway is freezing cold, and the screams coming from the various prisoners in the cells down here are practically deafening.

31.Name: The Prison Hall
31.Description: The prison hallway is freezing cold, and the screams coming from the various prisoners in the cells down here are practically deafening.

32.Name: A Horrible Prison Cell
32.Description: Inside the cell here, you see piles of bones and corpses. Apparently the ogres simply throw back the dead remainds of their victims among the unlucky souls who happen to be imprisoned down here.

33.Name: A Horrible Prison Cell
33.Description: Inside the cell here, you see piles of bones and corpses. Apparently the ogres simply throw back the dead remainds of their victims among the unlucky souls who happen to be imprisoned down here.

34.Name: The Prison Hall

38.Name: The Prison Hall
38.Description: The prison hallway is freezing cold, and the screams coming from the various prisoners in the cells down here are practically deafening.

39.Name: The Prison Hall
39.Description: The prison hallway turns to the north here, where the ogre's torture chamber is located.

40.Name: The Prison Hall
40.Description: The stone hall heads off to the east where the torture chamber is located.

41.Name: Before the Torture Chamber
41.Description: The stone hall heads off to the east where the torture chamber is located. You wonder if it is a good idea to even risk poking around in here...

42.Name: The Greeanjok Torture Chamber
42.Description: Massive devices built only to cause pain line the walls here. Random spikes and other instruments of death are scattered about the place, giving you a real uneasy feeling.

43.Name: The Greeanjok Torture Chamber
43.Description: Massive devices built only to cause pain line the walls here. Random spikes and other instruments of death are scattered about the place, giving you a real uneasy feeling.

44.Name: The Greeanjok Torture Chamber
44.Description: Massive devices built only to cause pain line the walls here. Random spikes and other instruments of death are scattered about the place, giving you a real uneasy feeling. To the south is a huge steel door.

45.Name: The Greeanjok Torture Chamber
45.Description: Massive devices built only to cause pain line the walls here. Random spikes and other instruments of death are scattered about the place, giving you a real uneasy feeling.

46.Name: The Office of the Inquisitor
46.Description: You have to literally wade through a pool of blood to get to the center of the room. It has a stone chair and table like the captain's office upstairs, but these seem to be unused and are full of broken human corpses. Writtings in blood on the wall display: "Teoark ni'ys aorm". You have no idea what this means, and really have no desire to find out.

47.Name: Pantheon of Darkness Staging Room
47.Description: A horrible demonic portal has appeared here, allowing Barakhorn and his army of darkness quick entrance into the ogre fortress of Greeanjok.

0.Name: Grotto Entrance
0.Description: Stepping inside the large opening in the cliff, you find yourself in the entrance to an oceanside grotto. Up to the north, the rock of the cliff gives way to sandy floors.

1.Name: Inside the Grotto
1.Description: The sandy floor seemingly brightens up the grotto, making it seem not as spooky as the freezing ghostly sand outside. However, you hear a ghastly shriek from deep in the grotto and you realize this place is just as bad. There are two rocky enclaves to your sides.

2.Name: Rocky Enclave
2.Description: The rocky enclave here is just large enough to step up into. A pile of bones half stuck into the rock wall gives you a horrible case of the shivers.

3.Name: Rocky Enclave
3.Description: The rocky enclave here is just large enough to step up into. A pile of bones half stuck into the rock wall gives you a horrible case of the shivers.

4.Name: Inside the Grotto
4.Description: The thick sandy floor of the grotto is pleasingly comfortable to walk on. Your visibility is slightly hindered by a grayish mist lazily swirling throughout the grotto.

5.Name: Inside the Grotto
5.Description: The thick sandy floor of the grotto is pleasingly comfortable to walk on. Your visibility is slightly hindered by a grayish mist lazily swirling throughout the grotto. A shallow stream of water covers a trail to the west.

6.Name: Watery Grotto Passage
6.Description: The water in this passage goes up to around your shins. It is surprisingly warm. You see small angry looking fish swimming around your feet...

7.Name: Watery Grotto Passage
7.Description: The water in this passage goes up to around your shins. It is surprisingly warm. You see small angry looking fish swimming around your feet...

8.Name: Watery Grotto Passage
8.Description: The water in this passage goes up to around your shins. It is surprisingly warm. You see small angry looking fish swimming around your feet...

9.Name: Watery Grotto Passage
9.Description: To the south the water filled passage ends and rises up to more grotto sand. You notice it is getting quite warm in this part of the area.

10.Name: Heated Grotto
10.Description: The sand on the floor is practically sizzling here! Up on the grotto rocks to the south you can see a huge bonfire.

11.Name: Heated Grotto
11.Description: You barely manage to climb onto the rocks. They are heated by the raging fire to the south. Strangely, the fire is giving off no smoke...

12.Name: Heated Grotto
12.Description: You barely manage to climb onto the rocks. They are heated by the raging fire to the west. Strangely, the fire is giving off no smoke...

13.Name: Grotto Fire
13.Description: A circle of charred rock surrounds the blazing fire. It gives off an intense amount of heat, but doesn't seem to give off any smoke at all. This is clearly not a man made fire.

14.Name: Further in the Grotto
14.Description: The rock of the grotto replaces the sand on the floor as you head deeper into the place. The mist gets much thicker up ahead.

15.Name: Further in the Grotto
15.Description: The grotto narrows down significantly here, and turns sharply to the right. It is getting harder to see where you are going for the gray mist continues to thicken.

16.Name: Before a Grotto Shack
16.Description: A rough wooden wall built into the grotto wall blocks your passage to the north. The rocky path continues to the east, where it seems to get much darker.

17.Name: Further in the Grotto
17.Description: The rocky grotto passage continues here, turning to the south a bit ahead. The thick gray mist is really starting to trouble you.

18.Name: Grotto Shack
18.Description: Getting passed the locked wooden door, you find yourself in a wooden shack built into the grotto. This room is full of broken furniture.

19.Name: Further in the Grotto
19.Description: The grotto passage turns to the east here. The thick gray mist is clearly coming from the end of the passage here.

20.Name: Grotto Shack
20.Description: The shack continues here. To the west the shack wall has been torn down and opens up to a deep pool of water. It looks like there used to be a rope bridge crossing the pool, but it is longer there.

21.Name: Dark Pool
21.Description: Jumping into the water, you get a shock at how absolutely freezing cold it is. You don't know if you can manage to swim your way across.

22.Name: A Treasure Pile
22.Description: Climbing out of the freezing pool, you are shocked to find a huge pile of treasure. Perhaps the people who had built the grotto shack hid their plunder here. Unfortunately, you see no possible way to move the treasure back across the pool of water and out of the grotto.

23.Name: Inside the Mist
23.Description: The passage ends here, but there is a black hole in the ground that the gray mist is billowing out of. You think you can fit down the hole. My, aren't adventurers a clever lot.

24.Name: Deep Grotto
24.Description: Jumping down the hole, you are totally surrounded by the mist. Something down here is forcing it up and out of the hole. You see a weak light to the south that must be the key to this mystery.

25.Name: Deep Grotto
25.Description: Clinging to the dark grotto walls, you can escape the stream of smoke that is being forced up the hole to the north. This area is much darker than up above but is not any colder.

26.Name: Deep Grotto
26.Description: Cleverly avoiding the gray mist, you can see a passage leading to the west and to the south. The eerie light seems to have a purple shade to it and is definitely coming from the south.

27.Name: Deep Grotto Enclave
27.Description: The passage here turned out to be a small enclave in the dark stone grotto walls. A large pile of bones is well placed in here.

28.Name: Deep Grotto
28.Description: The dark grotto passage takes a sudden turn to the east. The stream of mist is much more concentrated here, and the purple light from the east is growing more powerful.

29.Name: Deep Grotto
29.Description: From here you can clearly see the source of the gray mist. It is some sort of black looking rock.

30.Name: Source of the Mist
30.Description: The passage ends here. Randomly placed on the floor is a large pitch black rock. It gives off a steady purple light. The stream of gray mist simply leaks out the rock. You have absolutely no explanation what this is, but it somehow seems to be not of this world.

0.Name: Entrance to Halls
0.Description: You stand at the entrance to the greatest building the Veratine Empire ever built. In the distant past, the Halls of Sorrow might have had a different, more glorious name. In your time it is a monument to death, misery, pain and suffering. Debris from countless expeditions into the Halls litter the ground: empty potion vials, discarded food, broken weapons, and damaged armor. Barely audible incoherent whispers emanate from the black maw to the West.  To the East lies your only escape from the terror that grips you with every breath.  Hastily scrawled on the wall you read the message: \bSafe haven, rest well.\b0

1.Name: Garrison of Sorrow
1.Description: This room was a guard post established to protect the Halls of Sorrow from unwanted intruders and those seeking to steal the riches long since plundered after the fall of the Veratine Empire.  The malevolence that seeps from this place is so overwhelming, it threatens to break your resolve to see this through to the end. You begin to realize why the only ones that venture here are those that are supremely capable or those that are either too brave or too stupid to recognize the danger this place represents.

2.Name: Concerto of Sorrow
2.Description: You enter a room shrouded in mist.  It roils around your feet as if it were a alive and capable of consuming your very soul.  The feeling that you are in mortal danger has not lessened since defeating the Guardian in the other room.  This room looks like it was used as a concert hall of some sort.  Now it is a charnel house of violence.  The room reeks of spilt blood and decay; which stands in stark contrast to the mellifluous music you hear.

3.Name: A Shadowy Corridor
3.Description: You step into a strange corridor filled with shadows.  The darkness is so oppressive that the feelings of fatigue and hopelessness threaten to overwhelm you.  The shadows in this room flitter around you like a living thing, playing tricks on your mind and making you think you will be attacked at any moment.

4.Name: Shadowy Corridor
4.Description: You step into another strange corridor filled with shadows.  The darkness remains oppressive, so much so that you consider turning back.  The shadows in this room flitter around you like a living thing, playing tricks on your mind and making you think you will be attacked at any moment.

5.Name: Museum of Sorrow
5.Description: You step into a room that is surprisingly neat and clean despite being abandoned for more than two thousand years.  Implements of war are encased in finely crafted display cases.  You rub your hands together greedily knowing that any of these ancient items would command a king's ransom if brought back. It is clear from the expertly crafted display cases this room was a museum used to flaunt the spoils of past conquests.  Exquisite tapestries adorn the walls depicting battles long forgotten.  One tapestry in particular shows an enormous ax wielding conqueror flanked by two hideous demons. Your breath catches in your throat as the images begin to move in your direction.

6.Name: Pitch Black Corridor
6.Description: This passage is so dark you find it hard to maintain your sense of direction. You close your eyes and realize the dark is so absolute that there is no discernible difference between having your eyes opened or closed. Only a pin prick of light to the West provides any reassurance you didn't stepped into an endless void.

7.Name: Pitch Black Corridor
7.Description: This passage is so dark you find it hard to maintain your sense of direction.  You close your eyes and realize the dark is so absolute that there is no discernible difference between having your eyes opened or closed. Only a pin prick of light to the North provides any reassurance you didn't stepped into an endless void. You steel your nerves and continue to move forward.

8.Name: Throne of Sorrows
8.Description: You finally reach the last room in the Halls of Sorrow.  The room is grand with vaulted ceilings and polished onyx columns.  For all its size and grandeur the room is spartan in its decor. The sole exception is a large mural on the wall to your left depicting Serpolis just before the fall.  At the far end of the room is an enormous throne.  Given its size and exsquisite design you can only marvel at the labor and craftsmanship that it must have taken to build it.  Noticing your approach, the immense being seated at the throne rises to welcome you.

9.Name: Altar of Bones
9.Description: You step into a room littered with bones.  It is impossible to move quietly in this place because of the thousands of bones covering the floor.  As you step on a bone it pops loudly before crumbling into dust. Out of the corner of your eye you think you see a shape move, but when you turn to focus on it there's nothing there.  At the far end of the room you notice an altar of skulls neatly stacked into a pyramid.  The skull at the top is missing.  Perhaps the owner is still using it.

10.Name: Keeper of Sorrows
10.Description: The darkness in this room is so complete you can barely see your hands in front of your face. An eerie low moan seems to emanate from all directions further confusing your sense of direction.  You instinctively crouch in an attempt to prepare for an attack you can't see coming.

0.Name: Entrance to the Fallen Gods
0.Description: The room is dense and humid, you sense a long loss feeling you haven't felt in a long time, and not in a good way.

1.Name: Cassiels Soulreaper's Tomb
1.Description: The Room reeks of heavy decomposition. True evil resonating from the walls.

2.Name: bad room
2.Description: A Bright luminous light in the middle of the room that is being supressed by the darkness around it. Symbolizing that the being in the room still has light within themselves but is encompassed with darkness.

3.Name: Astral Hall
3.Description: There is an astral camp fire to provide warmth.

4.Name: Malachi's Tomb
4.Description: Polished marble and granite slabs encompasses the room, kept in pristine conditions looking almost no aged has occured.

5.Name: Astral Hall
5.Description: there is a camp fire to provide warmth

6.Name: Zadkeil's Tomb
6.Description: The walls entranced with an divine barrier but with displeasing wicked alterations.

7.Name: Astral Hall
7.Description: There is an astral camp fire to provide warmth.

8.Name: Balthazar's Tomb
8.Description: The empty void of the room is basked in an aura of malevolence.

0.Description: The trees here slowly give way to luscious grassland as the road continues north.

1.Name: The Old Road
1.Description: The road begins to slowly fade away into the grass as the forest is left behind. To the north is is the sparking blue waters of Lake Conosiat.

2.Name: The Old Road
2.Description: The road ends here, and only small cart and cattle tracks can be seen leading in various directions through the grass.

3.Name: Cattle Trail
3.Description: A small path through the grass, worn down by the travel of carts and cattle, leads north here.

4.Name: Cart Trail
4.Description: A small cart trail heads off to the west here, towards a small cluster of farms and houses.

5.Name: Grasslands
5.Description: The grasslands surrounding Lake Conosiat continue here, which gently sway in the wind. The smell of cattle is strong here, coming from the cattle ranch to the northeast.

6.Name: Cattle Trail
6.Description: The small path through the grass continues to head to the north. Up ahead you can see a small wooden building as well as a large fenced field with a great many cattle grazing in it.

7.Name: Cart Trail
7.Description: The cart trail, which seems well used enough, continuest towards the group of farms and houses to the west. Because the grass grows so fast near the lake, it has been impossible for a dirt road to be established.

13.Name: The Conosiat Cattle Ranch
13.Description: You are standing before a small wooden gate which leads into the Conosiat Cattle Ranch. It seems quite prosperous, as you can count over 100 cattle grazing in their large pastures.

14.Name: The Ranch House
14.Description: The ranch house is clean inside and is furnished with all sorts of interesting furniture, most relating in one way or the other to raising cattle. A book laying open on the kitchen table reads "Conosiat Cattle - 64 gold / pound , Epiach". The book seems rather old, however.

15.Name: Conosiat Ranch Pasture
15.Description: The contented looks on the many cattle here tell you that they must enjoy the luscious grass around here a great deal. The cattle raised on this ranch not only provide most of the meat for Myronmet, but back when the Southern Road was still safe to be traveled on, it provided alot of meat for Epiach as well.
