61.Name: Cart Trail
61.Description: The cart trail continues to the west. You can see the some grain fields on either side of the road, although it seems to be an ongoing struggle to keep the fast growing grass from overcoming the crops.

62.Name: Lake Conosiat
62.Description: A wooden fence surrounds the small collection of farms which lie to the west here. To the north, the blue waters of Lake Conosiat sparkle in the sunlight.

63.Name: A Farmhouse
63.Description: The farmhouse here is well built, but not very well furnished inside. It shows that the people up here care little for material possesions, and are entirely focused on the growing and selling of their crops.

64.Name: Before the Conosiat Farms
64.Description: A few modest looking buildings to the west house the farmers and their families who have their crops around here.

65.Name: Conosiat Farms
65.Description: To the south is a large grain field, which seems to be the most prosperous one of all the fields around here. The other farms are located to the west,

66.Name: A Grain Field
66.Description: The large rows of grain suggest that it will be time to harvest them soon. Judging by the amount of food grown here, it probably helps to feed most of Myronmet.

67.Name: Jeb Sedgeway's House
67.Description: The fine wooden furnishings suggest Jeb has quite a deal of wealth. Mounted on the back wall is a steel broad sword and an Imperial Majestic insignia, suggesting that Jeb once served in the Imperial military.

68.Name: Conosiat Farms
68.Description: To the south is the farm house of Jeb Sedgeway, the younger brother of Mayor Harn. While not nearly as prosperous as his older brother, Jeb has become quite rich from the sale of his grain to Myronmet and to his brother's shipping company.

69.Name: A Farmhouse
69.Description: The farmhouse here is well built, but not very well furnished inside. It shows that the people up here care little for material possesions, and are entirely focused on the growing and selling of their crops.

70.Name: Conosiat Farms
70.Description: The two farm houses ahead are not as large as Jebs, but seem rather nice none the less. The people living up here have shunned the busy city life of Myronmet, and instead spend their days working the land and enjoying the beauty of the lake.

71.Name: An Altar to Dephra
71.Description: A horrible altar, covered with blood and ash and with a symbol depicting the goddess of darkness, Dephra, stands here next to the lake. The ground around it is stained with blood and char. Nothing living surrounds the altar for 20 feet. You wonder what abomination of evil could have built this here, and why.

72.Name: A Sandy Path
72.Description: Up ahead appears to be some sort of red colored stone altar. The grass all around is dead, and bits of the water appear tainted. Along the bank, you see some dead fish floating in the water.

73.Name: A Lake Path
73.Description: A sandy path leads around the lake here. The grass around you begins to seem less healthy and has a touch of brown to it.

74.Name: A Sandy Path
74.Description: The sandy path continues around the lake, to the north. The grass definitly begins to seem withered, and you wonder what could be causing it.

75.Name: Wet Grassland
75.Description: A small stream which has grass all through it leads off to the south west, and helps feed the Myronmet Swamp.

76.Name: Grain Fields
76.Description: A few small grain fields here are grown and maintained by the people living in the houses to the east. A wooden fence to the west suggests the end of the small settlement around here.

77.Name: Wet Grassland
77.Description: A small stream which has grass all through it leads off to the south west, and helps feed the Myronmet Swamp.

78.Name: A Mine Entrance
78.Description: A rock outcropping in the grassland here has a goodly sized entrance which was blasted out a long time ago. It leads down into an old gold mine which was one of the original reasons Myronmet was founded, hundreds of years ago. You doubt its very safe to enter.

79.Name: Grassland
79.Description: A wooden fence marks the end of the small settlement. The grass is as tall and as healthy here as anywhere else near the lake.

80.Name: Fruit Trees
80.Description: A few rows of small looking apple and orange trees are here. Planted by Jeb, he is trying to bring more variety to people's diet in Myronmet, since no food from the rest of the Empire can arrive via land recently, and the ocean has been too rough for large ships to sail.

81.Name: Grassland
81.Description: A worn sign in the grass here reads, "Mine closed. Do not enter." A ways further to the west is a rock out cropping with a mine shaft entrance.

82.Name: Grassland
82.Description: Here, the grass was sucesfull in driving out the trees of the Illundium Forest.

83.Name: Trees and Grass
83.Description: The Illundium Forest is trying to fight back the rapidly growing grass. The ancient trees of the forest seem to be resisting the growth of the grass.

84.Name: Entrance to the Mine
84.Description: Old wooden scaffolding line the wet rock walls of the mine. Ruined mine carts and picks lay scattered around the floor here. Two shafts can be seen here, one leading north, one leading east.

85.Name: The East Mine Shaft
85.Description: A hole here leads down to an extensive mine system below.

86.Name: The North Mine Shaft
86.Description: A collapse of one of the rock walls here renders further progress in the north shaft impossible.

9.Name: Among the Ruins

10.Name: Among the Ruins

16.Name: Inside a Ruined Mansion
16.Description: The stone walls to several small rooms here have all crumbled to the ground here. These look like they were the rooms of children. Looking at the pile of ancient ruble on the floor, you can almost see the dead dreams of these people murdered two thousand years ago.

17.Name: Ancient Stone Courtyard
17.Description: The stone paving stones of this courtyard are in fairly good condition. All around you are the crumbling dark stone walls of an ancient mansion. Where there were once sounds of laughter and joy, there is now only the cold wind of the ruined city and frighting wails of inhuman things...

18.Name: Inside a Ruined Mansion
18.Description: The stone walls to several small rooms here have all crumbled to the ground here. These look like they were the rooms of children. Looking at the pile of ancient ruble on the floor, you can almost see the dead dreams of these people murdered two thousand years ago.

19.Name: Among the Ruins
19.Description: The ground here is wet and nearly swamp like. The ruined mounds of rock that make up the cities ancient statues, fountains, and buildings are now merely unidentifiable mounds of stone.

20.Name: Among the Ruins
20.Description: The ancient stones of the road are relativly unbroken here, and judging by the width of them you are probably on one of the main boulivards of the ruined Serpolis. The ruined mounds of rock that make up the cities ancient statues, fountains, and buildings are now merely unidentifiable mounds of stone.

21.Name: Approaching the Ruins
21.Description: The path you are traveling on is covered in a mix of dead grass, gravel, and small bits of the ruined stone of the ancient road leading into the city. Ruined stone buildings stretch out as far as you can see, and most do not appear to be safe for entering.

22.Name: Approaching the Ruins
22.Description: The path you are traveling on is covered in a mix of dead grass, gravel, and small bits of the ruined stone of the ancient road leading into the city. Ruined stone buildings stretch out as far as you can see, and most do not appear to be safe for entering.

Npcs.NpcName: A Terror Guard of Serpolis Reflection

23.Name: Top of the Chasm
23.Description: Climbing up to the sandy area at the top of the chasm, you can barely see the Coranin side far to the east. A heavy and cold fog makes it hard to see much to the west, by massive shapes in the fog look to be the ruined buildings of Serpolis.

24.Name: Up the Chasm
24.Description: Nearly at the top of the chasm, a frightning shriek pierces the sky and almost causes you to tumble down the cliffs to your death. You really shouldn't be surprised that there are beasts here...since it has been abandoned by human beings for over two thousand years.

25.Name: Up the Chasm
25.Description: Quickly crossing the chasm floor, you begin ascending the chasm wall once again. This small rocky path is filled with claw marks which suggest that it was not made by human beings.

26.Name: The Chasm Bottom
26.Description: The rocky path finally levels out and you step onto the cold sand of the chasm floor. Seeing the ruined foundations for the ancient stone bridge, you marvel at what an experience it must have been for travelers entering the city.

27.Name: Into the Chasm
27.Description: Variou piles of broken stone litter the steep rocky path, making the descent into the chasm extremely hazardous. You begin to feel a chill which easily penetrates your bones.

28.Name: bad room
28.Description: A steep rocky path leads away from the ruined stone path down into the ruins of the city. It looks that at one time the road sat on massive stone pylons, but they have long since been destroyed.

29.Name: Above the Ruins
29.Description: The ancient stone road here has collapsed into a rocky chasm. A small and dangerous path heads off to the south, which leads down into the ruins. You can see a chilling cold fog down in the valley.

Npcs.NpcName: A Dread Guardian of Serpolis Reflection

30.Name: Among the Ruins
30.Description: The ancient stones of the road are relativly unbroken here, and judging by the width of them you are probably on one of the main boulivards of the ruined Serpolis. The ruined mounds of rock that make up the cities ancient statues, fountains, and buildings are now merely unidentifiable mounds of stone.

31.Name: Inside a Ruined Mansion
31.Description: The cold stone hallways of the ancient building fill you with sadness at the thought that this was once a place where people of uncomprehensible wealth and power lived.

32.Name: Entrance to a Ruined Mansion
32.Description: The grand entry hall of an ancient mansion is in sorry shape. Portions of the roof have fallen down and huge cracks in the floor make it hazardous to walk. It is still very impressive that this building has remained standing for over two thousand years...

33.Name: Inside a Ruined Mansion
33.Description: The cold stone hallways of the ancient building fill you with sadness at the thought that this was once a place where people of uncomprehensible wealth and power lived.

34.Name: bad room
34.Description: ooops.

36.Description: ooops.

37.Description: ooops.

38.Description: ooops.

39.Name: bad room
39.Description: ooops.

40.Name: bad room
40.Description: ooops.

41.Name: Den of Talos
41.Description: Talos the Lost calls this murky place home.

42.Name: Among the Ruins
42.Description: Dark mud covers the ancient stone of the street here, washed in by the rapidly flowing river to the west.

43.Name: Beside the Raging River
43.Description: Dark mud covers the ancient stone of the street here, washed in by the rapidly flowing river to the west. A hole in the stone wall to the north presents an entrance into a huge ruined mansion

44.Name: Among the Ruins
44.Description: The ground here is wet and nearly swamp like. The ruined mounds of rock that make up the cities ancient statues, fountains, and buildings are now merely unidentifiable mounds of stone.

45.Name: Among the Ruins
45.Description: The ground here is wet and nearly swamp like. The ruined mounds of rock that make up the cities ancient statues, fountains, and buildings are now merely unidentifiable mounds of stone.

46.Name: An Ancient Building
46.Description: You find a small hole in the dark stone wall and step inside. You find yourself in the dark hallways of an ancient building. The walls are nearly all crumbled and you doubt the roof will be holding up much longer.

47.Name: An Ancient Building
47.Description: You find a small hole in the dark stone wall and step inside. You find yourself in the dark hallways of an ancient building. The walls are nearly all crumbled and you doubt the roof will be holding up much longer.

48.Name: An Ancient Building
48.Description: You find a small hole in the dark stone wall and step inside. You find yourself in the dark hallways of an ancient building.  On the ground is a tablet that says "Dolorem".

49.Name: An Ancient Building
49.Description: You find a small hole in the dark stone wall and step inside. You find yourself in the dark hallways of an ancient building. The walls are nearly all crumbled and you doubt the roof will be holding up much longer.

50.Name: Among the Ruins
50.Description: The ground here is wet and nearly swamp like. The ruined mounds of rock that make up the cities ancient statues, fountains, and buildings are now merely unidentifiable mounds of stone.

51.Name: Among the Ruins
51.Description: The ancient stones of the road are relativly unbroken here, and judging by the width of them you are probably on one of the main boulivards of the ruined Serpolis. The ruined mounds of rock that make up the cities ancient statues, fountains, and buildings are now merely unidentifiable mounds of stone.

52.Name: Among the Ruins
52.Description: The ground here is wet and nearly swamp like. The ruined mounds of rock that make up the cities ancient statues, fountains, and buildings are now merely unidentifiable mounds of stone.

53.Name: Inside a Ruined Mansion
53.Description: The kitchen of the building is a horrible mess, full of rock hard food and millenia old utensils. Looking at the utensils, you can't even begin to figure out how the people were able to eat their food with them.

54.Name: Before a Spiral Staircase
54.Description: The technically masterful spiral staircase made out of solid stone rises up into the second floor of the ruined mansion. Despite it's deteriorating features, it still remains the most impressive staircase that you have ever seen.

55.Name: Inside a Ruined Mansion
55.Description: The cold stone hallways of the ancient building fill you with sadness at the thought that this was once a place where people of uncomprehensible wealth and power lived. A crumbled portion of the west wall offers a convenient exit out to the streets of Serpolis.

56.Name: Staircase of a Ruined Mansion
56.Description: The wide stone spiral staircase climbs to a landing on the second floor. A wide hallway, impressive even though filled with ruined portions of the building's wall, fills you with a great feeling of loss.

57.Name: Second Floor of a Ruined Mansion
57.Description: The great hallway, littered with fallen stones and long forgotten relics of the Veratine Empire, you feel a slight breeze through an hairline gap in the wall panelling and a slight glow emitting from it. On the wall is ancient Veratine text that must have been burned in by some hellish fire. It reads Dixacarom.Dixacarom.

58.Name: Second Floor of a Ruined Mansion
58.Description: The great hallway, littered with fallen stones and long forgotten relics of the Veratine Empire, puts a feeling of deep sadness into your chest that you cannot seem to ignore.

59.Name: Second Floor of a Ruined Mansion
59.Description: The great hallway, littered with fallen stones and long forgotten relics of the Veratine Empire, puts a feeling of deep sadness into your chest that you cannot seem to ignore.

60.Name: Staircase of a Ruined Mansion
60.Description: Here there are more crumbling stone stairs, leading up into the base of what once was a gigantic stone tower rising out of the foundation of the mansion. Light streaming in from the top of the stairs shows that the tower has long since been destroyed.

61.Name: Second Floor of a Ruined Mansion
61.Description: The great hallway, littered with fallen stones and long forgotten relics of the Veratine Empire, puts a feeling of deep sadness into your chest that you cannot seem to ignore.

62.Name: Second Floor of a Ruined Mansion
62.Description: This room was once a bedroom of a very wealthy and powerful person. It is now filled with rubble and putrid refuse, left here by the various vile pests that are one of the few inhabitants left in Serpolis.

63.Name: Second Floor of a Ruined Mansion
63.Description: This room was once a bedroom of a very wealthy and powerful person. It is now filled with rubble and putrid refuse, left here by the various vile pests that are one of the few inhabitants left in Serpolis.

64.Name: Top of a Ruined Tower
64.Description: Having ascended the crumbling stairs of the ancient building, you stop out onto the ruined shaft of what looked to have once been a massive stone tower. The frightening scarring on the stone suggests a force uncomprehendable to you destroyed this place long, long ago.

1.Name: Main Street
1.Description: You are walking along the Main Street of Myronmet. A variety of well built wooden buildings are on both sides of the road. The street continues on towards the west, where there are more buildings. Directly to the east is the center of Myronmet, with the town square being the hub of most activity in the city.

2.Name: Main Street
2.Description: The Main Street continues towards the western portion of the city. Buildings continue to line both sides of the street, however there are more residences here than near the center of the city, which has all the shops.

3.Name: Main Street
3.Description: You continue along the Main Street. To the north is a rather large, stone church. A chiseled enscription over the double doors of the building reads "For the Glory of Aran We Serve". To the south is Eldan Avenue, which leads to the residential district of Myronmet. Farther west is the town gate.

4.Name: Main Street
4.Description: The Main Street ends here at the western gate. Few buildings are on either side of the road, due to the proximity of the town wall as well as the poor condition of the soil. The swamp that Myronmet borders is directly beyond the western gate, and it causes the land even on the inside of the gate to be unsuitable for much construction.

5.Name: The Western Gate
5.Description: You are standing inside Myronmet's western gate. The town guards keep a steady eye on the swamp beyond the gate, as many vile creatures dwell out there. The gate itself is a well built steel one, and the town walls to the north and south are built of thick sturdy stone.

6.Name: Main Street
6.Description: The Main Street continues through the large commercial district of the city. To the north is the largest inn and tavern in Southern Majestia, amptly called the Lazy Lizardman. Back to the west is the town square, and to the east is the heart of the commercial district of Myronmet.

7.Name: Main Street
7.Description: You are standing in the heart of the commercial district of Myronmet. Carts and temporary shops are everywhere, making it hard to even move along the street. A great deal of small wooden shops are along both sides of the road. To the north is a stone building, which is a contrast to the many wooden shops that are on both sides of it. A picture of a pile of gold coins and the words "In Gold We Trust" above the door of the building mark it as the town bank. To the south is a brand new shop, entitled the Myronmet Trading Emporium.

8.Name: Main Street
8.Description: Past the commercial district, traffic is not so bad on this part of the Main Street. To the north are the large stone walls of the town Soldiers Union, where the guards are trained and housed. Continuing to the east, the street heads towards a mostly residential district.

9.Name: Main Street
9.Description: The Main Stree continues to the east, towards the town gate. The quality of the buildings is steadily decreasing the farther away you get from the town center, but they still seem rather nice for a city of this size. To the south the Eastern Eldan Avenue runs through a residential area.

10.Name: Main Street
10.Description: The street ends here at the eastern gates of Myronmet. The houses here have seen better days, and it makes one wonder why Mayor Sedgeway won't invest some money into improving the quality of the area, it being so close to the town's primary entrance and all.

11.Name: Palace Boulivard
11.Description: This road used to be named North Dock Street until Mayor Sedgeway constructed the Myronmet Palace. Now it has been renamed to the Palace Boulivard, in an attempt by the mayor to increase the image of the city. As such, this is the wealthiest commercial district in Myronmet, with stone shops on both sides of the road. To the north is the Palace itself, and back to the south is the town square.

12.Name: Before the Myronmet Palace
12.Description: The road here abruptly stops at the cast-iron gate of the Myronmet Palace. This impressive marble building is notably out of place amoung the mostly wooden buildings of the city. The fact that this building is made of marble is a testament to the vast wealth of Harn Sedgeway, the twenty second Mayor of Myronmet.

13.Name: The Myronmet Palace
13.Description: The reception area of the Palace is large, with many townsfolk waiting in line to speak with the town officials or with the Mayor himself. The palace guards keep a close eye on everyone, to make sure nothing goes wrong. To the north of the central chamber of the Palace, and to the south of the exit.

14.Name: The Myronmet Palace
14.Description: You are standing in the central chamber of the Palace. A few clerks talk amoung each other, and the echo of their hushed voices carries well in the marble walled room. A gilded sign on the far wall of the room shows that to the west is the Hall of Town Affairs, and to the east is the Office of the Mayor.

15.Name: The Myronmet Palace
15.Description: A number of town officials have offices here, but the most notable one is that of Mayor Sedgeway. His door is open and you can see him reading over a number of documents. They could be related to town business or related to his own shipping company, which is the largest business in Myronmet.

16.Name: The Myronmet Palace
16.Description: The Hall of Town Affairs is a large chamber with a great, wooden table taking up most of the central space of the room. Currently the room is nearly empty, except for a clerk working on some papers at one of the side seats of the table. This must be where town meetings are held.

17.Name: The Shining Armor Emporium
17.Description: This is the newly opened Myronmet branch of the Shining Armor Emporium! The finely created wooden walls are lined with the finest in basic armors from all over the Majestic Empire. A goodly selection, from basic leather armor to immaculatly polished chainmail adorn the shelves. The shop clearly expects to make great profits, as the shop is filled with the finest rugs and furniture.

18.Name: The Lazy Lizardman Inn
18.Description: You are standing in the common room of the Lazy Lizardman. A great deal of patrons fill the many tables in the crowded room. Verhan, the proprieter who was once a notorious pirate, is obviously working very hard to keep his customers happy as well as making sure his multiple barmaids are doing their jobs. In the north left corner is a wooden staircase leading to the rooms upstairs. There is also a door leading to the basement, but it is locked.

19.Name: The Pack Mule
19.Description: The large building here is the Pack Mule, one of the many branches of the well known adventurers stores. The huge shop has everything a person would need to survive off the Imperial Highways, whether it be simple weapons or camping gear. A fat man behind the counter in the center of the store beckons you to the counter.

20.Name: The Marvelous Edge
20.Description: This medium sized weapon shop is owned and operated by a Myronmet local, Nirgal Beldanward. There are many weapon racks here covered with all types of weapons, from simple cutlerly to some very mean looking blades.

21.Name: Dock Street
21.Description: The wide dirt road that is Dock Street heads south here, away from the town square. A great number of carts and supply runners are traveling on the road, bringing goods to and from the Myronmet docks.

22.Name: Dock Street
22.Description: The town docks are now visible, and the size of them are astonishing. The forest of ship masts, combined with a huge amount of dock workers constantly loading and unloading the ships, creates for an inspiring scene. Dock Street continues south towards the sea of activity.

23.Name: Dock Street
23.Description: Here the residential Eldan Avenue intersects Dock Street. A number of towns people head in all directions here, some heading home, and some heading to work. The smell of of sea air is noticable this close to the docks. While you take in the pleasant unfamiliar scent, a rapidly moving horse drawn cart nearly runs you over as it races from the docks towards the Lazy Lizardman Inn with a fresh shipment of food.

24.Name: Dock Street
24.Description: Here the road actually meets the well worn wooden planks of the large town docks. Myronmet's position as the southern most city in Majestia has done well for it's prosperity, and the size and number of ships in the docks are testament to that fact. A countless number of sailors and dockworkers swirl around you, with everyone seeming having urgent business to attend to.

25.Name: The Myronmet Docks
25.Description: This is the center of the Myronmet Docks. All trafic converges here before heading to the warehouses, the commercial district, or onto the ships. This creates for a chaotic tide of carts, dockworkers, and merchants looking for a good deal before they hit the retailers.

26.Name: The Myronmet Docks
26.Description: You are standing on the main dock, which is a very long wooden planked structure. Dockworkers are loading and unloading heavy crates from the ships here. Sailors jump to and from their ships with the agility that months at sea brings.

27.Name: The Myronmet Docks
27.Description: As you approach the southern tip of the dock, the ships get larger and larger. Since the smaller ships are more manueverable, they are forced to dock in the smaller slots closer to the city. This is actually favorable for them, since they can send their cargo to the warehouses more quickly.

28.Name: The Myronmet Docks
28.Description: The largest of the ships are moored here at the southern tip of the main dock. Huge gangplanks connect the ships to the dock, and dockworkers and sailors alike help to load and unload the huge cargos these ships bring in. You notice one large ship flying the flag of the Imperial Army. You wonder why a ship of war would be at a commercial port like Myronmet...

29.Name: The Myronmet Docks
29.Description: The docks continue here, and to the north is the private warehouse of the Sedgeway Shipping Consortium. This is the Mayor's business and the way in which he became so wealthy. Now, much of the money he makes from his business goes towards the improvement of Myronmet.

30.Name: The Myronmet Docks
30.Description: To the south is the private dock of the Sedgeway Shipping Consortium, and their many ships are moored there, waiting to deliver and pick up cargo from any port in the Majestic Empire.

31.Name: The Myronmet Docks
31.Description: Sedgeway's private docks continue here, with well dressed dockworkers efficiently loading and unloading cargo onto the the fleet of well maintained ships here.

32.Name: The Myronmet Docks
32.Description: The largest ship in the docks, the Pride of Myronmet, is moored here. Bearing the personal symbol of Mayor Sedgeway, he uses the ship both for personal travel and as the flagship in his shipping fleet. Currently it is not being used, as it encountered a bad storm well to the west of Majestia and was badly damaged.

33.Name: The Myronmet Docks
33.Description: You are standing at the edge of the Myronmet Docks. A pile of freshly cut lumber and an architect taking measurements here tells you that Mayor Sedgeway is planning on expanding the city docks soon.

34.Name: The Myronmet Docks
34.Description: The Myronmet Docks continue here, lining the walls of the warehouses on one side and bordering the Asadric Sea on the other. All around you, dockworkers cart around loads of crates and ship cargo.

35.Name: The Myronmet Docks
35.Description: You are standing before the entrance of the Western Warehouse. This is a public storage facility set up by Mayor Sedgeway in order to aid the smaller shipping companies that lack their own warehouses. As a payment for this service, merchants using the warehouse must pay a 5 percent commision to the city of Myronmet. In the end, everyone wins because of the Mayor's clever business move.

36.Name: The Myronmet Docks
36.Description: The poorer shipping companies use this dock, as it is smaller and less sturdy than the main or the eastern dock. The ships here are of markably lower quality, yet they still server their owners well and bring in good profits. The workers and sailors seem to be moving more slowly here than at the other two docks, probably because their salaries are lower.

37.Name: The Western Warehouse
37.Description: The vast wooden warehouse is divided up into twenty sections of storage, in order for many merchants to securly and easily store their cargo in between shipments and sales. Clerks and dockworkers travel along the isles here collecting items and taking inventory.

38.Name: The Salty Wench
38.Description: This "quality" tavern has the reputation among the sailors here as the provider of the meanest mug of Domican Spiced Rum this side of the Asadric Sea. Due to its reputation and the enormous amounts of income the tavern brings in for the city, the Mayor has overlooked the sale of Domican products at this establishment, for now. You do not see a seat anywhere, and the barmaids are so busy serving the hoards of routey sailors that no one even notices you.

39.Name: Sedgeway Shipping Consortium
39.Description: ooops.

40.Name: Sedgeway Shipping Consortium
40.Description: As you enter the large building which is the headquarters of the Sedgeway Shipping Consortium, a receptionist asks if she can help you. Trying to edge past her to get a better look at the building, she rudely informs you that if you're not a merchant, you have no business there.

41.Name: The Eastern Gate
41.Description: The steel gate here marks the end of the Myronmet city limits. Outside the gate, a well traveled road heads out through the Illundium Forest towards Epiach and the rest of the Majestic Empire. The guards here seem less alert than those stationed on the western side of the town, but nonetheless seem competant in defending the city.

42.Name: bad room
42.Description: ooops.

43.Name: bad room
43.Description: ooops.

44.Name: bad room
44.Description: ooops.

45.Name: bad room
45.Description: ooops.

46.Name: Eldan Avenue
46.Description: On both sides of the road are a variety of well constructed homes and buildings. To the east is the crowded Dock Street, and down the avenue a ways to the east you can make out the Mayor's own home.

47.Name: Eldan Avenue
47.Description: Eldan Avenue continues through the fine residential neighborhood of Myronmet.

48.Name: Eldan Avenue
48.Description: The avenue turns to the north here, towards Main Street. To the west is the large manor of Harn Sedgeway himself. With all his wealth, you wonder why his manor is simply constructed out of wood.

49.Name: The Hall of the Conclave
49.Description: A large wooden table with many seats is located in the center of this room. The decorations in here are much more elaborate, but they are still very grim. This is where the higher up members of the Conclave gather to talk about political happenings in the world around and them how they can continue to stay as neutral as possible.

50.Name: Eldan Avenie
50.Description: To the west is Dock street, which is the vein of merchant trafic in the city, as it is the route people must take in order to bring the goods of the merchants to and from the arriving and departing ships at the docks. On both sides of the avenue there are small wooden homes.

51.Name: Eldan Avenue
51.Description: A deal of small houses surround Eldan Avenue here as it makes its way east and west through the city. The clean condition of the packed dirt road impresses you and you note the good job that Mayor Sedgeway has been doing running the city.

52.Name: Eldan Avenue
52.Description: You continue along the Eldan avenue, which runs through the center of a pleasent residential district. The citizens of Myronmet really have done quite well for themselves over the years, whether they worked at the docks or capitalized on the many other job opportunities in the city.

53.Name: Eldan Avenue
53.Description: The avenue turns to the west here, towards a more affluent residential area. The road runs right up against the ancient stone wall of the Myronmet Library, and you can see the corner stone which reads 2438 AF, which, according to your limited knowledge of the ancient dating system, would make the building over a thousand years old!

54.Name: East Eldan Avenue
54.Description: Eastern Eldan Avenue heads town to the south here, through a decent residential neighborhood. To the south you can see the ancient stone walls of the Myronmet Library.

55.Name: East Eldan Avenue
55.Description: The avenue here is flanked by the enormous Myronmet Library. The ancient structure is by the far the oldest building in Myronmet, having been here over three hundred years before the founding of the city proper. To the west is the small shop of Crazy Ben, who was once a noted alchemist and still sells a variety of interesting potions and ointments.

56.Name: West Eldan Avenue
56.Description: The western portion of Eldan Avenue continues to the north here, towards Main Street. A good number of well built wooden houses line both sides of the street.

57.Name: West Eldan Avenue
57.Description: The westernmost portion of the road here has recently sunken into the swampy land which has moved in, despite the solid foundations of the town wall. The Mayor is going to have to hire a large team of workers to haul in dirt to cover up the swampy land, less it expand to further parts of the city and make the road here unusable.

58.Name: The Combatant's Way
58.Description: This small road, barely larger than an alley, runs along the large stone wall of the Myronmet Soldiers Union. Back to the south is Main Street.

59.Name: The Soldiers Union Gate
59.Description: An impressive solid metal door guards the entrance of the Soldiers Union. This fortress like building not only provides housing for the town guards, it also provides a place of training for new guards and prospective soldiers alike. Funded by the Imperial Army, the building looks well maintained.

60.Name: Herbs and More
60.Description: This small potion shop is run by none other than Crazy Ben, who was once the most famous alchemist in all of Atlaand. Over the past few years, times have been hard on old Ben and he sailed to Myronmet seeking a change from the constant energy of a huge city. Here his shop has done fairly well, being across from the city library and all, yet Ben has grown bored with the bladn herbs of the Myronmet Swamp and is looking to journey to Odun, as soon as he finds a ship captain crazy enough to sail all that way.

61.Name: The Myronmet Library
61.Description: The interior of the library is cold, damp, and poorly lit. The placement of the countless bookcases seem to be almost haphazard, with odd gaps and bookcases that block the narrow isles. A number of robed men and women move silently throughout the library, pursueing their research with an unrelenting intensity.

62.Name: The Myronmet Library
62.Description: More bookshelves line the walls here, but this large room has an ancient symbol embossed in the center of the floor. It is the sign of the Academy of the Arcane Sciences, the oldest and most well respected school of arcane studies as well as historical studies in all of Kaldana. Today, the Myronmet Library is no longer affiliated with the Academy, but this building was built over a thousand years ago as a research facility of the Academies, in order to study the lizardman society which existed in the swamp to the west. Now of course, the building is nothing more than a large library, and the once great lizardman society has been reduced to a single tribe of agressive and unintelligent beasts. Silently reading over a book is a tall woman wearing a shimmering black robe, marking her as a Guild Master of the Wizards Guild.

63.Name: The Soldiers Union
63.Description: Rows of beds line the walls of the dorimitory here. Men living here no more than their beds and a chest of drawers for personal belongings. The armor and weapons is stored in the armory to the east of the room. It looks like a rough life, but one conducive to fantastic combat training.

64.Name: bad room
64.Description: ooops.

65.Name: The Bank of Myronmet
65.Description: While not too large of a bank, this one is obviously prosperous as the lines of people waiting to deposit and withdraw money are long. The multiple tellers, safe behind a stone wall and bars of titanium, continuously take and hand over stacks of gold coins. Several very mean looking guards make sure no attempts at robbery are attemped. A new sign above the tellers reads: "Domican bank notes are no longer void at this bank, by decree of the Empress."

66.Name: The Church of Myronmet
66.Description: You are standing in the general worship area of the Church of Myronmet. On both sides are rows of stone pews. The path leading up to the altar is covered by a fine red carpet. Pious decorations adorn each wall of the church, and clearly it has a prosperous congregation. A few towns folk are sitting on the pews, offering their silent prayers to Aran.

67.Name: bad room

68.Name: The Nobles Tailor
68.Description: The first thing spotted upon entering this well lit stone shop is the tremendous Domican Silk rug that covers most of the floor. With the recent decline in relations between the Empire and the Domican Republic, this rug is all the more valuable. The fine goods of the shop match the value of the rug. Hanging from polished wooden racks are robes and clothes of the finest quality. The owner, Malak Jovendry, squints at you and clearly thinks that you will not be purchasing any of his expensive clothing.

69.Name: The Church Altar
69.Description: Before you is the Church alter, dedicated to the god of Light, Aran. Fifty lit candles have been placed in front of the altar, as acts of faith and devotion by the regular church atendees. An elderly man is standing to the side of the altar, dressed in typical clericals. He wears a gold and blue sash around his waist, which shows that he is a Theolate of the Church of Kaldana.

92.Description: It is quiter and less crowded upstairs, but the noise from the common room is unavoidable. Up and down the hallway of the second floor there are guest rooms. You take a peek inside one of them, and they seem quite nice for such a popular inn.

93.Name: The Lazy Lizardman Kitchen
93.Description: The kitchen of the Inn is a chaotic place, with cooks and barmaids all hurrying trying to keep their customers well fed and well provided with ale. Certainly Verhan is not going to appreciate you snooping around his kitchen, for fear that you would report his cook's rumored less than sanitary culinary styles. Right before you decide that the rumors are not true, you notice a rat climb into a cauldron of stew and fall in. One of the cooks bellows and takes it out, but not attempt is made to make a new batch of stew. You remind yourself not to try the stew here.

94.Name: The Lazy Lizardman Inn
94.Description: Guest rooms continue to line the second floor hallway of the Inn. A large room near the end of the hallway has Verhan's name inscribed on the door, and must be his personal room. In this day and age, it is good to see a succesull inn proprieter still living in the same place that he works at.

95.Name: Myronmet Guides Office
95.Description: A simple room adorned with a few desks.  When there are people here, you can be sure they are here to help.

96.Name: Sedgeway's Warehouse
96.Description: Before you can even get inside the door of the building, a burly guard notices you and escorts you back outside to the docks.

97.Name: The Myronmet Trading Emporium
97.Description: The brightly lit interior of this brand new shop is very impressive. Pristine carpet covers the floor from wall to wall and a well polished oak counter sits at the far end of the room. A smiling woman dressed in merchant garb looks you over, clearly expecting a sale.

Many men, old and young alike, continuously move about the place, talking amongst each other, many of them carrying weapons and armor for practice. To the south are the dormitories of the town guards and the men in training, and to the east is the union pavillion where sparring and weight training take place.

105.Name: The Soldiers Union Pavillion
105.Description: Surrounded on all sides by the walls of the Union, this grassy area provides a large place for battle training and for observance. A number of men are currently fighting here, using wooden weapons and padded armor to avoid injury. Overlooking it all is a large man, wearing the red sash of a Majestic Army officer, as well as a Guild Master of the Soldiers Guild.

0.Name: Naraikos - Streets
0.Description: You are walking through the dirty, cold, and crowded streets of Naraikos. Large numbers of people wander around the streets, all of them refugees or criminals fleeing from the Majestic Empire's wrath. Guards roam the streets looking for monsters that may have passed the walls, and smokey torches burn, trying to keep the streets relatively warm.

1.Name: Naraikos - Office
1.Description: You are in the office of the governer of Naraikos. The office is spartan, containing only a few desks and cabinets. The governer himself is a large, strong looking man, who looks extremely competent. He is probably the reason that this city is still in existance despite all the difficulties this region poses.

You're not sure who they are of, but you imagine that they are the founders of the city. The inscriptions on the bases of the statues have long since worn away, but their is a kind of grandeur and dignity to them that you wouldn't have expected in this place.

22.Name: Icy Plains

You hear the howls of monsters all around you, and you dread to think that you may encounter them soon. Freezing winds chill you to the bone as you slowly wander across the vast plains. To the east, you see the streets of the city of Naraikos through the gap in the wall.

28.Name: Naraikos - Assassin's Guild
28.Description: As you walk through this building, it slowly dawns on you where you are. This is the oft spoken of and rumored, but never discovered rogue assassins guild. This is where assassins who have decided that serving the empire is a waste of time flee to. It is a base of operations for all manner of cutthroats and murderers. Not a friendly place if you don't belong.

Large numbers of people wander around the streets, all of them refugees or criminals fleeing from the Majestic Empire's wrath. Guards roam the streets looking for monsters that may have passed the walls, and smokey torches burn, trying to keep the streets relatively warm.

37.Description: You are in what seems to be the administrative center of this city. There are not many people here, and those that are look stressed and worried beyond belief. This is logical, considering their city is almost constantly on the verge of collapse. The various officials pay you little mind. In the back of the building is the office of the city's leader.

161.Name: Frost Giant Temple
161.Description: You reach the top of the cliff, and see what the giants were protecting. It appears to be a massive, open temple to some Frost Giant god. A number of giants are congregated here in prayer, and they are being led by a huge robed priest. You don't think it's a terribly good idea to linger around here.

167.Name: Snow Covered Plains
167.Description: You are walking through a part of the plains where the icy ground has been completely covered with snow. This slows your progress greatly, but at least it's a little easier to move without falling here.

You hear the howls of monsters all around you, and you dread to think that you may encounter them soon. Freezing winds chill you to the bone as you slowly wander across the vast plains. To the east, the plains begin to slope upwards, leading up a frozen cliff face. You wonder what could be up there.

170.Name: Frozen Cliff
170.Description: You are making your way along a path leading up this huge cliff face. The gigantic inhabitants are not taking kindly to your intrusion, and are attacking you in droves to to try to drive you back. Their ferocity makes you wonder what exactly they are guarding at the top of the hill.

172.Name: Down an Icy Path
172.Description: The icy plains here take a sharp slant downward as they lead off into the Great Chasm of the north. Stories and rumors from this area tell of nothing good ever to have come from trips to the chasm...

173.Name: Treacherous Revine
173.Description: Snow and Ice from a recent avalanche has opened up a small narrow pasage through the frozen revine.

174.Name: Treacherous Revine
174.Description: The ground is loose underfoot, slipping would mean imminent death, shards of ice and stone fall from above.

175.Name: Treacherous Revine

176.Name: Treacherous Revine

177.Name: Treacherous Revine
177.Description: The Pathway opens up slightly and you can just make out the shilouette of buildings etched into the frozen cliffside ahead...

178.Name: Tinker Town
178.Description: You stand at the entrance to what looks to be a Gnomish settlement, the buildings technologies look far more advanced than anything you've seen before. The inhabitants looks less than happy to see you.

179.Name: Tinker Town
179.Description: Walking Deeper into the town it's obvious the inhabitants are far more technologically advanced than any you've seen before. The town is etched seemlessly into the mountainside. The large clock tower in the centre of town illumiates the whole town with a gentle blue hue.

180.Name: Tinker Town
180.Description: Standing in awe of the engineering surrounding you, the clock bell chimes and you suddently notice a gentle flow of people heading towards the north west of the town.

181.Name: Tinker Town
181.Description: Walking Deeper into the town it's obvious the inhabitants are far more technologically advanced than any you've seen before. The town is etched seemlessly into the mountainside. The large clock tower in the centre of town illumiates the whole town with a gentle blue hue.

182.Name: Workshop Entrance
182.Description: The last remaining people have now walked through the steel forged doors you stand before. Intricate lock mechanisums run up and down the doors, luckly they have been left open.... Thunderous bellows come from within.

187.Name: Clock Tower
187.Description: You stand at the base of the towns Clock Tower. its an impressive structure comprised of forged steel and stone. You can hear the mechanical gears within churning.

188.Name: Clock Tower Stairs
188.Description: You climb the small steps of the tower. You can hear the noise of the gears coming from the above.

189.Name: Mechanical Door
189.Description: You climb to the top of the tower. Standing before you is a large mechnical door, gears and levers run along it's side. The only way to pass is with the correct key. You can hear the noise of the clocks inner workings coming from the room in front beyond the door.

190.Name: The Clock Tower
190.Description: Reaching the top of the tower you're now stood behind the large clock face. Huge brass gears turn in perfect unison as this engineering marvel perpetuates itself. There is an almost blinding arcane flame in the centre of the room that was generating the blue hue throughout the town

191.Name: Dead End
191.Description: This corner seems to lead to a dead end. Better make your way out before something unlucky happens.

0.Name: The Mirage Trail
0.Description: The path to Echoed Oasis is a winding ribbon of sand that meanders through the unforgiving desert landscape like a mirage on the horizon. The sun beats down relentlessly, casting shimmering waves of heat that distort the surrounding dunes. The air is thick with the scent of sun-baked earth and the distant promise of water. Along the trail, ghostly shapes flicker in the heat haze, teasing the eye with illusions of shade and shelter. Each step is a struggle against the shifting sands, the path ahead disappearing and reappearing like a fleeting dream. Yet, despite the harshness of the journey, there is a sense of purpose that drives you forward, a whispered promise of sanctuary waiting just beyond the horizon.

The sun beats down relentlessly, casting shimmering waves of heat that distort the surrounding dunes. The air is thick with the scent of sun-baked earth and the distant promise of water. Along the trail, ghostly shapes flicker in the heat haze, teasing the eye with illusions of shade and shelter. Each step is a struggle against the shifting sands, the path ahead disappearing and reappearing like a fleeting dream. Yet, despite the harshness of the journey, there is a sense of purpose that drives you forward, a whispered promise of sanctuary waiting just beyond the horizon.

Exotic flowers bloom in riotous colors, their petals trembling in the gentle breeze. Tall, slender trees sway gracefully overhead, their branches reaching towards the heavens. As you wander through the garden, you can't shake the feeling of being watched by unseen eyes.

83.Name: The Mirage Trail
83.Description: The path to Echoed Oasis is a winding ribbon of sand that meanders through the unforgiving desert landscape like a mirage on the horizon. The sun beats down relentlessly, casting shimmering waves of heat that distort the surrounding dunes. The air is thick with the scent of sun-baked earth and the distant promise of water. Along the trail, ghostly shapes flicker in the heat haze, teasing the eye with illusions of shade and shelter. Each step is a struggle against the shifting sands, the path ahead disappearing and reappearing like a fleeting dream. Yet, despite the harshness of the journey, there is a sense of purpose that drives you forward, a whispered promise of sanctuary waiting just beyond the horizon.

Its walls of weathered stone hold the echoes of forgotten voices, their secrets guarded by the desert's embrace. Faded scrolls and crumbling tomes line the shelves, their contents a testament to the wisdom of civilizations long gone. Shafts of sunlight pierce the gloom, casting a golden glow upon the relics of antiquity that fill the chamber. Scholars of old once walked these halls, their legacy preserved in the dust that settles upon the forgotten desk. Amidst the silence, the archive whispers tales of mystery and wonder, waiting to be uncovered by those who dare to seek its hidden truths.

178.Name: Leviathan's Abyss
178.Description: Within Echoed Oasis lies Leviathan's Abyss, a dimly lit chamber adorned with bioluminescent algae. At its heart lies a crystalline pool, its surface serene yet harboring the ancient Leviathan. The air is heavy with humidity and the echo of dripping water, adding to the eerie atmosphere of this secluded sanctuary.

195.Name: Depths of the Leviathan's Maw
195.Description: Nestled within the darkest recesses of Leviathan's Abyss lies the foreboding Depths of the Leviathan's Maw, a cavernous chamber shrouded in perpetual twilight. Bioluminescent algae cling to the walls, casting an eerie glow that dances across the slick, obsidian surfaces.
195.TerrainColor: Surrounding the altar, a labyrinthine network of tunnels and passageways extends into the depths, each one shrouded in darkness and echoing with the faint whispers of unseen horrors. Here, in the Depths of the Leviathan's Maw, the true power of the abyss awaits those brave enough to venture forth.
195.RawExitFlags: At the heart of the chamber, a massive, ancient altar rises ominously from the depths, adorned with mysterious runes and symbols of long-forgotten rituals. Upon this altar, the Guardian of the Abyss, a colossal serpent of primordial power, coils in restless slumber, its eyes glowing with an otherworldly intensity.

437.Name: Aquatic Crypt
437.Description: Deep within the Echoed Oasis, the Aquatic Crypt lies in shadowed secrecy. Bioluminescent flora cast a dim, mystical light upon the submerged chamber. At its center, an imposing altar stands, adorned with cryptic engravings and relics of forgotten rituals. Concealed within the murky depths, a formidable beast slumbers, its presence casting a palpable aura of danger. Adventurers tread cautiously through twisting passages, wary of awakening the guardian that lurks within the Aquatic Crypt's mysterious confines.

32.Name: Town Square
32.Description: You are currently standing in the town square of  Lakeside. The road leads to the north into a market district, and south towards what looks like a fishermans wharf.

33.Description: You walk towards the bridge. It is an amazing site, massive statues line the sides, and it extends across the lake for what looks like miles.

34.Name: Bridge
34.Description: You take the first steps onto the bridge to Atlaand. Sun glints off the water to either side of you, and you take a deep, envigorating breath as you prepare to at last enter the capitol of the Empire.

1.Description: Several armed soldiers stand guard over a barricade to prevent supplies for the fort from getting there.  The soldiers wave at you and tell you not to move!

2.Name: Majestic Army Tent
2.Description: The large tent holds many bunks along its sides, with large plain wooden tables in the center.  Some soldiers mill around while others sit at the tables playing games of chance and talking.

3.Name: bad room
3.Description: ooops.

4.Name: Majestic Medical Tent
4.Description: The priests and healers of the army are at work, trying to tend to the needs of the wounded.  Just as one soldier leaves for duty, another wounded one seems to take their place.

5.Name: Burning Fire
5.Description: A large fire burns outside the tents where the doctors and priests practice their arts.  A constant supply of hot coals enters the tents, to keep it warm and dry. The coals also are applied to metal which is used to cauterize the soldiers wounds.

6.Name: Soldier Commons
6.Description: Many soldiers are hurrying around the commons getting ready for another assault on the fort.

7.Name: Deeper into the Camp
7.Description: A well worn path through the grass heads east to another section of the camp.  You can see several fires burning and the sounds of men getting ready for battle.

8.Name: Road to Sassaren Fort
8.Description: You walk into the camp of the Majestic Imperial Army.  Over the past few days, they have been besieging the fort of Sassaren in order to oust some special occupants inside.

9.Name: Roaring Campfire
9.Description: Men who are off duty are singing, dancing and drinking around a large roaring bonfire.  All the merry making is a source of great moral to the troops.

10.Name: Majestic Army Tent
10.Description: The large tent holds many bunks along its sides, with large plain wooden tables in the center.  Some soldiers mill around while others sit at the tables playing games of chance and talking.

11.Name: Road to Sassaren Fort
11.Description: Many troops are standing on the road here, getting ready to set off as soon as an officer arrives with orders.

12.Name: Camp Guard
12.Description: Officers and troops pass by often on their way to the entrance of the fort, where the fighting is fiercest.

13.Name: Road to Sassaren Fort
13.Description: Troops are rushing past you on all sides, towards the gates of the Fort. What is it that is driving the Majestic Imperial Army to attack such a fort way out in the middle of nowhere?

14.Name: Road to Sassaren Fort
14.Description: At one time, several days ago, beautiful trees used to rise proudly into the sky along the Boulevard that leads to Sassaren Fort.  The battle that has been waged here though, has taken not only its toll on the men fighting, but on the landscape as well.

15.Name: Majestic Medical Tent
15.Description: The priests and healers of the army are at work, trying to tend to the needs of the wounded.  Just as one soldier leaves for duty, another wounded one seems to take their place.

16.Name: Majestic Army Tent
16.Description: The large tent holds many bunks along its sides, with large plain wooden tables in the center.  Some soldiers mill around while others sit at the tables playing games of chance and talking.

17.Name: Soldier Commons
17.Description: Many soldiers are milling about waiting for some leadership to present itself. Men sit atop logs, polishing armor and sharpening weapons.

18.Name: Roaring Campfire
18.Description: Men who are off duty are singing, dancing and drinking around a large roaring bonfire.  All the merry making is a source of great moral to the troops.

19.Name: Sapper's Mound
19.Description: It seems that the Majestic Imperial Army has employed a group of sappers to dig a mine underneath the walls of the Sassaren Fort.  You wonder how far they have tunneled, and realize the only real way to find out is enter the tunnel.

20.Name: Soldier Commons
20.Description: Many soldiers are hurrying around the commons getting ready for another assault on the fort.  Loose armor being tightened down and a quick cloth to polish their sword is all they have time for.

21.Name: Majestic Commander's Tent
21.Description: The tent is clean and made of heavy white canvas that seems to shine amongst the bright green tents of the regular soldiers.  Fancy chests line the tent walls along with a large table used to show the current positions of various troops in the area.

22.Name: Majestic Army Tent
22.Description: The large tent holds many bunks along its sides, with large plain wooden tables in the center.  Some soldiers mill around while others sit at the tables playing games of chance and talking.

23.Name: Cooking Fire
23.Description: A soldier hovers over a steaming pot of stewed meat.  Quickly producing a cudgel, he prepares to beat any hands that get too close to the pot.

24.Name: Majestic Army Tent
24.Description: The large tent holds many bunks along its sides, with large plain wooden tables in the center.  Some soldiers mill around while others sit at the tables playing games of chance and talking.

25.Name: Majestic Army Tent
25.Description: The large tent holds many bunks along its sides, with large plain wooden tables in the center.  Some soldiers mill around while others sit at the tables playing games of chance and talking.

26.Description: At one time, several days ago, beautiful trees used to rise proudly into the sky along the Boulevard that leads to Sassaren Fort.  The battle that has been waged here though, has taken not only its toll on the men fighting, but on the landscape as well.

27.Name: Road to Sassaren Fort
27.Description: You pass the last remains of the trees that sheltered this boulevard.  However up ahead of you, you get a clear view of the mass of bodies and animals that are in a locked battle for the Fort.

28.Name: Between the Tents
28.Description: There is a gap here between the tents for soldiers to move forward to their positions on the front lines.

29.Name: Majestic Army Tent
29.Description: The large tent holds many bunks along its sides, with large plain wooden tables in the center.  Some soldiers mill around while others sit at the tables playing games of chance and talking.

35.Name: Catapult Station
35.Description: These catapaults were brought all the way from the garrison at Atlaand.  The main beam is larger then two men in width, and 4 men in length.  A huge box of lead bars seems to be the weight that drives the catapult to launch rocks such amazing distances.

37.Name: Small Barricade
37.Description: Men constantly run into the field from here, clothed entirely in white.  These men retrieve the bodies of their fallen and take them away for a decent burial.

42.Name: Behind the Barricade
42.Description: In an attempt to seal off their camp from the Sassarens, long wooden spikes have been buried halfway into the ground.  Should any cavalry charge into these stakes, it would mean the end of them.

43.Name: Behind the Barricade
43.Description: The long spikes seem to be coated with some clear sticky fluid that keeps them from catching fire. Otherwise the barricade would have burned down long ago.

44.Name: Majestic Army Quartermaster
44.Description: This tent is huge and full of equipment.  Large stocks of food for the siege, piles of weapons and equipment lay orderly all over the place.  The quartermaster here seems well stocked.

45.Name: Behind the Barricade
45.Description: In an attempt to seal off their camp from the Sassarens, long wooden spikes have been buried halfway into the ground.  Should any cavalry charge into these stakes, it would mean the end of them.

46.Name: Sapper Tunnel
46.Description: After climbing down the ladder, you find the tunnel is large enough for three men to stand shoulder to shoulder.  You have no problems with headroom either as the ceiling of the mine is a full head above you.

47.Name: Sassaren Fields
47.Description: The Fields are relatively quiet now, but from the tracks on the ground and smell in the air, you can tell that there are orcs nearby.

48.Name: Sassaren Fields
48.Description: The sharpened spikes from the defenses jut out from the ground south of you.  They seem to be coated with some sticky liquid that keeps them from catching aflame, or the defenders of the fort would have set fire to them long ago.

49.Name: Sassaren Fields
49.Description: You shield your eyes as a roaring fire claims the last trees that used to shelter the plains from the elements.

50.Name: Sassaren Fields
50.Description: The Fields are relatively quiet now, but from the tracks on the ground and smell in the air, you can tell that there are orcs nearby.

51.Name: Before the Gates of Sassaren
51.Description: Majestic Troops seem to flood against the heavily defended entrance to the fort.  There are heavy casualties on both sides, and the fighting is still intense.

52.Name: Gates of Fort Sassaren
52.Description: The gates lie splintered with the hinges and locks broken.  There are also the remains of a battering ram nearby, so the gates didn't fall without an intense fight.

58.Name: Wall Breach
58.Description: The wall has been collapsed by the work of the Sappers!

59.Name: Tower Stairs
59.Description: The stairs rise sharply, and must be quite the climb for the troops who have to run up and down it during the siege.

60.Name: Inside the Southeast Tower
60.Description: The tower stairs ahead of you have caved in and prevents passage to the top of the battlements.  There is no way back but the way you came.

61.Name: Inside the Southeast Tower
61.Description: Several men lie injured along the walls, with the Sassaren's medical officers moving about treating whom they can.

62.Name: The Southeast Tower
62.Description: A large wooden door lies open allowing troops to come and go to the battlements as needed. Should the attackers break into the city however, the doors can be quickly closed to allow the defenders to attack the attackers in the street mercilessly.

63.Name: Damaged Storage Shack
63.Description: The roof of this shack has caved in from the rocks of the catapaults set up outside the fort. Sappers rise out of the ground, ready to take the battle to the enemy inside their fort.

64.Name: End of the Sapper Tunnel
64.Description: With the sappers pushing past you and climbing the ladder up, you won't be able to make it back down once you go up.  Now is your only chance to turn back.

65.Name: Sapper Tunnel
65.Description: The light shines bright on your feet now, a thick beam of dusty light.  It looks as if Aran himself opened his arms to these poor sappers as they shoveled and picked their way through the earth.

66.Name: Sapper Tunnel
66.Description: The tunnel turns north and up ahead you can make out a thin glimmer of light.  Not lamplight, but real light that must be pouring in through the final exit to the mine.

67.Name: Sapper Tunnel
67.Description: The tunnel continues north again around the underground vein of stone.  Small lights along the wall guide the way through the tunnel, although even with such lights, it is very dark.

68.Name: Sapper Tunnel
68.Description: The Sappers built this tunnel extremely well.  Large solid wood beams span the ceiling, with larger logs from the surrounding woods as the support beams.  Still, you can't help but feel unsafe underground, where there might not be an escape route should the tunnel collapse.

69.Name: Sapper Tunnel
69.Description: The tunnel turns east again as the looming gloom of black tunnel passes.  They seem to have tunneled around the vein of ore successfully, and you think that the tunnels up ahead appear brighter, possibly with sunlight

70.Name: Sapper Tunnel
70.Description: The lights have gone out long before here, making this area very dark.  There is not much to see because of it.

71.Name: Sapper Tunnel
71.Description: The Sappers built this tunnel extremely well.  Large solid wood beams span the ceiling, with larger logs from the surrounding woods as the support beams.  Still, you can't help but feel unsafe underground, where there might not be an escape route should the tunnel collapse.

72.Name: Sapper Tunnel
72.Description: The lights have gone out long before here, making this area very dark.  There is not much to see because of it.

73.Name: Sapper Tunnel
73.Description: The mine turns here as you set your hand against the solid rock facing of the north wall.  There must be some sort of rock formation underground, and these sappers probably didn't want to mine through it.

74.Name: Sapper Tunnel
74.Description: The tunnel continues north again around the underground vein of stone.  Small lights along the wall guide the way through the tunnel, although even with such lights, it is very dark.

75.Name: Sapper Tunnel
75.Description: The lights have gone out long before here, making this area very dark.  There is not much to see because of it.

76.Name: Before the Southeast Tower
76.Description: You stand before the southeast tower of Fort Sassaren.  There are some odd noises coming from the destroyed storehouse west of you, and you can hear the telltale signs of heavy plate as defenders from the walls come down from the tower to check it out.

77.Name: Horseman Road
77.Description: Named after the Horseman who ride this road to and from the stables at all hours of the day, Horseman road houses the stables of most of the horses and animals under Remiliak's command.

78.Name: Horseman Road
78.Description: Named after the Horseman who ride this road to and from the stables at all hours of the day, Horseman road houses the stables of most of the horses and animals under Remiliak's command.

79.Name: Horseman Road

80.Name: Storeroom
80.Description: The storeroom is stacked with many different types of boxes, crates and barrels.

85.Name: Across the Stone Bridge
85.Description: South fo the bridge, a massive battle looms for control of the gates.  Out of desperation for their own lives, the defenders are throwing everything they have to defend the gates.  The attackers seem to be doing the same except to try and take the gate from the defenders.

91.Name: Sassaren Stables
91.Description: General Remiliak was a great general with the Majestic Empire before he was accused of treason.  He knew the value of good cavalry in combat, especially with the amount of horses and stables there are in the fort.

92.Name: Sassaren Stables

94.Name: Gate Towers
94.Description: The gate towers seem to loom high above you.  The whistling of arrows being let loose and the clang of metal from the battle at the breached gates reminds you of how pivotal this position is.

95.Name: Horseman Road
95.Description: You walk onto the Ishwa Tailum, or Horseman Road in the language of some of the Desert Dwellers who come occassionally to trade at Fort Sassaren.  The Horseman Road heads east towards the defensive tower in the southeast.

100.Name: Fork in the Road
100.Description: The road divides in half here, leading to Shelter Road and Horseman Road.  Most of the road names come from what the soldiers have called them at a passing glance.

101.Name: Shelter Road
101.Description: As you walk along Shelter Road, the smells of the stables to your south make you gag and retch.  You'll be happy to get away from those stables as soon as you can.

102.Name: Inn of Tomas the Poor
102.Description: A lanky man stands rests behind the counter wearing some leather armor that doesn't seem to fit right.  Once this fort was abandoned, Tomas stayed behind and ran a small Inn.  People didn't cross the wastes to come here very much, so Tomas ended up growing very poor.  However now that Remiliak's revolutionaries have taken over the fort, things are starting to look up for ole Tomas.

103.Name: Shelter Road
103.Description: As you walk along Shelter Road, the smells of the stables to your south make you gag and retch.  You'll be happy to get away from those stables as soon as you can.

104.Name: Inn of Tomas the Poor
104.Description: This old ramshackled inn looks as if it has seen better days.  The Common room is full of soldiers, although very few of them are drinking or singing in delight.

105.Name: Inn of Tomas the Poor
105.Description: This old ramshackled inn looks as if it has seen better days.  The Common room is full of soldiers, although very few of them are drinking or singing in delight.

106.Name: Shelter Road
106.Description: Lying north of the stables lies a quaint and rundown Inn of Tomas the Poor.  Perhaps this is where the men of Sassaren come to feast and enjoy.

107.Name: Shelter Road
107.Description: At the end of Shelter road you see a large wooden building, which is a surprise, as most of the original buildings in this fort burned down at the start of the siege.

108.Name: Majestic Casualties of War
108.Description: Normally graveyards are monuments to the people who died gloriously for their cause.  This however is not the case.  Graves lie dug up by the Orcs, with bodies of the dead strewn about by refuse.  There is no glory in the death of these warriors. Only disgrace.

109.Name: Atop the Battlements
109.Description: Soldiers and archers are moving all over the battlements trying to achieve better positions to fire upon the enemy.

110.Name: The Walls of Fort Sassaren
110.Description: As you look around the corner of the battlement at the gate, you see a jumble of soldiers shooting arrows, swinging swords, and throwing spears.

111.Name: The Walls of Fort Sassaren
111.Description: You watch from under the wall as more men join the charge on the fort, sprinting across the road on foot. The Majestic Empire obviously wants to make a statement about how they deal with traitors to the Empire.

112.Name: Sassaren Fields
112.Description: The Majestic Empire placed their dead to the east of you, a sad memory and monument to the battle raging. However there are orcs all over the graves, defiling them for the treasures of the dead.

113.Name: Sassaren Fields
113.Description: You gag as your lungs are filled with the black smoke from the fires west of you.  You feel it would probably be better if you didn't get any closer to them.

114.Name: bad room
114.Description: ooops.

115.Name: Sassaren Fields
115.Description: Black clouds of smoke billow into the sky from the large fire south of you.  You think you best move away from this area, as a strong gust could whip the fire into a raging firestorm that would sweep the plains.

116.Name: Hidden Soldiers
116.Description: Some sappers have taken up a position near the fort wall here.  They seem to be trying to bring the wall down on top of them. What a group of idiots!

117.Name: Sassaren Fields
117.Description: There are broken spears, cracked swords, bent shields and useless arrows lying on the ground all over.  It will take years for the fields to return to their once pristine glory.

118.Name: Sassaren Fields
118.Description: You gag as your lungs are filled with the black smoke from the fires east of you.  You feel it would probably be better if you didn't get any closer to them.

119.Name: Sassaren Fields
119.Description: The sharpened spikes from the defenses jut out from the ground south of you.  They seem to be coated with some sticky liquid that keeps them from catching aflame, or the defenders of the fort would have set fire to them long ago.

120.Name: Sassaren Fields
120.Description: A few days ago, there used to be a decorative grove of trees lining the boulevard on each side of the road into the fort. However most of them have been torn down to form spikes for the defenses, arrows, and even replacement parts for the catapults.

121.Name: Sassaren Fields
121.Description: A large cluster of trees at once time stood here long ago, but now there are only ashes and a charred stump.

122.Name: Sassaren Fields
122.Description: You see two large brown gates lying broken from the siege weapons brought by the Majestic Empire.  Mounted Soldiers seem to be holding off the attacking army fairly well, using combinations of charges and the fighting abilities of their war horses.

123.Name: Near the Gates of Sassaren
123.Description: Men constantly pass you as the death toll rises to your east.  The Sassarens are better armored and equipped but lack the numbers of army brought by the Majestic Empire.

124.Name: Near the Gates of Sassaren
124.Description: Men constantly pass you as the death toll rises to your east.  The Sassarens are better armored and equipped but lack the numbers of army brought by the Majestic Empire.
