130.Name: Sassaren Fields
130.Description: The Fields are relatively quiet now, but from the tracks on the ground and smell in the air, you can tell that there are orcs nearby.

131.Name: Sassaren Fields
131.Description: To the west is a makeshift graveyard where the dead from battle are buried.  Something isn't right though, as it seems there are orcs digging up the newly sown graves.

132.Name: Sassaren Fields
132.Description: The Fields are relatively quiet now, but from the tracks on the ground and smell in the air, you can tell that there are orcs nearby.

133.Name: Sassaren Fields
133.Description: The Fields are relatively quiet now, but from the tracks on the ground and smell in the air, you can tell that there are orcs nearby.

134.Name: Sassaren Casualties of War
134.Description: Dead bodies litter the ground, with shallow graves nearby.  Amongst the Sassaren dead, however are orcs, pillaging the bodies of their equipment and personal effects.  It seems the Orcs have taken up grave robbing easily. It is a problem that must continue, for the men that would be used to guard this graveyard are more desperately needed to defend the Fort.

135.Name: bad room
135.Description: ooops.

136.Name: bad room
136.Description: ooops.

137.Name: Keep Road
137.Description: Troops of all shapes and sizes pass by on foot and mount.  They all seem to be going to the defense of the front gate.

138.Name: Keep Road
138.Description: Troops of all shapes and sizes pass by on foot and mount.  They all seem to be going to the defense of the front gate.

139.Name: Before the Keep
139.Description: The keep at the center of this fort looms high above you.  Men stand guard at its entrance. You hold a breath and think that General Remiliak must be inside somewhere!

140.Name: Keep Road
140.Description: Troops of all shapes and sizes pass by on foot and mount.  They all seem to be going to the defense of the front gate.

141.Name: Keep Road
141.Description: Troops of all shapes and sizes pass by on foot and mount.  They all seem to be going to the defense of the front gate.

142.Name: Gate Towers
142.Description: The gate towers seem to loom high above you.  The whistling of arrows being let loose and the clang of metal from the battle at the breached gates reminds you of how pivotal this position is.

143.Name: Supply Road
143.Description: Supply Road houses a number of warehouses along its length, at the very end you spy the defensive towers of the fort.

144.Name: Divide in the Road
144.Description: The heavily traveled road divides heading to the general barracks and stables, as well as the southwest wall defenses. However, ahead of you, the Sassaren army seems to have constructed a Shrine to Aran, hoping that such a thing would turn the tide of this battle in their favor.

145.Name: Shrine Road
145.Description: This road was named for the shrine that Remiliak had constructed for the faithful.  It is a beautiful albeit simple building, yet you are sure it is very dear to the inhabitants of this fort.

146.Name: Supply Road
146.Description: To the south stands a sturdy building brimming with supplies and equipment.  It is obviously a quartermaster's hutt.

147.Name: Supply Road
147.Description: Supply Road houses a number of warehouses along its length, at the very end of the road you spy the defensive towers of the fort.

148.Name: Supply Road
148.Description: You have to weave your way in and out of the men that keep coming from the Barracks.  Most of them are strapping on weapons and putting on armor as they are coming out, obviously being rushed to defend the fort.

149.Name: Shrine Road
149.Description: Shrine roads leads all the way up to the Barracks, where men enter and leave almost every minute that passes.  Men gallop past you on their horses frequently, so the stable must be farther back along the road too.

150.Name: Shrine Road
150.Description: As you turn the corner, you can see large stable at the end of the road.  This appears to be the source of where all the riders are coming from.

151.Name: Shrine Road
151.Description: Shrine Road leads past the barracks where the riders and infantry of the Sassaren army stays.  Ahead of you to the west, you can see the stables, where men walk to and fro getting their mounts ready to charge into battle.

152.Name: Shrine to Aran
152.Description: This building in the past, used to be home to some of the officers of the Imperial Army that was stations here.  After General Remiliak was declared a traitor and retreated here, the building was remodeled into a Shrine of Aran.  Now a former Paladin has taken up duties of Theolate within this shrine.

153.Name: Sassaren Stables
153.Description: The stable holds all manners of beasts and fowl.  Large war horses used by the cavalry in General Remeliak's army lie tethered against the wall.  Freshly brushed and well-fed, these horses are the pride of the Sassaren army.

154.Name: Sassaren Barracks
154.Description: Rows of double bunks lie against the wall.  Some soldiers are sleeping, others are polishing their equipment and cleaning their uniforms.  The amount of discipline these soldiers exhibit is remarkable and is a testament to surviving here.

155.Name: Sassaren Barracks
155.Description: The heavy door of the Barracks lies open, letting a cool wind blow inside.  The floor is clean and the walls look freshly painted.  The Sassaren army has done well since they took over this abandoned fort out past the wastelands.

156.Name: Sassaren Barracks
156.Description: The heavy door of the Barracks lies open, letting a cool wind blow inside.  The floor is clean and the walls look freshly painted.  The Sassaren army has done well since they took over this abandoned fort out past the wastelands.

157.Name: Sassaren Barracks
157.Description: Rows of double bunks lie against the wall.  Some soldiers are sleeping, others are polishing their equipment and cleaning their uniforms.  The amount of discipline these soldiers exhibit is remarkable and is a testament to surviving here.

158.Name: Quartermaster's House
158.Description: Danja the Quartermaster stands here, going through an inventory and checklist of all the supplies remaining in the fort.  He doesn't appear paniced by the numbers, so things must be good for the Sassaren forces.

159.Name: bad room
159.Description: ooops.

160.Name: Gates and Portcullis of the Keep
160.Description: The Portcullis and gates are open for now, allowing officers and personnel to return to their troops with orders to further the defense.

161.Name: Inside the Keep
161.Description: The thick walls of the Keep, keep almost all of the rocks and arrows from hitting any of the inhabitants in the Keep.

162.Name: Inside the Keep
162.Description: The keeps smooth stone floor and thick stone walls provide a haven against the effects of catapults and arrows that rains down on the rest of the fort.  Some soliders are sleeping in the corners on the cold ground, finding comfort that they can be safe here.

163.Name: Stairs to the Keep Summit
163.Description: Finely polished yet plain steps ascend to the top of the keep.  Officers and Soldiers run up and down the stairs ceaselessly, so perhaps that is where Remiliak is watching the battle unfold.

164.Name: Inside the Keep
164.Description: The keeps smooth stone floor and thick stone walls provide a haven against the effects of catapults and arrows that rains down on the rest of the fort.  Some soliders are sleeping in the corners on the cold ground, finding comfort that they can be safe here.

165.Name: Commander's Table
165.Description: The commander is here directing the forces that will attempt to break the siege of the fort.  He does not appear to be a man to sit behind walls, as his armor looks beaten and in need of a good repair and polish.

166.Name: Inside the Keep
166.Description: The keeps smooth stone floor and thick stone walls provide a haven against the effects of catapults and arrows that rains down on the rest of the fort.  Some soliders are sleeping in the corners on the cold ground, finding comfort that they can be safe here.

167.Name: Atop the Keep
167.Description: The stairs finally end and you find yourself under a hazy sky overlooking the gruesome results of the battle below.

168.Name: Overlooking the Battlefield
168.Description: You have a clear view of the battlefield.  Fires rage out of control, and Majestic soldiers are constantly rushing the fort.

0.Name: Above the Ruins
0.Description: The ancient stone road here has collapsed into a rocky chasm. A small and dangerous path heads off to the south, which leads down into the ruins. You can see a chilling cold fog down in the valley.

1.Name: Into the Chasm
1.Description: A steep rocky path leads away from the ruined stone path down into the ruins of the city. It looks that at one time the road sat on massive stone pylons, but they have long since been destroyed.

2.Name: Into the Chasm
2.Description: Variou piles of broken stone litter the steep rocky path, making the descent into the chasm extremely hazardous. You begin to feel a chill which easily penetrates your bones.

3.Name: The Chasm Bottom
3.Description: The rocky path finally levels out and you step onto the cold sand of the chasm floor. Seeing the ruined foundations for the ancient stone bridge, you marvel at what an experience it must have been for travelers entering the city.

4.Name: Up the Chasm
4.Description: Quickly crossing the chasm floor, you begin ascending the chasm wall once again. This small rocky path is filled with claw marks which suggest that it was not made by human beings.

5.Name: Up the Chasm
5.Description: Nearly at the top of the chasm, a frightning shriek pierces the sky and almost causes you to tumble down the cliffs to your death. You really shouldn't be surprised that there are beasts here...since it has been abandoned by human beings for over two thousand years.

6.Name: Top of the Chasm
6.Description: Climbing up to the sandy area at the top of the chasm, you can barely see the Coranin side far to the east. A heavy and cold fog makes it hard to see much to the west, by massive shapes in the fog look to be the ruined buildings of Serpolis.

7.Name: Approaching the Ruins
7.Description: The path you are traveling on is covered in a mix of dead grass, gravel, and small bits of the ruined stone of the ancient road leading into the city. Ruined stone buildings stretch out as far as you can see, and most do not appear to be safe for entering.

8.Name: Approaching the Ruins
8.Description: The path you are traveling on is covered in a mix of dead grass, gravel, and small bits of the ruined stone of the ancient road leading into the city. Ruined stone buildings stretch out as far as you can see, and most do not appear to be safe for entering.

9.Name: Among the Ruins
9.Description: The ancient stones of the road are relativly unbroken here, and judging by the width of them you are probably on one of the main boulivards of the ruined Serpolis. The ruined mounds of rock that make up the cities ancient statues, fountains, and buildings are now merely unidentifiable mounds of stone.

10.Name: Among the Ruins
10.Description: The ground here is wet and nearly swamp like. The ruined mounds of rock that make up the cities ancient statues, fountains, and buildings are now merely unidentifiable mounds of stone.

17.Name: Before an Ancient Building
17.Description: The ground here appears to be the stones of an ancient road, but you cannot be sure with the thick fog swirling around your feet. To the north are stones so dark that they appear almost black.

18.Name: Among the Ruins
18.Description: The ground here is wet and nearly swamp like. The ruined mounds of rock that make up the cities ancient statues, fountains, and buildings are now merely unidentifiable mounds of stone.

19.Name: Among the Ruins
19.Description: The grass on the ground here is dead, drowned by the rapidly flowing waters of the river to the west. To the south is a huge stone courtyard, surrounded by dark stone walls of a literally gigantic ruined mansion.

20.Name: Ancient Stone Courtyard
20.Description: The stone paving stones of this courtyard are in fairly good condition. All around you are the crumbling dark stone walls of an ancient mansion. Where there were once sounds of laughter and joy, there is now only the cold wind of the ruined city and frighting wails of inhuman things...

21.Name: Beside the Raging River
21.Description: The grass on the ground here is dead, drowned by the rapidly flowing waters of the river to the west. You can see stone ruins underwater, suggesting that this river two thousand years ago was not nearly as large or as rapidly moving as it is now.

22.Name: River Pass
22.Description: You attempt to hold yourself steady as you make way through the trecherous rapids.

25.Name: Beside the Raging River
25.Description: Dark mud covers the ancient stone of the street here, washed in by the rapidly flowing river to the west. A hole in the stone wall to the north presents an entrance into a huge ruined mansion

26.Name: Among the Ruins
26.Description: Dark mud covers the ancient stone of the street here, washed in by the rapidly flowing river to the west.

27.Name: Entrance to a Ruined Mansion
27.Description: The grand entry hall of an ancient mansion is in sorry shape. Portions of the roof have fallen down and huge cracks in the floor make it hazardous to walk. It is still very impressive that this building has remained standing for over two thousand years...

28.Name: Before a Spiral Staircase
28.Description: The technically masterful spiral staircase made out of solid stone rises up into the second floor of the ruined mansion. Despite it's deteriorating features, it still remains the most impressive staircase that you have ever seen.

29.Name: Inside a Ruined Mansion
29.Description: The stone walls to several small rooms here have all crumbled to the ground here. These look like they were the rooms of children. Looking at the pile of ancient ruble on the floor, you can almost see the dead dreams of these people murdered two thousand years ago.

30.Name: Inside a Ruined Mansion
30.Description: The cold stone hallways of the ancient building fill you with sadness at the thought that this was once a place where people of uncomprehensible wealth and power lived.

31.Name: Inside a Ruined Mansion
31.Description: The kitchen of the building is a horrible mess, full of rock hard food and millenia old utensils. Looking at the utensils, you can't even begin to figure out how the people were able to eat their food with them.

32.Name: Inside a Ruined Mansion
32.Description: The cold stone hallways of the ancient building fill you with sadness at the thought that this was once a place where people of uncomprehensible wealth and power lived. A crumbled portion of the west wall offers a convenient exit out to the streets of Serpolis.

54.Description: You find a small hole in the dark stone wall and step inside. You find yourself in the dark hallways of an ancient building.  On the ground is a tablet that says "Dolorem".

55.Name: Staircase of a Ruined Mansion
55.Description: Here there are more crumbling stone stairs, leading up into the base of what once was a gigantic stone tower rising out of the foundation of the mansion. Light streaming in from the top of the stairs shows that the tower has long since been destroyed.

56.Name: Second Floor of a Ruined Mansion
56.Description: This room was once a bedroom of a very wealthy and powerful person. It is now filled with rubble and putrid refuse, left here by the various vile pests that are one of the few inhabitants left in Serpolis.

57.Name: Second Floor of a Ruined Mansion
57.Description: This room was once a bedroom of a very wealthy and powerful person. It is now filled with rubble and putrid refuse, left here by the various vile pests that are one of the few inhabitants left in Serpolis.

58.Name: Second Floor of a Ruined Mansion
58.Description: The great hallway, littered with fallen stones and long forgotten relics of the Veratine Empire, puts a feeling of deep sadness into your chest that you cannot seem to ignore.

59.Name: Second Floor of a Ruined Mansion
59.Description: The great hallway, littered with fallen stones and long forgotten relics of the Veratine Empire, puts a feeling of deep sadness into your chest that you cannot seem to ignore.

60.Name: Staircase of a Ruined Mansion
60.Description: The wide stone spiral staircase climbs to a landing on the second floor. A wide hallway, impressive even though filled with ruined portions of the building's wall, fills you with a great feeling of loss.

61.Name: Second Floor of a Ruined Mansion
61.Description: The great hallway, littered with fallen stones and long forgotten relics of the Veratine Empire, you feel a slight breeze through an hairline gap in the wall panelling and a slight glow emitting from it. On the wall is ancient Veratine text that must have been burned in by some hellish fire. It reads Dixacarom.Dixacarom.

62.Name: Second Floor of a Ruined Mansion
62.Description: The great hallway, littered with fallen stones and long forgotten relics of the Veratine Empire, puts a feeling of deep sadness into your chest that you cannot seem to ignore.

63.Name: Top of a Ruined Tower
63.Description: Having ascended the crumbling stairs of the ancient building, you stop out onto the ruined shaft of what looked to have once been a massive stone tower. The frightening scarring on the stone suggests a force uncomprehendable to you destroyed this place long, long ago.

64.Name: Den of Talos
64.Description: Talos the Lost calls this murky place home.

65.Name: Ruined Library
65.Description: As you step into Lord Barakhorn's hidden study you gag reflexively from the foul stench.  It appears this room was sealed away for centuries, but now that it has been exposed to the rest of the Ruined Mansion the decay and putrescence long sealed away has been released. Rotting papers and mouldy furniture lay scattered about what was once an elegant study.

19.Description: The ancient packed dirt of the path heads to the north, away from Epiach. On both sides of the road, rocky hills make it hard to go anywhere but along the path.

20.Description: The ancient packed dirt of the path heads to the north, away from Epiach. On both sides of the road, rocky hills make it hard to go anywhere but along the path. However, you do see an old worn path leading off in the side of the hill to the west.

23.Name: Before the Iron Mine
23.Description: The path ends at the entrance of a large mine. Abandoned mine carts and pick axes lay about the ground here. Judging from the sounds coming from inside, it appears that the Ogres have taken over this mine. A torn down wooden sign reads "The Lariakin Iron Mine -- stay out".

24.Name: Along the Ancient Path

25.Name: The Laraikin Iron Mine
25.Description: The interior of the mine is well lit. This part seems to be completely mined out of iron, but mine cart tracks lead deeper into the mine to the south.

26.Name: The Laraikin Iron Mine
26.Description: This part of the mine has been mined to the point where there is no more iron. However, the mine continues to the south.

30.Name: Before the Gold Mine
30.Description: The entrance to the House Mandralor Mine is here. The sign that used to mark it as such has been torn down, no doubt by the invading Ogres from up the mountain. There are several skulls of miners who thought to defend the mines sitting on the tip of an Ogre spear here.

31.Name: House Mandralor Mine
31.Description: The interior of the mine is poorly lit, as most of the torches were destroyed when the Ogres took over. You hear the sound of rock being smashed, which is the telltale sign of Ogre miners at work.

37.Name: Before the Silverspire Mountains
37.Description: The path begins to switch back and forth here, as the foothills turn into the Silverspire Mountains proper. To the west the path gets steeper and harder to travel.

38.Name: Outside the Walls
38.Description: A gentle grassland meets right up against the edge of the tall stone walls of Epiach. Farther north the land begins to get rocky and uneven, marking the begginings of the Silverspire Foothills.

39.Name: Outside the Walls
39.Description: A gentle grassland meets right up against the edge of the tall stone walls of Epiach. Farther north the land begins to get rocky and uneven, marking the begginings of the Silverspire Foothills.

40.Name: The Silverspire Foothills
40.Description: The grass here is dead or dieing, because it is too hard for it to grow in the rocky soil. The ground around here is getting very rocky and very hilly, making farming or building out here impossible.

41.Name: The Silverspire Foothills
41.Description: The grass here is dead or dieing, because it is too hard for it to grow in the rocky soil. The ground around here is getting very rocky and very hilly, making farming or building out here impossible.

43.Name: Outside the Walls
43.Description: A gentle grassland meets right up against the edge of the tall stone walls of Epiach. Farther north the land begins to get rocky and uneven, marking the begginings of the Silverspire Foothills. Large rock outcroppings to the west and north prevent any further progress.

44.Name: An Old Grove of Trees
44.Description: Ancient stone ruins are located in the center of the grove of gnarled old trees, possibly marking the remains of an old ritual site.

45.Name: The Laraikin Iron Mine
45.Description: This part of the mine is where most of the tools were abandoned by the Laraikin miners when the ogres invaded from the mountains. It seems that the Ogres have been trying to mine the iron themselves, but not succeeding too well at it.

46.Name: The Laraikin Iron Mine
46.Description: Judging by the fresh cuts in the rock, this is the newest part of the mine. It appears that the Ogre's crude methods of smashing the rock with their bare fists has been somewhat succesfull for getting the iron out of the walls.

47.Name: House Mandralor Mine
47.Description: The interior of the mine is poorly lit, as most of the torches were destroyed when the Ogres took over. You hear the sound of rock being smashed, which is the telltale sign of Ogre miners at work.

48.Name: House Mandralor Mine
48.Description: The interior of the mine is poorly lit, as most of the torches were destroyed when the Ogres took over. You hear the sound of rock being smashed, which is the telltale sign of Ogre miners at work.

49.Name: A Grassy Hill
49.Description: You are able to climb up to the top of a grassy hill here. Ogres are notoriously terrible and climbing things, and so this is a safe spot.

50.Name: A Grassy Hill
50.Description: The top of the grassy hill continues on here. To the north west you can see a small grove of very old trees.

51.Name: A Grassy Hill
51.Description: You are able to climb up to the top of a grassy hill here. Ogres are notoriously terrible and climbing things, and so this is a safe spot. To the north is a small grove of old trees.

52.Name: An Ancient Grove of Trees
52.Description: A small group of ancient looking trees is growing at the top of the hill here. Fortunatly the Ogres have not been able to make it up the narrow and steep path which leads up here, or surely the trees would have all been cut down by now. You see a small dirt tunnel at the base of one of the trees, that leads down under the hill.

53.Name: A Grassy Hill
53.Description: You are able to climb up to the top of a grassy hill here. Ogres are notoriously terrible and climbing things, and so this is a safe spot. To the north is a small wooden hut. You wonder who would be crazy enough to live this far into the foothills?

54.Name: A Grassy Hill
54.Description: You are able to climb up to the top of a grassy hill here. Ogres are notoriously terrible at climbing things, and so this is a safe spot.

55.Name: The Epiach Northern Watchtower
55.Description: The watchtower is little more than a tall wooden building, which allows guards to stand on top to spot anything coming down the mountain path before they are too close to the city for warning. Built in the early days of Epiach, the watchtower is now being used again to fend off the ever increasing marauding Ogres.

56.Name: Goucho Al'Fraze's Mountain Shack
56.Description: Judging by the piles of goodberries laying around, you quickly realize that this is the shack of none other than Goucho Al'Fraze, the brother of Hortle!

57.Name: Druid Burial Cave
57.Description: The dirt tunnel leads into a large cave. There is a greenish mist swirling around that makes things hard to see. On the north wall is a stone slab with druidic engravings on it.

58.Name: Druid Burial Cave
58.Description: The cave opens up here, and you can see several wooden coffins in here. This must be where the mountain druids killed by the Ogres are buried. Oddly enough, not a single coffin has it's lid on.

59.Name: Druid Burial Cave
59.Description: The cave opens up here, and you can see several wooden coffins in here. This must be where the mountain druids killed by the Ogres are buried. Oddly enough, not a single coffin has it's lid on.

62.Description: The cave opens up here, and you can see several wooden coffins in here. This must be where the mountain druids killed by the Ogres are buried. Oddly enough, not a single coffin has it's lid on. An elaborte earthen tomb is located to the north, and seems to be the source of the green mist.

63.Name: Druid Burial Cave
63.Description: This portion of the cave is an elaborte druid burial tomb, complete with all sorts of inscriptions and dried up plants. The coffin appears to have been desecrated, for it is smashed open and the remains of whatever important druid it was that was buried here is nowhere to be found.

64.Name: On a Worn Path
64.Description: A worn path leads through the hills towards the west. You cannot see where the path leads, but you get an ominous feeling about the area to the west.

5.Name: The Ancient Mountain Path
5.Description: The road continues upwards into the silverspire mountains. You have little choice but to continue upward on the road, as steep rocks prevent you from going anywhere else. To the west is a large boulder with it's side collapsed so that you can climb up onto it.

6.Name: On top of a Boulder
6.Description: Standing on top of the large boulder, you can see a green patch of trees off to the north. The ancient mountain road heads off to the northeast, and noticably deteriorates as it heads higher and higher up the mountain.

7.Name: The Ancient Mountain Path
7.Description: The steep rock walls of the road give way here to a thick grove of trees to the north and west. The road itself heads up the mountain to the east. Signs of the ogres who dominate the mountain continue to get stronger and more frequent.

8.Name: An Alpine Forest
8.Description: The forest this high in the Silverspire Mountains is full of pine trees. The soft dirt ground is a welcome change from the hard rock of the mountain road. The ogres do not seem to have gone into the forest here, which is another very welcome change.

9.Name: An Alpine Forest
9.Description: The forest this high in the Silverspire Mountains is full of pine trees. The soft dirt ground is a welcome change from the hard rock of the mountain road. The ogres do not seem to have gone into the forest here, which is another very welcome change.

10.Name: A Boulder Above the Alpine Forest
10.Description: This boulder seems to have crashed down into the forest, flattening a bunch of trees. How it got here, you have no idea. It gives you a nice view of the forest, and of a lake far to the west.

11.Name: An Alpine Forest
11.Description: The forest this high in the Silverspire Mountains is full of pine trees. The soft dirt ground is a welcome change from the hard rock of the mountain road. The ogres do not seem to have gone into the forest here, which is another very welcome change.

12.Name: The Ancient Mountain Path
12.Description: The steep rock walls of the road give way here to a thick grove of trees to the west. The road itself heads up the mountain to the east. Signs of the ogres who dominate the mountain continue to get stronger and more frequent.

13.Name: The Ancient Mountain Path
13.Description: The steep rock walls of the road give way here to a thick grove of trees to the north and west. The road itself heads up the mountain to the east. Signs of the ogres who dominate the mountain continue to get stronger and more frequent.

14.Name: An Alpine Meadow
14.Description: The forest suddenly gives way to a flat grassy meadow here. To the west are the sparkling blue waters of a mountain lake. This is no doubt the source for the rivers which feed into Lake Conosiat and which provide water for all of the cities of Southern Majestia!

15.Name: On A Large Boulder
15.Description: Climbing up the side of a large boulder sitting in the meadow, you get a nice look of the vast mountain lake which is so important to the people of Southern Majestia. The crystal clear purity really gives you hope that all the troubles in the world will work themselves out eventually.

16.Name: Overlooking the Silverspire Lake
16.Description: Climbing up the side of a large boulder sitting in the meadow, you get a nice look of the vast mountain lake which is so important to the people of Southern Majestia. The crystal clear purity really gives you hope that all the troubles in the world will work themselves out eventually.

17.Name: A Rocky Canyon
17.Description: Off the road to the east here is a tall rocky canyon, filled with skulls and other signs of ogres. This is no doubt the entrance to their mountain fortress.

18.Name: A Boulder Above the Forest
18.Description: The top of this boulder is covered in mysterious druidic engravings and altars. From here you can see the Silverspire Mountains towering above you, although the peak is out of view as a thick layer of clouds covers the higher parts of the mountains.

19.Name: The Ancient Mountain Path
19.Description: The road continues upwards into the silverspire mountains. You have little choice but to continue upward on the road, as steep rocks prevent you from going anywhere else.

20.Name: The Ancient Mountain Path
20.Description: The air begins to chill noticably as you begin to get extremely high into the mountains. A thick layer of clouds hides the view of the top of the mountains that you are approaching.

21.Name: The Ancient Mountain Path
21.Description: The air begins to chill noticably as you begin to get extremely high into the mountains. A thick layer of clouds hides the view of the top of the mountains that you are approaching.

22.Name: The Ancient Mountain Path
22.Description: The rocky path begins to become covered in frost, and up to the north a thick layer of snow covers the ground. Crudely placed stone markers provide the location of the path up ahead. The thick clouds at the top of the mountain make it very hard to see much.

23.Name: The Ancient Mountain Path
23.Description: The snowy path continues on up the mountain here. A few worn stone markers show you the way to go, and you feel it would be very dangerous to stray off the path. The thick clouds up here make it hard to see anything that isn't a few paces in front of you.

24.Name: The Ancient Mountain Path

26.Name: The Ancient Mountain Path
26.Description: The snow covered path barely recognizable as a road finally levels out as you read the summit of the Silverspire Mountains! To the west is the snow capped absolute top of the mountain range. The path begins to descend again to the north, although what lays beyond is enshrouded in the thick clouds found up this high.

27.Name: A Rocky Canyon
27.Description: The rocky canyon here is over 100 spans deep, and you can see various skulls and other unfriendly reminders that you are heading towards the ogre fortress.

28.Name: A Rocky Canyon
28.Description: The rocky canyon here is over 100 spans deep, and you can see various skulls and other unfriendly reminders that you are heading towards the ogre fortress.

29.Name: Before the Ogre Basin
29.Description: The rocky canyon opens up to the east to a rocky basin which the Ogres have set up various mines and shacks to live in. You can hear the howls of their prisoners, and know that it might not be likely you will ever return from here alive.

30.Name: The Ogre Basin
30.Description: Various open pit mines and shacks are spread out in this large valley, which is of course full of very many Ogres. A well worn path to the east marks the way to their horrible fortress, known to them as Greeanjok.

31.Name: bad room
31.Description: ooops.

32.Name: Before the Deserted City
32.Description: To the east, you see signs of a civilization long since forgotten.

33.Name: The Ancient Mountain Path
33.Description: The snowy path starts to head down the mountain here. A few worn stone markers show you the way to go, and you feel it would be very dangerous to stray off the path. The thick clouds up here make it hard to see anything that isn't a few paces in front of you.

34.Name: The Ancient Mountain Path
34.Description: As you get farther from the summit, the clouds begin to lessen and you can even see a break in the snow farther down to the north.

35.Name: The Ancient Mountain Path
35.Description: The snow completly subsides here, and you're back to walking on the hard rock of the mountain road. The thick clouds are thinning out greatly as the road switchbacks steeply down the mountainside.

36.Name: The Silverspire Mountains Summit
36.Description: The fantastic view you would probably have of Majestia from up here is ruined by the thick clouds covering the mountains. The air is frigid and you feel light headed from the altitude. To the east you can make out the stone markers which show the where ancient mountain road is supposed to be.

37.Name: The Ancient Mountain Path
37.Description: Below the clouds circling the Silverspire Mountains summit, you can see the steep road switchbacking all the way down to the Coranin Forest below.

A small camp is set up here, housing the Imperial soldiers who are here to keep the road safe from the bandits who live in the mountains to the south.

53.Name: Before the Ogre Fortress
53.Description: Massive stone walls, towering 100 feet into the air, mark the entrance of Greeanjok. This ancient fortress is said to have once been a bastion of Veratine power, but after the mysterious decline of that empire the Ogres seem to have taken it over as their own center of power.

54.Name: The Entrance of Greeanjok
54.Description: The heavy dark steel gates of the gigantic ogre fortress have recently been opened, inviting those foolish enough to travel this far into their fortress of death.

55.Name: A Hidden Snowy Path
55.Description: You happen to stumble onto a narrow snowy path leading around the side of the summit of the Silverspire Mountains. The snow blowing around here makes it hard to see, but you feel you should be moving to the north.

56.Name: A Hidden Snowy Path
56.Description: The small snow covered path continues off around the summit of the Silverspire Mountains towards an unknown place.

57.Name: Before a Frozen Valley
57.Description: The snowy path suddenly ends at the edge of a steep ice covered cliff. Down far below you can see a valley filled with frozen trees. You could climb down the icy cliff if you use extreme caution.

0.Name: The Southern Road
0.Description: The southern road turns to the east here. The forest surrounding it continues to remain thick and you can't see much off the path.

1.Name: The Southern Road
1.Description: The road that connects most of the southern portion of the Majestic Empire continues through the forest to the north here. The condition of the road is not so good, as the greater portion of southern Majestia hasn't seen an Empire sponsored maintenance crew in over three years now.

2.Name: The Southern Road
2.Description: The southern road continues here in a straight line heading east and west. The forest surrounding it does not seem to be getting any less thick any time soon.

3.Name: The Southern Road
3.Description: The southern road continues here in a straight line heading east and west. The forest surrounding it does not seem to be getting any less thick any time soon. There are hardly any foot or horse prints on the ground, so not many people have used this road in a while it seems.

4.Name: The Southern Road
4.Description: The southern road continues here in a straight line heading east and west. The forest surrounding it does not seem to be getting any less thick any time soon. You see a broken-down cart here - it looks like it was abandoned quite some time ago.

5.Name: The Southern Road
5.Description: The road turns to the north here, although the forest continues to be just as thick all around. The condition of the road seems to be a little worse here than at the road closer to Myronmet.

6.Name: The Southern Road
6.Description: Here the road leads south and east. You are on a little rise here and you think you can see the ocean a ways to the south, but it is hard to see through the thick trees.

7.Name: The Southern Road
7.Description: To the west the road slopes up to go over a small rise in the forest. Off to the east you can see a small wooden barricade which is blocking the road.

8.Name: The Southern Road
8.Description: A wooden barricade here is blocking the road. You don't see a way to get past it, but you do see a small path that leads north through the forest, which may lead around the block.

9.Name: A Path through the Forest
9.Description: A small winding path leads through the forest here. It is very narrow and hard to see anything, except that the path leads to the north and the south here.

10.Name: The Southern Road
10.Description: This road is blocked off by a wooden barricade.

11.Name: The Southern Road
11.Description: ooops.

12.Name: The Southern Road
12.Description: This road is blocked off by a wooden barricade.

13.Name: The Southern Road
13.Description: This road is blocked off by a wooden barricade.

14.Name: The Southern Road
14.Description: This road is blocked off by a wooden barricade.

15.Name: The Southern Road
15.Description: A wooden barricade is here, blocking all traffic on the road leading to the south. The villagers in Steltan have been trying to remove the barricade, but with the heavy bandit activity in the area and no sign of the Imperial Army anywhere, they have been unable to.

16.Name: A Path through the Forest
16.Description: A small winding path leads through the forest here. It is very narrow and hard to see anything, except that the path continues to the north and to the south.

17.Name: A Path through the Forest
17.Description: Here the small path widens out a bit and you can see that it leads to the north as well as to the south and east.

18.Name: The Path through the Forest
18.Description: The small path through the forest leads on to the east and the west.

19.Name: The Path through the Forest
19.Description: To the west the narrow path continues through the dense forest. To the east is the southern road.

20.Name: The Southern Road
20.Description: There is an old, weathered signpost here on the edge of the road. It shows that Myronmet is to the west, Steltan is to the east, and that the city of Epiach is a ways to the north. On the bottom of the sign is the eblem of the Majestic Empire, which is a crystal sword with two colored orbs on each side and a red and black shield in the background.

21.Name: The Steltan Gate
21.Description: The wooden wall that surrounds Steltan has an iron gate here. The rag-tag guards who are watching the gate look exhausted from the constant bandit raids on the city. The wall and gate both look to be of low quality craftsmanship, and apparently were only constructed recently to aid in the defence of the village against the bandits.

22.Name: The Southern Road
22.Description: The southern road heads off to the north here. The forest surrounding it is gradually getting less dense as the road continues to the north. Back to the south is a junction which leads to Steltan and to Myronmet.

23.Name: The Southern Road
23.Description: The Southern Road continues off to the north here. The forest is a bit less dense here, but is still very thick. Travel without off of the road would no doubt be impossible.

24.Name: Steltan Village
24.Description: Before you lies the small village of Steltan, which in past years has been a prosperous and peaceful town in the heart of the Illundium Forest. As of late, the bandits from the north have set up a camp in a clearing in the woods near here, and have laid seige to the town ever since. Without the Imperial patrols that used to keep the Southern Road safe from this sort of problem, the villagers are activly seeking outside help.

25.Name: The Steltan Town Square
25.Description: You are standing in the small town square of Steltan village. Steltan is a small hamlet that recently the bandit leader Reshke has decided he wants to conquer. The people here are all doing their part to help fight the bandits but the town is getting tired, and with trafic from Myronmet cut off, they are quickly running out of food and fighting supplies...

26.Name: The Steltan Church
26.Description: You are standing inside the small church of Steltan. There are four rows of benches and a narrow carpeted walkway running through the middle. At the far wall of the church is an altar dedicated to Aran, the supreme god of Light. There is also a smaller altar, dedicated to Naltim-ka, the god of the forest.

27.Name: Steltan Village
27.Description: A good number of houses surround both sides of the village street here. The houses are all constructed of wood with thatch roofs, but are kept clean and well maintained, even in light of all the recent bandit attacks.

28.Name: Steltan Village
28.Description: More houses line the road here, and a few large ones which must belong to the wealthier of the farmers and merchants in the town are along the culdesac at the east end of the village street.

29.Name: Steltan Village Market Square
29.Description: This is the market square of the village, where all the shops are and where the trading takes place. Steltan has little to offer beyond wood crafted items, however it also has its share of what the farmers have been able to produce in the small patches of light forest around the edge of the village. There are also two large shops on the west and east end of the square. The west shop has a sign above the door which displays an axe, while the east shop has a sign to the side of the door which displays a mug of ale.

30.Name: Steltan Weapon Shop
30.Description: You are standing in the tidy interior of the Steltan weapon shop. Most of the sales come no doubt from the sales of axes that the town lumberjacks use to cut the trees in the forest surrounding the village. There also are some swords behind the counter, recently in stock, in order to help the village defend against the bandits.

31.Name: The Flirting Dryad
31.Description: Before the bandits began attacking Steltan, this tavern used to be full nearly all day long. Now, hardly anyone is in here, as they are all either resting or helping to defend the village. The bar counter is well smoothed from use over the years, and even with the recent supply shortage, it seems the barkeep has done a good job keeping an ample supply of ale and other alchohol.

32.Name: A Path through the Forest
32.Description: The path here gets wider and clearly has had alot of use lately. It continues on to the north and back to the south.

33.Name: A Clearing in the Forest
33.Description: Here the path leads into a medium sized clearing in the forest. Ahead of you is a ring of five tents, one of which is much bigger than the other four. There are a few cook fires in the middle. This must be the camp the bandits have been using to stage their attacks on the road and against Steltan.

34.Name: The Bandit Camp
34.Description: You are standing in the center of the bandit camp. There are 2 tents on either side of you, and a large tent to the north with a red banner which has the name "Reske" embroidered in gold letters on it. All around the camp there are weapon racks, and there are large crates of food and supplies that clearly have been stolen from the merchants who used to travel along the southern road.

35.Name: The Eastern Bandit Camp
35.Description: Besides the two tents which are staked up here, there are also some more crates of supplies left by the bandits here. There doesn't seem to be much organization to the camp, but it does seem like the bandits know what they are doing.

36.Name: The West Bandit Camp
36.Description: Two of the camps tents are here, as well as a large pile of wooden beams off to the side. It looks like the bandits are gathering materials to construct a permenant structure of some sort, perhaps a fort or more barricades for the southern road.

37.Name: Reshke's Tent
37.Description: The interior of Reskhe's tent is kept bright by 3 incensed torches. There are fine carpets that must have been purchased from outside of the Majestic Empire. In back of the tent, behind Reskhe's bed, are several locked metal chests. A large table in the middle of the tent has a well drawn map of Southern Majestia, with detail on the area in betwen Myronmet and Epiach.

60.Name: The Southern Road
60.Description: The road here turns to the north, continuing through the Illundium Forest. The condition of the road continues to be poor here.

61.Name: The Southern Road
61.Description: The road turns to the east, avoiding a small rock outcropping to the north.

62.Name: The Southern Road
62.Description: Around the large rock formation, the road turns back to the north.

63.Name: Southern Road
63.Description: The forest shows no sign of thinning out any time soon. The poorly maintained road continues off to the east here, away from that large rock formation to the west.

64.Name: The Southern Road
64.Description: The Southern Road of the Majestic Empire continues in both directions here.

65.Name: The Southern Road
65.Description: The road turns to the north here. The surrounding forest continues to be thick and impassible, except for the area that the road goes through.

66.Name: The Southern Road
66.Description: The road here continues, in the same poor condition as it is back towards Myronmet.

67.Name: The Southern Junction
67.Description: Here a junction branches off the road in three directions. An old but well built stone sign reads: "West - Myronmet. East - Vatlan Cliffs. North - Epiach.

68.Name: The Epiach Highway
68.Description: The Southern Road gives way to the Epiach Highway here. Already you can notice a vast improvement in the condition of this road. The road continues in a relativly straight line to the north.

69.Name: The Epiach Highway
69.Description: The highway continues to the north and south here. The hard packed dirt looks like the road would still be travelable even after a rain storm.

70.Name: The Epiach Highway
70.Description: The forest surrounding the highway definitly begins to thin out here. The road continues uninterupted to the north.

71.Name: The Southern Road
71.Description: This part of the road looks like it has been used even less than the road back to the west of the junction.

72.Name: The Southern Road
72.Description: The road continually degrades the farther away you get from the junction.

73.Name: The Southern Road
73.Description: The path is hardly recognizable as a road here, and looks more like a rough path through the forest.

74.Name: A Forest Pathway
74.Description: The packed dirt from the Southern Road can not even be seen anymore. You are now heading along a pathway through the forest, which is a weed covered grassy clearing in the forest.

75.Name: A Forest Pathway
75.Description: The forest is working hard to reclaim the path here. Progress it still possible, but it's getting slower.

76.Name: A Forest Pathway
76.Description: You think you see a break in the forest up ahead, but you can not be sure.

77.Name: A Forest Pathway
77.Description: You can barely walk on this path any more, but there definitely seems to be a break up ahead.

78.Name: Before the Vatlan Cliffs
78.Description: Suddenly the forest ends, and you emerge onto a grassy clearing. Far off to the south east, you can see the rocky top of the Vatlan Cliffs.

79.Name: The Epiach Highway
79.Description: The highway begins to widen here, and up ahead you can see the trees of the Illundium Forest begin to thin.

80.Name: A Small Cave Entrance
80.Description: You are standing on top of a small rock formation, rising out of the thick surrounding forest. Below you, is a small hole which leads into a dark passage.

81.Name: The Illundium Forest
81.Description: The dense forest here has been partially cleared by years of Steltan lumberjacks cutting down the dense growth of trees in this part of the forest. Amazingly, despite all the trees that have been cut, the forest is still impassable to the south or west. Off to the east are the wooden pallisades of Steltan Village.

0.Name: Workshop Entrance
0.Description: You walk into the large central forge of the workshop. What the Gnomish inhabitants have created within the mountain is truly astonishing. The noise is overwhelming as you try to make sense of which direction to head.

1.Name: bad room
1.Description: ooops.

2.Name: Master Smithie's Quarters
2.Description: Walking through the mechanical door you've entered the Master Smithies Quarters, unlike the other inhabitants this fellow stands slightly taller and looks of Dwarven origins, his creations hung proudly on the walls throughout the room.

3.Name: Western Casting Grid
3.Description: The molten metal from the central smelting pot flows into casts of what seems to be the moulds of a weapon hilt.

4.Name: Smelting Pot
4.Description: The heat from the smelting pot is incredile, the flames from the Bellows and fire below is creating a heat that unbearable.

5.Name: Eastern Casting Grid
5.Description: The molten metal from the central smelting pot flows into casts of what seems to be ring moulds.

6.Name: Mechanical Bellows
6.Description: The large mechanical furnace bellow, thrusts air into the central forge. the bellow is made from brass studs and leather made from what looks like a Wyverns hide.

7.Name: Northern Casting Grid
7.Description: The molten metal from the central smelting pot flows into casts of what seems to be bracelet moulds.

8.Name: Mechanical Bellows
8.Description: The large mechanical furnace bellow, thrusts air into the central forge. the bellow is made from brass studs and leather made from what looks like a Wyverns hide.

9.Name: Southern Casting Grid
9.Description: The molten metal from the central smelting pot flows into casts of what seems to be armor moulds.

10.Name: Mechanical Bellows
10.Description: The large mechanical furnace bellow, thrusts air into the central forge. the bellow is made from brass studs and leather made from what looks like a Wyverns hide.

11.Name: Boiler Room Corridor
11.Description: You enter the corridor, pipework for the whole workshop runs inches above your head, gusts of steam erupt from the seals as you carefully make your way down into its depths.

12.Name: Boiler Room Corridor
12.Description: Continuing down the corridor the heat from the forge leaves you. The pipwork runs seemlessly above the large mechanical door in front of you.

13.Name: Mechanical Door
13.Description: You stand in front of another mechincally locked door. The gear and levers are all engaged and the only way through is with the right key.

14.Name: Master Smithie's Quarters
14.Description: Walking through the mechanical door you've entered the Master Smithies Quarters, unlike the other inhabitants this fellow stands slightly taller and looks of Dwarven origins, his creations hung proudly on the walls throughout the room.

15.Name: Mess Hall Corridor
15.Description: The smell of food flows down this corridor, curiosity grips you as you follow your nose towards the mess hall

16.Name: Mess Hall
16.Description: Large groups of Gnomes are taking a well earned break from work and refueling for the rest of their shifts, the aromas make your stomach rumble, another large mechanical door lies to the east, guarding what looks to be the kitchen.

17.Name: Mechanical Door
17.Description: You stand in front of another mechincally locked door. The gear and levers are all engaged and the only way through is with the right key.

18.Name: Workshop Kitchen
18.Description: As you step into the Kitchen through the mechanical door. You notice large industrial contraptions that seem to be cooking food at regulated controlled tempretures, you've never smelt or seen anything like it.

19.Name: R and D Corridor
19.Description: You enter an extremely well lit area, this place is much cleaner than elsewhere. you notice another large mechanical door to the north

20.Name: Mechanical Door
20.Description: You stand in front of another mechincally locked door. The gear and levers are all engaged and the only way through is with the right key.

21.Name: Research Lab
21.Description: Walking through the mechanical door you've entered what seems to be a large Research and Design Area, drawnings and plans lay scattered on the centrel workbench. Half finished contraptions are scatted on the floor.

22.Name: Smithing Corridor
22.Description: You step into the Smithing Corridor, Tools and equipment hang from the walls, You can hear a thunderous sound of hammer on anvil  in the distance.

23.Name: Smithing Corridor
23.Description: Edging Closer to the thunderous sound bellowing down the corridor, Another large mechanical door stands in your way to the south.

24.Name: Smithing Corridor
24.Description: Edging Closer to the thunderous sound bellowing down the corridor has lead you to a winding staircase heading deeper into the workshop.

25.Name: bad room
25.Description: ooops.

26.Name: Mechanical Door
26.Description: You stand in front of another mechincally locked door. The gear and levers are all engaged and the only way through is with the right key.

27.Name: Boiler Room
27.Description: Pipework Sprawls through the area into a central furnace. The whole workshop is powered through what looks like steam engineering, you have never seen anything quiet like it. A Stout Figure stands menacingly in front of you.

0.Name: Shadowed Tunnel
0.Description: Torches seemingly precariously mounted on the stone walls cast shadows of indefineable objects on the earthen floor.  You see a spacious chamber in front of you.

1.Name: Lair
1.Description: The ground is strewn with the bones of dead questers, their lives ended by something powerful enough to break them in half and leave great gouges on the bone.  The cavernous chamber would echo your own screams nicely...

2.Name: Torchlit Room
2.Description: The ancient cavern built by the ancient Lizardmen seems to have held up remarkably for its age. No matter how well the stone was built however, it could not stop the gradual degradation of this chamber which is now a bed of earth and broken rock.

25.Description: Water dripping from above has long since covered all stone with dangling moss.  A stench of rot makes this dank locale most unpleasing.

29.Name: Neglected Hallway
29.Description: The lizardmen mentioned an area too dangerous for the best of their kind to venture.  Due to the forsakenness of these depths, you would place a large sum of gold on the odds that you are drawing near.

30.Name: Stone Sanctuary
30.Description: An air of solemnity assails you when you enter this room.  Not even the horrible beasts wish to venture near...  You hear shuffling noises to the west...

31.Name: Stone Stairwell
31.Description: The stairwell is open, leading down to a dark abyss.  Only extremely powerful heroes should enter...

32.Name: Earthen Entrance
32.Description: The hole you came through above you appears bright compared to the dismal darkness you rest in.  Strange noises and lights come from the junction before you.

33.Name: Earthen Entrance
33.Description: The hole you came through above you appears bright compared to the dismal darkness you rest in.  Strange noises and lights come from the junction before you.

34.Name: Junction
34.Description: A strange light comes from the west, filling the room with an eerie purple glow.  The east holds more impenetrable darkness and a musty smell.  This whole walkway is little more than an excavated hole!

35.Name: Dark Hallway
35.Description: The dark hallway extends a seemingly interminable distance ahead of you, horrid scrapings and shufflings, just loud enough for you to hear, strike fear into your heart.  I'd turn back if I were you.

44.Description: As you feel the walls to attempt to grasp where you are, the tight walls around you give way to a massive earthen cavern.  The trials you came through to get here, your intution tells you, will be nothing compared to what lies in this chamber.

48.Name: Critical Junction
48.Description: An ancient stone ceiling begins here, giving you an impression of ancient importance, of old stories, heroes and death.  A faint purple light pulses to the south... along with a sense of power.  The west hardly looks safe, but it might be easier than what you find to the South.

49.Name: Stone Hall
49.Description: The stone hallway goes on to the south, the glow only increasing with each step.  Your fear of peril grows insurmountably within you!  You can't face the peril! It's too perilous!

50.Name: Stone Hall
50.Description: The old wet stone makes a soft noise as you step, and you feel the ancient power before you grow like a plague within your heart.  The stone hallway resonates inside your mind in a horrible, yet subtle way.

51.Name: Stone Hall

53.Name: Stone Hall
53.Description: The old wet stone makes a soft noise as you step, and you feel the ancient power before you grow like a plague within your heart.  The stone hallway resonates inside your mind in a horrible, yet subtle way. Carefully inspecting the walls of this passage way, you see text etched into the stone. The ancient script is near impossible to decipher, but you think it says Nenitaria.

54.Name: Stone Hall

56.Description: The old wet stone makes a soft noise as you step, and you feel the ancient power before you grow like a plague within your heart.  The stone hallway resonates inside your mind in a horrible, yet subtle way.  Before you is a black marble entryway.  You're going to have to stoop to enter.

57.Name: Black Marble Tunnel
57.Description: Slick slimy black marble coats your hands as you duck into this hallway, stooped over.  The glow before you should warn you of your impending doom, but you feel resigned to your fate.

58.Name: Black Marble Tunnel
58.Description: The end of the hallway is in your sight.  Could the rumors about Issik's Tomb be true?

59.Name: Black Marble Tunnel
59.Description: The end of the hallway is in your sight.  Could the rumors about Issik's Tomb be true?

60.Name: Black Marble Tunnel
60.Description: Right before you is the tomb of Issik.  A sign says "ACCEPTING DONATIONS FOR REFURBISHMENT FOR THE TOMB OF THE UNDEAD LORD"

61.Name: Lair of Issik
61.Description: You are right next to Issik's coffin.  Death fills your heart and you can't help feeling despair, as stout a warrior as you are.

62.Name: Lair of Issik

63.Name: Lair of Issik
63.Description: Issik's marble coffin is the source of that horrible glow, and rather than blinding you by its proximity, it seems to draw you to it like a deep well.  You hope he isn't still lurking around here somewhere.

73.Name: Grotto Entrance
73.Description: The dark hallway seems to have come to an end, maybe you should explore this cavern you find in front of you, if only you could see anything?

74.Description: A vacuous space devoid of light is where you now find yourself.  It smells musty and you can tell nothing good must live here.

0.Name: Before the Cliffs
0.Description: The nearly unusable path gives way to a grassy patch of ground, that leads to the rocky ledge of the huge Vatlan Cliffs.

1.Name: Before the Cliffs
1.Description: The grassy patch here continues on towards the towering rock cliffs to the south.

2.Name: Before the Cliffs
2.Description: The grassy patch here continues on towards the towering rock cliffs to the south.

3.Name: A Patch of Dead Grass
3.Description: The grass here is trampled and dying, especially where it borders the rocky ledge that makes up the top of the cliffs here.

4.Name: The Vatlan Cliffs
4.Description: The rocky top of the Vatlan cliffs goes on for a ways here. Off to the south, you can see the sparkling blue waters of the Asadric Sea.

5.Name: The Vatlan Cliffs
5.Description: The rocky top of the Vatlan cliffs goes on for a ways here. Off to the south, you can see the sparkling blue waters of the Asadric Sea.

6.Name: The Vatlan Cliffs
6.Description: The rocky top of the Vatlan cliffs goes on for a ways here. Off to the south, you can see the sparkling blue waters of the Asadric Sea.

7.Name: The Vatlan Cliffs
7.Description: The rocky top of the Vatlan cliffs goes on for a ways here. Off to the south, you can see the sparkling blue waters of the Asadric Sea.

8.Name: A Grassy Patch
8.Description: There is a small patch of grass here growing in the cliff top here. To the south and east, you can see the blue waters of the Asadric Sea.

9.Name: The Vatlan Cliffs
9.Description: The rocky top of the Vatlan cliffs goes on for a ways here. Off to the south, you can see the sparkling blue waters of the Asadric Sea.

10.Name: The Vatlan Cliffs
10.Description: The rocky top of the Vatlan cliffs goes on for a ways here. Off to the south, you can see the sparkling blue waters of the Asadric Sea.

11.Name: The Vatlan Cliffs
11.Description: The rocky top of the Vatlan cliffs goes on for a ways here. Off to the south, you can see the sparkling blue waters of the Asadric Sea.

12.Name: The Vatlan Cliffs
12.Description: The cliffs turn more towards the north here. They appear more eroded than down south, no doubt because of the years of the ocean crashing against their base. This area is well known for having raging sea storms quite frequently.

13.Name: The Vatlan Cliffs
13.Description: The cliffs turn more towards the north here. They appear more eroded than down south, no doubt because of the years of the ocean crashing against their base. This area is well known for having raging sea storms quite frequently.

14.Name: The Vatlan Cliffs
14.Description: The cliffs turn more towards the north here. They appear more eroded than down south, no doubt because of the years of the ocean crashing against their base. This area is well known for having raging sea storms quite frequently.

15.Name: A Grassy Patch
15.Description: A layer of grass is growing here, covering the bare rock of the cliffs. Up north you see a group of very poorly constructed wooden shacks, with a camp fire in the middle.

16.Name: The Vatlan Cliffs
16.Description: The rocky top of the Vatlan cliffs goes on for a ways here. Off to the south, you can see the sparkling blue waters of the Asadric Sea.

17.Name: Before the Camp
17.Description: The collection of shacks looks to be more of a camp then a permanent settlement. You see rubble strewn about, that looks to have been salvaged from a wrecked ship.

18.Name: The Vatlan Cliffs
18.Description: The rocky top of the Vatlan cliffs goes on for a ways here. Off to the south, you can see the sparkling blue waters of the Asadric Sea.

19.Name: The Vatlan Cliffs
19.Description: The rocky top of the Vatlan cliffs goes on for a ways here. Off to the south, you can see the sparkling blue waters of the Asadric Sea.

20.Name: A Pirate's Shack
20.Description: The interior of the shack is dimly lit and stinks heavily of fish oil. You see a row of bunk beds that were salvaged from the pirate's wrecked ship.

21.Name: The Pirate Camp
21.Description: Surrounding you is a small camp, inhabited by a ragtag group of pirates. They appear to have been stranded on these cliffs when their ship was wrecked by the cliffs. Why they have decided to set up a camp here, instead of heading off to find more places to plunder, is beyond you.

22.Name: The Pirate Camp
22.Description: The largest of the shacks stands to the north here. It probably houses the leader of the pirates. Before the shack are various emptied chests and quite a few broken mugs.

23.Name: The Captain's Shack
23.Description: Stepping inside, it is obvious that this is the captain's personal shack. Decent quality furniture provides the impression that the Captain lives pretty well, even in this cliff top camp. There are two metal chests along the east wall that are both empty.

24.Name: A Cliff Overhang
24.Description: The rocky cliff juts out over it's base here. Looking over the edge, you see a straight drop the ocean below. The height of the cliffs are truley impressive to you.

25.Name: Before a Rock Fall
25.Description: To the south the vertical face of the cliff has given way to a very steep slope, leading down far below to a sandy beach.

26.Name: The Rock Slope
26.Description: And old rock slide has created a steep, yet climbable, pathway down to a small beach below.

27.Name: The Rock Slope
27.Description: And old rock slide has created a steep, yet climbable, pathway down to a small beach below. You can now see a wrecked ship on the beach. That must be where the pirates came from!

28.Name: The Rock Slope
28.Description: And old rock slide has created a steep, yet climbable, pathway down to a small beach below. You wonder why the pirates have not attempted to repair the ship. It looks damaged, but with all the wood available around here, it seems like they could repair it without too much trouble.

29.Name: The Base of the Rock Slope
29.Description: The rock slide gives way to the white and yellow sand of a beach here. The beach meets with the high rock wall of the Vatlan Cliffs to the north and slowly lowers off into the water to the south.

30.Name: A Sandy Beach
30.Description: The sand feels warm on your feet, and you decide that you could make a whole lot of money setting up a vacation spot here.

31.Name: A Sandy Beach
31.Description: The warm sand soothes your feet and makes you feel at peace. The wrecked ship, however, is very unsettling to you as there is a greenish mist hovering over and through it.

32.Name: A Sandy Beach
32.Description: The sand here gently meets the lapping waves of the Asadric Sea here. You are tempted to go for a swim, but the water is shockingly cold.

33.Name: A Sandy Beach
33.Description: The sand is getting colder as you approach the wrecked ship, but you assume it is because of the shadow that the massive cliff casts over the beach here.

34.Name: A Sandy Cove
34.Description: A small cove in the beach here is covered with various shells and scraps of wood. The massive shadows from the towering cliffs above make it very dark in here.

35.Name: A Sandy Beach
35.Description: The sand here gently meets the lapping waves of the Asadric Sea here. You are tempted to go for a swim, but the water is shockingly cold.

39.Name: Before the Wrecked Ship
39.Description: Frosty winds whip around you, seeming to come directly from the ship. The green mist oozing out from the great crack in the hull repulses you and makes you want to climb up the cliff to get back into the sunlight. Jagged wood prevents you from entering the ship here.

43.Name: The Ghostly Ship
43.Description: Stepping inside the ruined galleon, you are blasted by an unholy stench. Fortunatly the extreme cold makes it somewhat bearable. Rotting flesh abounds here, mixed in with the abandoned treasure of the pirates that crashed here. It is no wonder why they havn't come back for their plunder...the evil surrounding the ship seems to be too strong for this world.

44.Name: The Ghostly Ship
44.Description: More death and decay confronts you in this part of the ship. You have no clue why you are so foolish as to be wandering around this haunted place...

45.Name: The Ghostly Ship

46.Name: A Freezing Beach
46.Description: The sand here is utterly freezing and is actually painful to walk on. No doubt this is caused from the wrecked ship to the south...there must be a source of great evil inside it.

49.Description: Sleeping mats and garbage lay around the floor here, carelessly tossed about by the pirates. The carcasses of some deer shows that they have been hunting in the nearby forest for food.

10.Name: Second Vault Corridor
10.Description: As you step off the central walkway, you sigh with relief knowing you're safe from the Vault's security system for the time being. The corridor extends to the west and a magical aura fills the air.

11.Name: Before the Second Vault Door
11.Description: As you approach the vault door, a Stone Golem takes shape from the floor beneath you, infused with magical energies to protect the contents within!

12.Name: Second Vault
12.Description: After working your way through the lock you're now inside the vault.. the spoils are yours!

15.Name: Third Vault

16.Name: Before the Final Vault

17.Name: Final Vault
17.Description: After working your way past the golem, you stand before the final vault. This is by far the largest of the four. Seemingly the only way to unlock this door is to open the other three vaults. Something stands in your way and you cannot back out!

18.Name: Vault Duct
18.Description: The ducting for the vault is larger than you imagined and it looks like you can just about squeeze through.. What a poor design..

157.Description: The passage here stops abruptly, as the walls ahead have collapsed, making it impossible to continue. You think you spot a number of strange shapes moving around through the rubble.

158.Name: Labryinth
158.Description: You are inside the dark, confusing labryinth underneath the abandoned church. You feel your way along the walls, hoping that you aren't disturbing anything unpleasant. The passage here abruptly breaks off to the north.

159.Name: Crypt
159.Description: You have stumbled upon an old crypt. There are a number of tombs inlaid into the walls here; this is likely an area where many lesser members of the church were buried. The whole place makes you feel very uncomfortable.

192.Name: Cursed Ground
192.Description: You get a horrible feeling walking through this area. You can feel the power of the malevolent magic that infests this area running through you every step you take. There is a small gap in the wall of the church to the south that you could probably fit through.

193.Name: Cursed Ground

195.Name: Church Entrance
195.Description: You make your way through the ruined gates of the church and to the inside. The inside is actually in fairly good shape. A number of masterful statues line the walls, and you recognize some as likenesses of the God of Light Aran.

196.Name: Blasted Plains
196.Description: The Ground here is completely bare, and is lower down than most of the rest of the battlefield. Perhaps this area was destroyed by magic. To the north you can see a huge, ruined church.

197.Name: Blasted Plains
197.Description: The Ground here is completely bare, and is lower down than most of the rest of the battlefield. Perhaps this area was destroyed by magic. To the south the land becomes an impassable wetland.

198.Name: Blasted Plains
198.Description: The Ground here is completely bare, and is lower down than most of the rest of the battlefield. Perhaps this area was destroyed by magic. To the North you can see a huge ruined church.

199.Name: Church
199.Description: You are inside the large church. Works of art line the walls of this place; tapestries and statues are everywhere. The art in this place is likely worth a fortune!

200.Name: Church
200.Description: You are inside the large church. Works of art line the walls of this place; tapestries and statues are everywhere. The art in this place is likely worth a fortune!

201.Name: Open Hall
201.Description: You enter a large open hall. This area was likely used to host banquets or major events when the church was still operational.

202.Name: Seats
202.Description: You maneuver your way through a number of pews in front of a large altar. The number of seats remaining is impressive. This church must have been very important.

203.Name: Church
203.Description: You are inside the large church. Works of art line the walls of this place; tapestries and statues are everywhere. The art in this place is likely worth a fortune! A hole in the wall to the north leads outside.

204.Name: Cell
204.Description: This small cell is likely where a priest lived when this church was still in operation. There is a small wooden bed in the corner, but other than that it is empty.

205.Name: Lookout
205.Description: You go to the southern Lookout Point. From here, you can see the huge Raim River, and the fertile Epiach Fields to the south.

206.Name: Stairwell
206.Description: You arrive at a massive set of stairs, at the top of the Bastion. There are lookout points in all directions.

207.Name: Lookout
207.Description: You go to the western lookout point. From here you can look out over the desolate plains that served as a battlefield hundreds of years ago. You think you can make out what looks like a ruined church far to the west.

208.Name: Lookout
208.Description: You go to the eastern lookout point. From here you can see the city of Epiach, and a vast plains extending beyond it to the east.

209.Name: Lookout
209.Description: You go to the north lookout point. From here you can see the towering Silverspire Mountains. There is a closed door to the west.

210.Name: Chambers
210.Description: You enter a personal bedroom. It's not terribly fancy, but it looks comfortable enough. Most likely whoever is commanding these bandits lives here.

211.Name: Basement
211.Description: You slowely make your way into the southern part of the basement. This place is massive! Suddenly, you are struck with fear...you could have sworn you saw a shape moving somewhere nearby.

212.Name: Passage
212.Description: You go down a nearly unlit passage. You have to feel the walls to be able to find your way. You are a bit disquieted when you notice a glowing shape in the dark.

213.Name: Storage
213.Description: You enter another nearly empty storage room. The shelves have long since been cleared of anything useful.

214.Name: Food Storage
214.Description: You enter what you assume is a food storage room, due to all the rotting meat that was left down here. The stench is almost overwhelming.

215.Name: Food Storage
215.Description: You make your way to the back of the food storage area. It still smells awful, and you'd like to get out of here as soon as possible.

216.Name: Storage
216.Description: You enter a storage room in the basement. There are many empty shelves and casks lying about.

217.Name: Basement
217.Description: You are at the bottom of a stairwell, in the poorly lit basement of the Bastion. You feel a slight chill run down your spine, for some reason.

218.Name: Wine Cellar
218.Description: You enter a dark room, and find that it is filled with old bottles of wine! You wonder if any of it is still drinkable, or if it's all turned to vinegar.

219.Name: Back of Wine Cellar
219.Description: You make your way to the back of the wine cellar. This room is rather cold, and there are still many bottles of wine down here. Odd that they weren't cleared out with everything else.

220.Name: Basement
220.Description: You walk through a large open area of the basement. You become a bit nervous as you see a positively ghostly shape move in the corner of your eye.

221.Name: Basement
221.Description: You make your way to a corner of the basement. To your horror, you find a massive pile of human bones here! They must have been trapped down here somehow, many years ago.

222.Name: Cave Entrance
222.Description: You are at the bottom of a slope into the mountains. It's very dark here, but you can see a dim light to the west.

223.Name: Cavern
223.Description: You walk through the dark cave. There are dim torches set up on the walls. Someone obviously resides here.

224.Name: Cavern
224.Description: You walk through the dark cave. There are dim torches set up on the walls. Someone obviously resides here.

225.Name: Cavern
225.Description: You walk through the dark cave. There are dim torches set up on the walls. Someone obviously resides here.

226.Name: Cave Passage
226.Description: You make your way into a small side passage in the cave. It's very dark in here, but you could continue to go down the passage if you wished.

227.Name: Underground Lake
227.Description: You come upon a small underground lake. Apparently is it fed by some water running down from the mountains to the north. It is quite an amazing sight.

228.Name: Cavern
228.Description: You walk through the dark cave. There are dim torches set up on the walls. Someone obviously resides here.

229.Name: Large Cave
229.Description: You are at the end of the long winding cavern. It has opened up into a massive, fairly well lit dome-like formation. To your surprise, you see a number of tents pitched to the south and west. There's a whole colony of people down here!

230.Name: Tents
230.Description: You walk among the grubby tents. You see a number of haggard men and women walking around, looking rather distressed.

231.Name: Tents
231.Description: You walk among the grubby tents. You see a number of haggard men and women walking around, looking rather distressed.

232.Name: Large Tent
232.Description: You come upon a fairly large tent, compared to the others. There is an old man sitting outside of it, reading an old scroll.

233.Name: Labryinth Entrance
233.Description: You are at the bottom of the oddly placed stairway. You seem to have found one of the infamous labyrinths built underneath the old churches of Aran.
