0.Name: Path from the Dark Forest
0.Description: You emerge from the thickest part of the Dark Forest, and find yourself walking along an overgrown dirt path. Large animal tracks lie all across the area. You hear a wolf howl in the distance; the sound sends a chill down your spine.

1.Name: Path from the Dark Forest
1.Description: You continue along the barely visible path. The animal tracks are less obvious here, but are still numerous. The rustling from the underbrush is making you feel quite uneasy as you walk along.

2.Name: Path from the Dark Forest
2.Description: As you proceed along the path, it becomes less and less visible. It is fairly obvious that people do not often travel this way, or the path would likely be better maintained. The path you are taking begins to slope downwards slightly.

3.Name: Path from the Dark Forest
3.Description: You reach what seems to be the end of this path. It becomes completely overgrown here, and vanishes. A large outcropping of rocks blocks your passage west; you will have to turn to the north to continue, into a dreary, dead forest.

4.Name: The Deadwood
4.Description: You are at the edge of the infamous, and aptly named Deadwood. The trees here are all bereft of life, and yet somehow never quite fall to the ground and rot. The thousands of bare skeletons of trees are an unsettling sight.

5.Name: The Deadwood
5.Description: You are now slightly into the Deadwood. Despite being near the fringes, you can't help but feel oppressed by the bare, gnarled trees hovering to the sides. You are able to find a number of possible paths here, though the woods are strangely dark, and you cannot tell what may lie in any given direction.

6.Name: The Deadwood
6.Description: You are now deep within the Deadwood. The snarls of unknown wild animals can be heard from among the trees, but you cannot see the origin of the noises. The forest becomes too thick to pass to the north, but you could go around it to the west.

7.Name: The Deadwood
7.Description: You make your way through some short blasted trees, and see that the woods open up into a clearing of sorts to the west. You feel a great measure of relief to be out of the cramped part of the woods, but you have an uneasy feeling that the worst parts of this pace are yet to come.

8.Name: The Deadwood
8.Description: You are standing in a fairly large clearing in the middle of the Deadwood. In the distance to the north, west, and east you can see places where you could proceed through the woods. Oddly, you also think you can see a cottage in the corner of the clearning.

9.Name: The Deadwood
9.Description: You are in the northern part of the clearing. Looking around, you see a number of terrifyingly large paw prints heading off through the trees to the north. To the west lies another, slightly less threatening path.

10.Name: The Deadwood
10.Description: You proceed through the trees and thorny bushes. It is difficult to make progress though the area, but you could manage to continue north if you wished. You think you see a dark, ominous cave farther ahead.

11.Name: A Cave in the Deadwood
11.Description: You find yourself in a pitch dark cave. You strike a light, and are able to see some of your surroundings. Bones both human and animal litter the ground, and a number of fresh corpses lie rotting and torn open on the floor. The sight of all the gore and death nearly overwhelms your senses, but you resolve to continue, and destroy the beast that has created this place.

12.Name: The Deadwood
12.Description: You are in the very edge of the clearing in the Deadwood. More ominous, unnatural trees await your coming to the west. Hopefully you will not encounter so many beastial creatures in that direction.

13.Name: The Deadwood
13.Description: You are making your way through another cramped, claustrophobia inducing area of the Deadwood. The trees hover very close here, lending an oppressive air to the area. The forest seems to open up a bit to the east, and thickens to the west.

14.Name: The Deadwood
14.Description: You are making your way through a near-impassible portion of the Deadwood. Though you manage to twistingly make your way forward, the trees themselves seem to be exerting malevolent energies to block your way.

15.Name: The Deadwood
15.Description: You force your way through more of the seemingly endless Deadwood. As you move farther north however, you begin to notice some light falling into the forest. Perhaps you are nearing the end of this frightful place.

16.Name: The Deadwood
16.Description: You make your way closer to the fringe of the forest. Judging from the thinning of the trees in that direction, you should be able to get out of the forest to the north. You long to be out of this evil place.

17.Name: The Deadwood
17.Description: You have reached the northern edge of the Deadwood. You loath to enter that unpleasant place, but you know it is the only way back to civilized lands.

18.Name: Werewolf Cave
18.Description: You force yourself to go to the back of the sickening cave. Human bones are arranged in an almost ceremonial fashion along the walls, probably to further deter people like you. You wonder for a moment how many brave souls lost their lives in this horrid place. You can only steel yourself for whatever battle may come.

19.Name: The Deadwood
19.Description: You proceed carefully to the east, as the shadows of the wood creep unnaturally across the path you are making for yourself. Strangely, you find that the trees become so thick here that you cannot find a way through to continue east...perhaps this is a good thing.

20.Name: The Deadwood
20.Description: You are now in the southern part of the clearing. Despite being able to see much farther around you than on the cramped paths, you still feel uneasy about the noises coming from the woods; above all, the howls. To the west, you can see a small cottage, with smoke rising from the chimney.

21.Name: Cottage in the Deadwood
21.Description: You open the door to the small old cottage, and slowly walk in. There is a fire burning in the hearth, and it looks as though someone lives here. You wonder who would decide to settle here in their right mind.

22.Name: The Deadwood
22.Description: You are in the western part of the clearing. You can see the sky overhead, but oddly, very little light is able to penetrate into the forest. Looking at the sky is somewhat like looking at a black void. To the south, you can see a small cottage.

23.Name: Edge of the Deadwood
23.Description: You are in a decaying area just before the deadwood. To the west lies the vast expance of the Northern Wastes, one of the most inhospitable and deadly places in the world. You're not really sure which direction is a better option.

24.Name: The Deadwood
24.Description: You push your way through densely growing thickets of thorns, and the trees of the forest suddenly become much more sparse. You feel relieved at having found a clearing, until you notice that there are fewer trees here because the ground has been scoured with some form of dark magic.

25.Name: The Deadwood
25.Description: You continue along the evil-feeling magic blasted area, until you reach a place where the trees begin to regain their domain, and indeed grow together so thick as to make further passage south impossible. You wonder what caused the brief lack of trees.

26.Name: End of the Deadwood
26.Description: You are at the northern edge of the Deadwood. You have little desire to enter the haunted, deadly forest, but all things considered, it's probably better than the vast wastelands that lie to the west.

27.Name: The Wasteland
27.Description: You are making your way through the far eastern area of the great Northern Wasteland. The border of the Deadwood lies to the east, and you hear horrible crunching to the north. You wonder what could make such sounds in this barren environment.

28.Name: The Wasteland - Behemoth Crag
28.Description: You are walking into a deep crag in the rocky wasteland. I appears that the crunching sound was made by huge claws, dragging through the stone and crushing them. The ground and stone cliffs of the area are all covered in deep clawmarks.

29.Name: The Wasteland - Behemoth Crag
29.Description: You continue walking through the crag. Huge, terrible beasts rise to meet you as you make your way farther in. They are gigantic, hairy, and extremely ill-tempered. You don't think it would be wise to go in here alone.

30.Name: The Wasteland
30.Description: You see, for certain now, a small grouping of huts to the west. You wonder, somewhat apprehensively, what sort of people could manage to survive out here, and even set up a village. You hope you don't have to deal with too many of them, whoever they are.

31.Name: The Wasteland
31.Description: You you north a short ways, until you reach a cliff that drops off a few hundred feet. You don't think you're going to be able to get down this way any time soon, though there doesn't seem to be anyone, or anything around.

32.Name: The Wasteland
32.Description: You notice more and more trappings of a human settlement here. There are burnt out campfires, and discarded hunting gear (though you wonder what anyone would hunt out here). You're not sure, but you think you see some small huts to the west.

33.Name: The Wasteland - Barbarian Village
33.Description: You cautiously walk into the small village. You spot a few lookouts as you approach, but they do not attack you immediately. Rather, they look somewhat relieved at your appearance. You wonder who these people are.

34.Name: The Wasteland - Barbarian Barracks
34.Description: You enter a small barracks. A number of the Barbarian Tribe's warriors live here, practicing their deadly skills of combat. To your relief, they are not immediately hostile, only stopping to examine you upon entrance before going back to their drills.

35.Name: The Wasteland - Barbarian Village Huts
35.Description: You walk  in and among some of the small huts that make up this village. The various people dwelling here seem fairly relieved to see that you are not a marauding monster, and some are even moderately friendly. You hope this cordial welcome lasts.

36.Name: The Wasteland - Barbarian Shrine
36.Description: You enter a small shrine, dedicated to a Barbarian god. You're not sure what god it is set up to worship, but the altar is massive, carved out of a block of stone. Various priests preside over the shrine.

37.Name: The Wasteland - Barbarian Gate
37.Description: You are standing before the large gate to the Barbarian Village. Dangerous lands lie beyond, and you'd best be prepared if you plan to venture far past this wall. A set of wooden steps lead down into a small earthen tunnel. A crudely carved sign reads: "To Ferry".

38.Name: The Wasteland
38.Description: You are on the west side of the gate to the barbarian Village. The relative safety of the village lies to the east, while the further expanse of the Northern Wastes lies west. You dread to think of what horrid beasts may await you in this area.

39.Name: The Wasteland - Barbarian Village
39.Description: You are in the western part of the Barbarian Village. You see a large gate to the north, constructed of hard wood. You wonder what lies beyond it that these people felt the need to build such a sturdy gate on this side, unlike on the east.

40.Name: The Wasteland - Barbarian Village
40.Description: You are standing at the center of the small Barbarian Village. There is a fountain here, probably enchanted, that constantly shoots a gout of water into the air. You're impressed that the inhabitants of the village were able to make such a thing.

41.Name: The Wasteland - Barbarian Huts
41.Description: You walk  in and among some of the small huts that make up this village. The various people dwelling here seem fairly relieved to see that you are not a marauding monster, and some are even moderately friendly. You hope this cordial welcome lasts.

42.Name: The Wasteland - Barbarian Chief's Hut
42.Description: You pass under a heavy fur pelt, and enter the hut of the Barbarian Chief. Although small, the hut is well decorated with animal furs, and various carved pieces of art. These people don't really seem all that barbaric after all. You wonder why they're living out here.

43.Name: The Wasteland - Barbarian Village Huts
43.Description: You walk  in and among some of the small huts that make up this village. The various people dwelling here seem fairly relieved to see that you are not a marauding monster, and some are even moderately friendly. You hope this cordial welcome lasts.

44.Name: The Wasteland
44.Description: You are at the base of a large cliff. To the north, you could probably make your way up and around the rocky cliff, to see what lies up there. To the west, the ground grows darker, as if corrupted by some unknown force.

45.Name: The Wasteland
45.Description: You are standing at the start of a large stretch of blackened earth. There are a few strange tracks in the dusty ground, but you cannot identify exactly what they are. The only way to find out will be to look around.

46.Name: The Wasteland - Basilisk Lands
46.Description: You are standing deeper in the blackened area. Suddenly, a chill goes down your spine as you see a remarkably lifelike stone statue, frozen in place on the ground. You come to the conclusion that you are likely facing basilisks.

47.Name: The Wasteland - Basilisk Lands
47.Description: You have passed beyond the still slightly livable lands into land that is almost completely black. You wonder how the inhabitants managed to cause such devestation.

48.Name: The Wasteland - Basilisk Lands
48.Description: You are now deep within the basilisk lands. Stone statues and broken fragments of them litter the ground. You feverently hope that you do not run into many of the horrible creatures that have caused this destruction.

49.Name: The Wasteland - Basilisk Lands
49.Description: You enter a secluded area. There are no tracks here, and you could likely retreat here if the situation becomes dire.

50.Name: The Wasteland - Basilisk Lands
50.Description: You have reached the western end of the basilisk lands. You desire strongly to be out of here, but you have a feeling that what lies ahead to the north could only be worse. You steel yourself to proceed in that direction.

51.Name: The Wasteland
51.Description: You are on what seems to be an unpopulated pathway. You're not sure where it will end up, but the lack of horrid monsters is welcome.

52.Name: The Wasteland - Basilisk Lands
52.Description: You make your way to the back of the basilisk cave. Very few of the lesser basilisks seem to be in this area, but the stone statues still abound. You hope you haven't sumbled upon something deadly.

53.Name: The Wasteland - Basilisk Lands
53.Description: You enter a large, dark cave. You strike a light, to see not only statues, but eggs as well. This is likely where the basilisks breed. A large number of basilisks come to meet you to defend their young eggs.

54.Name: The Wasteland - Basilisk Lands
54.Description: You are nearing the western edge of the basilisk lands. A number of the horrid, reptilian creatures crawl along the blackened ground, making cruel hissing noises in your direction. You try to avert your gaze from certain death as you walk among them.

55.Name: The Wasteland - Basilisk Lands
55.Description: You enter the small cave. Inside are a number of statues of humans and animals alike who have made a similar mistake as you just have. You hear a scraping and scuttling noise in the back of the cave; it is likely the resident.

56.Name: The Wasteland - Basilisk Lands
56.Description: You are standing at a minor junction in this corrupted area. To the south the wasteland ends, becoming the northern part of the Coranin Forest. To the west you see what looks like a small cave. You're not terribly eager to learn what lives inside.

57.Name: The Wasteland - Basilisk Lands
57.Description: You are near the southern end of the wastelands. You can see the Coranin Forest far south, but it is much too thick to penetrate into it.  A small table is here reading, "Memoria".

58.Name: The Wasteland - The Cliff
58.Description: You are near the bottom of the huge cliff. You can make your way up it to the north. As you stand around, you hear bird-like shrieks on the air, but when you look up, you do not see normal birds. They seem to have wingspans of nearly 100 feet. Rocs.

59.Name: The Wasteland - The Cliff
59.Description: You are now at a plateu on the cliff. The shrieks of the aggressive rocs pain your ears as you struggle to fend them off. You could go west into a small open area, or proceed farther up the cliff to the north.

60.Name: The Wasteland - The Cliff
60.Description: You are following a winding path up the huge cliff. There is no end in sight, but the number of Rocs increases here, and you see flying up the cliff, presumably to their nest at the summit

61.Name: The Wasteland - The Cliff
61.Description: You are in a small area, sheltered by the face of the ascending cliff. You could probably hide yourself from the many huge rocs here with minimal fear of being attacked.

62.Name: The Wasteland - The Cliff
62.Description: You make a sharp turn on the way up the cliff, and can see the summit. It lies only a few hundred feet away, up the twisting path along the cliff. The rocs now begin to make a concerted effort to keep you away.

63.Name: The Wasteland - The Cliff
63.Description: You are near the top of the huge cliff. You see a number of carved out holes where various rocs have build their nests. You think it wise to proceed through this area quickly, before too many notice you.

64.Name: The Wasteland - The Cliff
64.Description: You are just before the summit of this cliff. Rocs circle the area, as if guarding it, and many sweep down to intercept you. These things seem quite a bit more intelligent than your average bird.

65.Name: The Wasteland - The Cliff Summit
65.Description: You have reached the summit of this cliff. Groups of rocs fly in to meet you, letting out their piercing shrieks. The rocs here seem even larger than the ones before, and much deadlier. You could, if you wished, make your way into their nest, where the roc eggs are hatched.

66.Name: The Wasteland - The Nest
66.Description: You are in the nest of the rocs. Hundreds of eggs are being tended here, in a definitely motherly fashion, by a huge number of the massive birds. The mothers pay you little mind, but a number of guardian birds don't much care for your prescence.

67.Name: The Wasteland - The nest
67.Description: You have reached the far side of the roc nest. Here, the king of this group of rocs resides, watching over his flight of subjects. You hope the king isn't here as you make your way into the area, searching for something of interest.

68.Name: The Wasteland
68.Description: Your feet almost move by themselves towards the west end of this pathway. To the south, you can see a large cave mouth. You could tear yourself away to explore it if you wished.

69.Name: The Wasteland
69.Description: You enter the cave. There is a slithering south in here, which makes you think of snakes. You're pretty sure no normal snakes could survive out here though, and you dread to find out what is making the noises.

70.Name: bad room
70.Description: ooops.

71.Name: The Wasteland
71.Description: You enter the cave. There is a slithering south in here, which makes you think of snakes. You're pretty sure no normal snakes could survive out here though, and you dread to find out what is making the noises.

72.Name: The Wasteland
72.Description: You are walking up a rising slope of rock. You hear slithering noises similar to the caves earlier along the path. As you move farther north, a sickly feeling permeates your being. You feel as though you're going to vomit, but are able to keep it down.

73.Name: The Wasteland
73.Description: You are at the top of the stone slope. The sickly feeling is less here, and is replaced by one of fear. To the east you see a cavern entrance of sorts, but a obviously magical, greenish glow is emanating from it. Perhaps it would be worth exploring.

74.Name: The Wasteland
74.Description: The path drops down here slightly, and soon ends completely against a face of solid rock. If you wished, you could proceed to the north, but you get a horrible, sickly feeling from that direction, and you don't know if it would be a very good idea to go there alone.

75.Name: The Wasteland - Cave Entrance
75.Description: You are standing at the glowing entrance to a mysterious cave. You dread to think of what beasts are living down there, but you steel your courage, and resolve to descend down into the cave if you so desire.

76.Name: The Spiral Dungeon
76.Description: You are near the entrance of this cave. As soon as you step down into it however, you realize that it really isn't a cave. This place has obviously been constructed, and literally glows with magical power. You have no idea what could have created this; it seems beyond even the Veraine Empire.

77.Name: The Wasteland
77.Description: You continue to the west. The compulsion to move is becoming less now, but you still feel the urge to continue west. You suddenly notice that the ground and the occasional rock here are painted with a dark purple dye, creating a number of odd arcane symbols. You wonder what out here would have the desire to create such things.

78.Name: The Wasteland - Behemoth Crag
78.Description: You are near the end of Behemoth Crag. The claw marks here are so numerous that the ground itself seems hewn out into a small bowl where the creatures walk. To the east you see many more Behemoths, congregated around something.

79.Name: The Wasteland - Behemoth Crag
79.Description: You reach the end of Behemoth Crag. To your surprise, the stones in this area look as though the monsters have carved them consciously into an abode of sorts. You doubt that whatever lives in the structure will be very happy to see you.

80.Name: The Wasteland
80.Description: You are walking through the vast Wasteland. Surprisingly, you spot definite signs of human habitation in the area. It looks as though you might find a settlement of some kind of the west.

81.Name: The Wasteland - Behemoth Crag
81.Description: You are deep into the Crag. You're not sure why, but the beastial inhabitants of this area seem dead set on getting you out of here, and none seem to fear you at all.

82.Name: The Wasteland
82.Description: You are walking along a makeshift pathway. There don't seem to be any creatures here bent on killing you, which is always a good thing. You can't help but feel uneasy about the sudden lapse in action however.

83.Name: The Wasteland
83.Description: You continue along. The relative peace of this path is beginning to wear on your nerves more than relax you. It is lending an oppressive feeling to the air, as if something is luring your forward.

84.Name: The Wasteland
84.Description: You continue down the path. The feeling that you are being pulled to the west is becoming very strong. You wonder what could place such a powerful compulsion upon your body. You can barely force yourself to move back to the east.

85.Name: The Spiral Dungeon
85.Description: You are walking down a long, glowing corridor. You think you can see a place where it turns to the south, but you're not sure due to how the walls glow. A sudden fear grips your heart as you notice shapes floating through the walls and across the hallway.

86.Name: The Spiral Crypt
86.Description: You are walking down a long, glowing corridor. You think you can see a place where it turns to the south, but you're not sure due to how the walls glow. A sudden fear grips your heart as you notice shapes floating through the walls and across the hallway.

87.Name: The Spiral Crypt
87.Description: You are walking down a long, glowing corridor. You think you can see a place where it turns to the south, but you're not sure due to how the walls glow. A sudden fear grips your heart as you notice shapes floating through the walls and across the hallway.

88.Name: The Spiral Crypt
88.Description: You are walking down a long, glowing corridor. You think you can see a place where it turns to the south, but you're not sure due to how the walls glow. A sudden fear grips your heart as you notice shapes floating through the walls and across the hallway.

89.Name: The Spiral Crypt
89.Description: To your surprise, you find that you have reached the southern end of this corridor. The hallway turns sharply to the east, and the glow of the walls becomes somewhat darker. You have little choice but to continue on.

90.Name: The Spiral Crypt
90.Description: You are walking down a second corridor. This one is marginally darker, and the roving spirits seem to frequent this corridor less often. This does not reassure you however, only convincing you that worse foes are to come.

91.Name: The Spiral Crypt
91.Description: You are walking down a second corridor. This one is marginally darker, and the roving spirits seem to frequent this corridor less often. This does not reassure you however, only convincing you that worse foes are to come.

92.Name: The Spiral Crypt
92.Description: You are walking down a second corridor. This one is marginally darker, and the roving spirits seem to frequent this corridor less often. This does not reassure you however, only convincing you that worse foes are to come.

93.Name: The Spiral Crypt
93.Description: You are walking down a second corridor. This one is marginally darker, and the roving spirits seem to frequent this corridor less often. This does not reassure you however, only convincing you that worse foes are to come.

94.Name: The Spiral Crypt
94.Description: You almost run into the wall as you reach the eastern edge of the corridor, as the glow of the wall hardly changes. The hallway swings again to the north, and in the distance you can see the walls begin to glow a deep purple.

95.Name: The Spiral Crypt
95.Description: Here, there is a very sudden change in the glowing color of the walls. They go from a light greenish color to a deep purple. You wonder if this signifies a breakup of territories.

96.Name: The Spiral Crypt
96.Description: You are walking down a long purple glowing hallway. The walls are so sleek that you can hardly tell where they end and the floor begins; it's almost as though something very large has been slithering down them. You cringe at the thought of such a beast.

97.Name: The Spiral Crypt
97.Description: You are somewhere in the glowing purple corridor. You have very little frame of reference as to your position, but happily the hallway simple continues forward, not breaking off into any twists and turns.

98.Name: The Spiral Crypt
98.Description: You nearly slip and fall here as the corridor makes a smooth curve to the west. It seems certain that this hall was carved intentionally, somehow, but you have no clue what could have done so. The walls seem harder than steel.

99.Name: The Spiral Crypt
99.Description: You are somewhere in the glowing purple corridor. You have very little frame of reference as to your position, but happily the hallway simple continues forward, not breaking off into any twists and turns.

100.Name: The Spiral Crypt
100.Description: You are somewhere in the glowing purple corridor. You have very little frame of reference as to your position, but happily the hallway simple continues forward, not breaking off into any twists and turns.

101.Name: The Spiral Crypt
101.Description: You nearly slip and fall here as the corridor makes a smooth curve to the south. It seems certain that this hall was carved intentionally, somehow, but you have no clue what could have done so. The walls seem harder than steel.

102.Name: The Spiral Crypt
102.Description: You continue through the purple hallway. You think you can see something different around another curve to the south; a bright green glow, much brighter than the earlier hallways. You also notice a small passageway to the west. It would be too small for Wyrms to get through, but you could likely slip through.

103.Name: The Spiral Crypt
103.Description: You have finally reached the end of what you have decided is a large spiral. The purple hallway ends here, but a bit to the east you can see another sloping hole, similar to the entrance to this entire place, leading down.

104.Name: Glowing Hole
104.Description: As you approach the hole down, you are gripped with a horrible fear. You have no idea what lies below, but whatever it is, even at a distance it nearly paralyzes you. Only your great experience as an adventurer gives you the courage to continue on.

105.Name: The Spiral Crypt
105.Description: You are in a small hidden passageway that leads back to near the entrance of this dungeon. You are happy you found it, as it would not have been pleasant to have had to go through that entire spiral again to return.

106.Name: Dark Hallway
106.Description: As you descent the steeply sloping hole, the green glow suddenly vanishes. Your torch can barely make any light by the time you reach a flat surface, and a terrible fear is overwhelming you. You can barely see, but you make out that the area continues to the south.

107.Name: Dark Hallway
107.Description: As you enter this area, the light from your torches improves slightly, and you see that the area is littered with huge piles of bones of all types; human, animal, and monstrous. You wonder what creature would live down here. The only way to find out is to continue south.

108.Name: The Chamber of Bone
108.Description: As you enter this place, a complete fear grips your heart. A huge pile of bones is laid out here, and at the top lies something every mortal dreads to see; a dracolich, an undead dragon, the most fearsome beast, real or mythological ever to be forced into existance on Kaldana. You can do nothing now but stand and fight.

109.Name: Tunnel to the Ferry
109.Description: The craftsmanship apparent in this tunnel looks like nothing the Barbarians could have accomplished. Pale torches light the way up to the docks, and also back up the stairs to the village surface.

110.Name: Barbarian Village Docks
110.Description: A set of old wooden planks float out into the frigid waters of the northern ocean. Most of the Wastelands is a shear cliff that leads straight into the water and provides no place for any harbor. Here, someone tunneled into a soft part of the cliff and created this dock. You can see a swirling portal in front of you, you catch a glimpse of Captain Bones on the other side, what madness is this?

111.Name: bad room
111.Description: ooops.

112.Name: bad room
112.Description: ooops.

113.Name: bad room
113.Description: ooops.

114.Name: bad room
114.Description: ooops.

115.Name: Clearing through the trees
115.Description: You continue along the evil-feeling magic blasted area, until you reach a place where the trees begin to regain their domain, and indeed grow together so thick as to make further passage south impossible. You wonder what caused the brief lack of trees.

116.Name: Clearing through the trees
116.Description: You continue along the evil-feeling magic blasted area, until you reach a place where the trees begin to regain their domain, and indeed grow together so thick as to make further passage south impossible. You wonder what caused the brief lack of trees.

117.Name: Clearing through the trees
117.Description: You continue along the evil-feeling magic blasted area, until you reach a place where the trees begin to regain their domain, and indeed grow together so thick as to make further passage south impossible. You wonder what caused the brief lack of trees.

118.Description: You continue along the evil-feeling magic blasted area, until you reach a place where the trees begin to regain their domain, and indeed grow together so thick as to make further passage south impossible. You wonder what caused the brief lack of trees.

121.Name: Dromon's Cave
121.Description: You enter the chamber of the legendary Lycanthrope, Dromon. This may very well be suicide.. Is it worth it to antagonize the beast?

0.Name: Forgotten Forest Path
0.Description: It doesn't seem as though anyone has used this path in quite a long time as the forest has been allowed to flourish undisturbed. There's almost no sound from the wildlife of the forest here. It's almost eerie in a way.

1.Name: Forgotten Forest Path
1.Description: It doesn't seem as though anyone has used this path in quite a long time as the forest has been allowed to flourish undisturbed. There's almost no sound from the wildlife of the forest here. It's almost eerie in a way.

2.Name: The Sacrificial Altar
2.Description: You find what remains of a raised stone platform. You can see 18 distinct, thought quite small, holes surrounding the platform in a mysterious circle shape. What would happen if you placed the Jewels in the slots? Should you just leave and forget this place even existed?

3.Name: Forgotten Forest Path
3.Description: It doesn't seem as though anyone has used this path in quite a long time as the forest has been allowed to flourish undisturbed. There's almost no sound from the wildlife of the forest here. It's almost eerie in a way.

4.Name: Forgotten Forest Path
4.Description: It doesn't seem as though anyone has used this path in quite a long time as the forest has been allowed to flourish undisturbed. There's almost no sound from the wildlife of the forest here. It's almost eerie in a way.

0.Name: Black Marsh Entrance
0.Description: You walk through the murky swamp, and into the infamous Black Marsh. You've heard all sorts of stories about the beasts that reside within the place. You'd best be on your guard.

1.Name: The Black Marsh
1.Description: You walk through the murky slime of the Black Marsh. You are barely able to find places to stand to continue walking, and you see many creatures swiming through the water.

2.Name: The Black Marsh
2.Description: You walk through the murky slime of the Black Marsh. You are barely able to find places to stand to continue walking, and you see many creatures swiming through the water. To the north, you see a veritable forest of swamp trees, which you could make your way into from here.

3.Name: Swamp Tree Forest
3.Description: You enter the thick forest of swamp trees. It is actually not terribly unpleasant, as the trees give off an interesting, soothing odor. You could continue through the forest to the west.

4.Name: Swamp Tree Forest
4.Description: You walk through the large forest of swamp trees. The trees become more clustered here, and it is becoming difficult to make much progress. You could probably continue a bit to the west if you wished.

5.Name: Swamp Tree Forest
5.Description: You enter a part of the forest where a number of thick trees surround one particularly large one. The single tree is quite intriguing. Perhaps you should have a look.

6.Name: The Black Marsh
6.Description: You make your way through the northern part of Black Marsh. The ground is slightly more solid here than it was in other parts of the marsh, and you have a fairly easy time keeping level footing. You can see the large swamp tree forest to the east, but it's far too thick here for you to enter.

7.Name: The Black Marsh
7.Description: You make your way through the northern part of Black Marsh. The ground is slightly more solid here than it was in other parts of the marsh, and you have a fairly easy time keeping level footing.

8.Name: The Black Marsh
8.Description: You make your way through the northern part of Black Marsh. The ground is slightly more solid here than it was in other parts of the marsh, and you have a fairly easy time keeping level footing.

9.Name: The Black Marsh
9.Description: You struggle your way through a part of the marsh north of the snake pit. The area is quite unpleasant, and the swamp gases here make it difficult to breathe. You would be very happy to leave soon.

10.Name: The Black Marsh
10.Description: You struggle your way through a part of the marsh north of the snake pit. The area is quite unpleasant, and the swamp gases here make it difficult to breathe. You would be very happy to leave soon.

11.Name: The Snake Pit
11.Description: You continue making your way through the twisting snake pit. Many large snakes slither around your feet, and some take obviously aggressive action against you. It's obvious they don't want you in here.

12.Name: The Snake Pit
12.Description: You climb down the fallen rubble into the large pit. As you look around, you hear a disconcertingly large amount of hissing all around you. The snakes in this place done seem nearly as inclined to avoid you as in the rest of the swamp.

13.Name: The Black Marsh
13.Description: You make your way through the southern part of the Black Marsh. You can see a flowing body of water to the south and east, marking the way to the ocean.

14.Name: The Black Marsh
14.Description: You make your way through the southern part of the Black Marsh. You can see a flowing body of water to the south and east, marking the way to the ocean.

24.Description: You make your way through the southern part of the Black Marsh. You can see a flowing body of water to the south and east, marking the way to the ocean. To the north, you see what looks to be a fairly shallow wet area, which you could wade through to head north.

25.Name: The Black Marsh
25.Description: You make your way through the southern part of the Black Marsh. You can see a flowing body of water to the south and east, marking the way to the ocean.

26.Name: The Black Marsh
26.Description: You make your way through the southern part of the Black Marsh. You can see a flowing body of water to the south and east, marking the way to the ocean. To the west, a pile of stone rubble allows a way down into the large pit. Perhaps you could explore...

27.Name: The Black Marsh
27.Description: You make your way through the southern part of the Black Marsh. You can see a flowing body of water to the south and east, marking the way to the ocean. To the west, you see a large pit, but it is too deep for you to drop down here.

28.Name: The Black Marsh
28.Description: You struggle your way through a part of the marsh north of the snake pit. The area is quite unpleasant, and the swamp gases here make it difficult to breathe. You would be very happy to leave soon.

29.Name: bad room
29.Description: ooops.

30.Name: Wet Marsh
30.Description: You wade into the waist-deep pool of swamp water. It is an unpleasant sensation at best, but you see no other way of exploring farther north. You swallow your nervousness as various unidentified creatures swim around you, and continue on.

31.Description: ooops.

40.Name: Dry Land
40.Description: You climb out of the water and stand on a small patch of dry land. None of the water-bound creatures will come up here, so you could probably rest here safely.

41.Name: Wet Marsh
41.Description: You wade into the waist-deep pool of swamp water. It is an unpleasant sensation at best, but you see no other way of exploring farther north. You swallow your nervousness as various unidentified creatures swim around you, and continue on.

43.Name: The Black Marsh
43.Description: You make your way through the northern part of Black Marsh. The ground is slightly more solid here than it was in other parts of the marsh, and you have a fairly easy time keeping level footing. To the west, you are almost certain that you hear the sounds of civilization.

44.Name: Lizardman Village
44.Description: You proceed farther into the swamp, and to your surprise, there is a small settlement of lizardmen here in the marsh. To the west, you see a number of small huts.

45.Name: Lizardman Village
45.Description: You proceed farther into the swamp, and to your surprise, there is a small settlement of lizardmen here in the marsh. You can see a crude stone temple to the west.

46.Name: Lizardman Temple
46.Description: You walk into a small stone temple that the lizardmen use to worship one of their gods. The temple is fairly well made, and was probably not constructed by the current inhabitants.

47.Name: Lizardman Huts
47.Description: You are walking in and among the few huts that the lizardmen live in. Most of them shy away from you, but a few approach, seemingly willing to speak if you don't kill them on sight.

48.Name: Lizardman Huts

49.Name: Lizardman Village
49.Description: You are standing in the middle of the lizardman village. The occupants are eyeing your nervously, not sure whether you're an enemy or an ally. To the south you see a temple, to the west lie the lizardmen's huts, and to the north is what looks like the hut of the village chief.

50.Name: Lizardman Chief's Hut
50.Description: You are in the hut of the lizardman chief. It is sparsely decorated, with many animal hides and other trophies. There's even a strange, but comfortable looking bed.

51.Name: The Snake Pit
51.Description: You continue making your way through the twisting snake pit. Many large snakes slither around your feet, and some take obviously aggressive action against you. It's obvious they don't want you in here.

52.Name: The Snake Pit

It's obvious they don't want you in here. Nearby, you can see a large hold leading down into the ground. You could climb down it if you wished.

53.Name: Under the Snake Pit
53.Description: You are wandering underneath the large snake pit. The hissing is terribly loud down here, and the sound of angry reptiles is omnipresent. You don't particularly look forward to continuing down this tunnel.

68.Description: You squeeze your way through the wall. The smell of swamp gas fills your nose as you realize you're going over a major vent. Most of the snakes seem to be staying out of here.

4.Description: Thick slabs of stone are placed here, creating an area elevated above the fog. Here a stone able lies, with an old Altar to Aran near it. Obviously this is where the burial ceremonies were conducted, but it seems none of that has happened in quite some time.

5.Name: In the Graveyard
5.Description: You stand before a rather large tomb, looking to be much more recently constructed than most here.

6.Name: In the Tomb
6.Description: The lid to the tomb's coffin lies on the floor, and the coffin is empty. You suddenly get a very foreboding feeling from the cold fog swirling around. Like the other tombs, there is a stone staircase leading down to the depths.

7.Name: In the Graveyard
7.Description: The swampy ground gives way to the smooth brown rock of the ocean cliffs to the south. The fog literally seems to pouring over the cliffs onto the ground here.

8.Name: An Ocean Cliff
8.Description: The swampy ground gives way to rock which makes the top of a reasonablly sized cliff. Below the cliff is the blue water of the Asadric Sea.

9.Name: Before a Tomb
9.Description: The swampy ground is partially obscured by a cold fog that is blowing in from the ocean cliffs far to the south. To the west is a cold looking stone tomb, housing the remains of one of the more wealthy Myronmet citizens no doubting.

10.Name: Graveyard Entrance
10.Description: The swampy ground is partially obscured by a cold fog that is blowing in from the ocean cliffs far to the south.

11.Name: A Tomb
11.Description: The interior of the tomb is dark and cold. The ocean fog is thicker here, making it dangerous to walk around. In the corner, behind an old wooden coffin, is a small stone staircase leading to the lower parts of the tomb.

44.Description: You wonder why you would ever want to roam around the basement of someone's tomb. The cold fog makes it hard to see, much less to concentrate on the eerie sounds coming from down the dark passage.

45.Name: Beneath the Graveyard
45.Description: The fog down here chills you to the bone. The cold stone walls that line the chambers beneath the tomb to not make you feel any better about where you are. What's worse, you hear the scratching of bone against stone...

There is a huge stone coffin in the middle of the room here, with the engraving "Relrarth ne`tua ckmmon -- Sessenia Aurdock". The inscription is definitly not in the language that you know...

57.Name: Dungeon Entrance
57.Description: The iron gate you passed through is behind you, but all around you now is what you can only describe as a decorous dungeon.  Whether left over from the lawless time before the New Gods or simply a craft of evil, the stench of death invades your nostrils.

59.Name: Before the Tunnel
59.Description: Before you is a hallway extending from the unpleasantness into seeming opulence.  Midnight blue carpetting adorns the floor, and strange candles light your path.  A magical presence comes from ahead and you get the feeling that once you venture too far, you will never be able to return.

67.Name: Boding Hallway
67.Description: Wow this guy must really have been something!  Obviously a necromancer of some kind... \cf6 "A dark wave erupted from my staff, and before it reached Sedgeway, he slit the throats of my wife and child.  He collapsed immediately afterward, and his body began to quickly decompose.  I was innured to this and focused on the battle around me, for indeed, men surrounded me from either side.  Never again would those men underestimate the power of the the East."\cf2

68.Name: bad room
68.Description: ooops.

69.Name: Boding Hallway
69.Description: It's getting intense now... You are gripped by the story. \cf6 "There were seventeen foes before me.  I spun my staff in a wide arc and smote the two before me.  As the rest charged me, I quickly incanted, and the two dead rose to greet the onslaught.  I vaulted into the air and levitated above the horde.  I cast such spells as to give my resurrected champions strength unimaginable."\cf2

70.Name: Boding Hallway
70.Description: Who could equal such power?  The writing continues with it's auditory and visual power- \cf6 "As my ghouls ripped my assailants apart, my staff also rained contagion upon their mortal bodies until none were left.  I removed the souls of the two men i had animated, and turned to Sedgeway.  His fate would be inutterable.  Had I just a Monk of Light with me from my Homeland, my family would have been salvagable... but THIS MAN had slaughtered them and deterred aid until their bodies had already lost the spark of Life."\cf2

71.Name: Boding Hallway
71.Description: Further reading... wow he's making you work for whatever is at the end... \cf6 "As my initial spell took hold of Sedgeway, he stiffened and groaned.  I had given him the immense power he desired, and all the riches he could want.  He had died, and his soul had departed.  His mind was still stuck in a shell of everlasting power and everlasting agony.  The only way for him to be released is..."\cf2

72.Name: Boding Hallway
72.Description: OH the suspense!  \cf6 "He must encounter a judge knowledgeable in the events of his misconduct, and then must repent his wrongs.  The judge may then release him from his cursed life." \cf2

73.Name: Boding Hallway
73.Description: This is the last inscription:  \cf6 "So now, as I shut the once-man of evil in his crypt, I know that I shall find a way back across the sea, never to return to this cursed land.  May the barbarous people here never find us, nor discover our secrets before they are ready.  I, Yoshen Zi-Shinouken, now take my leave." \cf2  There is a cryptic symbol you do not understand, and a few characters, ostensibly his signature.

74.Name: Boding Hallway
74.Description: As you reflect upon Yoshen's statements, you ponder... what then, lies ahead of me?  For some reason you think that in front of you lies something that you did not expect.

75.Name: Hallway Entrance
75.Description: Inscriptions line the walls of the carpetted walkway.  This particular one reads...  \cf6 "Once ye venture forward into the realms of the Deceased, thy soul shalt be afforded no ward against the evils within.  Know that thy fate shall be decided by thy knowledge of my inscriptions." \cf2    ...  I'd turn back if i were you.

76.Name: Boding Hallway
76.Description: Frantically you dust off the walls, searching for more text, since you know you will die unless you read it.  \cf6 "You have irrevocably stepped into a path you must complete or die in the attempt.  No succour shall be given to thee!  I, Yoshen Zi-Shinouken will tell you the tale of my kindred."\cf2

77.Name: bad room
77.Description: ooops.

78.Name: Boding Hallway
78.Description: In a continuation of what you saw in the last room, the neat text resumes:  \cf6 "I sailed across the sea only due to the favor of the Wind, who feels all.  The voyage was easy.  Many of my people had died in the rough seas which are infested with pirates and other unknown creatures in the depths.  At last i landed in a place I heard called by the primitive inhabitants as "Myr-den Hamen."\cf2

79.Name: Boding Hallway
79.Description: The next inscription reads:  \cf6 "I came from the Unknown Lands to the East, my family and I, purely on accident.  I had heard rumors of a land beyond the Great Sea, but never sought them until one day..." \cf2  Here the inscription trails off.

80.Name: Boding Hallway
80.Description: A sound like rolling thunder begins as the inscriptions you read flame up.  Yet somehow, you are unafraid and instead fill with righteous anger...  \cf6 "SEDGEWAY!  I vowed on the graves of my ancestors that I would end him.  I walked onto the street and Sedgeway, framed in torchlight, commanded me to give up all of my ancestral possessions to him.  He sounded more compelling with his knife at my wife's neck."\cf2

81.Name: Boding Hallway
81.Description: Almost unbothered by your previous trials, you read on with interest:  \cf6 "I was greeted by a man called 'Sedgeway'.  He seemed advanced and cunning for the primitives I saw around him.  His ways were nothing like those of my Homeland.  We have great warriors and men of cunning, but none whose minds run free like the wild beast.  He lacked the topknot of the Restrained Fist or the long tresses of the Ancestral Animators which I personally possessed."\cf2

82.Name: bad room
82.Description: ooops.

83.Name: Boding Hallway
83.Description: It continues- \cf6 "The Ancestral Animators do not give up their secrets to the unworthy, no matter the cost.  Though we deal with the dead, we do not serve Evil.  Rather, I contorted with fury, grasped my ancient scepter from my side and raised it with two hands... \cf9 Watashi wa yuumei o negawanai! Mou Benedictum-domo ni wa nanimo tanomu-mai!!\cf6 "\cf2

84.Name: Boding Hallway
84.Description: The inscription: \cf6 "I had dinner with him and his family.  His wife was a native, and i was now growing more certain that he was not.  I coddled his child on my knee, and after dinner, took him out and showed him the ways of the blade in accordance with the customs of my People.  He showed great aptitude, and I have him my Sword of Diamond as a result."\cf2

85.Name: Boding Hallway
85.Description: The hall grows dimmer and you have more difficulty making out the next inscription...  \cf6 "In retrospect, Sedgeway must have had his eyes the whole time upon my riches.  My family and I were staying at an inn with a depiction of a serpent; the inn was new and the proprietor, Hervan, was eager to have foreigners test out his beds.  I woke up in the middle of the night and heard muffled screams.  My wife and child were gone."\cf2

17.Name: The Cave
17.Description: The only light in the cave comes from the enterance.  The bodies of former adventurers and animals which happened to venture into the cave unwittingly.

18.Name: The bottom of the Cave
18.Description: This cave is covered with bones and tattered flesh.  Piles of refuse make a horrid stench that causes you to want to climb back up to the surface to get a breath of fresh air. A recently opened hole leads north to a new portion of the beast cave.

21.Name: A strange path in the swamp
21.Description: A small pile of wood and other military supplies are here. The soldiers of Myronmet have decided to build a small fort here to prevent the lizards from the castle to the north from invading the city.

22.Name: A strange path in the swamp
22.Description: A strange path has formed in the swamp here. It seems that many a foot has trodden this ground. Who's foot is the question, however.

23.Name: A strange path in the swamp

24.Name: The Lizardman Castle Gate
24.Description: You stand before a strange structure which seems to protrude out of nowhere.  The building towers above the swamp but was hidden due to the huge trees in the swamp.  The great stones are adorned with strange runes depicting a strange and horrible reptilian god of some sort.

25.Name: Inside the Lizardman Castle
25.Description: The gate to the lizardman keep is open here, giving you full view of the keep itself.  Two large towers made of stone lie on either side of the main portion of the castle, and reptilian figures can be seen hulking about atop them.

26.Name: Inside the Lizardman Castle
26.Description: The keep of the lizardmen is covered with bones and pelts of various animals the lizardmen must have killed in the Plains of Torin.

27.Name: On top of the Right Tower
27.Description: From the top of the tower here, you can see the Myronmet Swamp stretching away from here, as well as the city of Myronmet to the south east.

33.Description: You stand before the throne of the lizardman king and queen.  The throne itself is made of the purest gold and looks to be much too heavy for even a great many people to carry off. A recently opened passage leads down a dimly light stone cooridor to the west of the throne room.

69.Name: An Old Iron Gate
69.Description: Before you stands a rusty iron gate, which is swinging half opened on ancient bronze hinges. Through the gate is a gray fog, and under the fog you can make out various stone tombs and gravestones. The ground here is firmly paced rock. A nearly indecipherable sign to the right of the gate reads "Myronmet Graveyard".

73.Description: The room smells of stale air, because the lizards of the castle here have had it sealed off until just recently. The Lizardman King has deemed the evil coming from below to be too great to contain any longer, and as such has started to recruit adventurers from Myronmet to help explore the depths in order to quell the evils coming from below.
